0da180b0.title: Solution Architect
0da180b0.description:
**Company Description**
Join the leader in global work. Vialto helps leading organizations identify, develop, and execute their workforce priorities with confidence. Our practice areas include global tax, immigration, rewards, advisory and Vialto private and our team is the gold standard in navigating the complexities of cross-border compliance, and workforce strategies. We look for people our clients and assignees can count on to thoughtfully deliver clear solutions to complex problems.
  
  
To be the best in the business, we cultivate a dynamic, highly collaborative culture that fuels the growth of our people. We invite you to inquire boldly, learn deeply, and grow endlessly with us. You’ll work alongside recognized experts, shaping people-first, technology-driven solutions that drive the future of work. We help our clients achieve their goals and imagine new possibilities. And we can do the same for you. Whatever your aspirations, Vialto can help you find your way.
  
  
**Job Description**
We are hiring a hands-on Solutions Architect to design, build, and operate complex, regulated, global solutions across payroll, tax, and immigration domains. This role is technical-first: you will own the end-to-end architecture for a product or suite of products and contribute directly to implementation (spikes, reference services, critical-path features), while partnering with a global, cross-functional team to drive delivery, deployments, and production support across time zones. You will also lead the adoption of AI-powered development practices—including spec-driven development and agentic coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex)—and design AI-enabled solutions using Azure OpenAI APIs and intelligent agents to automate business process flows.
  
  
**What You’ll Do (Hands-On)**

* Architecture + Build: Produce architecture designs and implement key components (reference implementations, platform libraries, integration adapters, critical workflows).
* Distributed Systems: Design and build event-driven services (messaging, async workflows, idempotency, retries, backpressure, eventual consistency), including well-defined event contracts and versioning strategies.
* Azure Solution Design: Build using Azure PaaS services and patterns (identity, networking, storage, messaging, API management, monitoring), with practical tradeoffs across cost, scalability, resilience, and latency. Design and integrate AI capabilities using Azure OpenAI APIs (GPT, embeddings, assistants) to enable intelligent features and agent-driven automation within business process flows.
* Front-End Architecture: Architect and ship large Next.js/React applications (routing, state strategy, data-fetching patterns, performance, accessibility, modularization, micro-frontend considerations where relevant).
* Integration Architecture: Define secure integration patterns (REST and event-based), build connectors/adapters, and establish operational runbooks for partner/client integrations.
* Security by Design: Implement secure SDLC practices—threat modeling, secrets management, encryption, least-privilege access, audit logging, and secure defaults aligned to regulated environments.
* Authentication & Authorization: Implement end-to-end authn/authz using OAuth2/OIDC, SSO, and token-based access. Design RBAC/ABAC/ReBAC, tenant-aware authorization, API scopes/claims, and service-to-service identity (e.g., managed identities).
* Operational Readiness: Own observability and reliability patterns (structured logging, metrics, tracing, SLOs, alerting, incident response) and participate in troubleshooting production issues.
* Documentation that Ships: Create actionable architecture artifacts (ADRs, sequence diagrams, domain flows, deployment diagrams, runbooks) that teams can execute against.
* AI Agent Design; Process Automation: Design, build, and deploy AI agents that automate business process flows—using Azure OpenAI APIs, function calling, orchestration frameworks, and RAG pipelines—with appropriate guardrails, evaluation, and human-in-the-loop controls for regulated environments.
* Technical Leadership: Drive peer architecture/code reviews, coach engineers, and raise engineering standards across onshore/offshore teams. Lead and mentor teams in agentic development practices—spec-driven workflows, AI-assisted coding (Claude Code, Codex), and automated test/review generation—to accelerate delivery velocity while maintaining quality and governance.

**Patterns We Expect You to Use**

* Event-based systems (pub/sub, workflow orchestration, event sourcing where appropriate)
* Distributed systems (partitioning, resiliency, failure-mode design, consistency tradeoffs)
* Domain-driven integration approaches (bounded contexts, contracts, anti-corruption layers)
* Agentic AI patterns including plan/execute/verify loops, tool/function calling, RAG, verifier/critic steps, guardrails, evaluation, and agent observability/auditability. Experience applying these patterns to automate business process flows using Azure OpenAI APIs and orchestration frameworks.

**AI-Enabled Delivery Expectations**

* Experience working in environments using AI for development, build, and operations (coding assistants such as Claude Code and Codex, automated PR reviews, test generation, incident support).
* Comfortable using a spec-driven AI development workflow: translating requirements into structured specs, acceptance criteria, diagrams, and prompts that accelerate delivery while maintaining governance. Ability to lead teams in adopting agentic development practices—spec-driven development, AI-assisted coding, and agent-based automation—as standard ways of working.

**Required Qualifications**

* 10+ years in software engineering, including 3+ years in architecture/solution design (or equivalent scope).
* Proven experience designing and operating solutions in a regulated global environment (privacy, auditability, security controls, cross-border considerations).
* Strong Azure experience designing and building cloud-native solutions using Microsoft PaaS and frameworks, including Azure OpenAI APIs for AI-enabled features and agent-based automation.
* Strong experience architecting Next.js and/or React applications at scale.
* Demonstrated experience with event-driven and distributed system design and production operations.
* Hands-on experience with agentic development tools and practices (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, spec-driven development) and a track record of leading engineering teams in AI-assisted delivery workflows.
* Strong communication skills: can explain tradeoffs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with enterprise integrations (HRIS, payroll providers, finance systems) and/or iPaaS patterns.
* Strong testing and automation mindset (TDD/BDD, CI/CD quality gates).
* Experience with data modeling, SQL, and reporting/analytics.
* Microsoft certifications (Azure Solutions Architect or similar) a plus.
* Experience designing AI agents to automate business process flows (e.g., using Azure OpenAI Assistants API, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or similar orchestration frameworks).
* Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree preferred.

**Additional Information**

* This job is based in our Bangalore office, with the possibility of a hybrid work mode
* We are an equal opportunity employer that does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected status
* Please note that AI is used as part of the application process

* Lead development teams, conduct code reviews, enforce best practices, and drive technical governance.

* Leverage ServiceNow AI capabilities, automation, and Performance Analytics to improve operational efficiency and business outcomes.

* ServiceNow SOM/SOMT, TSM, TNI, ITSM, CSM, FSM, CMDB/CSDM, integrations
* Telecom OSS/BSS integration experience.
* Performance Analytics, Now Assist, AI Agents, and Agentic AI solutions.
* Strong communication, workshop facilitation, stakeholder management, and team leadership skills.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* College degree in a related technology field (Computer Science, Engineering, etc.) or equivalent experience
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA).
* Minimum two (2) ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) certifications.
* 8+ years of ServiceNow experience, including architecture, development, and integration delivery.
* Strong hands-on scripting experience in JavaScript, Glide APIs, Business Rules, Script Includes, Flow Designer, and IntegrationHub.
* Proven experience in telecom order management, order orchestration, fulfillment, and Lead-to-Cash processes.

* Experience with tools like JIRA, ServiceNow Agile, or equivalent for backlog management
* Exposure to ServiceNow upgrades, platform governance, and release management
* Experience in stakeholder management and client-facing roles
* Knowledge of ServiceNow’s latest features and roadmap

**What We Look For**

* A team player and Leader with strong technical acumen and leadership capabilities
* Proactive problem-solving mindset with a focus on operational excellence
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Passion to learn and adapt to new technologies

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start-ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work on inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. You’ll quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging assignments and be part of a collaborative environment focused on quality and innovation.
  
  
Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching, and feedback from experienced professionals
* Opportunities to develop new skills and grow your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

cb5ec1da.title: Customer Success Technical Architect
cb5ec1da.description:
**Introduction**
At IBM Global Sales, we bring together innovation, collaboration, and expertise to help clients solve their most complex business challenges. Working across industries and geographies, you'll partner with colleagues, clients, and partners to co-create solutions that drive digital transformation and lasting impact.Success in Global Sales is built on curiosity, empathy, and collaboration. You'll connect technical understanding with strong people skills, building trusted relationships and shaping solutions that improve business and society. With world-class onboarding, continuous learning, and a supportive culture, IBM offers the tools and opportunities to grow your career. Join us and be part of a global team that's passionate about driving innovation and making a difference.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
As a Customer Success Technical Architect (CSTA), you will be a trusted technical advisor to Confluent (an IBM Company) customers after they adopt our platform. You will help customers achieve measurable value from their Confluent investments by improving technical health, accelerating adoption, guiding best-practice decisions, and proactively managing risks across their streaming environments.
  
  
You will work as part of the broader customer account team and partner closely with Customer Success, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Professional Services, Support, Product, and Engineering. The role combines technical depth, customer leadership, structured execution, and the ability to translate complex architecture and operational topics into clear business outcomes.
  
  
What you will do
  
  

* Own customer-facing technical execution for a portfolio of strategic customers, aligning activity to customer goals, adoption plans, and desired business outcomes.
* Build trusted-advisor relationships with technical and business stakeholders, from practitioners and architects to senior leaders.
* Provide proactive guidance on Confluent and Apache Kafka architecture, workload optimization, operational practices, upgrades, reliability, security, governance, and adoption.
* Maintain a regular customer operating rhythm via office hours, quarterly reviews, health checks, roadmap alignment, and enablement.
* Assess technical health, identify adoption blockers and emerging risks, and create clear action plans with owners, milestones, and follow-through.
* Coordinate with Support and other Confluent and IBM teams on escalations, ensuring the customer has a clear path forward and that remediation actions are tracked to completion.
* Help customers prepare for critical events such as upgrades, major launches, architecture changes, and production growth.
* Educate customer teams on Confluent capabilities, recommended practices, and relevant product developments.
* Bring customer feedback and product insights back to Confluent, helping improve the customer experience and inform product direction.
* Contribute to the CSTA practice by sharing technical knowledge, reusable guidance, playbooks, and lessons learned.

**Preferred Education**
Bachelor's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field, or comparable practical background.
* 5+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical role such as Customer Success Architect, Technical Account Manager, Solutions Architect, Support Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer, or equivalent.
* Ability to discuss application architecture, APIs, networking, security, observability, data integration, and production operations with technical stakeholders.
* Hands on knowledge of one or more key cloud vendors (AWS, GCP and Azure)
* Solid understanding of cloud networking and security technologies (e.g. VPC, Private Link, Private Service Connect, TLS/SSL, SASL, Kerberos, etc.)
* Experience prototyping and analyzing code for client solutions in multiple languages (e.g. Java, Python, Go, etc.)
* Experience with Java Virtual Machine (JVM) tuning and troubleshooting
* Experience with operating Linux, you know how to configure, tune and troubleshoot both RedHat & Debian based distributions
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to lead structured conversations with both technical teams and executives.
* Ability to manage multiple customer priorities, create clarity in ambiguous situations, and drive actions to completion.
* A proactive, consultative mindset focused on preventing issues and creating customer value rather than only reacting to incidents.
* Willingness to continue learning in a rapidly evolving technical domain and to share knowledge with peers.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Experience helping customers build distributed systems or streaming solutions that use Apache Kafka alongside technologies such as Spark, Flink, Hadoop, Cassandra, etc
* Experience with Apache Kafka & Apache Flink
* Confluent or Apache Kafka certification
* Experience working with global customers

4bc6de7d.title: IT Solutions Consultant
4bc6de7d.description:
**Technical Consultant – API Management Platform Resiliency**
With a global team of 5600+ IT professionals, DHL IT Services connects people and keeps the global economy running by continuously innovating and creating sustainable digital solutions. We work beyond global borders and push boundaries across all dimensions of logistics. You can leave your mark shaping the technology backbone of the biggest logistics company in the world. Our offices have earned #GreatPlaceToWork certification, reflecting our commitment to exceptional employee experiences.
  
  
**No AI Without API. Digitalization. Simply delivered.**
Join us at DHL Group Digital Platforms department, where innovation thrives and technology evolves. With a presence across three countries and two continents, we are building a One Stop Shop for all DHL Group APIs and AI-enabled services. Our startup spirit within a stable enterprise environment enables us to deliver secure, scalable, and modern platforms powered by Agile and DevSecOps practices.
  
  
**About The Role**
Join the API Management Platform (AMP) Resiliency team and strengthen the availability, recoverability, scalability and operational resilience of enterprise API services. The role assesses platform risks, defines resilience standards and recovery requirements, and drives improvement initiatives across cloud and on-premises environments.
  
  
The position requires knowledge of both Apigee X, Apigee Hybrid or another enterprise API gateway to support the resilience of our API management platforms. You will work across DevOps, network, cloud, security and infrastructure teams to improve disaster recovery, business continuity, service readiness and operational controls.
  
  
**#DHL #DHLITServices #GreatPlace #digitalplatforms #APIPlatform #Resiliency #Cloud**
**Grow together**
**Your role as Technical Consultant - AMP Resiliency:**

* Coordinate platform resilience assessments, technical risk reviews and improvement roadmaps.
* Assess platform architecture for single points of failure, capacity constraints, service-dependency risks and recovery limitations.
* Define platform resilience, disaster recovery, business continuity and operational-readiness requirements.
* Identify critical service dependencies and support the definition and validation of recovery objectives.
* Plan, coordinate and govern disaster recovery, failover and recovery-readiness exercises; validate evidence, document outcomes, identify gaps and drive corrective actions to closure.
* Define and maintain resilience standards, runbooks, support procedures and service-readiness documentation.
* Establish minimum resilience and operational-readiness criteria for platform services.
* Work with DevOps, network, cloud, security and infrastructure teams to address availability, capacity, connectivity and recovery risks.
* Define and review monitoring, logging, alerting, dashboarding, observability and service-health reporting requirements.
* Assess the resilience and operational impact of vulnerabilities, BitSight findings, security findings and control gaps; coordinate remediation plans and monitor actions through closure.
* Support incident reviews and root-cause analysis, converting lessons learned into preventive improvements.
* Review platform changes, upgrades and architecture decisions for their impact on availability, recoverability and operational readiness.
* Report material risks, unresolved gaps, dependencies and remediation progress to relevant stakeholders.
* Promote consistent resilience practices across API gateway technologies and hosting models.
* Participate in major-incident escalation and the on-call support rotation when required, providing resilience, recovery and cross-team coordination expertise.

**Ready to embark on the journey? Here's what we are looking for:**

* Demonstrated experience in platform operations, infrastructure consulting, service reliability, SRE, disaster recovery or enterprise API platform support.
* Practical knowledge of both Apigee X and Apigee Hybrid.
* Strong knowledge of cloud and on-premises infrastructure.
* Knowledge of high availability, disaster recovery, business continuity, failover, capacity management and operational risk.
* Experience assessing technical architectures for resilience, recoverability and operational-readiness risks.
* Experience planning or governing disaster recovery and recovery-readiness exercises.
* Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, dashboards, observability and service-health reporting.
* Understanding of networking, connectivity, certificates, security controls and platform dependencies.
* Experience with incident management, problem management and root-cause analysis.
* Ability to define technical standards, produce clear assessments and drive cross-team remediation activities.
* Strong communication, facilitation, stakeholder-management and technical-consulting skills.
* Willingness and ability to participate in major-incident escalation and the on-call support rotation when required.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with SRE practices, Kubernetes, infrastructure automation or cloud platforms.
* Experience supporting security and compliance remediation in an enterprise environment.
* Knowledge of GCP and API platform network-connectivity patterns.
* Working knowledge of infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD, Kubernetes and automation concepts.

**An array of benefits for you:**

* Hybrid work arrangements to balance in-office collaboration and home flexibility.
* Annual Leave: 42 days off apart from Public / National Holidays.
* Medical Insurance: Self + Spouse + 2 children. An option to opt for Voluntary Parental Insurance (Parents / Parent -in-laws) at a nominal premium covering pre-existing disease.
* In House training programs: professional and technical training certifications.

123d3e6c.description:
**Req ID:**
387019
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Cloud Solution Delivery Sr Advisor to join our team in Pune, Mahārāshtra (IN-MH), India (IN).
  
  
Position/Job Title:
  
  
**ServiceNow Architech**
Organisation /Function:
  
  
Banking and Insurance
  
  
Minimum Experience:
  
  
12+ years
  
  
Language Requirement:
  
  
Fluent English
  
  
Role Overview:
  
  
We are seeking a highly skilled ServiceNow Architech to join a long-term client engagement within the banking and insurance sector. The successful candidate will design, develop, configure, upgrade, and support secure, scalable ServiceNow solutions across multiple modules.
  
  
This role requires deep technical ServiceNow expertise, experience working in regulated financial-services environments, and the ability to collaborate effectively with architects, business analysts, platform owners, security teams, and delivery teams.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Design, develop, configure, test, deploy, and support ServiceNow solutions in line with business and technical requirements.
* Deliver enhancements and integrations across ServiceNow ITSM, ITOM, GRC, SAM, and Vulnerability Response capabilities.
* Develop and maintain ServiceNow components, including business rules, client scripts, UI policies, script includes, workflows, Flow Designer flows, notifications, service catalog items, record producers, UI actions, and scheduled jobs.
* Build and support integrations using REST and SOAP APIs, IntegrationHub, MID Servers, web services, and other approved integration methods.
* Configure and maintain ITSM processes, including Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Knowledge, Service Catalog, and CMDB-related capabilities.
* Support ITOM implementations and enhancements, including Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, CMDB health, and operational visibility.
* Develop and support Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) solutions, including risk management, policy and compliance, audit, and issue management workflows.
* Support Software Asset Management (SAM) processes, data quality, licence compliance, and optimisation activities.
* Configure and enhance Vulnerability Response (VR) workflows, integrations, prioritisation, remediation tracking, and reporting.
* Plan and execute ServiceNow platform upgrades, including upgrade impact assessment, customisation review, regression testing, remediation, and post-upgrade validation.
* Ensure solutions follow ServiceNow best practices, coding standards, platform governance, security requirements, and maintainability principles.
* Conduct technical analysis, troubleshoot complex platform issues, and provide root-cause analysis for production defects.
* Participate in code reviews, peer reviews, technical design discussions, and quality assurance activities.
* Collaborate with business analysts and stakeholders to translate functional requirements into scalable technical designs.
* Produce and maintain technical documentation, including solution designs, configuration documents, interface specifications, and deployment runbooks.
* Provide technical mentoring and guidance to junior developers and other delivery team members.

**Competencies/Critical Skills:**

* Minimum 10 years of hands-on ServiceNow development experience.
* Strong practical experience with ServiceNow ITSM.
* Valid ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification.
* Valid ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) certification.
* At least one valid ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) certification including CIS- ITSM.
* Strong experience with ServiceNow ITOM, including relevant capabilities such as Discovery, Event Management, Service Mapping, CMDB, and MID Server configuration.
* Experience with ServiceNow GRC / Integrated Risk Management (IRM).
* Experience with ServiceNow Software Asset Management (SAM).
* Experience with ServiceNow Vulnerability Response (VR).
* Proven experience planning, executing, and supporting ServiceNow upgrades.
* Strong JavaScript development skills within the ServiceNow platform.
* Experience with ServiceNow client-side and server-side scripting, Flow Designer, Workflow, Service Catalog, portal experiences, and platform configuration.
* Experience building and maintaining integrations using REST APIs, SOAP APIs, IntegrationHub, and MID Servers.
* Strong understanding of CMDB concepts, data quality, configuration item relationships, and Common Service Data Model (CSDM) principles.
* Fluent English, with strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with technical and business stakeholders.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience working in the banking, insurance, financial services, or another highly regulated environment.
* Additional ServiceNow certifications in ITSM, ITOM, GRC/IRM, SAM, Vulnerability Response, or Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) credentials.
* Knowledge of ITIL practices and enterprise IT service management processes.
* Experience with ServiceNow Agile Development, DevOps practices, source control, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing.
* Familiarity with security, data privacy, operational resilience, regulatory compliance, audit, and risk-management requirements in financial services.
* Experience with ServiceNow Performance Analytics, reporting, dashboards, and data imports.

**Personal Attributes:**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Detail-oriented, quality-focused, and committed to secure, maintainable platform development.
* Comfortable working in a complex, enterprise-scale environment with multiple stakeholders.
* Proactive in identifying technical risks, upgrade impacts, and improvement opportunities.
* Effective mentor and collaborative team player.

**About NTT DATA**
NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in R&D.
  
  
Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. **Senior Program Manager**
to lead complex, cross-functional technology programs within the Corporate Applications Technology business unit under Global Engineering, specifically driving the
**ServiceNow platform**
capabilities. This role will be responsible for driving strategic program planning, execution governance, stakeholder alignment, risk management, and delivery outcomes across multiple teams and initiatives within the ServiceNow capability.

* Stakeholder management and expectation setting
* Decision making and problem solving

9384d102.title: Senior Technical Account Manager
9384d102.description:
**Location:**
Bengaluru (Work from Office)
  
  
**Experience:**
8–10 years
  
  
**Reports to:**
Head of Customer Success
  
  
**About Mojro**
At Mojro, we don’t just optimize logistics – we reimagine it. We are a deep-tech logistics optimization company helping some of the world’s largest FMCG, Paints, CEP and Retail enterprises simplify complex logistics challenges. Our platforms – PlanWyse (route and load optimization) and ExecuteWyse (real-time execution monitoring) – reduce transportation costs, raise service levels and power smarter, faster decisions for customers such as Unilever, Asian Paints, Berger and Godrej.
  
  
**The role**
You will own the technical success of a portfolio of enterprise accounts, from first kickoff to steady-state operations. You design and deliver the implementation, own the integrations, take customers live, and remain their primary technical authority after go-live. You are also the person who can explain
*why*
the optimization engine produced a given plan – and what to change when the plan isn’t right.
  
  
This role suits someone who has implemented a complex, decision-heavy SaaS product – a TMS or routing platform, or a supply chain planning, inventory or scheduling tool – and wants end-to-end ownership rather than a single slice of the lifecycle. You will also lead Mojro’s Customer Success Engineering (CSE) team. This is a hands-on leadership role: you remain the team’s strongest troubleshooter, not only its manager.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Implementation and solution design
* Lead implementations end to end: discovery, scoping, solution design, configuration, integration, testing and go-live.
* Author and own SOWs, Functional and Technical Design Documents (FDD/TDD), workflow diagrams and architecture specifications.
* Translate customer business rules – fleet, time windows, capacities, service levels, costs – into a working solution configuration.
* Integrations and technical delivery
* Own integrations with customer ERP, WMS, OMS and other systems via API, webhook and FTP/SFTP.
* Perform data mapping, environment setup and interface validation.
* Debug issues hands-on using SQL, Postman, logs and browser developer tools.
* UAT and go-live
* Plan and run User Acceptance Testing with customers; drive defect triage with Product and Engineering to closure.
* Prepare go-live plans, risk assessments, cutover checklists and hypercare.
* Technical account ownership after go-live
* Act as the primary technical contact for live accounts, alongside the Customer Success Manager.
* Run proactive technical health checks, usage reviews and periodic technical reviews with customer teams.
* Resolve complex product and integration issues, involving L3 Engineering only when needed.
* Identify technical expansion opportunities and support CS on renewals, upsells and cross-sells.
* Optimization and plan quality
* Diagnose plan-quality issues: unassigned orders, capacity or time-window violations, cost or utilization outliers.
* Tune constraints and parameters with customers, and explain trade-offs in business terms.
* Feed patterns back to Product to improve the engine and its defaults.
* Product feedback
* Surface product gaps, missing APIs and enhancement needs from implementations and live accounts.
* Work with Product and Engineering to define requirements and support prioritization.
* Leadership and team enablement
* Lead and manage the CSE team: hiring, goals, performance reviews and development.
* Act as the team’s technical escalation point, stepping in personally on the hardest integration and production issues.
* Review solution designs and integration approaches before every go-live.
* Prioritize technical issues across concurrent implementations and allocate the team accordingly.
* Mentor engineers on integration debugging, troubleshooting, documentation and customer communication.
* Own the team’s implementation standards, deployment templates, playbooks and knowledge-base content.
* Support Sales and Pre-Sales with technical scoping and feasibility for complex deals.

**What You Bring**
**Must have**

* 8–10 years in B2B SaaS implementation, technical account management, customer success engineering or solutions consulting for a complex enterprise product.
* Background in either: (a) logistics, TMS, routing or visibility platforms; or (b) optimization or planning software – supply chain planning, inventory, demand, scheduling or similar.
* Experience leading a team of engineers or consultants while staying hands-on yourself.
* Hands-on SQL, REST APIs, Postman and log interpretation; you still debug integrations yourself.
* Proven experience writing SOWs, FDDs/TDDs and workflow or architecture documentation.
* Experience owning customer accounts after go-live, not only through implementation.
* Ability to run several enterprise projects at once with strong project discipline.
* Clear communication with both customer IT and operations or business stakeholders.

**Good to have**

* Exposure to optimization concepts: constraints, objective functions, heuristics or solvers.
* Familiarity with Jira, HubSpot and BI tools (Power BI, Tableau).
* Knowledge of authentication flows (SSO, OAuth, MFA) and cloud deployment basics.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Operations Research, IT or a related field; equivalent depth of SaaS implementation experience will be considered.

**What Success Looks Like In Your First Year**

* You have taken at least two enterprise accounts live as the technical owner.
* Your live accounts run with stable integrations and few repeat escalations.
* Customers trust you to explain and improve plan quality without needing Engineering in the room.
* Your CSE team resolves most escalations without you, and works to standards and playbooks you set.

**Meet the Team**
The Product Operations team plays a critical role in delivering Cisco’s next-generation hardware products on a scale. Working at the intersection of engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing, the team ensures seamless product lifecycle execution—from new product introduction to high-volume production and customer delivery. With a strong focus on reliability, efficiency, and operational excellence, the team drives impact across global operations and enables successful product outcomes.
  
  
**Your Impact**
The Cisco Product Operations team is seeking a seasoned Product Lifecycle Program Manager (PLPM) to provide strategic leadership over global cost management and the end-to-end product lifecycle from inception to End-of-Life (EOL). This is a high-visibility, senior-level role that requires the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders—including Manufacturing, Engineering, Marketing, and Executive Leadership—to align on strategy and execution for a portfolio of complex product solutions. You will be responsible for defining and implementing the frameworks that ensure operational efficiency and market competitiveness across our global manufacturing footprint.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Strategic Cost Management & Lifecycle Oversight: Serve as the primary architect for end-to-end product lifecycle strategy, driving rigorous cost management protocols from launch through EOL to ensure sustained profitability.
* Engineering Change Governance: Provide authoritative oversight for Engineering Change Management, ensuring seamless technical transitions and minimal operational disruption.
* Product Quality & Financial Stewardship: Maintain stringent control over product quality benchmarks and cost structures, ensuring alignment with organizational financial targets.
* Complex Problem Resolution: Lead the mitigation of critical sustaining issues, including line-stop resolutions, CAP account management, AVL optimization, and continuous manufacturing process improvement.
* EOL Strategy & Orchestration: Direct the development and execution of holistic EOL strategies, partnering with integrated product teams to ensure smooth sunsetting of legacy solutions.
* Enterprise Risk Management: Oversee proactive risk assessment, including multi-source technology evaluation, component-level analysis, cost variance mitigation, and comprehensive supply chain reviews throughout the lifecycle.
* Field Performance & Margin Optimization: Lead strategic action planning for product field performance and spearhead initiatives to drive continuous improvement in gross margins.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or related technical field.
* 12+ years of progressive experience in Supply Chain management within the high-tech sector.
* Proven track record in complex Program Management and executive-level stakeholder management.
* Deep expertise in supply chain dynamics, specifically within high-tech environments, product costing, and sophisticated margin analysis.
* Advanced knowledge of Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) and sustaining product support

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in Engineering or Supply Chain Management and/or MBA.
* Knowledge of New Product Introduction (NPI) processes.
* Six Sigma Green or Black Belt certification.
* High proficiency in Agile methodologies and advanced MSFT tools.
* Extensive experience in the high-tech electronics industry and large-scale electronics manufacturing.
* Exceptional executive communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.

66c4a3f1.title: Principal System Architect
66c4a3f1.description:
**Job Description**
As the Principal System Architect, you will be at the forefront of our R&D efforts, contributing to the analysis and specification of key features for our WaveSuite product. Working closely with a team of domain experts and over 400 SW developers, you will own the system architecture, lead cross-functional technical initiatives, and ensure the successful delivery of high-quality solutions. Your customer-centric mindset and ability to engage with key partners will be instrumental in driving the success of our products.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**

* Seeking highly skilled R&D architect and systems engineer to contribute to analysis and specifications of features and components of our Network Management and Control Systems (WaveSuite).
* Working in a team of Optical and Telecommunications domain experts supporting a team of >400 SW developers and testers
* Working in an agile Scrum setup for SW development
* Customer focused mindset, adaptable and ability to drive engagement and collaboration with key Services Practices and Business partners
* Deriving product and R&D requirements from feature requests discussed with Sales and PLM teams as well as with customers and communicate them to the R&D teams
* The role includes

+ System architecture ownership
+ End-to-end solution design
+ Requirements analysis and decomposition
+ Feature specification and SRD creation
+ Cross-functional technical leadership
+ Customer requirement analysis
+ Technical decision making and trade-off analysis
+ Interface definition across NMS/EMS/network elements
+ Review and approval of designs and specifications
+ Technical leadership across multiple Scrum teams
+ Mentoring engineers and architects

**Key Skills And Experience**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Telecommunications/Electrical engineering or Computer Science with >10y or Experience in the TelCo domain
* Requirements Engineering: You can define and refine both functional and non-functional requirements to ensure clear product goals.
* Translate complex technical insights into clear, actionable business requirements for internal teams and stakeholders
* Experience in SW and System Architecture and Systems Engineering
* Experience with AI DLC, agentic AI harnesses as well as automation projects
* Optical Networking: You have deep knowledge on L0/L1/L2 networks and and ideally some experience on how to operate and manage transport networks
* Guide and engage with cross-functional teams, ensuring high-quality and timely solution delivery
* Restful API definition: knowledge on OpenAPI, gRPC and general API best practices (like TAPI, OpenConfig)
* Systems Thinking & Detail Orientation: You can see the big picture and pay attention to the details, ensuring complex systems are built with precision and reliability.
* Communication & Leadership: You are an excellent communicator, able to deliver presentations and detailed specifications. You are fluent in English and have a collaborative approach
* Standardization: You should be able to follow up with and contribute to standardization (ONF, MEF, TMF, IETF)
* Kubernetes/Containerization: You deeply understand container technology and Kubernetes, including building API extensions to manage complex applications.
* Distributed Systems: You have 10+ years of experience architecting and scaling resilient, high-performance distributed systems, ideally in observability or data-driven products.
* Cloud-Native & DevOps: You have a foundation in cloud-native and DevOps practices, including CI/CD, infrastructure as code, system reliability, root cause analysis, and performance optimization.
* Cloud Engineering: You have cloud engineering skills with experience deploying in both on-prem and public cloud environments.

**Advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.**
Nokia is a global leader in connectivity for the AI era. With expertise across fixed, mobile and transport networks, powered by the innovation of Nokia Bell Labs, we’re advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.

b60a2d49.title: Conversational AI Architect - Google Cloud Gemini CX
b60a2d49.description:
We are seeking a **Conversational AI Architect** to design, build and scale enterprise-grade conversational and agentic AI solutions on Google Cloud. This role combines deep technical expertise in Gemini CX, Dialogflow CX and Vertex AI with hands-on engineering leadership to move generative AI agents from pilot to secure, high-volume production environments.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Design and deploy enterprise-grade agentic AI and conversational AI solutions using Gemini CX, Vertex AI Agent Studio, Dialogflow CX and supporting Google Cloud AI services
* Orchestrate hybrid conversational workflows by combining generative playbooks and autonomous agent behaviors with deterministic Dialogflow CX state-machine controls
* Build and optimize RAG pipelines using Vertex AI Search to securely ground agents in enterprise documents, knowledge repositories and business data
* Develop secure backend integrations, connectors and webhooks using Cloud Run, Cloud Functions and Model Context Protocol (MCP) to integrate CRM, ERP and internal enterprise systems
* Implement security and compliance guardrails using Model Armor, VPC Service Controls, IAM least-privilege policies and appropriate data isolation controls
* Build conversation telemetry and analytics pipelines using BigQuery and CCAI Insights for error-taxonomy analysis, intent health, containment reporting and operational improvement
* Provide hands-on engineering leadership, write production-grade code, troubleshoot complex platform issues and guide solutions through production deployment and scale

**Requirements**

* 12-20 years of overall experience in IT
* Expertise in Gemini CX, Google Cloud Contact Center AI (CCAI), Vertex AI Agent Studio and the Advanced Agent Modeling (AAM) framework
* Proven experience designing and deploying agentic and conversational AI systems, including goal-oriented agents, multi-agent workflows and enterprise-scale customer interaction solutions
* Expertise in Dialogflow CX, including pages, parameters, conditional routing, transition routes, Speech-to-Text tuning, Text-to-Speech and telephony/SIP configurations
* Experience building Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions using Vertex AI Search and grounding AI agents securely with enterprise knowledge sources
* Proficiency in Python or Node.js, with hands-on development of APIs, webhooks, connectors and backend integrations using Cloud Run and Cloud Functions
* Knowledge of GCP infrastructure, BigQuery, Looker Studio, Terraform, IAM, VPC Service Controls, Model Armor, cloud security, data anonymization and enterprise security controls
* Proven experience moving generative AI agents from pilot/MVP stages into secure, scalable and high-volume production environments

**Nice to have**

* Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect or Professional Data Engineer certification
* Completion of Google Cloud Agentic AI or Gemini Enterprise for Customer Experience (GECX) learning paths, and experience with automation libraries such as dfcx-scrapi
* Experience delivering high-volume customer service solutions in Financial Services, Telecom, Retail or Healthcare environments

4a8afd59.description:
We are looking for a seasoned **AS/400 Architect** to define the technical vision and architectural direction for the AI Tools team, shaping EPAM's in-house solution for IBM iSeries (AS/400) application reverse engineering, analysis, and modernization at an enterprise scale.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Define the architectural vision, standards, and technical roadmap for the IBM iSeries (AS/400) reverse-engineering and modernization solution
* Conduct application portfolio analysis to identify redundant, unreachable, duplicated, obsolete, tightly coupled, and highly complex code, and assess application quality, maintainability, performance, technical debt, modernization readiness, and potential risks
* Analyze legacy IBM AS/400 applications, identify dependencies and business rules, trace data flows, document application behavior, and assess undocumented or complex codebases
* Drive IBM AS/400 modernization approaches, including code refactoring, format conversion, database modernization, API and web-service enablement, UI modernization, application decomposition, cloud integration, re-platforming, and application retirement
* Collaborate with the AI Tools team to define requirements, validate analysis logic, improve prompts and rules, and enhance the accuracy of AI-generated application documentation and code insights
* Architect AI capabilities for program understanding, dependency discovery, business-rule extraction, data-flow analysis, impact analysis, code summarization, test-case generation, and modernization recommendations
* Contribute to technical assessments, proofs of concept, solution demonstrations, effort estimation, project planning, risk identification, progress reporting, and executive-level presentations
* Partner with customer IBM i SMEs, application owners, business analysts, modernization specialists, AI Tools team members, testing teams, cloud architects, and Technical Leadership across the client and EPAM organizations
* Ensure that the reverse-engineering and modernization solution complies with enterprise architecture standards, customer security policies, source-code handling requirements, data-protection controls, audit requirements, and applicable regulatory obligations

**Requirements**

* 13+ years of experience in enterprise midrange (iSeries or AS/400) technologies, with 5+ years focused on application analysis, reverse engineering, and modernization solutions
* Expertise in RPG III, RPG IV, and RPGLE, including hands-on development, maintenance, and refactoring of large-scale legacy applications
* Proficiency in free-format RPG, CL/CLLE, and COBOL, with the ability to analyze and convert fixed-format code to modern equivalents
* Skills in DDS, DSPFs, and SQL, including designing, interpreting, and optimizing display files, physical/logical files, and complex queries
* Background in Db2 for i, covering database design, performance tuning, journaling, stored procedures, triggers, and DDS-to-DDL conversion
* Understanding of IBM i architecture, including libraries, objects, service programs, printer files, commitment control, and integrated file systems
* Knowledge of reverse engineering techniques for legacy AS/400 applications, including dependency mapping, business-rule extraction, and data-flow tracing
* Familiarity with modernization strategies such as API enablement, web-service integration, UI modernization, application decomposition, cloud migration, and re-platforming
* Competency in application portfolio assessment, technical debt evaluation, code quality analysis, and modernization readiness reviews
* Capability to collaborate with AI Tools teams by defining requirements, validating analysis logic, refining prompts, and improving AI-generated documentation and code insights
* Flexibility to support delivery activities, including proofs of concept, effort estimation, project planning, risk identification, and executive-level presentations
* Showcase of strong stakeholder management skills to engage IBM i SMEs, application owners, business analysts, cloud architects, and technical leadership across client and internal organizations
* Qualifications in governance and compliance, ensuring adherence to enterprise architecture standards, security policies, data-protection controls, and regulatory obligations
* Proficiency in English at an Upper-Intermediate level (B2) or higher

da11260d.title: Lead Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
da11260d.description:
**Overview**
WELCOME TO SITA
  
  
At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.
  
  
You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don't just move the world forward-we're proud to be recognized as a
**Great Place to Work**
® by 79% of our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.
  
  
Are you ready to love your job?
  
  
The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.
  
  
PURPOSE
  
  
As a Lead Cloud Infrastructure Engineer in SITA’s Airports Portfolio you will lead technical design, development and maintenance of the Azure Cloud platform and related services (using existing and emerging technologies) to enable the modernisation and efficient delivery of services to our customers.
  
  
We are seeking a talented and experienced Azure Cloud Engineer to join our portfolio platform team - dedicated to developing and deploying our cloud solutions in the best possible way now and into the future.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Key contributor to the design, planning and implementation of our Azure cloud solutions and services to ensure optimum cloud performance and reliability across our cloud infrastructure, building in continuous process improvement and CI/CD pipelines.
  
  
Works as part of a broader team of problem solvers helping to solve complex business issues from strategy to execution via automation.
  
  
Acts as a key liaison with senior technology stakeholders and partners to ensure full delivery of software releases & product roadmaps.
  
  
Interfaces with Developers Engineers Architects Ops and Support staff to design develop and implement cost effective Cloud Solutions using IaaS/PaaS/SaaS so that it is flexible extensible elastic secure and reliable at large scale.
  
  
Recommends and participates in the selection of new technologies and technical processes working closely with the Architecture Team to implement the top cloud architecture solutions to successfully meet the strategic needs of the organization.
  
  
Creates re-usable platform components for products, develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines from development right though to production.
  
  
Works within agile methodologies, following SITA coding guidelines and practices for all technical processes and documenting solutions.
  
  
Mentoring and guiding junior team members on IaC practices, Kubernetes operations, and Azure platform engineering.
  
  
Provides expert level support to Operational teams.
  
  
Issue technical recommendations and guidelines for implementation and support.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**EXPERIENCE**
6+ years Cloud Platform Engineering experience
  
  

* Experience designing, configuring & implementing infrastructure and network solutions in Azure.
* Experience with LAN & WAN networking, TCP/IP, load balancing principles.
* Experience with hub and spoke and landing zones.
* Experience with automating CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps.
* Experience with production grade AKS clusters and associated challenges.
* Experience with creating application and infrastructure monitoring solutions.
* Experience creating and delivering Cloud Platform technology roadmaps

**Knowledge & Skills**
Ability to be the lead technical role on complex projects overseeing requirement analysis through implementation and/or support. Understand the customer's business objectives for assigned projects. Coordinate multiple technical streams of work to produce a complete solution with high-level designs. Understand the concept of IT security and its application to computer systems architecture. Sound knowledge of system integration and hardware. Sound understanding of agile methodologies and practices. Understand and articulate trade-offs and risks with technical choices.
  
  

* Strong understanding of Azure networking VNet peering, NSGs, UDR, NAT Gateway, private DNS, service endpoints
* Experience in managing and provisioning infrastructure through code (IaC).
* Experience with automating CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps.
* Ability to quickly learn and understand new technologies or concepts, review functional and technical requirements, raising potential issues and participating actively in design discussions
* Experience with creating application and infrastructure monitoring solutions.
* Experience creating and delivering Cloud Platform technology roadmaps
* You thrive in a team environment, excellent communication skills, with the ability to work independently & as a member of the team.

**Experience And Skills In The Following Technologies**

* Terraform experience with module authoring, state management, provider configuration, CI/CD integration
* Azure DevOps CI/CD Pipeline Engineering. Own the Azure Pipelines template library (multi-stage YAML), self-hosted agent infrastructure, and automated testing integration
* Kubernetes Operations managing AKS cluster lifecycle, Kluctl/Helm deployment orchestration, operator configuration
* Semantic versioning, commit conventions, and automated dependency management (Renovate, sv4git, commitlint)
* Container Platform maintain Docker base images, agent images, and secure image supply chain via industry best practices such as utilising ACR's and Trivy scanning
* Testing & Quality - maintain/extend the continuous deployment test framework (Postman API tests, K6 load tests, Pester unit tests)
* Practical hands-on Azure skills including Azure AppGW, WAF, Vnet, Routing, Subnets, App services, VM’s, Helm and Helmfile
* Security & Compliance Azure best practices for cloud security such as enforcing network segmentation, private endpoints, CIS-hardened images, WAF policies, RBAC, and managed identity patterns
* PowerShell module development, Pester testing, Azure automation
* Bash shell scripting for container entry points and CI tasks
* Active directory, Azure AD, Azure AD B2C
* Git-based workflows with trunk-based development and branch-per-environment patterns

**Experience In The Following An Advantage**

* Experience managing RabbitMQ clusters in Kubernetes
* Experience with Go / GoLang and Python languages
* Experience with the JinJa2 template engine
* MSSQL, Azure SQL
* Azure FinOps expertise & experience
* Azure Certification
* Previous application development experience

PROFESSION COMPETENCIES
  
  

* Agile Methodologies
* Capacity Planning & Management
* Cloud Computing
* Information Security Management
* Innovation
* Performance Measurement and Tuning
* Requirements Analysis
* Standards Procedures & Policies
* Systems Thinking

CORE COMPETENCIES
  
  

* Communication
* Customer Focus
* Leading Execution
* Results Orientation
* Teamwork

**Education & Qualifications**
University degree or equivalent preferably in Computer Science Engineering Mathematics or similar.Where applicable a recognised professional qualification is desirable.
  
  
**What We Offer**
We're all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We're really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.
  
  
🏡
**Hybrid Working Week:**
Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your team's needs)
  
  
⏰
**Core Working Hours with Flexibiliy:**
Set working hours for consistency, with flexibility to adapt to unexpectred needs. Where required provide on-call support outside of standard working hours. Benefits may vary by location.
  
  
🌎
**Flex-Location:**
Take up to 30 days a year to work from any location in the world.
  
  
🌿
**Employee Wellbeing:**
We have got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health - a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs.
  
  
🚀
**Professional Development:**
At SITA, we believe growth fuels innovation. Our learning ecosystem offers access to world-class platforms and programs designed to help you thrive. From
**LinkedIn Learning, Microsoft's Enterprise Skills Initiative,**
and
**Airport Council International**
-available to all employees-to specialized solutions like
**Pluralsight**
for technology upskilling,
**Harvard Business Publishing**
for people leadership,
**Stanford**
for strategic development and many others, we align learning opportunities with your Development Plan and our business priorities. Your development journey is supported every step of the way.
  
  
🙌
**Competitive Benefits:**
Competitive benefits that make sense with both your local market and employment status.
  
  
*SITA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value a diverse workforce. In support of our Employment Equity Program, we encourage women, aboriginal people, members of visible minorities, and/or persons with disabilities to apply and self-identify in the application process.*

5abdb89e.title: Technical Support Engineer (Cloud), India

At AlgoSec, what you do matters!
  
  
AlgoSec helps the world’s leading organizations secure application connectivity across hybrid and multi-cloud environments. Trusted by more than 2,200 global organizations, our platform delivers visibility, security policy management, risk reduction, and compliance automation across complex enterprise networks.
  
  
AlgoSec is looking for an experienced Technical Support Engineer to join our global Support organization.
  
  
For this position, we are specifically looking for a candidate with strong Cloud, Linux, and automation experience who can complement the networking and firewall expertise already existing within the team and support AlgoSec's continued evolution toward SaaS, cloud-based capabilities, and AI integrations.

Support Team Leader / Support Manager

Gurgaon, India – office-based preferred; remote work may be considered

Direct employment

* Practical experience with cloud platforms such as AWS and/or Microsoft Azure, including troubleshooting cloud infrastructure, networking, security, and platform services.

* Experience with scripting and automation using Bash, Python, PowerShell, Shell scripting, or similar technologies.
* Experience building or maintaining operational automations to improve efficiency, reduce manual effort, or enhance service reliability.
* Experience supporting network security, infrastructure, or other complex enterprise software products.

de075dd9.title: SPM Delivery Lead
de075dd9.description:
**Job Family Group**
Retail Group
  
  
**Job Description**
Job description:
  
  
**About Bp**
bp is a global integrated oil and gas company with over a century of expertise and a proud and enduring heritage. Around the world we work hard to help countries and millions of customers every day with their energy needs. We produce oil and gas, trade energy, and make, ship and sell energy products. We also invest selectively and on a smaller scale in EV charging, biofuels and biogas, offshore wind and solar. Our purpose is to deliver energy to the world, today and tomorrow.
  
  
**Let Me Tell You About The Role**
As a Supplier Performance Management Delivery Lead, you will lead day-to-day SPM delivery across a portfolio of bp markets, acting as the primary operational interface between in-market teams and the BTC SPM organisation. You will also act as the primary functional SME for Supplier Performance Management activities across your supported market portfolio, ensuring consistent application of SPM standards and protocols.
  
  
You will manage demand and capacity, ensure the quality of SPM outputs, resolve operational issues and develop the SPM Analyst team. Direct supplier interaction may occur to support performance reviews, data validation, governance activities and issue resolution. Ownership of supplier relationships and supplier decisions remains with the relevant Market or functional owner.
  
  
This is a fast-paced, decision making role requiring strong supplier-performance expertise, people leadership and the ability to balance competing priorities across markets.
  
  
**What You Will Deliver**
Act as the primary day-to-day interface and first partner concern point for supported markets, ensuring market context, priorities and requirements are understood by the BTC team and resolving issues before partner concern to the SPM Lead.
  
  

* Act as the primary functional SME for Supplier Performance Management activities across supported markets, providing guidance on supplier governance, performance management, escalation management and operational guidelines.
* Manage demand and capacity across the market portfolio, prioritising requirements and flexing analyst capacity across markets and workstreams to respond to cyclical peaks, changing priorities and quieter periods.
* Own delivery quality and outcomes, reviewing material analyst outputs before they reach market partners and ensuring work is accurate, timely and fit for purpose.
* Act as the primary day-to-day interface and first escalation point for supported markets, ensuring market context, priorities and requirements are understood by the BTC team and resolving issues before partner concern to the SPM Lead.
* Act as the primary functional SME for Supplier Performance Management activities across supported markets, providing guidance on supplier governance, performance management, issue management and operational protocols.
* Manage demand and capacity across the market portfolio, prioritising requirements and flexing analyst capacity across markets and workstreams to respond to cyclical peaks, changing priorities and quieter periods.
* Own delivery quality and outcomes, reviewing material analyst outputs before they reach market customers and ensuring work is accurate, timely and fit for purpose.
* Lead day-to-day service performance, monitoring workload, delivery commitments and service levels, removing blockers and making timely decisions on operational issues and exceptions.
* Provide functional direction on SPM activities, supporting Analysts in resolving complex performance, data, workflow and partner concern issues while maintaining consistent SPM standards.
* Lead the SPM Analyst team from a people and capability perspective, managing performance expectations, workload balance, coaching, career development and functional standards without directing individual tasks' day to day.
* Provide functional oversight of supplier onboarding and offboarding processes, ensuring Analysts implement workflows consistently, onboarding issues are resolved promptly collaborators dependencies are managed and onboarding activities are completed in line with agreed service expectations
* Maintain visibility of service performance and emerging risks, ensuring markets and the SPM Lead have clear information on demand, capacity, quality, exceptions and material delivery concerns.
* Support onboarding of new markets, supplier portfolios and services into the BTC SPM operating model, ensuring consistent adoption of processes, controls, governance standards and service expectations.
* Ensure supplier performance is actively monitored across supported markets, reviewing Key performance indicator, SLA and governance outcomes, challenging performance exceptions, driving corrective-action follow-up and intensifying material supplier-performance concerns where market intervention is required
* Drive continuous improvement through process optimisation, standardisation, automation and AI-enabled ways of working that improve quality, productivity and team member experience.

**What You Will Need To Be Successful**

* 6-8+ years of relevant experience across Supplier Performance Management, Supplier/Vendor Management, Procurement, Contract Management or a related operational rigor.
* 2-3+ years of people or service leadership experience, including team performance, coaching and capability development.
* Bachelor's / Master’s degree in Business, Procurement, Supply Chain, Operations or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Demonstrated experience managing demand, priorities and capacity across multiple markets, participants or workstreams.
* Strong understanding of supplier Key performance indicator /SLAs, scorecards, performance reporting, issue management and corrective actions.
* Strong analytical and operational judgement, with the ability to assess competing priorities, resolve issues and make timely decisions.
* Strong stakeholder-management skills and experience acting as the interface between business collaborators and delivery teams.
* Experience in a shared-services, pooled-resource or multi-market environment is strongly preferred.

**You Will Work With**
You will lead a team of BTC SPM Analysts and work closely with the BTC SPM Lead and in-market supplier-management partners, acting as the primary operational connection between market demand and BTC delivery.
  
  
You will also work with Procurement, category teams, Finance, other relevant functions and external suppliers where required, particularly to support performance reviews, resolve operational issues and manage defined exceptions. Supplier relationship ownership and final supplier-facing decisions remain with the appropriate in-market or functional owner.
  
  
**Why join bp**
At bp, we support our people to learn and grow in a diverse and challenging environment. We believe that our team is strengthened by diversity. We are committed to encouraging an inclusive environment in which everyone is respected and treated fairly.
  
  
There are many aspects of our employees’ lives that are meaningful, so we offer benefits to enable your work to fit with your life. These benefits can include flexible working options, a generous paid parental leave policy, and excellent retirement benefits, among others!
  
  
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
  
  
**Travel Requirement**
Up to 10% travel should be expected with this role
  
  
**Relocation Assistance:**
This role is eligible for relocation within country
  
  
**Remote Type**
This position is a hybrid of office/remote working
  
  
**Skills**
Authentic Leadership, Authentic Leadership, Building services and standards, Building sustainability, Collaboration, Commercial Acumen, Communication, Construction, Continuous Improvement, Contract Management, Crisis and emergency response management, Customer centric thinking, Customer experience, Data Analysis, Design Thinking, Diversity, Equity and Inclusion, Incident investigation and learning, incident investigation and response, Incident Management, Influencing, Management of Change, Negotiating, Operations Management, Project execution planning {+ 10 more}
  
  
**Legal Disclaimer**
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, socioeconomic status, neurodiversity/neurocognitive functioning, veteran status or disability status. Individuals with an accessibility need may request an adjustment/accommodation related to bp’s recruiting process (e.g., accessing the job application, completing required assessments, participating in telephone screenings or interviews, etc.). If you would like to request an adjustment/accommodation related to the recruitment process, please contact us.
  
  
If you are selected for a position and depending upon your role, your employment may be contingent upon adherence to local policy. This may include pre-placement drug screening, medical review of physical fitness for the role, and background checks.
