d46c7b49.title: Pre-Sales Solution Architect
d46c7b49.description:
**Location:**
New Delhi, India
  
  
**Function:**
(DEAI HV) Presales
  
  
**Requisition ID:**
R0147857
  
  
**Our Company**
We're Hitachi Vantara, the data foundation trusted by the world's innovators. Our resilient, high-performance data infrastructure means that customers - from banks to theme parks - can focus on achieving the incredible with data. If you've seen the Las Vegas Sphere, you've seen just one example of how we empower businesses to automate, optimize, innovate - and wow their customers. Right now, we're laying the foundation for our next wave of growth. We're looking for people who love being part of a diverse, global team - and who get excited about making a real-world impact with data.
  
  
The primary role of a TechSales Solutions Consultant is to work collaboratively with the direct sales team as well as partners to provide support for all presales solution aspects of the sales cycle. Job requirements include but are not limited to the following activities; RFI/RFP preparation, opportunity & account planning, technical liaison (representing Sales) to Professional Services / Partners and APAC TEs / Product Management teams, demonstrations, joint partner solutions etc. Solution Consultant plays a vital role in establishing and supporting the technical sales relationship with prospects & clients. In concert with the sales representative, the Solution Consultant maps product capabilities to client needs and sets mutually understood and accepted expectations related to our solutions to ensure the success of post-sale implementations.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Provide technical sales support to the sales team and partners leading the engagements
* Strong Focus on Customer engagements in ongoing opportunities
* Leverage technical relationship and trusted advisor role to create new opportunities with consultative selling
* RFI/RFP support (both proactive and reactive)
* Solution proposal support to highlight differentiators and quantified benefits with CXO level summary
* Technical engagements with key partners (SI, ISV etc.) for joint Solution development and / or joint bidding
* Lead initial solution demonstrations to customers/partners
* Assist in pre-sales to post-sale transition to ensure smooth implementation and maximum customer satisfaction

**Required Capabilities**

* Strong ability to identify, document and articulate the business and technical requirements of a prospective customer during the full sales cycle – qualification, proposal, post-sale transition
* Strong ability to communicate our software ability to address prospect’s requirements through compelling presentation (written, oral and product demonstrations) of the applications
* Excellent customer facing and presentation skills
* Excellent collaboration and Team work not only with in HV teams but also partner teams
* Proactive in approach to lead customer/partner/consultant engagements and strengthen HV’s presence in accounts
* Excellent writing and quantitative skills, specifically related to proposals, RFI/RFP response and MS PowerPoint presentations
* High level of energy, enthusiasm, persistence, discipline, and a strong desire to succeed
* Willingness to do whatever is necessary to win (Team work, ability to resolve issues etc.)
* Ability to travel

**Technical Skills**

* Good technical experience in Data Center level infrastructure with strong focus on Storage
* Good understanding of Object Storage technologies
* Minimum 10 years of experience with 8 years being in presales role
* Experience with Database, Application integration etc. desirable
* Experience in conducting demos
* Experience to lead consultative workshops to demonstrate business value

**About Us**
We're a global team of innovators. Together, we harness engineering excellence and passion for insight to co-create meaningful solutions to complex challenges. We turn organizations into data-driven leaders that can make a positive impact on their industries and society. If you believe that innovation can inspire the future, this is the place to fulfil your purpose and achieve your potential.
  
  
**Fostering innovation through diverse perspectives**
Hitachi is a global company operating across a wide range of industries and regions. One of the things that sets Hitachi apart is the diversity of our business and people, which drives our innovation and growth.
  
  
We are committed to building an inclusive culture based on mutual respect and merit-based systems. We believe that when people feel valued, heard, and safe to express themselves, they do their best work.
  
  
**How We Look After You**
We help take care of your today and tomorrow with industry-leading benefits, support, and services that look after your holistic health and wellbeing. We're also champions of life balance and offer flexible arrangements that work for you (role and location dependent). We're always looking for new ways of working that bring out our best, which leads to unexpected ideas. So here, you'll experience a sense of belonging, and discover autonomy, freedom, and ownership as you work alongside talented people you enjoy sharing knowledge with.
  
  
We're proud to say we're an equal opportunity employer and welcome all applicants for employment without attention to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, age, disability status or any other protected characteristic. Should you need reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know so that we can do our best to set you up for success.

3a02736c.title: Pre-Sales Solutions Consultant / Solutions Engineer
3a02736c.description:
**Location:**
Bengaluru, Karnataka, India (Remote-First – 2-Hour Commute Radius)

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Experience Level:**
Mid-Senior (2–5 Years)

Work Model & Location Requirement

This is a
**Remote-First**
role offering strong day-to-day work-from-home flexibility. However, because high-stakes enterprise pitches, client briefings, and core engineering syncs require in-person collaboration,
**candidates must reside within a ~2-hour drive/commute radius of our Bengaluru Headquarters**
to join on-site sessions
**4 to 8 times per month**
(typically 1–2 days per week).

About TRALEXHO

TRALEXHO is an AI-powered Traceability-as-a-Service (TaaS) platform built to bring end-to-end transparency and sustainability to the global food supply chain. By connecting every stage of the supply chain—from first-mile producers to end consumers—we help food businesses streamline operations, build consumer trust, and comply with strict global standards like USFDA FSMA 204 and EUDR.

Why This Role Matters

As a
**Solutions Engineer**
, you will serve as the technical anchor for our revenue team. You’ll bridge the gap between complex supply chain technology and business value, guiding enterprise food and agriculture clients through discovery, live platform demos, and technical validation.

If you thrive on translating intricate compliance and AI capabilities into compelling solution architectures, this role is built for you.

What You Will Do

* **Lead Technical Discovery & Demos:**
  Conduct deep-dive technical discovery sessions to uncover prospect pain points, and deliver tailored live platform demos to enterprise decision-makers.
* **Build Proof-of-Concepts (PoCs):**
  Collaborate with product and engineering teams to design, configure, and present custom PoCs and solution proposals.
* **Remove Technical Blockers:**
  Act as the trusted technical advisor during the sales cycle, addressing regulatory compliance (FSMA, EUDR), data integration, and security questions.
* **Leverage AI Tools:**
  Utilize AI-assisted workflows (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, CRM AI agents) to streamline RFP/RFI responses, objection-handling repositories, and demo setup.
* **Inform the Product Roadmap:**
  Gather front-line technical requirements and customer feedback to partner with our remote engineering team on feature prioritization.

What We Are Looking For

* **Experience:**
  2–5 years in a B2B SaaS Pre-Sales, Solutions Architecture, or Technical Sales Consulting role. (Experience in supply chain, agtech, or enterprise SaaS is a plus).
* **Technical & Solutioning Ability:**
  Proven track record of understanding SaaS architectures, API integrations, and complex data flows, with the ability to present them clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
* **Communication & Presence:**
  Exceptional verbal and written presentation skills, with a strong track record of commanding the room during executive client meetings (virtual and on-site).
* **Proximity & Availability:**
  Based within a 2-hour commute radius of our Bengaluru HQ and available for in-person collaboration
  **4 to 8 times per month**
  .

What We Offer

* Competitive base salary with revenue performance incentives.
* Remote-first working model with structured in-person team collaboration.
* Opportunity to solve real-world global food safety and traceability challenges using cutting-edge AI.
* Collaborative, high-autonomy culture

**Job Description**
**Build your best future with the Johnson Controls team**
As a global leader in smart, healthy and sustainable buildings, our mission is to reimagine the performance of buildings to serve people, places and the planet. Join a winning team that enables you to build your best future! Our teams are uniquely positioned to support a multitude of industries across the globe. You will have the opportunity to develop yourself through meaningful work projects and learning opportunities. We strive to provide our employees with an experience, focused on supporting their physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing.
  
  
We are a
**Great Place To Work-Certified**
organization. Become a member of the Johnson Controls family and thrive in an empowering company culture where your voice and ideas will be heard – your next great opportunity is just a few clicks away!
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary
* Paid vacation/holidays/sick time
* On the job/cross training opportunities
* Encouraging and collaborative team environment
* Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy

**What You Will Do**
The primary responsibility for this role is to support pre-sales engineering for Security System global projects as per country specific standards. Basic knowledge about bill of material preparation, cost estimation to come up with competitive bid. Follow processes, maintain required quality standards and on time deliveries to ensure customer satisfaction.
  
  
**How You Will Do It**

* Review project inputs and specifications; should be able to capture the scope and understand the complete requirements of the project.
* Review MEP drawings, specification, SOP and identify equipment related to Security System (Access, Video, Intrusion , Complete ELV system etc)
* Preparation and participation for project kick-off / review meetings with technical queries, compliance / deviations log, risk logs and record minutes of meeting.
* Adherence to standard estimation process and guideline to select proper combination of hardware, software, equipment, materials and services to come up with the optimum budget.
* Creation of bill of material, selection of Backend, Controllers, Field Devices, Software Identification, Network connection, Cable Type and Length Calculations related to Security System.
* Preparation of Costing Sheet including Preliminaries and other costs, Cost comparison charts, Checklist, Technical Write-up, Block Diagram, Deviation Chart etc.
* Ensure quality assurance, defect free deliverables, on time deliveries and customer satisfaction.
* Escalate issues in the right time, so as not to affect the project delivery schedule; any escalations with respect to scope-creep must be clearly backed up with evidences.
* Keep operational parameters at desired level for all assigned projects.
* Ensure timesheet compliance with respect to entry and review for self and team.
* Weekly/Monthly customer reporting for project progress.
* Active participation in organization employee engagement initiatives

**What We Look For**

* BE (Instrumentation / Electrical / Electronics / Electronics & Communication).
* Strong knowledge of Security Systems (Access, Video, Intrusion , Complete ELV system etc)
* Expertise in Security Guidelines.
* Proficient in AutoCAD, MS Office tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, etc.) , Blue Beam
* Knowledge of different types of network protocols like BACNet, Modbus, OPC, and other protocols.
* Must be a quick learner, team player & should have a keen eye for problem solving.
* Proficient in written and verbal communication.
* Ability to demonstrate good leadership skills.

**Preferred**
2-5 years of relevant experience in Security System.

8dfd670c.title: Business Solutions Engineer
8dfd670c.description:
**About TruKKer and the Role**

TruKKer is hiring a Business Solutions Engineer who owns the full journey from a business problem to a solution people actually use, building with Claude Code on top of our existing systems.

TruKKer is a technology-driven road freight and logistics company. Our business teams run on fast-moving, process-heavy workflows, and many of their pain points are best solved by small, well-targeted software rather than long project cycles.

The Business Solutions Engineer sits inside that gap: one person, embedded with the business, who can understand a problem, decide what to build, build it, prove it works, roll it out and keep it useful. There are no hand-offs between a business analyst, a product manager, a developer and a tester.

  

**The Business Solutions Engineer is all of them for the solutions they own.**

  

If you prefer working from requirements someone else has already

written, this is not the role. If you would rather spend a morning with an operations team, find where hours are leaking every week, and have something working in front of them soon after, read on.

  

**Role Summary**

The Business Solutions Engineer is the single owner of a solutions entire lifecycle. You start by understanding what the business team is struggling with, and you finish only when the team is using the solution and getting value from it.

  

**In practice you will:**

* Spend time with business teams to find and define real problems, not just take requests.
* Research the product options and gather requirements from the right stakeholders.
* Build the solution end to end using Claude Code, either as an enhancement to an existing system or a new build from scratch.
* Test it yourself, end to end, before anyone else sees it.
* Train the business team, launch the solution and stay on as its owner.
* Track adoption, and when usage is low, find out why and fix it.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

The work runs in seven stages. You own every one of them.

**1. Discover and understand business challenges**

* Work closely with business teams to learn how they operate day to day and where time, money or accuracy is being lost.
* Identify and prioritise the problems worth solving, using impact, effort and urgency.
* Define each problem clearly, with a measurable outcome, before any solution is proposed.

**2. Research and define the solution**

* Research the product space: how similar problems are solved elsewhere, and whether to enhance an existing system or build something new.
* Gather and document requirements from the relevant stakeholders (business users, managers, data owners, engineering).
* Propose a solution with scope, trade-offs and success criteria, and get alignment before building.

**3. Build end to end with Claude Code**

* Design and develop the solution using Claude Code, either as an enhancement within TruKKer’s existing systems or as a new build from scratch.
* Handle the full stack of the solution: data, logic, integrations, interface and deployment.
* Make sound decisions on architecture, security, access control and maintainability, and review AI-generated code with care.
* Keep documentation current so others can understand and support what you have built.

**4. Test it yourself**

* Own end-to-end testing: functional, integration, edge cases, data accuracy and user-flow checks.
* Validate with realistic business data and scenarios, and fix issues before release.

**5. Train and implement**

* Set up and run training and walkthrough sessions with the business team.
* Prepare simple guides or demos so users can adopt the solution without hand-holding.
* Manage the rollout and go-live, including the first weeks of hypercare.

**6. Support and enhance**

* Be the point of contact for business queries, issues and enhancement requests on your solutions.
* Triage and resolve issues quickly, and scope, build and ship enhancements as needs evolve.

**7. Drive adoption**

* Monitor whether each solution is actually being used, by whom and how often.
* If usage is low, sit down with the business to find the real reason (workflow fit, trust, training, missing features, process change).
* Provide and deliver the fix, whether that is a product change, more training or a process adjustment, until the solution is part of how the team works.

  

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

We care more about what you can build and own than about the title on your last job.

* 3 to 6 years of experience in software engineering, solutions engineering, product engineering or a similar hands-on role.
* Strong full-stack ability: you can read and write backend logic, work with databases and APIs, and build a usable front end.
* Hands-on experience building with AI coding tools, ideally Claude Code, and the judgement to review, test and correct AI-generated code.
* Proven ability to take a vague business problem, break it down, and turn it into clear requirements and a working solution.
* Comfortable working inside existing systems: reading unfamiliar code, integrating with current tools and making safe changes.
* Disciplined self-testing habits, covering functional checks, edge cases and data validation.
* Excellent communication: you can talk to a non-technical operations team and a senior engineer in the same day, and run a good training session.
* High ownership and follow-through, with a bias for action and for finishing what you start.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in logistics, supply chain, freight, marketplaces or other operations-heavy businesses.
* Familiarity with ERP, TMS, CRM or similar enterprise systems and their integrations.
* Experience with BI and analytics tools for building dashboards and usage tracking.
* Prior experience in a forward deployed, solutions engineering or internal tools role.
* Product management exposure, such as writing PRDs, prioritising backlogs and running user research.

**Who You Will Work With**

You will work daily with business teams such as operations, sales, customer success and finance, and with the product, engineering and data colleagues who own the systems you build on. The business reaches out to you directly, so you must be comfortable being the face of the solution.

  

**How Success Is Measured**

The Business Solutions Engineer is judged on outcomes the business can feel, not on lines of code shipped. Targets are set with the hiring manager once the role is filled.

* Problem-solution fit — Solutions shipped that address a validated business problem, with a stated outcome
* Delivery speed — Time from problem identified to solution live
* Quality — Defects found after go-live, and rework needed after release
* Adoption — Share of intended users actively using the solution, and how that trends after launch
* Business impact — Time saved, errors reduced, or revenue or cost effect, versus the baseline
* Responsiveness — Time to respond to and resolve business queries and enhancement requests
* Stakeholder satisfaction — Feedback from business teams on trust, clarity and support

3f40c524.title: CTC Functional Solution Architect
3f40c524.description:
**Job Description**
**Purpose of the Role:**
**The Solution Architect — Functional, Credit to Cash is the functional design authority for the end-to-end Credit to Cash value chain.**
The outcome is a Credit to Cash process that is predictable, automated and controlled: faster and better credit decisions, higher straight-through cash application, risk-based and largely automated collections, fewer exceptions and disputes, lower DSO and overdue, and <1 Day Resolution wherever the process allows. Everything this role does serves that outcome.
  
  
The scope is the Credit to Cash value chain end to end, not a single module or platform — customer onboarding and credit risk assessment, credit limits, scoring, reviews and order hold or release; billing and invoice presentment as they feed receivables; customer statements and self-service portals; collections strategy, worklists and dunning; payment capture, bank statement and lockbox processing, remittance capture and cash application; unapplied and on-account cash; deductions, short-pays, claims and disputes; AR accounting, reconciliation, write-offs and bad-debt provisioning; and the period-end close, controls, reporting and KPIs that sit on top. The role designs across this scope as one integrated solution rather than as separate credit, collections and cash solutions.
  
  
A central part of the remit is bringing HighRadius into Diageo. The postholder leads the functional architecture and design for the HighRadius Cash Application, Collections and Credit Management modules — and the adjacent capabilities that touch them, such as deductions and integrates them with S/4HANA / ECC FI-AR and FSCM, banks, ClaimOne (under Control Tower) and the wider Customer Operations landscape. HighRadius is an enabler of the target design, not the design itself; the role decides what the process should be first, and then how the platform best delivers it.
  
  
The role combines four capabilities in one person. As a functional solution architect, they own the end-to-end Credit to Cash solution blueprint, the fit-gap against the global standard and the design decisions that hold it together. As a platform expert, they turn the blueprint into working configuration and integration design on HighRadius and SAP FSCM — matching rules, AI models, collection strategies, credit scoring and workflows. As a consultant, they diagnose where cash, credit and collection issues are really created and build the case for the fix. As a design authority, they set standards, review and assure the work of Specialists, system integrators and vendors, and keep the solution coherent as it scales across markets.
  
  
**The defining discipline of this role is architecting the value chain, not the module.**
A well-configured cash application engine is a smaller prize than a remittance that arrives clean; a sophisticated collections strategy is a smaller prize than a credit decision and invoice that never become overdue. The postholder is expected to design the hand-offs — order and credit, invoice and remittance, payment and dispute, AR and the ledger — as carefully as the modules themselves, and to push the fix upstream into O2I, Commercial, master data or the customer setup where that is where the problem starts.
  
  
**Understanding of markets and of upstream and downstream impact is central to the role.**
Credit to Cash outcomes are shaped by pricing, promotions, customer agreements, invoicing, banking practice, local regulation and the retained, GBO and BPO operating model. The postholder is expected to know how these differ across LAC, NAM, Europe, Africa and APAC, to define what must be global standard and what genuinely requires localisation, and to design accordingly.
  
  
**This is a transformation design and architecture role, not an operational one.**
The postholder does not run credit, collections or cash application; that stays with market, GBO and BPO run teams. The role changes how that work is done and ensures the solution handed to run is controlled, measurable and sustainable.
  
  
The role works independently within the frame set by the workstream lead, forms its own view and brings recommendations and design decisions rather than questions. It partners closely with D&T Enterprise and Solution Architecture, which own the technical architecture, and provides functional design direction to Specialists working on Credit to Cash fragments. Decisions are expected to be based on evidence rather than opinion, and every artefact is expected to meet the programme documentation, taxonomy and quality standards, including BPQMS.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities (3-5)**
**Own the end-to-end Credit to Cash functional architecture and target design — 25%.**
Define and maintain the Credit to Cash target process and solution architecture across credit, billing hand-off, collections, cash application, deductions and disputes, AR and close, aligned to the global standard and the target operating model. Lead current-state assessment and fit-gap across markets, platforms and controls, using exception, aging, matching, collection-effectiveness and dispute data to baseline the problem and size the opportunity. Own the solution blueprint, key design decisions and design principles; define what is global standard versus market localisation; and make sure the Credit to Cash design is joined up with O2I, Claims, Commercial and Customer Service.
  
  
**Lead the HighRadius functional solution design and deployment — 25%.**
Act as functional lead for bringing HighRadius into Diageo across Cash Application, Collections and Credit Management. Design remittance capture and cash-application rules toward straight-through posting — bank, lockbox, EDI 820, email and portal remittances, matching logic, auto-match and AI-led recommendations, unapplied-cash and exception handling. Design risk-based collection strategies, segmentation, prioritised worklists, automated dunning and correspondence, promise-to-pay and dispute routing. Design credit applications, scoring models, credit-limit setting and review cycles, blocked-order release and credit workflows. Lead fit-gap, configuration design, functional specifications and sign-off with HighRadius, system integrators and D&T, and shape the multi-market deployment approach and template.
  
  
**Design integration, data and controls across the Credit to Cash landscape — 20%.**
Own the functional design of data flows and integration between HighRadius, SAP S/4HANA / ECC FSCM, banks and payment providers, ClaimOne, customer portals and the reporting layer — customer master, open items, payments, postings, disputes, credit exposure and limits. Define master-data and reference-data requirements, reason-code frameworks and posting logic. Embed financial controls, segregation of duties, audit trail and SOX / internal-control requirements in the design, and define the KPIs and reporting — DSO, CEI, overdue, auto-match rate, unapplied cash, credit-decision cycle time, exception and resolution time — that let the business manage the process in BAU.
  
  
**Deliver the outcome and assure design quality through the value drops — 20%.**
Break the architecture into fragments that can be delivered on the two to four week value drop cadence, and act as design authority on each: review requirements, specifications, configuration and test coverage produced by Specialists, integrators and vendors. Define end-to-end test scenarios, lead integrated SIT and UAT across the value chain, and own resolution of design-level defects. Support cutover, data migration, deployment, hypercare and handover into run. Monitor post-go-live performance against the baseline and drive continuous improvement in automation rates, exception volume and resolution time. This is the accountability every other accountability serves.
  
  
**Shape the roadmap and lead across the programme — 10%.**
Own the Credit to Cash functional roadmap: sequencing of modules and markets, adoption of new HighRadius and SAP capability, AI and automation opportunities, and retirement of legacy tools and manual workarounds. Act as trusted adviser to the workstream lead, market Finance, Credit and Collections leaders, GBO, D&T and vendors. Coach and guide Specialists on Credit to Cash design, and surface cross-boundary impact with Order-to-Invoice, Claims, Customer Service and Record-to-Report before it becomes a deployment defect.
  
  
**Key Competencies (3)**

* End-to-end Credit to Cash mastery and functional architecture. Expert, end-to-end knowledge of the Credit to Cash value chain — credit risk and credit management, collections and dunning, payments and cash application, deductions, claims and disputes, AR accounting, reconciliation and close — and of how each step drives the next. Able to design an integrated target process and solution architecture, run a fit-gap, make and document design decisions, and balance global standard against local need. Built on a broad understanding of Customer Operations end to end (Order to Cash, Commercial and Supply) and of how markets actually work. Knows Consumer Products industry standards and the realities of Beer, Wine & Spirits — distributor and wholesaler concentration, complex customer agreements, deduction-laden remittances, multi-currency receipts and diverse banking practice. Working knowledge of Diageo BPQMS standards.
* HighRadius and SAP platform depth, integration and data. Hands-on functional depth in HighRadius Cash Application, Collections and Credit Management — configuration, matching and AI models, strategies, worklists, workflows and scoring — and in SAP FI-AR and FSCM (Credit, Collections and Dispute Management), including how the two integrate. Understands the data model, interfaces, bank formats, posting logic and controls beneath the process, and can work credibly with technical architects and integrators on integration patterns. Comfortable interrogating data directly to baseline problems and prove outcomes. Strong on solution design documentation, end-to-end testing, cutover and hypercare. Keeps up with the C2C technology market and can judge objectively where a platform fits and where it does not.
* Design authority, influence and leadership. Holds the design line with confidence and evidence — challenges solutions that would not work in the markets and is not satisfied with automating a workaround when the issue could be designed out. Strong stakeholder management and influencing across a global and local matrix, up to senior Finance and Customer Operations leaders, and with vendors and system integrators. Consultative by default: frames the problem before prescribing and drives stakeholders toward aligned decisions. Clear communicator able to explain complex design simply, manage conflict to a resolution and guide less experienced colleagues. Comfortable with ambiguity and with being redeployed across markets and workstreams. Resilient, collaborative and a visible role model for Diageo’s values.

**Qualifications**
**Qualifications and Experience Required:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience in Finance, Accounting, Business, IT or a related discipline; a professional accounting or MBA qualification is an advantage.
* HighRadius certification (Cash Application, Collections or Credit) and / or SAP S/4HANA FI-AR or FSCM certification is preferred. Solution-architecture, Agile / Scrum or Lean Six Sigma credentials are an advantage. Working knowledge of Diageo BPQMS standards.

**Experience — Essential**

* Overall. 12+ years in Credit to Cash / Order to Cash transformation, solution design and consultancy, including at least 5 years in a functional solution architect, solution lead or design authority role on large-scale, multi-market programmes.
* HighRadius. Functional lead or architect on at least two full-lifecycle HighRadius implementations covering Cash Application, Collections and / or Credit Management — from fit-gap and design through configuration, testing, deployment and stabilisation — ideally integrated with SAP.
* End-to-end Credit to Cash. Deep functional understanding of the whole value chain — credit, collections, cash application, deductions and disputes, AR and close — and evidence of designing across it as one solution, not only within a single module. Operational exposure is useful context; the requirement is designing the process, not running it.
* SAP and integration. Strong functional knowledge of SAP FI-AR and FSCM (Credit, Collections, Dispute Management) in S/4HANA or ECC, and experience defining functional integration with banks, lockbox / bank statement formats, EDI and third-party C2C platforms.
* Transformation. Experience in business process transformation across the full lifecycle, including current-state assessment, future-state operating model design, global template definition and multi-market rollout. Evidence of improving auto-match rates, DSO, overdue, exception volume or manual effort against a defensible baseline.
* Consultative and leadership. A track record as a trusted adviser to senior Finance and Operations stakeholders, leading design decisions across global and local teams, directing system integrators and vendors, and guiding analysts and specialists.
* Industry. FMCG or Consumer Products experience is essential. Beer, Wine & Spirits experience is strongly preferred.

**Experience — Desirable**

* Exposure to the wider HighRadius suite (Deductions, EIPP / invoice presentment, Cash Forecasting, Treasury) or to comparable C2C platforms
* Experience applying AI and machine learning in Credit to Cash — remittance capture, matching, collection prioritisation, payment prediction or credit scoring — and designing the controls around it.
* Experience designing for a retained / GBO / BPO operating model, or of a shared services transition or operating model consolidation.
* Experience with credit insurance, credit bureau and rating-agency integrations, e-invoicing and statutory requirements across multiple regions.
* Experience working in a pooled, on-demand or competency-based delivery model across multiple workstreams.

**About Us**
With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations.
  
  
Bring your talent, curiosity and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge, support and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning, improving and raising the bar for our brands, our business and each other.

8fb0e8bc.title: Salesforce Technical Architect - B2B Commerce
8fb0e8bc.description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
Job Category
  
  
Customer Success
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
**The Experience**
As a Technical Architect, you will translate client business requirements into well-architected solutions on the Salesforce platform, including B2B Commerce. You will lead technical design sessions and oversee the delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration for Salesforce implementations.
  
  
You will work closely with client stakeholders and Salesforce product teams to define requirements, set expectations, and support successful implementations. You may also join pre-sales activities such as discovery sessions and proof-of-concept work, and you will travel to client sites for projects.
  
  
**What You'll Actually Be Doing**

* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Translate business requirements into well-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client’s current and desired end states
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues
* From time-to-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep-dive sessions, Proof-Of-Concept (POC) development with prospects
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50-75%

**You’re Our Person If...**

* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including B2B commerce on core, Sales, Service, and Community clouds
* Understanding of B2B sales processes, customer journeys, and e-commerce best practices.
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, ESB, marketing automation, reporting, etc.)
* Understanding of B2B Commerce Einstein Features & Capabilities
* Understanding B2B Commerce Extensions framework
* Understanding on B2B Commerce APIs and Connect APIs
* Understanding of cross cloud use cases (B2B, D2C, Loyalty, Revenue)
* Understanding of Salesforce OMS
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance-driven solutions
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth)
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.)
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Ability to clearly articulate complex technical situations to business and management audiences

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
  
  
Accommodations
  
  
If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.
  
  
Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.
  
  
Posting Statement
  
  
Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

f643a954.title: Specialist Solutions Architect - AI/ML
f643a954.description:
**Job Description**
As an AI/ML Specialist Solutions Architect (SSA), you will be the trusted technical ML & AI expert to both Databricks customers and the Field Engineering organization. You will work with Solution Architects to guide customers in architecting production-grade ML & AI applications on Databricks, while aligning their technical roadmap with the continually evolving Databricks Data Intelligence Platform. You will continue to strengthen your technical skills through applying cutting-edge technologies in GenAI, MLOps, and ML more broadly, expanding your impact through mentorship, and establishing yourself as an AI thought leader.
  
  
This is a Hybrid role, based in Bengaluru.
  
  
The impact you will have
  
  

* Architect production-level ML & AI workloads for customers using our unified platform, including agents, end-to-end ML pipelines, training/inference optimization, integration with cloud-native services, MLOps, etc.
* Serve as a trusted practitioner for enterprise GenAI solutions, including RAG architectures, agentic systems (tool-calling agents, multi-agent orchestration, guardrails), natural language querying of structured data, AI evaluation and observability, and monitoring systems
* Build, scale, and optimize customer AI workloads and apply best-in-class MLOps to productionize these workloads across a variety of domains
* Provide advanced technical support to Solution Architects during the technical sale, ranging from feature engineering, training, tracking, serving, to model monitoring, all within a single platform, as well as participating in the larger ML SME community in Databricks
* Collaborate cross-functionally with the product and engineering teams to represent the voice of the customer, define priorities, and influence the product roadmap, helping with the adoption of Databricks’ AI offerings

What we look for
  
  

* 5+ years of hands-on industry ML experience in at least one of the following:
* ML Engineer: Build and maintain production-grade cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP) infrastructure that supports the deployment of ML applications, including drift monitoring.
* AI Engineer: Experience with the latest techniques in LLMs & agentic systems, including vector databases, fine-tuning LLMs, AI guardrail systems, and deploying LLMs with tools such as HuggingFace, Langchain, and OpenAI
* Graduate degree in a quantitative discipline (Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Operations Research, etc.) or equivalent practical experience
* Experience communicating and/or teaching technical concepts to non-technical and technical audiences alike
* Passion for collaboration, life-long learning, and driving business value through ML & AI
* [Preferred] 2+ years customer-facing experience in a pre-sales or post-sales role
* Can meet expectations for technical training and role-specific outcomes within 3 months of hire
* Can travel up to 30% when needed

**About Databricks**
Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.
  
  
**Benefits**
At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here.
  
  
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
  
  
At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.
  
  
Compliance
  
  
If access to export-controlled technology or source code is required for performance of job duties, it is within Employer's discretion whether to apply for a U.S. government license for such positions, and Employer may decline to proceed with an applicant on this basis alone.

0db1a123.description:
**Description -**
We are looking for a
**Senior data architect / Techno functional Integration specialist**
who will be responsible for leading the integration architecture, design, development, and implementation of supply chain planning solutions, including Forecasting, supply planning, inventory optimization and available to promise. You will work closely with senior leadership, business stakeholders, and external partners to
**align integration of IT strategy with the business goals and deliver innovative, scalable, secure, integrated solutions**
. You will also collaborate with a team of highly talented IT professionals to create system, data and process architectural blueprints leveraging latest technologies ensuring adherence to enterprise standards. This position requires
**individual to bring in thought leadership on latest data / integration guidelines**
,
**industry standard best practices, technology trends including AI**
- aligned to SAP’s forward looking product roadmap. Exposure to AI tools is a must and direct experience building AI solutions for data management is preferred.
  
  
**Detailed Job Description / Key Responsibilities**

* Strategy and vision: Define and execute data / integration strategy roadmap for supply chain planning, ensuring alignment with the business strategy and priorities.
* Solution delivery: Lead Data / Integration workstream for all supply chain planning programs with SAP Embedded BW / Integrated business planner (IBP) as the core platform, managing end-to-end project lifecycle, from scoping and planning to testing and deployment. Strong techno functional knowledge of Master and transaction data needed for planning is MANDATORY.
* Design integration strategies, data maps while minimizing data footprints across landscape.
* Integration leadership: Manage integration of SAP embedded BW / SAP business technology platform (BTP), cloud platform integration for data services (CI-DS) with other systems and applications, such as SAP S4 HANA, SAP IBP and related third-party tools.
* System Interoperability: Design, build, and govern enterprise-wide data pipelines.
* Operational stability: Oversee the maintenance, support, and enhancement of all integrations existing in supply chain planning systems and applications, ensuring optimal performance, availability, and security.
* Manage a team of IT professionals, providing guidance, coaching, and feedback, and fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and excellence.
* Stakeholder management: Establish and maintain effective relationships with senior leadership, business stakeholders, and external partners, acting as a trusted advisor and a key point of contact for IT-related matters.
* Identify, evaluate, and recommend competitive and/or new alternative data integration technologies and products which further the enterprise application and data strategy.

**Skills / Qualifications**

* Extensive domain knowledge of supply chain planning with deep technical expertise and strong knowledge of master and transaction data.
* Minimum 15-18 years of IT experience, with at least 10 years in a techno functional leadership role and comprehensive understanding of AI tools / solutions, relevant to data management.
* Proven track record of successfully delivering large-scale and complex cross function IT projects, preferably in the supply chain planning domain.
* Extensive experience with SAP embedded BW / BTP / CI-DS, including architecture, configuration, customization, integration, testing, and deployment. Candidate must be ‘hands on’ for consideration.
* Strong knowledge of SAP EBW, S4 HANA, SAP business technology platform (BTP) and other SAP modules and applications related to supply chain planning, with deep expertise in SAP system capabilities.
* Knowledge of AI models specific to enhancing data quality along with deployment expertise.
* Excellent communication, influencing, presentation, and interpersonal skills, ability to communicate effectively with senior leadership, business stakeholders, and external partners.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and independent decision-making skills, with the ability to handle multiple tasks and prioritize effectively.
* Capable to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment and adapt to changing business needs and requirements.
* Willingness to travel internationally as needed.

Lead voice and digital AI self-service solutions for large, multi-location contact centers.
  
  
Design, develop, and implement AI self-service applications using

.
  
  
Interface directly with clients to lead design decisions and define solution requirements.
  
  
Serve as project lead for assigned Google CCAI implementations.
  
  
Collaborate with conversation designers and project teams on IVA specifications.

208573d2.description:
**Role & responsibilities**

  

The Senior Cloud Site Reliability Engineer (Senior Cloud SRE) is responsible for ensuring the reliability, scalability, availability, performance, security, and operational excellence for cloud platforms and critical product infrastructure.

This role combines software engineering, cloud engineering, automation, observability, and operational governance practices to build highly resilient and self-healing platforms across hybrid and cloud-native environments. The ideal candidate will drive SRE best practices, improve service reliability through automation, establish observability standards, and partner closely with Engineering, Product, Security, DBA, and DevEx teams to improve operational maturity across the organization.

The role requires deep expertise in cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, DevOps/SRE principles, telemetry, incident management, monitoring, and automation, along with strong collaboration and communication skills.

***Site Reliability Engineering & Operational Excellence***

* Drive and implement Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) best practices across cloud platforms and services.
* Define, maintain, and improve:

+ Service Level Indicators (SLIs)
+ Service Level Objectives (SLOs)
+ Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
+ Error Budgets

* Improve service reliability, resiliency, scalability, and operational efficiency.
* Establish operational standards, reliability governance, and production readiness practices.
* Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA), postmortems, and reliability improvement initiatives.
* Participate in on-call rotations, incident management, and major incident resolution activities.
* Continuously improving operational processes to reduce Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) and Mean Time to Resolve (MTTR)

***Observability, Monitoring & Telemetry***

* Design, implement, and maintain enterprise observability and telemetry platforms.
* Build operational dashboards, reliability scorecards, and service health monitoring solutions.
* Configure proactive alerting, anomaly detection, and incident correlation mechanisms.
* Implement centralized monitoring and telemetry using:

+ Grafana
+ Prometheus
+ Azure Monitor
+ Log Analytics
+ ELK Stack / ElasticSearch
+ Power BI dashboards

* Develop actionable operational metrics and telemetry reporting for engineering and leadership teams.
* Enhance visibility into infrastructure, application, Kubernetes, and platform health.

***Automation & Auto-Healing Engineering***

* Drive automation-first operational practices across infrastructure and platform services.
* Develop Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) solutions using:

+ Terraform
+ ARM/Bicep
+ Ansible

* Build operational automation scripts using:

+ Python
+ Bash
+ PowerShell

* Develop self-healing and auto-remediation capabilities for recurring operational incidents.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning, monitoring, scaling, backup, recovery, and deployment workflows.
* Reduce manual operational effort and improve engineering productivity through intelligent automation.

***Collaboration & Engineering Partnership***

* Collaborate closely with:

+ Cloud Engineering teams
+ Product Engineering teams
+ DevEx teams
+ Security teams
+ DBA teams
+ Operations teams

* Support engineering teams in improving production readiness and operational maturity.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, reliability reviews, and operational excellence programs.

**Experience**

* Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience/certification).
* Knowledge of Python, scripting, or Infrastructure-as-Code tools (e.g., Terraform, Ansible, ARM/Bicep).
* Experience managing cloud platforms (e.g., Azure, AKS, Pivotal Cloud Foundry, or equivalent).
* Strong understanding of Kubernetes and containerization concepts.
* Experience with application packaging, deployment automation, and release management.
* Solid knowledge of relational databases (MS-SQL) and exposure to NoSQL technologies (e.g., Redis, ElasticSearch, MongoDB).
* Experience with CI/CD tools (Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar).
* Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools (Grafana, ELK stack, Prometheus, PowerBI, etc.).
* Proficiency with Git and modern branching/merging workflows.
* Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting skills.
* Excellent problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills.

b55b3366.description:
**Overview**
Are you passionate about helping organizations transform the way people work through AI? As a
**Digital Solution Engineer, AI Workforce**
, you will be a trusted technical advisor to customers, helping them envision, design, validate, and adopt AI-powered solutions across Microsoft 365 Copilot, agents, and the broader Microsoft AI ecosystem.
  
  
You will partner with customers and sales teams to lead the
**technical decision**
, translating business challenges into secure, scalable solutions and demonstrating how AI can deliver meaningful business outcomes. You will use your technical expertise and consultative skills to conduct technical discovery, deliver compelling L300+ demonstrations and workshops, design solution architectures, build prototypes and agents, and lead proofs of concept that demonstrate value in the customer's environment.
  
  
As part of Microsoft's AI Workforce team, you will help customers move from
**AI possibility to practical implementation**
, bringing together Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio and agentic experiences to address real business scenarios. You will engage technical and business decision-makers to remove technical blockers, shape the solution approach, and build customer confidence in adopting AI responsibly and at scale.
  
  
You will also contribute to a broader community of solution engineers, sharing reusable technical patterns, demonstrations and customer learnings while drawing on Microsoft's senior technical experts for complex opportunities. The DSE organization emphasizes architecture validation, workshops, POCs, rapid prototyping, technical depth and community-based knowledge sharing rather than routine presentations or basic product demonstrations.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead technical engagements: Serve as a trusted technical advisor to customers, leading technical discovery and translating business requirements into secure, scalable AI and modern-work solutions.
* Drive the technical decision: Design and deliver compelling technical demonstrations, architecture sessions, workshops, rapid prototypes, pilots, and proofs of concept that demonstrate the value of Microsoft solutions and help customers confidently make technology decisions.
* Build AI-powered solutions: Apply hands-on expertise across Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, agents, and the broader Microsoft AI ecosystem to develop solutions addressing customers' business scenarios.
* Accelerate AI transformation: Help customers move from AI experimentation to adoption by identifying high-value use cases, validating technical feasibility, addressing technical blockers, and demonstrating measurable business value.
* Design secure and scalable architectures: Guide customers on solution architecture, security, governance, identity, data readiness, integration, and responsible AI considerations required to deploy AI solutions successfully.
* Engage technical and business decision-makers: Build trusted relationships with customer stakeholders, understand their technology strategy and priorities, and articulate how Microsoft's AI capabilities can support their transformation objectives.
* Collaborate to win: Partner with sales teams, specialists, architects, engineering teams, partners, and other technical experts to develop comprehensive solutions and successfully navigate complex customer requirements.
* Showcase technical excellence: Maintain deep technical expertise and continuously develop skills across AI, agents, Microsoft 365, security, and emerging technologies while bringing Microsoft's latest innovations into customer engagements.
* Scale technical impact: Capture and share customer insights, technical patterns, reusable demonstrations, architectures, best practices, and learnings to strengthen the broader technical community.
* Embody Microsoft's culture: Demonstrate a growth mindset, customer obsession, collaboration, inclusion, integrity, and accountability in customer and team engagements.

**Qualifications**
Bachelor's degree in
**Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Technology**
, or a related field, OR equivalent practical experience.
  
  
Experience in a
**technical pre-sales, solution engineering, solution architecture, technical consulting, or customer-facing technology role**
, with the ability to translate business requirements into compelling technical solutions.
  
  
Strong understanding of
**Microsoft 365 and AI-powered productivity solutions**
, with knowledge of areas such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, agents, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, Microsoft Graph, Power Platform, or related technologies.
  
  
Demonstrated ability to deliver
**hands-on technical engagements**
, including technical demonstrations, architecture and whiteboarding sessions, workshops, rapid prototypes, pilots, or proofs of concept. This directly reflects the FY27 DSE expectation to prioritize high-value technical activities over basic presentations and demonstrations.
  
  
Understanding of
**enterprise security, identity, data governance, compliance and responsible AI**
considerations relevant to deploying AI solutions in enterprise environments. Current AIWF execution guidance specifically calls for DSEs to resolve technical, governance and compliance concerns during customer engagements.
  
  
Ability to engage and communicate effectively with
**technical and business decision-makers**
, connecting technology capabilities to customer requirements and business outcomes.
  
  
Strong
**problem-solving, technical communication and consultative skills**
, with the ability to navigate complex customer environments and collaborate across sales, engineering, partners and customer teams.
  
  
This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
  
  
Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. 175734ef.title: Solutions Architect, ISV
175734ef.description:
**Description**
AWS Global Sales (AGS) drives adoption of the AWS Cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud.
  
  
Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud.
  
  
AWS is where innovation, risks, and ideas are celebrated. We are builders; we try new things, imagine big dreams and reuse whenever we can. It is still Day 1 for us, and we are looking for curious people to be part of our diverse teams of thinkers, problem solvers, and doers. Come join us and work with AWS technologies that enable our Independent Software Vendor (ISV) customers and partners to adopt cloud-based solutions.
  
  
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
This role is within the ISV team in Amazon Web Services India (AWS India) and can be based out of Bangalore, Delhi, Mumbai, Pune and Hyderabad locations.
  
  
As a Solutions Architect, you’ll help your customers plan their successful cloud journey leveraging emerging technologies like GenAI to achieve business outcomes. You’ll solve complex, technical challenges so your customers can focus on their business. This includes using your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures. You’ll drive or take part in technical solutions discussions, diving deep into the details with customer teams.
  
  
Building relationships to understand our customers and partners is key. As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll use your interpersonal skills to influence a variety of stakeholders from technical teams to executives. You’ll help ensure their short-term technology decisions are aligned with their long-term goals. Speeding up the adoption of our services will be part of your day to day.
  
  
You’ll also act as thought leader in the wider community. This includes taking part in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops. You won’t just be part of an industry movement; you’ll be leading it.
  
  
As a customer obsessed advisor, you’ll also have the chance to shape the direction of our products and services. This is through gathering feedback from customers whilst collaborating with our engineering and service teams.
  
  
To be successful in this role you need to be passionate about ISV and cloud architectures. You are a builder with genuine curiosity about how technology can support your customers’ business models and objectives.
  
  
Want to find out what it’s like to be a Solution Architect at AWS? Watch this video (https://bit.ly/3keYcC9).
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
The Solutions Architect team at AWS is responsible for helping customers successfully implement cloud technologies. In a typical week you will meet multiple customers, and you will collaborate with them on designing and operating well-architected solutions. You will earn their trust and show them the art of the possible, educating them around the capabilities of AWS. Partnering with internal teams and experts, leveraging a deep knowledge of our tools and products, you’ll craft highly scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures that address our customers’ business problems. As part of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to continuously learn and innovate daily.
  
  
**About The Team**
ISV Solutions Architects work hand in hand with AWS customers to help drive AWS services adoption. They are at the crossroads of business and technology and engage with customers of different stages. Supporting the overall technical relationship between customers and AWS, they work to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology. Solutions Architects also have broader impact at scale, taking a supporting role in creating and presenting technical content and best practices.
  
  
You will be part of a team that is responsible for driving adoption of AWS technologies while bringing differentiated value to customers. This is a team dedicated to ISV customers, an important and growing subset of customers for AWS India. ISV customers follow unique technology adoption patterns and growth trajectories that distinguish them from traditional businesses, so you will be employing engagement strategies and programs tailored to their business needs and technical preferences.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Experience in design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures
* Experience in a similar role such as technical account manager, consultant, solutions architect, platform engineer, systems engineer, cloud architect, or service delivery manager
* Experience in specific technology domain areas like software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data and analytics
* 4+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* Experience contributing to the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems, or experience in computer architecture

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of AWS services
* Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud
* Experience architecting/operating solutions built on AWS
* Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
* AWS certification, such as, AWS Solutions Architect, or a similar cloud certification
* Experience conveying complex technical concepts to both technical and business audiences
* 4+ years of cloud architecture and solution implementation experience, or degree in advanced technology

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
  
  
  
**Company**
- AWS India - Karnataka

**Job Profile Summary**

The Senior Commercial Architect is an advanced subject matter expert, responsible for taking the commercial lead for client engagements.

This role is responsible for positioning the commercial capabilities of the organization to clients, leading a commercial pursuit team and ensuring that client solutions are commercially optimized, innovative and profitable.

This role ensures the balance of risk and reward is reached through detailed financial analysis, considered risk management and clearly aligned interaction with the legal team.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Provides recommendations and reviews the pricing and costing of deals to ensure maximum benefit and minimum risk to the organization and prepares the commercial parts of sales proposals for submission to clients.
* Builds and compiles pricing models for specific proposals and provides input into the development of standardized pricing models.
* Presents key pricing assumptions and risks for sign-off at relevant levels, in line with the authority matrix.
* Engages with and leverages off relationships between the organization and vendors and/or subcontractors and strategic alliances, including the Legal Team during the conception, construction, and review of client proposals, soliciting information, and escalating queries.
* Ensures that deal profitability is not eroded over time by calculating the long-term profit of deals, evaluating and concluding on foreign currency issues and the impacts of these both financially and contractually.
* Ensures deal profitability by investigating taxation, inflationary movements cost of living issues, etc.
* Provides support to relevant team by assisting with the maintenance of vendor warranties to ensure inclusion in the construction of deals.
* Analyses pricing impacts on cash flow for the client and take responsibility for building pricing profiles.
* Mitigates risks in terms of the calculation and payment of penalties, contract termination, building agreements, limitation of liability, and non-solicitation for bids and/or deals and provides feedback to the key stakeholders regarding these.
* Manages commercial and contract risks associated with the client agreement to protect the organization's profitability and legal exposure.
* Prepares contract and financial budgets, reports and summaries, as require, including profitability and cashflow analysis.
* Performs any other relevant task as requested by management.

  

**Knowledge and Attributes:**

* Solid understanding of the local operating, commercial and general business conditions.
* Expert negotiation skills with lateral thinking ability.
* Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Solid business and commercial acumen coupled with an analytical mind.
* Ability to work under pressure without compromising quality and accuracy.
* Solid team skills, particularly engaging with the team to continuously develop own expertise.
* Solid communication skills, especially related to facilitation, documentation, and reporting.
* Solid Microsoft Office skills (Excel/Word/PowerPoint).
* Highly numerate and display high levels of integrity.

  

**Academic Qualifications and Certifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Business Administration or Finance or a related field.

  

**Required experience:**

* Advanced experience working within a Commercial or similar field, preferably within a global IT services organization.
* Advanced experience working with pricing assumptions and developing pricing models.
* Advanced demonstrated experience in deal structuring, pricing review, and negotiation.
* Advanced experience working with vendors and/or suppliers.
* Advanced experience in an accounting type role.
