ec819fee.title: Agile Delivery Manager - VOIS
ec819fee.description:
**Who we are**
--------------

VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

**About this Role**
-------------------

We are seeking an Agile Delivery Manager to own squad-level delivery within Security Monitoring & Analytics, part of Global Cyber Security. You will focus on delivering committed outcomes predictably through effective planning, tracking, dependency management, risk and issue management, stakeholder alignment and transparent reporting.  
Working closely with the Technical Product Owner, Tech Leads and Release Train Engineer, you will support PI readiness, effective sprint execution and timely escalation when delivery is at risk. Agile practices and ceremonies will enable delivery outcomes, with a strong focus on flow, transparency and continuous improvement.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

Own the end-to-end squad delivery lifecycle, including delivery plans, milestones, sequencing and commitments aligned with PI objectives.  
Improve delivery predictability and transparency by actively managing scope, timelines, capacity and delivery flow.  
Maintain accurate, relevant and timely delivery reporting.  
Identify, track and support the removal of blockers, escalating unresolved impediments and driving actions through to closure.  
Manage squad-level risks, issues, actions and dependencies (RAID), ensuring clear ownership, mitigation and timely escalation.  
Lead squad readiness and execution for PI Planning, including estimation, capacity planning, dependencies, risks and constraints.  
Ensure PI Planning outputs are accurately produced, documented and shared.  
Provide delivery governance and reporting covering sprint progress, delivery confidence, PI objectives, risks, issues, dependencies and adjustments against plan.  
Contribute delivery information to PI, ART and leadership reporting where required.  
Facilitate stand-ups, refinement, sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives, ensuring ceremonies remain focused on delivery outcomes.  
Coach and support squad members in improving Agile ways of working and maintaining consistent delivery.  
Follow through on improvement actions while supporting team morale and a sustainable delivery pace.  
Work collaboratively across squads and stakeholder groups to manage dependencies and maintain delivery transparency.

**Who you are**
---------------

You have proven delivery management experience in complex, cross-functional environments, with a focus on delivery predictability, flow and transparency.  
You have strong knowledge of SAFe and Agile delivery practices, including PI Planning, capacity planning, dependency management, forecasting and delivery reporting.  
You proactively develop a detailed understanding of squad deliverables and accountabilities and use this insight to support effective planning and execution.  
You have experience managing risks, issues, dependencies and impediments, with the ability to coordinate stakeholders and drive resolution.  
You can balance capacity, scope, timelines and risks, applying sound judgement when delivery moves away from plan.  
You have excellent stakeholder management, facilitation and communication skills, including the ability to provide transparent and timely escalation.  
You have strong reporting and documentation capabilities and can translate delivery data into clear insights for stakeholders and leadership.  
You have experience using tools such as Azure DevOps, Jira or Confluence for backlog management, delivery tracking and reporting.  
Experience within Security Monitoring & Analytics or SOC modernisation programmes would be beneficial but is not essential.  
Relevant certifications such as SAFe Scrum Master, PRINCE2, PMP or ITIL would be beneficial but are not essential.

**Not a perfect fit?**
----------------------

Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

**What's in it for you**
------------------------

Opportunity to work within Global Cyber Security and contribute to Security Monitoring & Analytics delivery.  
Exposure to complex, cross-functional cybersecurity delivery and PI-level planning.  
Collaboration with Technical Product Owners, Tech Leads, Release Train Engineers and wider stakeholder groups.  
Opportunity to influence delivery predictability, transparency and continuous improvement across squad-level delivery.

**What skills you will learn**
------------------------------

Deeper practical experience of SAFe delivery and PI Planning within a cybersecurity environment.  
Advanced RAID, dependency and delivery-flow management.  
Delivery forecasting and reporting using tools such as Azure DevOps, Jira and Confluence.  
Stakeholder coordination and escalation across squads and Agile Release Train structures.  
Greater domain exposure to Security Monitoring & Analytics and SOC modernisation.

**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
----------------------------------------------

Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.

**Join Us**
-----------

At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
  
We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
  
With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

**Job Description**
We are looking for an experienced AI Delivery Lead to drive large-scale AI transformation programs across enterprise clients. This leadership role requires a strong blend of technical expertise, delivery excellence, program management, and stakeholder engagement. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience delivering enterprise AI solutions, including Agentic AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, and AI/ML platforms, while managing global teams and complex client engagements.
  
  
The candidate should be a techno-functional leader capable of translating business objectives into scalable AI solutions and ensuring successful program execution from strategy through implementation.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead end-to-end delivery of large-scale AI, Generative AI, Agentic AI, and Machine Learning programs.
* Define delivery strategy, execution roadmap, governance, and operating models for enterprise AI initiatives.
* Partner with business stakeholders to understand strategic objectives and translate them into scalable AI solutions.
* Drive multiple concurrent AI transformation programs, ensuring timely delivery, quality, and customer satisfaction.
* Lead cross-functional teams comprising Architects, Data Scientists, AI Engineers, ML Engineers, Data Engineers, and Product teams.
* Establish delivery governance, risk management, resource planning, budgeting, and program reporting.
* Drive adoption of AI best practices, Responsible AI principles, and enterprise AI governance.
* Collaborate with Sales, Presales, and Solution teams to support proposals, solution design, and client presentations.
* Mentor delivery managers and technical leaders while building high-performing AI delivery teams.
* Stay current with emerging AI technologies and identify opportunities to accelerate business transformation.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 16+ years of experience in Technology Delivery, Digital Transformation, or Enterprise Program Delivery.
* Proven experience managing large-scale AI/GenAI transformation programs for enterprise clients.
* Strong understanding of Agentic AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, LLMs, and AI automation.
* Experience delivering AI solutions on cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Strong knowledge of AI architecture, MLOps, data engineering, and enterprise integration.
* Experience managing distributed global delivery teams and multiple client engagements.
* Excellent stakeholder management with CXO-level client interaction.
* Strong financial management, delivery governance, and program management expertise.
* Experience working in Agile and hybrid delivery environments.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience leading AI Centers of Excellence (CoE) or AI practice teams.
* Exposure to Agentic AI frameworks, RAG architectures, AI orchestration, and enterprise LLM platforms.
* Knowledge of Responsible AI, AI governance, and regulatory compliance.
* MBA or relevant leadership certifications are an added advantage.

**About The Team**
eClerx is a global leader in productized services, bringing together people, technology and domain expertise to amplify business results. Our mission is to set the benchmark for client service and success in our industry. Our vision is to be the innovation partner of choice for technology, data analytics and process management services. Since our inception in 2000, we've partnered with top companies across various industries, including financial services, telecommunications, retail, and high-tech. Our innovative solutions and domain expertise help businesses optimize operations, improve efficiency, and drive growth. With over 18,000 employees worldwide, eClerx is dedicated to delivering excellence through smart automation and data-driven insights. At eClerx, we believe in nurturing talent and providing hands-on experience.
  
  
eClerx is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability or protected veteran status, or any other legally protected basis, per applicable law.

9126013b.title: CDTR - Enterprise Technology Solutions - MS - Manager
9126013b.description:
The Opportunity
  
  
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
  
  
As a Manager in Enterprise Technology Solutions, you will play a pivotal role in consulting services for business applications, focusing on optimizing operational efficiency for clients. You will analyze client needs, implement software solutions, and provide training and support to validate seamless integration and utilization of business applications, enabling clients to achieve their strategic objectives. Within our Cyber, Data & Tech Risk practice, you will focus on validating compliance and enhancing security within Oracle applications, analyzing client requirements, implementing security measures, and offering guidance for compliance with regulatory standards.
  
  
As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for project success and maintaining standards, motivating and inspiring others to deliver quality. You will be responsible for coaching, leveraging team members' unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. With your growing knowledge of business operations, you will identify opportunities that contribute to the success of our firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values meaningfully. Embracing technology and innovation, you will enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same.
  
  
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will take ownership of projects, confirming their successful planning, budgeting, execution, and completion. You will address conflicts or issues, engaging in conversations with clients, team members, and other stakeholders, escalating where appropriate.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Leading the implementation of Oracle compliance and security measures to protect sensitive data and maintain regulatory standards
* Analyzing client requirements to develop tailored solutions for optimizing operational efficiency within Oracle applications
* Guiding teams in the strategic planning and execution of compliance and security initiatives
* Providing training and support to clients for seamless integration and utilization of business applications
* Developing and overseeing compliance programs to mitigate risks and enhance security frameworks
* Collaborating with client leadership to validate quality, timelines, and deliverables
* Mentoring team members to enhance their skills and performance in delivering client expectations
* Addressing conflicts and engaging in critical conversations with stakeholders to resolve issues
* Embracing technology and innovation to improve service delivery and encourage team adoption of new tools
* Upholding professional and technical standards, including adherence to PwC's code of conduct and independence requirements

What You Must Have
  
  

* At least a Bachelor's degree
* At least 8 years of experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required

What Sets You Apart
  
  

* Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Accounting, Analytics, Business Administration/Management, Business Analytics, Computer Engineering, Computer Programming, Computer and Information Science, Economics, Finance, Information CyberSecurity, Information Technology, Management Information Systems, Risk Management, Statistics, Systems Engineering
* At least one of the following: Oracle Cloud certification in Security, Identity, Governance, Risk Management, or related Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) security domains
* Demonstrating proficiency in Oracle E-Business Suite and Compliance Technology
* Utilizing analytical thinking to enhance compliance and governance frameworks
* Developing policies and guidelines for regulatory compliance program development
* Embracing change and innovation to drive operational performance management
* Mentoring and coaching team members to foster professional growth

97eb9841.title: Program Manager I, Tech (QA Automation)
97eb9841.description:
**About The Team**

* We are the QA Tech Strategy & Automation team within Global Support Services (GSS) Quality Assurance. We make the quality of customer-support tools and experiences measurable, repeatable and AI-assisted.
* We own test automation across mobile (Android/iOS), web and backend systems for multiple lines of business, and we run it on Uber's in-house automation platform as part of CI/CD and release validation.
* We build and apply in-house GenAI solutions to quality engineering: AI-assisted test generation, self-healing tests, automated failure triage and risk-based test prioritization.
* We partner closely with Engineering, Product, Operations and regional QA teams to catch defects at the source and raise release confidence, and we measure it: test coverage, maintenance effort, defect leakage and release reliability.
* We are a collaborative, global team that favors experimentation: prototype quickly, measure accuracy and reliability, then scale what works.

**What You'll Do**

* Own and drive GenAI-based quality engineering programs end to end, from problem definition and prototype through delivery and adoption.
* Build and deploy GenAI solutions (LLMs, agents and automation frameworks) for test generation, regression detection, failure analysis and coverage improvement.
* Integrate these solutions into engineering workflows and CI/CD pipelines so quality signals reach teams early and automatically.
* Turn complex quality problems into working prototypes, evaluate their accuracy and reliability, and work with engineering teams to scale the ones that succeed.
* Define and track metrics for defect detection, testing efficiency, test maintenance effort and release quality, and report progress to stakeholders and leadership.
* Work with Engineering, Product and QA leads to prioritize automation coverage, reduce defect leakage and strengthen release gating.
* Contribute to the team's strategy, roadmap and strategy-of-record, and spread best practices in AI-assisted quality across teams.

**What You'll Need**

* 5+ years in quality engineering, test automation or technical program management, with hands-on ownership of quality initiatives for large-scale software systems.
* Demonstrated experience building and deploying GenAI solutions to quality engineering problems, such as test generation, regression detection, failure analysis and test coverage improvement.
* Proficiency in Python or a similar language, with experience integrating LLMs, agents and automation frameworks into engineering workflows and CI/CD pipelines.
* Ability to turn complex quality challenges into working prototypes, evaluate accuracy and reliability, and partner with engineering teams to scale them.
* Proven ability to drive cross-functional programs from problem definition through delivery, using metrics to show improvements in defect detection, testing efficiency and release quality.

**Ready to Ride?**
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.
  
  
Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.
  
  
Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.

84dd2979.title: Associate Director - Senior Program Manager (M&A)
84dd2979.description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
  
  
Lead complex M&A carve-out, separation, integration and transformation programmes across multiple functions, translating strategic objectives into clear, measurable outcomes and sustainable business value. Provide end-to-end leadership across pre-deal, sign-to-close and post-close phases, ensuring operational readiness, business continuity, effective execution and delivery of deal value.
  
  
Establish integrated transformation plans, governance, priorities and milestones, aligning senior stakeholders around critical value drivers and enabling disciplined decisions on technology, investment and resource allocation. Identify and proactively manage execution risks, dependencies and opportunities across the programme.
  
  
Build an agile, collaborative and innovation-led environment that enables teams to navigate ambiguity, adapt rapidly and deliver at pace. Partner with cross-functional leaders to embed new operating models, realise synergies, drive sustainable performance improvements and ensure transformation outcomes are fully integrated into the business.
  
  
Lead proactive stakeholder engagement and communications, ensuring clear, timely and consistent messaging on programme objectives, progress, risks, decisions and business impacts.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead complex M&A carve-out, separation, integration, and transformation programmes across multiple functions.
* Own end-to-end transaction execution from pre-deal through sign-to-close and post-close delivery.
* Develop and execute integrated transformation plans aligned to strategic objectives, milestones and value drivers.
* Drive senior stakeholder alignment and engagement, ensuring accountability, collaboration and informed decision-making.
* Lead programme communications, delivering clear and consistent messaging across executive, functional and broader stakeholder groups.
* Establish robust governance, reporting and decision-making frameworks to maintain delivery momentum and transparency.
* Drive prioritisation, technology and resource allocation to maximise execution and value.
* Proactively manage risks, dependencies and critical issues, protecting business continuity and delivery outcomes.
* Lead operating model, organisational and business change, ensuring effective implementation and adoption.
* Build an agile, high-performing and innovation-led culture capable of delivering through ambiguity and change.
* Embed transformation outcomes into business-as-usual operations, ensuring benefits realisation and long-term sustainability.
* Lead data disposition strategy across structured and unstructured sources including ERP datasets driving data governance, tooling, automation throughout M&A lifecycle.

**Education & Professional Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
* Programme management certifications desirable (e.g., Managing Successful Programmes, PMI Program Management Professional, PRINCE2 or SAFe).

**Area of Specialisation**

* Large-scale technology transformation and merger, acquisition and separation delivery, covering due diligence, Day One readiness and transition arrangements.
* Expertise in enterprise transformation, programme governance, stakeholder management, executive communications & organisational change.

**Job-Related Experience**

* Minimum 15+ years’ relevant professional experience, including significant experience in M&A integration, separation, carve-out, due diligence, data disposition or post-deal value realisation.
* Minimum 15+ years’ experience leading complex, multi-workstream programmes, with demonstrated responsibility for governance, risk management, dependencies and delivery.
* Demonstrable experience of managing and influencing senior/executive stakeholders across complex programmes, with strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to apply structured problem-solving, data disposition and analytics to support business decisions and improve programme outcomes; experience using GenAI or similar emerging technologies is desirable.
* Demonstrable experience working across multiple functions, geographies or distributed teams, with the flexibility to travel in line with business requirements.

**Desirable**

* Full M&A Lifecycle Experience – Experience across multiple stages of the M&A lifecycle, including due diligence, sign-to-close, Day 1 readiness, integration, carve-out, separation and post-deal value realisation.
* Cross-Functional Integration Experience – Experience delivering complex integration or separation programmes across multiple business functions, including Technology/IT, Finance, HR, R&D, Commercial or Supply Chain.
* TSA & Transition Management – Demonstrated experience in the design, structuring, governance and execution of Transition Service Agreements (TSAs).
* Consulting & Transformation Experience – Previous experience in management consulting, strategy, operations or large-scale business transformation within complex or global organisations.
* Digital, Data & GenAI Capability – Experience using data, analytics, automation or GenAI-enabled tools to improve programme delivery, generate insights and support decision-making.
* 5 or more International M&A deals experience – Experience delivering cross-border transactions, particularly across US and EMEA markets, and working effectively with geographically distributed teams.
* Led data disposition and M&A data strategy across structured, unstructured environments, including ERP datasets, leveraging automation, AI, and technology tooling to accelerate data discovery, classification, governance, retention, separation, and compliant disposal.

**Skills**
Agile Methodology, Agile Project Management, Change Management, Compliance Risk Management, Cross-Functional Collaboration, Data Analytics, Delivery Management, Financial Budgeting, Governance Management, Key Performance Indicators (KPI), KPI Analysis, M&A Integration, M&A Transition Service Agreements (TSAs), Microsoft Programmes, Problem Solving, Program Management, Project Management, Resource Management, Shareholder Communications
  
  
**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
  
  
People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.
  
  
**Inclusion at GSK:**
As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.
  
  
Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.
  
  
**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**
GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.
  
  
It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.
  
  
**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**
If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

2b3d7ae4.title: AI Security Solutions Lead
2b3d7ae4.description:
**About Astellas**

Astellas is a global life sciences company committed to turning innovative science into VALUE for patients. We provide transformative therapies in disease areas that include oncology, ophthalmology, urology, immunology and women's health. Through our research and development programs, we are pioneering new healthcare solutions for diseases with high unmet medical need. Learn more at Astellas.com

Are you driven to make a real difference in the lives of patients?

We're seeking passionate individuals who thrive in dynamic environments, embrace new ideas, and aren't afraid to take intelligent risks. People who act with unwavering integrity and are deeply committed to making a tangible impact.

  

**Purpose and Scope:**

Shape how a global pharmaceutical company adopts AI safely. As AI Security Solutions Lead, you will set the security architecture, standards and guardrails for the AI systems Astellas uses and builds, from copilots and agents to AI supporting research and regulated (GxP) processes, and lead the AI security program as it moves from build into day-to-day operation.

Responsibilities and Accountabilities:

Scope: Generative AI, AI agents and multi-agent systems, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI platforms and APIs, and foundation model integrations, whether bought or built in-house, including GxP-regulated uses.

Architecture & Standards: Own the AI security architecture strategy and roadmap; define AI security standards, guardrails and reference architectures for generative, agentic and RAG systems on Astellas' Microsoft-based AI platforms (e.g., Copilot, Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Agent 365); and keep them aligned with enterprise security architecture and frameworks such as NIST AI RMF, OWASP Top 10 for LLMs, MITRE ATLAS, ISO 42001 and the EU AI Act.

Design Reviews & Threat Modeling: Lead security architecture reviews and threat modeling for new and high-risk AI solutions; define the design mitigations required; and set the security requirements for the secure AI and agent development lifecycle.

Program Delivery: Drive the AI security program end to end, including bringing AI security monitoring, incident response, threat modeling, red teaming and AI vendor risk capabilities into day-to-day operation by the Astellas team; oversee our implementation partner's Secure AI delivery; set priorities and report progress and AI security posture to leadership.

Emerging Technology: Evaluate new AI technologies, attack techniques and defensive approaches, and advise on AI platform and security tool selection.

Partnership & Leadership: Act as the primary AI security advisor to enterprise and solution architects, AI engineers, data scientists and AI governance; present recommendations to technical leadership and governance bodies; and mentor the AI security engineers and analysts.

  

Required Qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Engineering or a related field.
* 10+ years in cybersecurity, including 5+ years in security architecture.
* 2+ years securing AI, machine learning or generative AI systems.

Experience leading cross-functional initiatives with global stakeholders and overseeing external partners or vendors, including leading or mentoring a team.

* Experience designing secure cloud architectures (Azure preferred) and leading architecture reviews and threat modeling.
* Strong understanding of AI/ML architectures, including large language models, agents and RAG.
* Ability to explain complex risk clearly to technical and executive audiences.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Experience in pharmaceutical, life sciences or other regulated industries, including GxP.

  

* Hands-on experience with Microsoft AI and security platforms (Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, Entra, Defender, Purview, Sentinel).

  

* Knowledge of enterprise architecture frameworks such as SABSA or TOGAF.

  

* Master's degree in a related field.

  

* Certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, SABSA, Microsoft Cybersecurity Architect Expert (SC-100) or an AI governance certification (e.g., IAPP AIGP).

**Working Environment:**

At Astellas we recognize the importance of work/life balance, and we are proud to offer a hybrid working solution allowing time to connect with colleagues at the office with the flexibility to also work from home. We believe this will optimize the most productive work environment for all employees to succeed and deliver. Hybrid work from certain locations may be permitted in accordance with Astellas’ Responsible Flexibility

  

**What awaits you at Astellas?**

* Global collaboration: Become part of a connected global business of like-minded life science leaders, all dedicated to improving patients' lives worldwide.
* Real-world patient impact: Contribute to transformative therapies that reach patients around the world, knowing your work makes a difference every day.
* Relentless Innovation: Join a company at the forefront of scientific breakthroughs, where you'll have the opportunity to shape the future of healthcare.
* A Culture of Growth: Chart your own course within a supportive environment that values your contributions, champions your development, and empowers you to pursue your passions.
  

**Our Organizational Values and Behaviors**

Values: Innovation, Integrity and Impact sit at the heart of what we do.

Behaviors: We come together as ‘One Astellas’, working with courage and a sense of urgency. We are outcome focused and consistently take accountability for our personal contribution.

Design scalable hybrid model architectures that enhance core banking and finance processes ensure robust data integrity and deliver reliable day shift support for complex enterprise ecosystems without travel requirements.

* Design end to end Salesforce and nCino solution architectures that align with enterprise banking and financial process standards while ensuring scalability security and long term sustainability of platforms
* Provide detailed technical guidance on SFDC development and customization to enable robust feature implementation that supports complex finance workflows and regulatory compliance
* Drive optimization of SFDC configuration across objects workflows approvals and automation to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual intervention for finance and accounting teams
* Lead design and implementation of SFDC Lightning components and modern user experiences that streamline daily tasks for business users and enable intuitive access to critical financial data
* Execute integration strategies between SFDC platforms and external core banking or finance systems to ensure accurate data synchronization and high integrity information flows across the enterprise
* Oversee technical impact analysis and solution design reviews for new business requirements to confirm that changes are aligned with architectural principles and do not compromise system stability
* Collaborate closely with finance and accounting stakeholders to translate domain requirements into well structured Salesforce and nCino capabilities that directly support key financial reporting and lending processes
* Guide teams on best practices for code quality configuration management and environment governance to maintain reliable deployments and reduce production incidents in hybrid work settings
* Develop reusable architectural patterns integration templates and design standards that accelerate delivery of new features while maintaining consistent quality across multiple Salesforce implementations
* Support performance tuning and scalability improvements for SFDC and nCino applications to handle growing transaction volumes and complex financial products without degradation in user experience
* Coordinate with information security and compliance teams to embed regulatory controls audit readiness and secure data handling into every architectural decision impacting financial information
* Provide day shift technical oversight and issue resolution for critical incidents in Salesforce ecosystems ensuring minimal service disruption and timely restoration of business operations
* Document architectural decisions solution blueprints and technical roadmaps that help stakeholders understand system evolution and guide future investments in cloud based financial platforms

**Qualifications**

* Possess extensive hands on experience in SFDC development and customization using Apex Visualforce and Lightning capabilities to deliver complex enterprise grade solutions
* Demonstrate strong proficiency in configuring SFDC objects workflows validation rules and automation features that support structured finance and accounting processes
* Show deep practical knowledge of SFDC Lightning design patterns and component based development that enables responsive and user friendly interfaces for business users
* Exhibit solid expertise in SFDC integration approaches including APIs and middleware based connectivity to seamlessly link Salesforce with core banking and financial systems

Salesforce Certified Application Architect Salesforce Platform Developer certification preferred nCino technical certification desirable

6ca83f2e.title: Principal AI Tech Architect
6ca83f2e.description:
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
Industry Focus: Banking & Insurance (FI)
  
  
As part of the Enterprise Architecture (EA) practice at BCG Platinion, you will support architecture consulting engagements for Banking and Insurance clients. You’ll help define target-state architectures, drive digital modernization, and address key technology challenges including core transformation, cloud adoption, data enablement, and API-led innovation.
  
  
You’ll work closely with client CXOs, business leaders, and technology teams to translate strategy into actionable technology roadmaps and ensure architecture decisions create measurable business value. This role offers exposure to end-to-end transformation initiatives across financial services, including retail and corporate banking, insurance, payments, and wealth management.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead and deliver enterprise architecture engagements for banking, NBFC, and insurance clients.
* Define target architecture blueprints across applications, data, integration, cloud, infrastructure, and security layers.
* Assess current-state architectures and design modernization roadmaps aligned with digital transformation goals.
* Develop conceptual and solution architectures for core banking, PAS/LOS/LMS, and insurance platforms.
* Evaluate build vs. buy vs. reuse options and develop implementation strategies accordingly.
* Recommend best practices in DevSecOps, Agile delivery, and platform engineering.
* Drive technology governance, vendor selection, and implementation oversight.
* Provide advisory on emerging financial technologies such as open banking, digital lending, API ecosystems, and cloud-native core modernization.
* Collaborate with diverse teams to ensure architecture alignment with client’s business objectives.
* Present recommendations and architecture roadmaps to senior stakeholders and executive forums.

**Skills & Experience Required**

* B.Tech / M.Tech in Engineering from a top-tier institute; an MBA will be an added advantage.
* TOGAF, AWS/Azure/GCP certifications are highly desirable.
* 15+years of experience in enterprise architecture, solution design, or digital transformation within the Banking or Insurance domains.
* Strong understanding of BFSI business processes, including core banking, digital channels, payments, lending, and insurance systems.
* Expertise in enterprise architecture frameworks such as TOGAF or equivalent.
* Hands-on experience with architecture design across cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP), data, and integration technologies.
* Familiarity with modern technology trends such as microservices, containerization, and API-led architecture.
* Experience with DevSecOps, Agile delivery models, and continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD).
* Exposure to digital transformation programs across banking, NBFC, or insurance organizations.
* Excellent communication and client engagement skills, with the ability to simplify complex technology topics.
* Proven track record in stakeholder management and working with multi-disciplinary teams.
* Strong analytical mindset, business acumen, and passion for technology-led innovation.

Industry Focus: Cross Industry (Non-FI)
  
  
As an Enterprise Architect at BCG Platinion, you will help organizations architect and deliver next-generation technology foundations that support business growth and transformation. You’ll work at the intersection of strategy and technology—defining architecture roadmaps, leading design and delivery, and guiding clients through modernization, cloud adoption, data enablement, and emerging tech integration. This role is cross-industry, offering opportunities to work across sectors such as consumer, energy, healthcare, manufacturing, telecom, and public sector—helping clients navigate complex enterprise landscapes and realize business value through technology.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Architecture Strategy & Design
  
  

* Define target enterprise architecture across enterprise systems- digital, data, AI, application, cloud, and integration layers.
* Align technology strategy with business priorities and transformation goals.
* Create architecture blueprints, principles, and reference models tailored to client needs.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and their applicability to business use cases.

Delivery & Transformation
  
  

* Lead architecture assessments, define modernization roadmaps, and oversee implementation governance.
* Guide design and delivery of complex enterprise systems leveraging cloud-native, microservices, and API-first patterns.
* Ensure architecture compliance and quality assurance through technical reviews and best practices.
* Drive adoption of agile, DevSecOps, and platform engineering practices.
* Evaluate technology options to support target architecture, onboard and oversee end to end build.

Advisory & Leadership
  
  

* Act as a trusted advisor to senior IT and business leaders.
* Provide thought leadership on digital platforms, data ecosystems, and technology strategy.
* Contribute to BCG Platinion’s knowledge base, frameworks, and capability development.
* Coach and mentor team members and client architects to build sustainable capabilities.

What You Bring
  
  
Professional Experience
  
  

* 15+ years of experience in technology architecture, solution design, or enterprise technology consulting.
* Proven experience in defining and implementing enterprise-scale architecture solutions across industries such as industrial goods, consumer goods, transportation, logistics, manufacturing.
* Proven experience in deploying one or more enterprise systems such as ERP, CRM, SCM platforms, Manufacturing and IT.
* Exposure to multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and hybrid architectures.
* Strong understanding of integration patterns (APIs, ESB, event-driven), data architecture, and security design.
* Experience in digital transformation initiatives, technology roadmaps, or modernization programs.
* Experience working with system integrators or in house teams to drive end-to-end implementation.

Technical Expertise
  
  

* Knowledge of architecture frameworks (TOGAF, Zachman, or equivalent).
* Familiarity with core enterprise platforms (ERP, CRM, SCM) and modern stacks (microservices, containerization, serverless).
* Experience in working on the client-side delivery collaborating across tech and functional teams.
* Understanding of data and analytics platforms, AI/ML enablement, and API-led connectivity.
* Hands-on experience or strong collaboration exposure in cloud migration, DevSecOps, and platform engineering.

Soft Skills
  
  

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking.
* Ability to work collaboratively in multi-disciplinary, cross-geography teams.
* Comfort in engaging C-level stakeholders and translating complex concepts into business value.

**About BCG Platinion**
BCG Platinion is part of the Boston Consulting Group (BCG) family, specializing in technology consulting that bridges strategic business challenges with modern technology solutions. BCG Platinion is a rapidly growing global team of leading IT experts. We are shaping the future of IT consulting by combining business expertise with cutting-edge technology capabilities. We help our clients solve their most pressing challenges by designing and delivering enterprise architecture solutions. We partner with clients across industries to design and implement enterprise architecture and digital transformation programs that drive innovation, agility, and scalable value.
  
  
Why Join BCG Platinion
  
  
**At BCG Platinion, You Will Enjoy**

* A challenging and rewarding career in enterprise architecture consulting
* A diverse and inclusive culture that values your unique perspective and contribution
* Enterprise Architecture consulting with implementation and value realization in a client setting
* A supportive and collaborative environment that fosters your personal growth and development
* A competitive compensation and benefits package that reflects your skills and experience
* Opportunity to deepen knowledge in specific industries and gain implementation experience.

If you want a challenging and rewarding career in enterprise architecture consulting, apply now!
  
  
Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

The TAM works closely with customer System Administrators and internal teams to understand business processes, ensure effective system configuration, and help customers maximize value from the platform.

* Partner with customer System Administrators to understand business processes, workflows, and system configurations
* Maintain deep familiarity with each customer’s environment, priorities, and use cases55

**Product Expertise & Consultation**

* are technical-focused with analytical and problem-solving skills while able to describe technical configurations to non-technical audiences

SnapLogic (Workato preferred)5

**ABOUT LEGION**
Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a mission-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission.
  
  
Our award-winning AI-native workforce management platform is intelligent, automated, and employee-centric and proven to deliver 13x ROI. We help labor-intensive organizations maximize labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously.
  
  
Legion has earned recognition for its innovation, including spots on the Inc. 5000 list, Forbes’ Next Billion Dollar Startups, and awards for our AI technology. Backed by leading investors such as Norwest Venture Partners, Stripes, First Round Capital, XYZ Ventures, Webb Investment Network, Workday Ventures, and NTT DOCOMO Ventures, we're making real change.
  
  
If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling.
  
  
**BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY**
There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3,200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy, make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options. Legion’s mission is to turn hourly jobs into good jobs, serving the hourly workers who make up the majority of the US workforce. We believe in empowering employees and helping employers be efficient and innovative by enabling intelligent automation powered by Legion’s Workforce Management platform to optimize labor efficiency and enhance the employee experience simultaneously.
  
  
Legion WFM was built for the cloud with AI at the core and is designed to handle the complexity of modern businesses and meet the needs of today’s hourly employees. Our team is composed of dedicated individuals from all backgrounds and experiences, globally distributed across all time zones.
  
  
For more information, visit https://legion.co
  
  
**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**
At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a hybrid employer in Bucharest, Romania, pay for positions is determined using local, national, and industry-specific survey data.
  
  
We strive to make competitive offers, allowing employees room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position.
  
  
Benefits include, but are not limited to:
  
  

* Health Benefits
* Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays
* Parental Leave
* Equity
* Monthly Wellness Reimbursement
* Monthly Lunch at Legion

**EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY**
Legion Technologies is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, marital status, familial status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, genetic information, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, veteran status, and any other legally protected status under federal, state, or local anti-discrimination laws.

  such as institutions attended, degrees, certifications, training courses, publications, and transcript information.
* **Legally protected classification information**
  such as race, sex/gender, religious/ philosophical beliefs, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, marital status, military service, nationality, ethnicity, request for family care leave, political opinions, and criminal history.
* **Other information**
  such as any information you voluntarily choose to provide in connection with your job application.

* How We Use Personal Information

We collect, use, share, and store personal information from job applicants for our and our service providers’ business and operational purposes in the recruitment process such as: processing your application, tracking your application through the recruitment process, contacting references with your authorization, conducting background checks you authorize, and making hiring decisions. We will also use job applicant information for internal analysis purposes to understand the applicants who apply and to improve our recruitment process. We may sometimes need to use applicant information for legal purposes, such as in connection with any challenges made to our hiring decisions.
  
  

* With Whom We Share Personal Information

We will disclose job applicant personal information to the following types of entities or in the following circumstances (where applicable):
  
  

* **Internally**
  : to other Legion personnel involved in the recruiting and hiring process.
* **Vendors**
  : such as technology service providers, travel management providers, human resources suppliers, background check companies, and employment agencies or recruiters, where applicable.
* **Legal Compliance**
  : when required to do so by law, regulation, or court order or in response to a request for assistance by the police or other law enforcement agency.
* Litigation Purposes: to seek legal advice from our external lawyers or in connection with litigation with a third party.
* **Business Transaction Purposes**
  : in connection with the sale, purchase, or merger.

* **How to Contact Us About this Policy**
  – If you have any questions about this Policy, please contact privacy@legion.co.

0bd212c7.title: Service Delivery Manager
0bd212c7.description:
Work Your Magic with us!
  
  
Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.
  
  
**Service Delivery Manager**
**Location:**
Bangalore
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Service Delivery Manager is responsible for establishing, operating, and continuously improving Service Level Management for the assigned SAP and ERP application services. The role ensures reliable service delivery, effective lifecycle management, compliance, security, and ongoing alignment with business requirements.
  
  
The incumbent will work closely with business stakeholders, internal technology teams, SAP functional teams, infrastructure teams, and external service providers to design sustainable solutions, manage service performance, and drive continuous improvement across the SAP application landscape. The role includes ownership of service governance, vendor performance, service reporting, incident and problem management, application lifecycle management, and operational readiness.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**SAP Application and Functional Service Management**

* Manage the end-to-end service delivery of SAP applications and related ERP services.
* Work with business stakeholders and SAP functional teams to understand business requirements, service expectations, and improvement opportunities.
* Ensure that SAP services are designed, transitioned, operated, and retired in line with established service management processes.
* Coordinate SAP application enhancements, releases, upgrades, maintenance activities, and improvement initiatives.
* Ensure appropriate integration between SAP applications and connected systems, platforms, and business processes.
* Support the successful transition of new or enhanced SAP solutions into production with minimal business disruption.
* Ensure operational readiness, including support documentation, monitoring, knowledge transfer, support models, and formal handover.
* Monitor application availability, performance, capacity, stability, adoption, and user satisfaction.

**Service Level and Performance Management**

* Establish and manage Service Level Agreements, Operational Level Agreements, and related service targets.
* Define meaningful service performance indicators and ensure that agreed KPIs are measured and reported consistently.
* Lead periodic service reviews with business stakeholders, internal teams, and strategic service providers.
* Prepare and deliver service performance reports, management dashboards, annual service reviews, and improvement plans.
* Identify service gaps, agree corrective actions, and track improvement initiatives through to completion.
* Ensure that service-related information is maintained accurately in relevant repositories and IT service management tools, such as ServiceNow, CMDB, monitoring platforms, and reporting solutions.
* Drive consistent implementation of the service management framework across the assigned SAP service portfolio.

**Incident, Problem, and Change Management**

* Ensure effective management of major incidents, recurring incidents, problems, and service requests.
* Coordinate root-cause analysis, corrective actions, preventive actions, and post-incident reviews.
* Track application outages, downtime, service interruptions, and business impact.
* Ensure that changes to SAP applications are assessed, approved, communicated, tested, and implemented in accordance with change management procedures.
* Work with relevant teams to reduce recurring incidents and improve service stability.
* Support automation and process optimisation opportunities across service management and SAP operations.

**Vendor and Partner Management**

* Manage the operational performance of SAP service providers and strategic partners.
* Review vendor performance against agreed SLAs, KPIs, quality targets, and contractual obligations.
* Ensure timely delivery of service reports, improvement plans, corrective actions, and annual service reviews.
* Facilitate governance meetings and maintain clear escalation and communication paths.
* Ensure that suppliers meet applicable security, quality, compliance, and service management expectations.

**Compliance, Risk, and Business Continuity**

* Ensure that SAP services comply with applicable internal policies and external requirements, including security, vulnerability management, data protection, licensing, GxP, and GDPR obligations, where relevant.
* Support risk identification, mitigation planning, audit readiness, and compliance reporting.
* Develop and maintain Disaster Recovery and business continuity plans for the assigned SAP applications.
* Plan, coordinate, and document Disaster Recovery tests and follow up on identified actions.
* Ensure that service operations support business continuity and minimise disruption to critical business processes.

**SAP Functional Background**
A good understanding of SAP functional processes and the ability to collaborate effectively with SAP business process owners and functional consultants is required.
  
  
Experience in
**two or more of the following SAP functional modules**
will be considered an added advantage:
  
  

* SAP FI – Financial Accounting
* SAP CO – Controlling
* SAP MM – Materials Management
* SAP SD – Sales and Distribution
* SAP PP – Production Planning
* SAP PM – Plant Maintenance
* SAP QM – Quality Management
* SAP PS – Project System
* SAP WM / EWM – Warehouse Management / Extended Warehouse Management
* SAP Ariba – Procurement and Supplier Management

**Education And Professional Experience**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 10+ years of experience in software services, application management, ERP operations, or IT service delivery.
* At least 5 years of experience working in an international or globally distributed environment.
* Experience managing SAP applications, enterprise platforms, or complex business-critical application services.
* Strong experience working with internal stakeholders, business teams, technology functions, and external service providers.
* Fluency in written and spoken English is mandatory.
* ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent practical experience is required.

**Skills And Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of IT service management principles, particularly Service Level Management, Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, Capacity Management, and Service Continuity Management.
* Practical understanding of SAP application landscapes, functional processes, integrations, and operational dependencies.
* Ability to translate business requirements into sustainable service and application management solutions.
* Strong capability to develop concepts, establish governance models, and drive pragmatic implementation.
* Experience with service performance management, KPI frameworks, dashboards, and reporting solutions.
* Familiarity with ITSM tools, CMDBs, monitoring solutions, ticketing systems, and service repositories.
* Strong vendor management, negotiation, escalation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Good understanding of information security, risk management, data protection, quality standards, and regulatory compliance.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong analytical, organisational, and decision-making abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a complex, international, and matrixed environment.
* Proactive approach to automation, standardisation, service improvement, and operational excellence.

**What we offer:**
We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!
  
  
Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

8ec24000.title: Principal Technical Program Manager
8ec24000.description:
**Job Description**
The AI Infrastructure GPU Delivery team is responsible for planning, coordinating, and delivering the infrastructure that powers Oracle Cloud Infrastructure's rapidly expanding AI and GPU portfolio. The organization partners closely with Engineering, Cloud Platform, Networking, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Data Center Operations, Observability, Finance, Business Operations, hardware partners, and senior leadership to deliver highly complex infrastructure programs at global scale.
  
  
As a
**Principal Program Manager**
, you will oversee the planning, execution, and operational readiness of strategic AI infrastructure and GPU delivery initiatives. You will be responsible for translating complex technical and operational requirements into integrated execution plans, establishing governance frameworks, driving cross-functional alignment, and ensuring successful delivery across multiple concurrent programs. This role requires the ability to influence across organizations, navigate ambiguity, manage competing priorities, and drive executive decision-making without direct authority.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own the end-to-end execution of complex AI infrastructure and GPU delivery programs, from strategic planning and deployment readiness through operational handoff.
* Identify, prioritize, and successfully execute a broad portfolio of cross-functional initiatives while managing multiple programs concurrently.
* Develop and maintain integrated program plans that define milestones, deliverables, dependencies, risks, owners, key decisions, and committed actions.
* Coordinate delivery across Engineering, Cloud Platform, Networking, SRE, Data Center Operations, Observability, Finance, Business Operations, hardware partners, and executive leadership.
* Establish and lead program operating mechanisms, including weekly execution reviews, readiness assessments, governance forums, executive business reviews, and cross-functional planning sessions.
* Monitor GPU fleet readiness, deployment progress, operational health, service availability, and reliability across current and next-generation AI platforms.
* Manage deployment governance, operational readiness reviews, stakeholder transitions, and change management processes to ensure successful service delivery.
* Navigate complex dependencies across organizations, resolve execution risks, drive mitigation plans, and ensure accountability through program completion.
* Serve as the primary escalation point between engineering and operations to accelerate issue resolution and remove execution blockers.
* Establish structured incident management processes, including root-cause analysis, corrective and preventive action tracking, and verification of long-term resolutions.
* Develop executive-level reporting and dashboards that communicate program health, operational KPIs, customer impact, dependencies, financial status, risks, mitigation plans, and key decisions.
* Partner with Observability and Telemetry teams to improve visibility into GPU health, network fabric performance, RDMA, RoCE, InfiniBand, and overall service health.
* Collaborate with internal engineering organizations and external hardware partners to improve deployment quality, operational efficiency, and time to resolution.
* Establish scalable program management frameworks, documentation standards, runbooks, playbooks, onboarding materials, and repeatable delivery processes.
* Drive continuous improvement through automation, AI-assisted workflows, data-driven decision making, validation frameworks, version readiness, and operational optimization.
* Build and maintain consistent reporting, scorecards, KPIs, and program metrics to support executive decision-making and portfolio management.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Minimum of seven years of program management, product management, technical project management, or related experience leading large-scale, cross-functional initiatives.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex technical programs involving infrastructure, cloud services, networking, distributed systems, or enterprise software.
* Proven ability to lead multiple concurrent programs while effectively managing competing priorities, dependencies, risks, and stakeholder expectations.
* Strong experience partnering with cross-functional technical and business organizations to deliver strategic initiatives.
* Experience developing executive dashboards, KPI reporting, scorecards, and data-driven program insights to support operational and business decisions.
* Demonstrated ability to establish scalable governance frameworks, operating cadences, and standardized program management processes.
* Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and executive presentation skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all organizational levels.
* Proven ability to work effectively in highly ambiguous, fast-paced environments while driving accountability and execution across organizations without direct authority.
* Experience with AI infrastructure, GPU deployments, cloud infrastructure, data center operations, networking, observability, or large-scale distributed systems is strongly preferred.
* PMP, Scrum Master, or equivalent project management certification is a plus.

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
  
  
Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

1f3f1aae.description:
**Description**
Amazon NOW is the fastest delivery on Amazon platform, serving our customers with gourmet of catalogue from grocery, personal care and baby products, all delivered in minutes. Are you interested in being a part of this exciting journey?
  
  
Whatever our customers want, we will find the means to deliver it. With your help, Amazon will continue to enable people to discover new worlds and implement innovation.
  
  
This is your chance to make history.
  
  
Business Area: Operations
  
  
Operations is at the heart of the Amazon customer experience. Each action we undertake is done on behalf of our customers, as meeting their expectations makes us feel good.
  
  
The Operations teams are responsible for overall performance management. The Ops team is also involved in launching new FCs and stabilizing its operations. Constant benchmarking with processes and efficiency goals is one of the important task Ops team will undertake.
  
  
Program Manager, Operations
  
  
This role entails driving Think Big programs with respect to launch of Hubs and central tracking of critical projects to scale up our Hub Operations by working with 3P partners. The role act as liaisons with other departments and run cross functional projects in close collaboration with Supply Chain, Real Estate, Engineering and Operations.
  
  
The position's mission is to help Now succeed in scaling operations whilst meeting performance commitments through working hard and smart to strengthen standardization, by running Think Big initiatives and coordinating the top business efforts/projects.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
The position will be owning national programs as well as implementation at site. He/She will be working with site Ops team to:
  
  

* 3P Operations Launch Management: Lead end-to-end launch activities for 3P operations, ensuring seamless site activation through stakeholder coordination, milestone tracking, and operational readiness assessments.
* Capacity Planning & Delivery: Partner with supply chain and operations teams to assess network capacity needs and delivering solutions through new building launches, facility expansions, and infrastructure enhancements.
* Engineering Collaboration & Design Excellence – Work closely with engineering teams on facility design, layout optimization, and automation integration to ensure buildings are built or retrofitted for maximum operational efficiency and scalability.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Experience in Engineering, Operations, Business Administration, or a related field
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Experience applying strong numerical and analytical abilities to develop product/program strategies and evaluate complex processes and financial scenarios
* Travel up to 25% of the time

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree, or MBA in supply chain management, operations, engineering, analytics or related field

**About The Team**
We are hub operations team that act as a first mile for Quick Commerce. These hubs feed into multiple Micro fulfillment centers spread across the cities. We are responsible for smooth functioning of the Hubs that entails Launch, Capacity expansion, Process optimizations, Tech and Automation projects to increase productivity.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, operations, supply chain, transportation logistics

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers.
