506d3824.title: Technical Project Manager – IT Infrastructure, Cloud Transformation & Data Center Migration
506d3824.description:
****Job Summary****
Synechron is seeking an experienced Technical Project Manager to lead and manage large-scale IT infrastructure delivery and transformation initiatives. The role will oversee projects involving data centers, networks, security, cloud, servers, storage, backup, disaster recovery, business continuity, and enterprise infrastructure platforms.
  
  
The Technical Project Manager will manage projects from initiation through closure, establish effective governance, coordinate geographically distributed teams, oversee budgets and vendors, and communicate progress and risks to senior stakeholders. The role contributes to business objectives by enabling reliable infrastructure delivery, controlled transformation, operational readiness, and timely transition to support teams.
  
  
****Software Requirements****
**Required Software Skills**

* Microsoft Project: Experience creating and maintaining integrated project plans, schedules, dependencies, milestones, and critical paths.
* Jira: Experience tracking project activities, risks, issues, actions, dependencies, and delivery progress.
* ServiceNow: Working knowledge of change management, service transition, incidents, problems, and operational readiness processes.
* Clarity PPM: Experience with project, portfolio, resource, financial, or governance tracking is preferred within the required toolset.
* SharePoint and Confluence: Experience maintaining project documentation, governance records, decisions, action trackers, and delivery artefacts.
* Microsoft Excel: Experience with budget tracking, forecasting, resource planning, risk analysis, reporting, and data reconciliation.
* Microsoft PowerPoint: Experience preparing executive presentations, governance packs, project dashboards, and leadership updates.
* Project governance tools: Experience maintaining project plans, RAID logs, status reports, implementation schedules, governance dashboards, and change-control records.
* Tool versions: Experience using the versions and configurations of project-management, service-management, collaboration, reporting, and portfolio-management tools adopted by the assigned Synechron environment.

****Preferred Software Skills****

* Experience with portfolio-management, financial-management, resource-planning, dashboarding, or enterprise reporting tools.
* Familiarity with infrastructure monitoring, service-management, change-management, and operational-readiness platforms.
* Experience using collaboration tools for geographically distributed and matrix-based teams.
* Familiarity with automation or dashboard tools that improve project reporting, data accuracy, and governance efficiency.

Equivalent tools may be considered where they provide comparable capabilities.
  
  
****Overall Responsibilities****

* Manage end-to-end infrastructure project delivery from initiation through closure.
* Define project scope, timelines, budgets, resource plans, milestones, dependencies, governance models, and delivery outcomes.
* Monitor project milestones, risks, issues, dependencies, assumptions, decisions, and change requests.
* Maintain project plans, RAID logs, status reports, implementation schedules, governance dashboards, action trackers, and meeting minutes.
* Ensure timely escalation and resolution of project risks, delivery challenges, technical dependencies, and scope changes.
* Drive project governance, implementation readiness, change management, operational handover, and post-implementation reviews.
* Lead projects involving:Data center migration and consolidationServers, virtualization, and compute platformsStorage and backup solutionsNetwork infrastructure and connectivityFirewall and security implementationsCloud and hybrid cloud transformationsDisaster recovery and business continuityHardware refresh and infrastructure modernizationMPLS, WAN, SD-WAN, and telecommunications connectivity
* Coordinate infrastructure readiness across architecture, security, network, database, application, operations, and vendor teams.
* Ensure effective cutover planning, rollback strategy, implementation readiness, operational handover, and transition to support teams.
* Partner with business, technology, architecture, security, operations, PMO, vendor, and leadership teams.
* Facilitate governance meetings, steering committees, project reviews, delivery checkpoints, and executive forums.
* Manage stakeholder expectations and communicate project priorities, risks, dependencies, decisions, and changes clearly.
* Coordinate delivery across regional and global teams operating within matrix organizations.
* Prepare project dashboards, governance packs, executive presentations, leadership updates, and portfolio-level reporting.
* Present project health, risks, budgets, milestones, dependencies, and key decisions to senior management.
* Manage project budgets, forecasts, resource allocations, financial tracking, funding requests, and commercial governance.
* Coordinate procurement activities, vendor deliverables, contracts, Statements of Work, milestones, and acceptance criteria.
* Track vendor performance and ensure adherence to agreed delivery commitments.
* Promote sustainable infrastructure practices by considering resource utilization, energy efficiency, capacity optimization, reuse, lifecycle management, and long-term operational support.
* Measure performance through delivery predictability, milestone achievement, budget adherence, risk resolution, operational readiness, stakeholder satisfaction, and successful transition to support.

****Technical Skills (By Category)****
**Programming Languages**
****Essential****

* Ability to understand technical discussions, infrastructure dependencies, delivery constraints, implementation risks, and solution impacts.
* Ability to interpret technical information from architecture, network, security, cloud, server, storage, database, and operations teams.

****Preferred****

* Familiarity with scripting, automation, or infrastructure-as-code concepts.
* Exposure to technical automation initiatives that support infrastructure provisioning, monitoring, reporting, or operational efficiency.

**Databases/Data Management**
****Essential****

* Understanding of infrastructure data, asset information, service records, capacity information, project metrics, financial data, and operational reporting.
* Ability to review and reconcile project, resource, budget, milestone, risk, issue, and dependency information.
* Understanding of data accuracy, traceability, reporting controls, and appropriate handling of project and operational information.

****Preferred****

* Familiarity with configuration management databases and service-management data.
* Experience using reporting dashboards, portfolio data, financial information, or infrastructure inventories to support project decisions.
* Exposure to data-center capacity, asset lifecycle, backup, disaster recovery, or service availability information.

**Cloud Technologies**
****Essential****

* Strong understanding of cloud and hybrid cloud transformation concepts.
* Ability to coordinate cloud infrastructure delivery, migration planning, implementation readiness, security, operational support, and transition activities.
* Understanding of cloud-related considerations such as scalability, availability, resilience, security, cost, governance, and service ownership.

****Preferred****

* Experience managing infrastructure projects involving AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Familiarity with cloud migration, landing zones, networking, identity and access management, monitoring, disaster recovery, and cloud operating models.
* Awareness of cloud resource optimization and sustainable infrastructure practices.

**Frameworks and Libraries**
****Essential****

* Working knowledge of infrastructure delivery frameworks, project governance models, service transition practices, ITIL concepts, and Agile or hybrid delivery approaches.
* Ability to apply appropriate project-management and governance practices based on project scope, risk, complexity, and delivery model.

****Preferred****

* Experience with structured infrastructure transformation, migration, modernization, or service-transition frameworks.
* Familiarity with portfolio, program, value-stream, or enterprise transformation frameworks.
* Exposure to architecture governance, technical design review, operational readiness, and change-control frameworks.

**Development Tools and Methodologies**
****Essential****

* Strong experience in project planning, scheduling, RAID management, risk and issue management, change control, resource planning, capacity management, vendor management, and stakeholder management.
* Experience managing infrastructure projects across initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, control, implementation, transition, and closure.
* Knowledge of ITIL concepts, change management, service transition, operational readiness, incident awareness, and problem-management awareness.
* Experience with Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, or hybrid project delivery methodologies.
* Experience preparing governance dashboards, executive reports, steering committee materials, financial reports, and project documentation.
* Ability to coordinate delivery across cross-functional, geographically distributed, and matrix-based teams.

****Preferred****

* PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, Scrum, or equivalent project-management certification.
* Experience with infrastructure transformation programs, cloud migration, data-center consolidation, disaster recovery, network modernization, or enterprise platform delivery.
* Familiarity with formal portfolio governance, benefits tracking, business-case preparation, funding approval, and post-implementation review practices.

**Security Protocols**
****Essential****

* Understanding of infrastructure security, firewall implementation, access management, network security, cloud security, data protection, and operational controls.
* Ability to coordinate security requirements, reviews, approvals, remediation actions, and implementation dependencies.
* Awareness of security, privacy, compliance, risk, auditability, and segregation-of-duties considerations.
* Ability to include security readiness and operational controls in project planning, cutover, handover, and transition activities.

****Preferred****

* Experience managing infrastructure projects involving firewall, identity, encryption, vulnerability management, security monitoring, or regulatory controls.
* Familiarity with security governance, risk acceptance, audit preparation, disaster recovery testing, and business continuity requirements.
* Experience working with security teams to track remediation and compliance milestones.

****Experience Requirements****

* 8+ years of project-management experience with significant exposure to IT infrastructure delivery.
* Experience delivering enterprise-scale infrastructure projects and programs.
* Strong understanding of data centers, networks, security, cloud, servers, storage, backup, disaster recovery, business continuity, and enterprise infrastructure operations.
* Experience managing projects involving infrastructure migration, modernization, transformation, implementation, integration, or operational transition.
* Experience coordinating architecture, security, network, database, application, operations, vendor, and support teams.
* Experience managing project scope, schedules, budgets, resources, risks, issues, dependencies, changes, governance, and executive reporting.
* Experience with cutover planning, rollback strategy, operational readiness, handover, transition to support, and post-implementation review.
* Experience managing vendor deliverables, contracts, Statements of Work, milestones, procurement activities, and commercial governance.
* Experience in banking, payments, financial services, FinTech, global capability centers, or large enterprise environments is preferred.
* Candidates may also qualify through equivalent combinations of infrastructure program management, technical delivery management, service transition, transformation leadership, PMO leadership, or enterprise technology delivery experience that demonstrate the required capabilities and outcomes.

**Day-to-Day Activities**

* Review project schedules, milestones, RAID logs, budgets, resources, dependencies, change requests, and implementation readiness across active infrastructure initiatives.

ba14feba.title: Senior Technical Program Manager - Data Center Cybersecurity & Commissioning
ba14feba.description:
We are seeking an experienced **Senior Technical Program Manager** to lead the planning, coordination, readiness, and execution of complex cybersecurity verification and validation activities across large-scale data center construction and commissioning programs.

This is a highly technical program leadership role positioned at the intersection of **data center construction, commissioning, controls engineering, operational technology, networking, cybersecurity, facility operations, and OEM/vendor management**.

The Technical Program Manager will coordinate activities across construction teams, commissioning organizations, data center operations, controls and automation teams, OEMs, system integrators, network teams, cybersecurity specialists, and independent Cybersecurity Commissioning Agents.

The successful candidate must be capable of understanding both the **construction/commissioning lifecycle and the underlying technical systems being validated**. This is not a general administrative project-management position.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Program & Multi-Site Delivery Management**

* Lead technical program coordination across multiple concurrent data center projects.
* Align all sites with integrated program plans covering cybersecurity verification and validation, construction, commissioning, operational readiness, and technical dependencies.
* Coordinate activities across multiple geographic regions, sites, delivery teams, and Cybersecurity commissioning agents.
* Maintain visibility of site readiness, schedules, dependencies, risks, constraints, and required technical resources.

* Maintain program-level schedule, effort, resource utilization, budget, and financial health tracking.

* Own and coordinate program and site-level prerequisites required for successful execution.
* Develop standardized governance and execution processes that can scale across a large multi-site portfolio.
* Coordinate work allocation and execution across multiple cybersecurity assurance vendors while maintaining consistent program expectations.

**2. Construction & Commissioning Integration**

* Integrate cybersecurity V&V activities into the overall data center construction and commissioning lifecycle.
* Understand and coordinate dependencies between construction completion, equipment installation, controls integration, functional testing, commissioning, and cybersecurity validation.
* Work with General Contractors, commissioning teams, system integrators, technical PMOs, and site teams to determine when systems are sufficiently ready for cybersecurity activities.
* Prevent premature mobilization by establishing clear technical and operational readiness criteria.
* Coordinate cybersecurity activities around critical project milestones without unnecessarily affecting construction or commissioning progress.

**3. Controls / Data Center Engineering / OT Systems Coordination**

Provide technical coordination across data center control and monitoring environments, including systems such as:

* Building Management Systems (BMS)
* Power Management Systems (PMS)
* SCADA
* DCS and industrial control platforms
* PLCs and industrial controllers
* RTUs, gateways, meters, relays, and IEDs
* EPMS and electrical monitoring systems
* Environmental and mechanical controls
* Industrial networking infrastructure
* Engineering workstations and management platforms
* Associated servers, applications, interfaces, and communications infrastructure
* **Maintain sufficient technical knowledge of controls and OT platforms to understand system architecture, ownership, technical dependencies, testing prerequisites, and escalation requirements.**

 **4. Data Center Operations Integration**

* Establish strong coordination between project delivery teams and Data Center Operations.
* Ensure cybersecurity verification activities consider operational constraints and production-readiness requirements.
* Coordinate technical handover requirements between construction/commissioning teams and operations.
* Track ownership of systems, credentials, documentation, configurations, software, and technical artifacts necessary for validation.
* Help resolve gaps between global program objectives and actual site execution conditions.

**5. OEM, Vendor & System Integrator Coordination**

* Serve as the program-level coordination point for OEMs, system integrators, contractors, controls vendors, and Cybersecurity Commissioning Agent organizations.
* Identify the correct technical owner for equipment and systems requiring verification.
* Coordinate vendor availability during testing windows.
* Ensure required engineering software, documentation, configurations, credentials, access, technical SMEs, and testing support are available.
* Escalate unresolved vendor or technical dependencies before they affect execution.
* Coordinate common requirements across OEMs rather than repeatedly resolving the same issues independently at each site.

**6. Technical Logistics & Readiness**

Own the technical-readiness process covering:

* Site access
* Assessment workstations
* Network connectivity
* Engineering system access
* Required documentation
* Network and controls architecture
* Asset inventories
* Configuration documentation
* OEM technical resources
* System integrator resources
* Cybersecurity commissioning agent requirements
* Testing windows
* Evidence collection
* Technical repositories
* Finding and workflow-management systems

Establish a formal **readiness gate** before site mobilization.

**7. Cybersecurity Verification & Validation Program Coordination**

* Coordinate execution between program stakeholders and independent Cybersecurity Commissioning Agents.
* Translate program objectives into executable site-level technical activities.
* Maintain consistent V&V expectations, evidence requirements, acceptance criteria, and reporting across multiple providers.
* Coordinate testing activities involving OT devices, controls platforms, industrial networks, applications, and supporting infrastructure.
* Track systemic findings and recurring issues across the portfolio.
* Facilitate escalation of findings requiring program-level rather than site-level resolution.
* Support integration of lessons learned into future design, procurement, commissioning, and operational requirements.

**8. Program Governance & Reporting**

* Maintain integrated RAID logs covering risks, actions, issues, dependencies, and decisions.
* Develop program dashboards covering readiness, execution status, testing progress, findings, dependencies, and blockers.
* Facilitate technical program reviews and readiness meetings.
* Maintain clear RACI across site teams, operations, controls teams, OEMs, integrators, Cybersecurity Commissioning Agents, and other stakeholders.
* Escalate systemic issues requiring enterprise or program-level decisions.
* Drive consistent methods across sites while accommodating genuine technical differences between facilities.

**Mandatory Experience**

Candidates must demonstrate relevant experience across all of the following areas. These requirements represent the core technical and program-management capabilities necessary for the role.

**Data Center Experience**

* Significant experience delivering technical programs within **hyperscale, colocation, mission-critical, or similarly complex data center environments**.
* Demonstrated understanding of data center construction, commissioning, operational readiness, and handover.

**Construction Experience**

* Demonstrated experience working within major construction or infrastructure delivery programs.
* Strong understanding of construction schedules, contractor dependencies, site readiness, commissioning gates, and project controls.

**Controls / OT Experience**

* Strong working knowledge of building automation, industrial control, power-management, SCADA/DCS, PLC, and related cyber-physical systems.
* Ability to interpret controls architecture, network diagrams, system interfaces, and technical dependencies.

**Networking Experience**

Working understanding of:

* TCP/IP
* VLANs
* Routing and switching
* Firewalls
* Network segmentation
* Industrial Ethernet
* Remote access
* IT/OT integration

Demonstrated ability to engage effectively understand and interact with network engineering teams on architecture, segmentation, routing, switching, firewall, remote-access, and IT/OT integration requirements.

**Cybersecurity Experience**

* Experience leading or coordinating cybersecurity programs involving OT, industrial systems, critical infrastructure, or cyber-physical systems.
* Understanding of cybersecurity verification, validation, assessment, risk management, remediation, and technical assurance.
* Ability to translate cybersecurity requirements into activities that engineering and commissioning organizations can execute.

**Commissioning Experience**

* Direct experience working with commissioning organizations or commissioning programs.
* Understanding of FAT, SAT, functional testing, integrated systems testing, commissioning, acceptance, turnover, and operational readiness.
* Demonstrated ability to integrate additional assurance requirements into an active commissioning environment.

**Program Management Experience**

* Demonstrated experience coordinating complex, multi-site technical programs.
* Experience managing multiple contractors, vendors, engineering organizations, and technical workstreams simultaneously.
* Strong dependency, escalation, risk, schedule, and stakeholder-management capabilities.

**Experience Level**

**12+ years of overall relevant industry experience**, including substantial experience across data center construction/commissioning and technical infrastructure programs.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Electrical, Controls, Automation, Mechanical, Network, Computer, Systems, or related engineering degree.
* PMP or PgMP.
* Commissioning credentials such as CxA, CCP, CBCP, or equivalent experience.
* CISSP, GICSP, IEC 62443, or comparable cybersecurity certification.
* Experience with controls ecosystems from Schneider Electric, Siemens, Rockwell Automation, ABB, Honeywell, Johnson Controls, or similar OEMs.
* Experience with mission-critical electrical and mechanical infrastructure.
* Experience coordinating third-party testing, assurance, validation, inspection, or commissioning organizations.
* Experience supporting global programs spanning multiple regions and delivery organizations.

**Critical Competencies**

**Technical credibility**
  
Demonstrates sufficient technical depth to actively lead discussions with controls engineers, network engineers, commissioning teams, cybersecurity specialists, and data center operations personnel.

**Construction fluency**
  
Demonstrates strong understanding of construction execution, commissioning sequences, schedule pressures, project dependencies, and operational-readiness milestones.

**Systems and Safety thinking**
  
Identifies cross-functional dependencies affecting cybersecurity execution, including OEM contracts, construction schedules, controls integration, configurations, credentials, network readiness, technical ownership, and operational constraints.

**Execution discipline**
  
Turns program requirements into owners, dependencies, readiness gates, dates, escalation paths, and measurable outcomes.

**Vendor orchestration**
  
Can coordinate multiple Cybersecurity Commissioning Agents and technical vendors without allowing delivery methodology or quality to fragment between sites.

**Executive communication**
  
Can convert complex construction, OT, commissioning, cyber, and vendor issues into concise program-level decisions.

**Technical curiosity**
  
Demonstrates strong root-cause analysis and technical problem-solving skills to identify and resolve underlying readiness and execution constraints

ef9c7504.title: SOC Engineer — Integration & Presales
ef9c7504.description:
**Company Description**
CrossCipher delivers an advanced Managed Detection and Response (MDR) service that goes beyond traditional Security Operations Center (SOC) offerings by providing comprehensive threat intelligence, proactive threat hunting, continuous security monitoring, incident analysis, and incident response. Instead of relying solely on rules and signatures, CrossCipher uses advanced security analytics across endpoints, user behavior, applications, and networks to achieve deeper and more accurate threat detection. The MDR platform leverages Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning to accelerate investigations, automatically contain threats, and orchestrate coordinated responses. This approach enables organizations to respond faster to emerging risks while improving overall security posture and operational resilience. Candidates joining CrossCipher will contribute to a modern, technology-driven security environment focused on innovation and impact.

**Role Description**

**Client Integration Responsibilities / Onboarding & Platform Integration**
•

Lead the technical onboarding of new clients onto the SOC platform — from scoping and discovery through to full go-live • Configure data source integrations including syslog forwarding, API connectors, firewall log ingestion, and cloud log pipelines • Deploy, configure, and validate XDR agents across client Windows and Linux endpoints • Create client-specific SIEM rules, dashboards, and alert policies tailored to their environment • Coordinate with client IT teams to ensure network access, firewall exceptions, and proxy settings are correctly configured • Conduct onboarding handover sessions and produce integration documentation for both client and internal SOC teams

We are seeking a technically strong and client-oriented SOC Engineer to own the end-to-end onboarding of new clients onto our SOC platform, support presales technical engagements, and ensure the successful deployment and operation of XDR agents across diverse client environments. You will serve as a key bridge between our sales team and the technical operations team — translating client needs into working security solutions while troubleshooting issues across Windows and Linux environments.

**XDR Agent Troubleshooting**
• Diagnose and resolve XDR agent installation failures, connectivity issues, and performance problems on Windows and Linux systems • Analyze agent logs, Windows Event Viewer entries, and Linux system journals (journalctl / syslog) to identify root causes • Troubleshoot common Windows issues: Group Policy conflicts, service failures, registry misconfigurations, and AV exclusion errors

Troubleshoot common Linux issues: package dependencies, SELinux/AppArmor policies, daemon failures, and permission errors • Document recurring issues and develop step-by-step remediation runbooks for the support team • Escalate unresolved technical issues to the vendor with full diagnostic detail and follow through to resolution.

**Responsibilities Handover**

18919b22.description:
Job Description

**About Persistent**

  

We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what's next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry-leading organizations across the world, including 18 of the Fortune 50 companies, 7 of the 10 top US banks, 9 of the 10 technology companies, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.

  

Our disruptor's mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We have delivered 26 sequential quarters of growth with $487.6M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 7.8% Q-o-Q and 20.0% Y-o-Y. Our 29,500+ global team members, located in 21 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. **Expertise You'll Bring:**

* Experience building customer, partner, and community portals using Salesforce Sales Cloud.
* Strong proficiency in Apex Classes, Apex Triggers, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce, SOQL, SOSL, Salesforce APIs.

* Strong understanding of Salesforce CRM processes and platform architecture.

* Strong understanding of Salesforce DevOps practices and CI/CD implementation.
* Hands-on experience with Git, Salesforce CLI (SFDX), Deployment Pipelines, Pull Requests, Automated Validation, Release Management.
* Experience managing deployments across multiple Salesforce environments.
* Strong knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern web technologies.
* Ability to write secure, maintainable, and scalable code.
* Strong troubleshooting, debugging, and code-review capabilities.
* Experience working in Agile and Scrum delivery environments.
  

**Benefits:**

* Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards

6f47987a.title: AI Solution Architect
6f47987a.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
  
  
The Position
  
  
**About The Role**
At Roche Digital Technology, we are advancing the boundaries of Applied AI. As part of our strategic initiatives, we are enabling high-value AI (with a strong focus on Generative AI) through fit-for-purpose platforms, services and applications. The Applied AI Use Case Engineering & Operations Team is tasked with building innovative AI applications, genAI agents and agentic foundations.
  
  
In the 2026 tech landscape, the lines between traditional disciplines have blurred. We operate in small agile teams (e.g., ~9 members) powered by advanced coding agents (like Claude Code) to develop and ship solutions faster than ever before. We are looking for a highly skilled, deeply hands-on AI Software Architect to design and help implement end-to-end GenAI and non-Gen AI applications, with a particular focus on agentic systems. You will not simply be drawing diagrams; you will be expected to remain deeply entrenched in the code, acting as a full-stack technical anchor whose workload for rigorous code review and architecture enforcement is critical to our high-velocity teams.
  
  
****Core Tech Stack & Scope****
This role will involve working deeply with multimodal foundation models, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, advanced agentic workflows, vector, graph and traditional databases, APIs, MCPs, A2A, MLOps subsystems, new emerging technologies and other solution components. You will utilize cloud services (AWS and multicloud) to develop scalable and robust AI solutions. Beyond AI components, the architect must ensure that the entire system's software ecosystem - from frontend and backend services to data pipelines, integrations, authentication, observability, and infrastructure - is well-designed, scalable, and maintainable.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****
End-to-End System Architecture & Hands-On Engineering:
  
  

* Define and design AI (with focus on genAI and agentic) and non-AI components of software systems, ensuring modularity, scalability, and security
* Architect solutions that integrate AI capabilities into enterprise systems while ensuring seamless interoperability with backend services, APIs, MCPs, databases, and user interfaces
* Ensure adherence to cloud-native best practices across AWS and multicloud deployments, including containerization, orchestration, and infrastructure as code
* Evaluate the best fit for purpose technologies
* Ensure newly developed AI applications fit within the context of particular RDT and Business functions, and that they strictly follow architectural patterns and standards used across RDT

****Agentic AI Model Integration & Optimization:****

* Define robust patterns for utilizing LLMs, multimodal models, and RAG, agentic systems and other emerging AI technologies
* Design efficient model-serving pipelines, integrating AI capabilities into existing business workflows

****Full-Stack Enterprise Engineering & Code Quality:****

* Ensure that AI applications follow software engineering best practices, including version control, CI/CD, MLOps, automated testing, and code quality assurance
* Conduct rigorous code reviews for agent-assisted and human-generated code to maintain high enterprise standards
* Architect secure and scalable integrations to facilitate seamless communication between AI models, databases, and user interfaces
* Design data pipelines that efficiently handle structured and unstructured data, ensuring AI models receive high-quality input data
* Integrate identity management and authentication mechanisms to ensure secure access to AI applications
* Be ready to jump into the code to be a hands-on partner within solutions development teams

****Observability, Performance & Security:****

* Define monitoring and logging strategies for AI-driven applications to ensure model performance, API/MCP health, and data integrity
* Implement AI observability practices, ensuring visibility into application behaviors and anomaly identification
* Design architectures that adhere to data governance, security, compliance, and ethical AI guidelines

****Collaboration & Governance:****

* Work closely with AI Engineers, Software Engineers, Product Owners and other members of Agile development teams to translate business requirements into AI-driven architectures
* Provide technical leadership in AI architecture reviews, design discussions, and solution validation
* Collaborate with Agile teams and key stakeholders across the organization to consult on, design and implement AI systems that meet Roche's architectural standards and adhere to AI governance guidelines

**Practical Skills Required**
****Experience:****

* 7+ years of experience in software architecture and engineering, including at least 3 years in AI-related projects
* Proven track record of designing and deploying large-scale, cloud-based AI and non-AI systems
* Proven experience leveraging AI coding agents to accelerate full-stack development cycles

**Skills**
****Must-have:****

* Architecting production-level AI systems including RAGs, Vector DBs, MCP, end-users, integrations, etc., but also observability, DevOps, durable and available system designs
* AI Expertise: Deep understanding of various ML algorithms, model training techniques, and evaluation metrics, foundational models utilization and integration, agentic systems design and engineering
* Cloud Platforms: Expertise in AWS and multicloud services, serverless computing, and other cloud services required to build AI applications end-to-end, from IaC with Terraform to exposing securely production-level applications over the network, understanding of hardware and software infrastructure needed to support AI workloads
* Databases: Strong architectural knowledge of vector databases (e.g. AWS OpenSearch, Azure AI search), Snowflake, SQL, NoSQL, event-driven and graph architectures
* Building resilient, highly available and secure IT systems
* Security & Compliance: Strong understanding of software solutions security and compliance requirements
* Stakeholder management and communication: Influence your colleagues, but also non-technical Senior Stakeholders on designs you create
* Programming: Advanced proficiency in Python with strong experience in backend development, coupled with a strong command of modern frontend ecosystems
* Software Engineering Best Practices: Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps, Infrastructure as Code and microservices design

****Should-have****

* Familiarity with TypeScript is considered an advantage - to have a common language with the full-stack Software Engineers

****Could-have:****

* Regulatory Compliance: Proven experience in working within highly regulated industries

****Capabilities:****

* Problem-Solving Skills: Strong analytical skills with the ability to tackle complex architectural and engineering challenges, integrate new technologies, and improve existing processes
* Business Acumen: Understanding of how AI can be leveraged to drive business value and achieve strategic objectives
* Leadership: Abilities to step into a Tech Lead role when necessary
* Consulting: Abilities to work closely with stakeholders across the enterprise to consult on the technological approaches to their business problems
* Ethics: Familiarity with biases, fairness, and responsible use of AI

**Qualifications**
The successful candidate should:
  
  

* Hold a B.Sc., B.Eng., M.Sc., M.Eng., Ph.D. or equivalent in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field
* Have a strong understanding of both AI and traditional software engineering principles
* Experience in implementing DevOps and MLOps principles and practices
* Be passionate about AI, staying up-to-date with the latest developments in LLMs, GenAI, agentic, classical ML, cloud computing, and software architectures
* Have experience in leading technical teams and mentoring engineers
* Be team-oriented, proactive, and collaborative , with the ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
* Be an excellent problem solver and analytical thinker , detail-oriented and highly organized , and a great communicator
* Be willing to learn and expand their skill set in an environment where roles are fluid and multidisciplinary
* Be able to communicate in English at the level of: C1+
* Located in Hyderabad, India, with working hours structured to capture the 'golden hours' of overlap with Central European Time (typically running through the IST evening)

****Why Join Us?****

* Innovative Environment: Work on cutting-edge AI solutions in a highly visible Roche function
* Growth Opportunities: Advance your career by working on complex, high-impact AI solutions and systems
* Collaborative Culture: Be a part of a diverse and inclusive team that values technical excellence, collaboration and innovation

**Shift:**
CET time zone
  
  
#Hyderabad2026
  
  
Who we are
  
  
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
  
  
Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Direct employment

* Drive the development and adoption of edge-to-cloud architectures, industrial communications, device management, remote monitoring, predictive maintenance, and data analytics solutions.
* Support customer deployments and operational excellence initiatives through digital solutions that improve machine performance, uptime, quality, and operational visibility.
* Promote a culture of innovation, technical excellence, DevOps practices, cybersecurity awareness, and data-driven decision making.

****Critical Capabilities And Qualifications****

* Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate, coach, and develop a high-performing technical team.
* Strong decision-making, problem-solving, and strategic thinking capabilities.
* System-level thinking at both product and enterprise levels.
* Strong understanding of Industrial IoT architectures, edge computing, cloud platforms, and distributed systems.
* Strong knowledge of software engineering principles, system integration, and modern development methodologies.
* Experience with industrial communications and protocols including OPC UA, MQTT, Modbus TCP, Ethernet/IP, Profinet, and related technologies.
* Knowledge of cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or equivalent.
* Experience with IoT device management, telemetry collection, data pipelines, analytics platforms, and monitoring solutions.
* Understanding of cybersecurity principles, secure software development practices, and industrial network security.
* Experience with DevOps tools, CI/CD pipelines, source control systems, and agile development methodologies.
* Demonstrates a high degree of flexibility and adaptability while embracing changing priorities.
* Knowledge of Husky products, manufacturing processes, tools, standards, and technologies is an asset.
* Experience with Edge Computing, AI/ML applications, predictive analytics, digital twins, and Industry 4.0 initiatives is an asset.
* Experience facilitating cybersecurity, safety, or technology risk assessments is an asset.
* Relevant cloud, cybersecurity, or industrial automation certifications are considered an asset.

**Education**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical discipline from an accredited university.

****Experience****

* Proven leadership experience leading multidisciplinary engineering teams.
* Experience delivering enterprise-scale software, cloud, or Industrial IoT solutions from concept through deployment.
* Experience in manufacturing, automation, machinery, packaging, injection molding, or industrial technology industries is an asset.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

1cc3abc0.title: Solutions Architect, ISV
1cc3abc0.description:
**Description**
AWS Global Sales (AGS) drives adoption of the AWS Cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud.
  
  
Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud.
  
  
AWS is where innovation, risks, and ideas are celebrated. We are builders; we try new things, imagine big dreams and reuse whenever we can. It is still Day 1 for us, and we are looking for curious people to be part of our diverse teams of thinkers, problem solvers, and doers. Come join us and work with AWS technologies that enable our Independent Software Vendor (ISV) customers and partners to adopt cloud-based solutions.
  
  
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
This role is within the ISV team in Amazon Web Services India (AWS India) and can be based out of Bangalore, Delhi, Mumbai, Pune and Hyderabad locations.
  
  
As a Solutions Architect, you’ll help your customers plan their successful cloud journey leveraging emerging technologies like GenAI to achieve business outcomes. You’ll solve complex, technical challenges so your customers can focus on their business. This includes using your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures. You’ll drive or take part in technical solutions discussions, diving deep into the details with customer teams.
  
  
Building relationships to understand our customers and partners is key. As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll use your interpersonal skills to influence a variety of stakeholders from technical teams to executives. You’ll help ensure their short-term technology decisions are aligned with their long-term goals. Speeding up the adoption of our services will be part of your day to day.
  
  
You’ll also act as thought leader in the wider community. This includes taking part in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops. You won’t just be part of an industry movement; you’ll be leading it.
  
  
As a customer obsessed advisor, you’ll also have the chance to shape the direction of our products and services. This is through gathering feedback from customers whilst collaborating with our engineering and service teams.
  
  
To be successful in this role you need to be passionate about ISV and cloud architectures. You are a builder with genuine curiosity about how technology can support your customers’ business models and objectives.
  
  
Want to find out what it’s like to be a Solution Architect at AWS? Watch this video (https://bit.ly/3keYcC9).
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
The Solutions Architect team at AWS is responsible for helping customers successfully implement cloud technologies. In a typical week you will meet multiple customers, and you will collaborate with them on designing and operating well-architected solutions. You will earn their trust and show them the art of the possible, educating them around the capabilities of AWS. Partnering with internal teams and experts, leveraging a deep knowledge of our tools and products, you’ll craft highly scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures that address our customers’ business problems. As part of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to continuously learn and innovate daily.
  
  
**About The Team**
ISV Solutions Architects work hand in hand with AWS customers to help drive AWS services adoption. They are at the crossroads of business and technology and engage with customers of different stages. Supporting the overall technical relationship between customers and AWS, they work to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology. Solutions Architects also have broader impact at scale, taking a supporting role in creating and presenting technical content and best practices.
  
  
You will be part of a team that is responsible for driving adoption of AWS technologies while bringing differentiated value to customers. This is a team dedicated to ISV customers, an important and growing subset of customers for AWS India. ISV customers follow unique technology adoption patterns and growth trajectories that distinguish them from traditional businesses, so you will be employing engagement strategies and programs tailored to their business needs and technical preferences.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience in design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures
* Experience in a similar role such as technical account manager, consultant, solutions architect, platform engineer, systems engineer, cloud architect, or service delivery manager
* Experience in specific technology domain areas like software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data and analytics
* 4+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
* Experience communicating clearly and concisely with leadership, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams
* Can create proof of concepts, demos, and/or scripts from scratch or leveraging reusable components.
* Able to create technical content that is easily adopted and reusable by others.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of AWS services
* Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud
* Experience architecting/operating solutions built on AWS, or experience implementing a cloud-based technology solution
* Experience implementing cloud services including migrations and modernization projects or similar
* AWS certification, such as, AWS Solutions Architect, or a similar cloud certification, or Cloud Technology Certification
* Able to present to technical and business audiences (training, workshops, publications)
* 4 years’ experience as a Solution Architect or related role.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

ba6b4d15.title: Applied AI Architect
ba6b4d15.description:
**Job Description**
About the Team
  
  
The AI Architect team partners with organizations to turn OpenAI's most capable models into meaningful, real-world impact. We work with customers across industries and digital-native businesses to identify where AI can create value, design secure and scalable solutions, and help those solutions move from early exploration into sustained production adoption. The team brings together technical strategy, customer partnership, and practical deployment expertise, working closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, and specialist delivery teams.
  
  
**About The Role**
As an AI Architect, you will be the senior technical owner for a named portfolio of customers and the primary technical counterpart to their leadership teams. You will act as the “CTO of your book of business”, shaping each customer's AI strategy and guiding their journey from pre-sales discovery and solution evaluation through deployment, adoption, and measurable business impact.
  
  
You will own the technical account plan across ChatGPT Enterprise, the OpenAI API, Codex, and other agentic AI solutions. In partnership with the Account Director, you will translate business priorities into a focused use-case portfolio, an actionable adoption roadmap, and a clear path to durable customer value and growth. The Account Director owns commercial strategy; you own the technical strategy, customer journey, and path to production value.
  
  
You will remain accountable for the technical outcome while bringing in the right specialists across deployment, implementation, enablement, security, product, and partners to provide deeper expertise and execute work where needed. This role calls for strong industry fluency, sound architectural judgment, and the ability to move confidently between executive strategy and hands-on technical conversations.
  
  
This role can be based in Delhi, Mumbai, or Bangalore. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees
  
  
In this role, you will
  
  

* Serve as the primary technical advisor and long-term technical relationship owner for a named portfolio of existing customers and pre-sales prospects.
* Partner with Account Directors on account strategy while owning the technical account plan, technical milestones, adoption priorities, and expansion opportunities.
* Lead discovery with executives and technical teams to identify, qualify, and prioritize use cases tied to meaningful business outcomes.
* Develop clear Applied AI Architectures spanning models, applications, data, integration, security, privacy, governance, evaluation, and deployment.
* Guide customers through technical evaluations, demonstrations, workshops, prototypes, and proofs of value, securing confidence in both the solution and its path to production.
* Maintain a focused use-case portfolio with clear decision criteria, ownership, blockers, success measures, delivery needs, and adoption plans.
* Develop trusted relationships and technical champions across CTOs, CIOs, CISOs, AI leaders, engineering teams, and other customer stakeholders.
* Qualify and coordinate support from Deployment Engineering, implementation, training and enablement, product and domain specialists, partners, and other delivery teams.
* Remain accountable for technical progress and customer outcomes while ensuring delivery teams own implementation execution once engaged.
* Track adoption, usage, account health, production readiness, and measurable customer impact, intervening early when risks threaten value realization.
* Apply industry or digital-native expertise to recognize repeatable patterns, sharpen customer priorities, and identify relevant expansion opportunities.
* Share customer insights with Product, Engineering, and Research, translating field learnings into better products, architecture guidance, and reusable practices.

You might thrive in this role if you
  
  

* Have significant experience in customer-facing technical roles such as solutions architecture, solutions engineering, technical account leadership, AI deployment, or technical customer success.
* Have guided enterprise organizations from technical evaluation through production adoption and measurable business impact.
* Build credibility with senior technical and business leaders while communicating equally well with hands-on engineers.
* Bring strong software and cloud architecture foundations, including APIs, distributed systems, data integration, identity, security, and privacy.
* Understand modern AI systems, frontier LLM models, agentic applications, model evaluation, retrieval, or enterprise AI workflows.
* Can prototype, explain technical tradeoffs, and work confidently with APIs, SDKs, and languages such as Python or JavaScript.
* Exercise sound judgment about when to go deep personally, when to involve specialists, and how to define clear handoffs and ownership.
* Have experience developing technical account plans, prioritizing complex customer portfolios, and connecting adoption to measurable outcomes.
* Bring meaningful expertise in a relevant industry or strong fluency with the needs of digital-native businesses.
* Communicate clearly and can turn ambiguity into a practical technical narrative, executive decision, or action plan.

**Position Summary**

**Work you’ll do:**
As a Consultant in our Cyber Application Security team, you will be part of our Oracle practice and will be responsible for delivering Oracle security and controls implementations services across a varied format of architectures. Responsibilities will include assessment, design and implementation of security and controls on cloud-based Oracle environment to secure this environment.
  
  
The key job responsibilities will be to:
  
  

* Design, and implement customized, scalable and SOX compliant security solutions
* Lead requirements gathering, design documentation by conducting client workshops in onsite/offshore delivery model for projects
* Advanced debugging and troubleshoot issues, including interacting with technology vendors
* Architect, design and implement the SSO solutions for various Oracle SaaS/PaaS services

124108a8.description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
Job Category
  
  
Customer Success
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
**The Experience**
The Technical Architect will support the full implementation lifecycle, from prioritizing to deployment in an evolving ecosystem consisting of clients and partners. Be responsible for efficiently designing and building the Salesforce industry-specific Financial Services Cloud, Healthcare Cloud, revenue cloud. It also requires maintaining an ongoing comprehensive understanding of the cloud-computing ecosystem. Technical Architects typically specialize in a salesforce platform (e.g. Force.com (Sales, Service, Community, IoT, Einstein Clouds), Marketing Cloud, Commerce, and Health Cloud), and developing solutions cross-cloud is becoming more critical.
  
  
**What You'll Actually Be Doing**

* Working closely with Delivery Managers, Functional Solution Architects, and if required directly with clients to devise technology solutions to meet client needs and ensure the software product is used accurately and the go-forward solution is easy to maintain and meets standard processes. This includes a lead role in project discovery and definition workshops, supplying crafting scope and development estimates, and documenting requirements and designs.
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Champion an AI-first delivery methodology, utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation across projects
* Collaborate with internal team members (sales/pre-sales, engineering, other services teams, etc.) to help customers increase the value of their Salesforce Industry products and services.
* Designing ground-breaking technical solutions and working directly with customers to meet their business requirements in accordance with industry-standard methodologies.
* Leading and mentoring the development and QA teams on the project.
* Application design, development, and support of Salesforce-related projects. The candidate must demonstrate dynamic leadership in the full life cycle of the software development environment.
* Through the use of UML diagrams, design documentation, and best-practice methodologies; detailed design of Salesforce-related projects from inception through production support.
* Responsible for ensuring that the system accurately meets the defined expectations of the business unit, ensuring that proper testing is implemented, and performance requirements are closely supervised by working with the development teams.
* Responsible for creating, and delivering, in a timely and accurate fashion, CRMs and workflow solutions using Salesforce/Apex, Force, Visualforce, and J2EE technologies.
* Advocate and implement standard process development methodology to drive quality delivery of enterprise solutions. Develop POCs or help customers and partners with complex coding tasks.
* Identify and lead internal initiatives to grow the consulting practice; contribute to the overall knowledge base and expertise of the community.

**You're Our Person If...**

* 10+ years of experience in developing technology solutions.
* 2+ years of experience in handling client-facing projects in positions of increasing responsibility in the context of systems development and related business consulting.
* Handling multiple projects/issues, Coaching Architects, Strong Industries background.
* Demonstrated Ability in Financial Services domain/Healthcare domain/Salesforce CPQ or Revenue Cloud domain.
* Excellent written and spoken communication skills.
* Experience in designing and developing software components and having a very strong Service Oriented Architecture and integration background. Specializes in gathering and analyzing information and designing comprehensive solutions that meet best practice standards and the client's needs.
* Experience in Salesforce (SFDC) CRM with end-to-end implementation experience.
* Salesforce integration experience, including between different business systems as well as working with integration tools.
* Proficiency in programming using Salesforce SFDC, Force.com, APEX, J2EE, HTML, Java, JavaScript, and XML and their use in the development of CRM solutions.
* Strong experience with configuration, customization, programming with APEX APIs, APEX Triggers, and implementing new instances of Salesforce from scratch.
* Strong experience with configuration, customization, and programming with Lightning Aura Components.
* Knowledge in LWC.
* Strong practical deployment knowledge of VisualForce, Flex, Salesforce configurations, Apex classes, APEX Web services, API, AppExchange deployment, and Salesforce controls.
* Ability to define the system landscape, identify gaps between current and desired end-states, and deliver a CRM solution.
* Additional Salesforce experience includes Workflow Alerts and Actions, and Approval Workflow.
* Experience leading teams in the analysis of complex problems, and the design and implementation of related solutions.
* Diligent with the ability to learn quickly to demonstrate new concepts, technologies, and solutions.
* Ability to work independently and be a self-starter.
* A pioneering innovator who continually studies new technologies and functionality, and is involved in projects that push the capabilities of existing technologies.
* Ability to travel to client sites as needed (average of 30-50%), but may be higher or lower based on the engagement.
* Degree or equivalent relevant experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the strengths you'll need for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
  
  
Accommodations
  
  
If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.
  
  
Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.
  
  
Posting Statement
  
  
Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit.
