56da17ec.title: Senior Cloud Services Sales Specialist
56da17ec.description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Title:**
Senior Cloud Services Sales Specialist
  
  
**Locations:**
Gurgaon/ Bangalore/ Mumbai
  
  
**About the Role:**
NTT DATA is a strategic technology services and solutions partner of AWS, Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud, helping enterprises modernize their technology environments and accelerate cloud, data and AI transformation.
  
  
We are looking for an experienced Cloud Specialist Sales professional to drive cloud-led business development and Sales across NTT DATA’s enterprise client base. The role will operate within NTT DATA India working horizontally across Client Management, Business Units, hyperscaler alliance teams, solutioning/presales and delivery organizations.
  
  
The Cloud Specialist Seller will act as a cloud subject-matter sales leader and opportunity orchestrator, identifying and creating cloud transformation opportunities, shaping customer conversations, developing qualified pipelines and bringing the right NTT DATA and hyperscaler capabilities together to progress opportunities through to closure.
  
  
The role requires someone who can operate effectively across organizational boundaries, influence without direct authority, engage senior customer stakeholders and translate cloud technology capabilities into measurable business outcomes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Cloud Business Development & Pipeline Creation
* Develop and execute cloud sales strategies across an assigned portfolio of enterprise customers.
* Identify opportunities across cloud migration, modernization, application

transformation, infrastructure modernization, cloud-native development, managed cloud services and cloud optimization.
  
  

* Proactively create demand rather than relying solely on existing account pipeline.
* Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of qualified cloud opportunities and achieve agreed sales/revenue targets.
* Identify opportunities to expand existing NTT DATA relationships through cloud-led transformation initiatives.
* Develop account-level cloud whitespace maps covering AWS, Azure and GCP

opportunities.
  
  

* Client Engagement & Consultative Selling
* Engage with CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, CISOs, business leaders and technology decision-makers to understand transformation priorities.
* Lead executive-level conversations around the business value of cloud, rather than selling individual cloud products.
* Understand customer technology landscapes, transformation roadmaps, business drivers and pain points.
* Position NTT DATA’s capabilities together with hyperscaler technology to develop differentiated customer propositions.
* Build trusted-advisor relationships with customers and establish NTT DATA as a strategic cloud transformation partner.
* Matrix / Client Manager Collaboration

As a horizontal specialist organisation, the role will work closely with Client Managers and BU sales teams across NTT DATA.
  
  
**Key responsibilities include:**

* Partner with Client Managers to identify and qualify cloud opportunities within strategic accounts.
* Work across multiple BUs to leverage existing customer relationships and industry expertise.
* Establish joint account plans with Client Managers and BU leadership.
* Support Client Managers with cloud-specific opportunity identification, qualification and strategy.
* Bring specialist cloud expertise into broader account planning and customer

engagements.
  
  

* Maintain clear ownership and engagement models with Client Managers to avoid channel conflict and ensure a coordinated customer experience.
* Influence stakeholders across the matrix without relying on direct reporting authority.
* Hyperscaler Alliance Engagement
* Develop strong working relationships with AWS, Microsoft and Google Cloud sales and technical teams.
* Create joint account strategies and opportunity plans with hyperscaler sellers.
* Leverage hyperscaler funding, migration programs, assessments, workshops, incentives and partner programs to accelerate opportunities.
* Coordinate joint customer engagements involving NTT DATA and hyperscaler teams.
* Build differentiated propositions leveraging NTT DATA’s services capabilities and hyperscaler platforms.
* Track hyperscaler ecosystem developments and translate relevant capabilities into customer opportunities.
* Opportunity Shaping & Sales Leadership
* Lead the commercial sales strategy for qualified cloud opportunities.
* Develop opportunity plans covering customer business problem, solution proposition, stakeholders, competition, commercial model and path to closure.
* Coordinate with solution architects, presales, delivery, commercial and legal teams.
* Ensure opportunities are appropriately qualified before significant presales investment.
* Lead proposal strategy, customer presentations, workshops and executive engagements.
* Maintain accurate CRM hygiene, forecasting and opportunity reporting.
* Drive opportunities from initial qualification → solution shaping → proposal →negotiation → closure.
* Cloud Solution & Commercial Understanding

The successful candidate should have sufficient technical understanding to engage credibly with customers and technical stakeholders across:
  
  

* Cloud migration and modernization
* IaaS / PaaS / SaaS
* Cloud-native architectures
* Containers and Kubernetes
* Data platforms and analytics
* AI/ML and Generative AI workloads
* Cloud security
* Networking and hybrid cloud
* DevOps / DevSecOps
* FinOps and cloud optimization
* Managed cloud services

The role is not expected to be the primary technical architect, but must be able to understand customer requirements, challenge solution assumptions and connect technical capabilities to business outcomes.
  
  

* Internal Orchestration

The specialist seller will act as the single-threaded sales orchestrator for cloud opportunities, bringing together:
  
  
Client Manager → BU → Cloud Specialist → Presales/Solution Architecture → Delivery →Hyperscaler → Commercial/Finance
  
  
**Responsibilities include:**

* Establishing the right internal team for each opportunity.
* Creating clear roles, responsibilities and next steps.
* Driving opportunity cadence and governance.
* Removing internal blockers.
* Ensuring commercial, solution and delivery stakeholders remain aligned.
* Maintaining momentum from opportunity creation through closure.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 8–10+ years of enterprise technology sales experience, preferably including significant cloud sales experience.
* Proven experience selling AWS, Azure and/or GCP solutions/services.
* Experience in a Systems Integrator, IT Services company, hyperscaler or technology consulting organisation preferred.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex enterprise sales cycles.
* Experience working in a matrixed organisation is highly desirable.
* Experience selling through or alongside hyperscaler partner ecosystems preferred.
* Technical & Business Skills

**Strong understanding of:**

* AWS / Azure / GCP cloud platforms
* Cloud transformation and modernization
* Data & AI workloads
* Cloud economics and business cases
* Enterprise architecture concepts
* Managed services
* Cloud security
* Digital transformation
* Sales Competencies
* Consultative / value-based selling
* Enterprise account planning
* Opportunity qualification
* Pipeline generation
* Executive stakeholder management
* Deal shaping and negotiation
* Partner ecosystem management
* Forecasting
* Cross-functional influence
* Strong communication and presentation skills

**Workplace type:**
On-site Working
  
  
**About NTT DATA**
NTT DATA is a $30+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune
  
  
Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through
  
  
responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with
  
  
unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and
  
  
application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move
  
  
confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more
  
  
than 70 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as
  
  
established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each
  
  
year in R&D.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
NTT DATA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.
  
  
**Third parties fraudulently posing as NTT DATA recruiters**
NTT DATA recruiters will never ask job seekers or candidates for payment or banking information during the recruitment process, for any reason. Please remain vigilant of third parties who may attempt to impersonate NTT DATA recruiters whether in writing or by phone in order to deceptively obtain personal data or money from you. All email communications from an NTT DATA recruiter will come from an
**@nttdata.com**
email address. If you suspect any fraudulent activity, please
*contact us*
.

e1997e6d.title: Senior Solution Consultant
e1997e6d.description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.
  
  
**The Role**
**Your Impact**
As a Sr Solution Consultant, you will partner with AspenTech sales teams during the sales cycle to lead in the consultative discovery process with customers; craft a vision and roadmap of a solution that addresses customer requirements; identify differentiated value capture potential; and design an implementation/sustainment program for that solution. This involves maintaining a keen understanding of AspenTech’s product strategy; our value enablers; the execution capabilities of our professional services team and those of our partners; and of the sales pipeline to drive opportunities where AspenTech solutions can bring significant business value to our customers and to AspenTech.
  
  
The Sr Solution Consultant is responsible for delivering high quality solutions and business outcomes based on existing AspenTech products. Demonstrating deep knowledge of the solutions and offerings, capable of contributing to the design of a complete solution across the entire lifecycle of a project - from pre-sales through design and delivery of the solution - the Solution Consultant drives transformational results and realizes business strategy for AspenTech customers.
  
  
This is a customer-facing role that requires self-motivated individuals with excellent business, industry and technical knowledge, along with strong consultative and communication skills to position AspenTech solutions and services with our customers.
  
  
The ideal candidate will be self-motivated, with a proven track record in software / technology sales / consulting. We are looking for candidates who are comfortable at the intersection of technology and business. On the business side, the ability to connect technology with measurable business value is critical to this role.
  
  
**Role Details**

* Develop industry- and application-specific solutions for the customer. This is a very customer-facing position that will have you leading value discovery customer sessions, assessing customer needs, and developing solutions.
* Determine and understand prospective customers’ critical business issues in order to present and demonstrate AspenTech’s software capabilities as the best possible solution to win the business.
* Build customer-specific solutions on the AspenTech platform using all the available tool options.
* Develop robust recommendations, proposals and scope of work documents for AspenTech Consulting engagements, while also identifying critical dependencies & gaps.
* Consult with customers and advise on relevant AspenTech solutions and services and establish a credible value proposition.
* Develop & execute sales campaigns and plans together with the Sales teams.
* Work with the Sales team to identify and qualify business opportunities; identify key customer technical challenges; and develop solutions to meet business needs.
* Proactively support pipeline development (e.g. marketing, account planning, awareness sessions, etc.) and sales execution (e.g. strategy for accounts and opportunities, including commercial model conversion, deal models, and Business Requirement Plans) in assigned accounts and opportunities.

What You'll Need
  
  

* Proven experience within consulting, pre-sales, professional services consulting or process industry verticals such as Energy, Petro chemicals, bulk or specialty chemicals.
* Candidates will have a strong understanding of manufacturing economics, with an ability to interact with potential customers and talk knowledgeably about their plants, work processes, and manufacturing economics.
* Technology specialization in one or more of the areas of focus for Aspentech such as:
* Process Engineering
* Manufacturing Supply Chain – Planning and Scheduling
* Advanced process control and optimization
* Predictive Maintenance
* IT/OT real-time Digital infrastructure modernization
* Strong drive to solve customer problems and rapidly convert pipeline opportunities into closed deals.
* Balance of business and technology acumen, including ability to articulate high-level technical solutions to business problems and the differentiated value those solutions can provide.
* Strong problem solving and analytical skills, including ability to create clear observations, analyses and conclusions based on customer interviews and data.
* Ability to travel approximately 40%, including domestic and international travel to support customer engagements.

Candidates with similar skills or experiences may be considered and training may be offered where needed. Applicants will be reviewed for this position as well as similar roles with varying skill requirements and/or years of experience.

9a358219.title: Pre-Sales Consultant - SAP Testing
9a358219.description:
**Job Title**

Pre-Sales Consultant SAP Testing

  

**Employer Description**

A fast-growing AI-led enterprise test automation platform company serving global digital transformation clients.

  

**Role Purpose**

We are seeking a high-impact Pre-Sales Consultant SAP Testing with strong SAP techno-functional expertise, customer-facing solutioning capability, and a deep understanding of SAP business processes, automation strategy, and AI-led testing innovation.

This role is positioned at the intersection of SAP transformation advisory, test strategy design, solution engineering, demo storytelling, and enterprise deal progression. The selected professional will work closely with sales, product, engineering, customer success, and enterprise client stakeholders to shape technically credible, commercially compelling SAP testing solutions.

The role requires a professional who can understand complex SAP landscapes, identify testing gaps, design structured testing strategies, present solution demonstrations, support RFP/RFI responses, run proof-of-concept engagements, and influence customer confidence across S/4HANA, RISE with SAP, Fiori/UI5, API, integration, and regression testing environments.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

**1. Customer Discovery and SAP Landscape Assessment**

• Assess current SAP landscapes, including ECC, S/4HANA, RISE with SAP, Fiori/UI5, and integrated enterprise systems.

• Understand SAP business processes across modules such as SD, MM, FI, PP, EWM, HR, and related functional areas.

• Identify current testing challenges across manual testing, automation coverage, regression cycles, integration validation, and release readiness.

• Evaluate pain points related to test maintenance, test data, execution planning, business process coverage, and cross-module dependencies.

• Translate discovery outcomes into structured solution opportunities and customer-facing recommendations.

  

**2. SAP Test Strategy and Solution Architecture**

• Design end-to-end test strategies for S/4HANA migration programs, including greenfield, brownfield, and selective transition scenarios.

• Build testing approaches for RISE with SAP programs, Fiori modernization, SAP steady-state operations, and ongoing transformation initiatives.

• Create structured test blueprints covering business process mapping, regression suite design, impact-based testing, and risk-based prioritization.

• Define testing scope across functional testing, integration testing, regression testing, API testing, data migration validation, and interface validation.

• Consider cross-module dependencies, release cycles, upgrade readiness, and industry-specific SAP process complexity.

  

**3. Demo Engineering and Technical Presentation**

• Prepare and deliver customer-specific demos for SAP UI5/Fiori workflow testing.

• Demonstrate testing approaches for SAP OData services, RFCs, BAPIs, APIs, IDocs, CPI, and PI/PO integrations.

• Explain how modern SAP testing reduces release risk, improves reliability, shortens testing cycles, and supports quarterly upgrade readiness.

• Present automation concepts clearly for SAP functional teams, QA leaders, Basis teams, enterprise architects, and business stakeholders.

• Use storytelling, structured narratives, and proof points to communicate solution value during pre-sales engagements.

  

**4. Proposal, RFP, and Solution Documentation**

• Prepare technical proposals, RFP responses, RFI responses, and customer-facing solution documents.

• Support security and compliance questionnaires with technically accurate, role-relevant input.

• Create high-level architecture diagrams, solution outlines, testing strategy documents, and estimation models.

• Develop test effort and complexity estimates based on SAP scope, modules, interfaces, transformation stage, and regression requirements.

• Tailor SAP testing strategies for industry contexts such as manufacturing, BFSI, retail, and other enterprise environments.

  

**5. Customer Engagement and Deal Progression**

• Work with Sales Directors to build compelling SAP testing narratives and customer-specific value propositions.

• Lead validation workshops with SAP functional consultants, QA teams, Basis teams, enterprise architects, and transformation stakeholders.

• Address customer objections around methodology, automation strategy, integration reliability, migration readiness, and testing governance.

• Define success criteria for proof-of-concept engagements and validation workshops.

• Run PoCs aligned to real customer business processes, SAP modules, integration flows, and technical environments.

• Support deal progression through technical credibility, structured solutioning, and stakeholder confidence-building.

  

**Required Qualifications and Experience**

• 810 years of experience in SAP functional consulting, ABAP development leadership, SAP project delivery, SAP solutioning, or SAP techno-functional consulting.

• Strong exposure to SAP projects in consulting, project management, technical delivery, implementation, migration, or customer-facing advisory roles.

• Hands-on understanding of SAP S/4HANA migration approaches, including greenfield, brownfield, and selective transition.

• Working knowledge of RISE with SAP architecture and enterprise SAP transformation models.

• Experience with SAP modules such as SD, MM, FI, PP, EWM, HR, or similar business process areas.

• Participation in at least one S/4HANA or RISE transformation project in a primary functional, technical, or consulting role.

• Strong communication skills, executive presence, demo capability, and solution storytelling ability.

  

**Preferred Qualifications and Experience**

• Experience in pre-sales, solution engineering, SAP advisory, SAP QA consulting, or customer-facing technical roles.

• Lead contributor experience in SAP implementation programs, especially in FI, SD, or MM domains.

• Exposure to SAP test automation, SAP QA, regression testing, impact-based testing, or structured testing frameworks.

• Background modernizing SAP testing from manual or recorder-driven approaches to structured automation frameworks.

• Experience supporting proposals, RFPs, technical presentations, solution workshops, PoCs, or enterprise deal cycles.

  

**Required Technical and Functional Expertise**

• SAP S/4HANA transformation and migration testing.

• RISE with SAP architecture and testing implications.

• SAP functional process knowledge across SD, MM, FI, PP, EWM, HR, or related modules.

• SAP UI5 and Fiori testing.

• SAP OData services, RFCs, BAPIs, IDocs, and interface flows.

• CPI and PI/PO integration environments.

• Functional testing, integration testing, regression testing, and data migration validation.

• Test case design, test data services, execution lists, regression suite planning, and risk-based testing practices.

• Business process coverage mapping and cross-module dependency analysis.

• Customer-facing solution architecture and technical storytelling.

  

**Required Professional Competencies**

• Ability to lead structured customer discovery discussions.

• Strong analytical ability to assess SAP testing gaps and transformation risks.

• Capability to design practical, enterprise-ready SAP testing strategies.

• Clear communication across technical and business stakeholders.

• Strong presentation, demo, objection-handling, and workshop facilitation skills.

• Ability to partner effectively with sales, product, engineering, and client-facing teams.

• Strong documentation discipline for proposals, RFPs, architecture diagrams, and solution notes.

• High ownership orientation and ability to drive technical deal progression.

  

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate is an SAP techno-functional professional with strong consulting maturity, enterprise communication skills, and the ability to translate SAP transformation challenges into structured testing solutions. The person should be comfortable discussing SAP business processes with functional teams, integration complexity with technical stakeholders, testing strategy with QA leaders, and business outcomes with senior decision-makers.

A strong fit would be someone who has contributed meaningfully to SAP implementation, migration, or transformation programs and now seeks a customer-facing pre-sales role combining SAP expertise, testing strategy, automation advisory, AI-led innovation, and enterprise solution consulting.

2390e7ea.title: Staff Technical Program Manager — Multi-Entity Account Scale & Access Lifecycle
2390e7ea.description:
**Overview**
Intuit's Identity organization is seeking a Staff Technical Program Manager to focus on how our platform scales for large and complex customers. Our Identity Platform is the primary gateway for millions of customers across TurboTax, QuickBooks, Credit Karma, and Mailchimp — a durable strategic lever that ensures personalized experiences are delivered with world-class security and compliance.
  
  
This role sits at the center of one of Intuit's largest growth bets: serving customers whose organizations look nothing like a single-owner small business. Accounting firms managing hundreds of clients. Multi-entity businesses running dozens of legal entities across currencies and locations. Mid-market companies with real hierarchies, real headcount, and real governance requirements. The users you build for are the people your customers employ — the staff, contractors, and accountants they invite into their own Intuit account — and the platform they administer today was designed for a much smaller shape of customer.
  
  
You will own two initiatives end to end.
**Scale**
is the work of taking our account model from hundreds of entities to thousands, delivering bulk and group-level administration, and standing up an API-first surface so customers and partners can manage identity programmatically rather than one user at a time.
**Access automation**
is the work of making the joiner/mover/leaver lifecycle automatic — permissions applied correctly the moment someone is added, revoked the moment they leave, with the audit trail to prove it — collapsing onboarding that takes weeks and eliminating access that outlives the person who held it.
  
  
We need an AI Native, results-oriented and empathetic technical leader who can navigate complex system architectures, establish order in ambiguity, and drive technical excellence in a fast-paced, matrixed environment. This role is based in Bengaluru India and partners daily with the engineering and product teams driving both initiatives.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Drive Technical Excellence: Own and drive two critical identity programs — multi-entity account scale and automated access lifecycle — from scope definition through launch and adoption. Navigate complex microservice architectures, multi-tenant account and permission models, and intricate system dependencies to deliver capabilities that are secure, performant, and reliable at scale.
* Own the Scale Initiative: Drive the work of taking our account model from hundreds of entities to thousands — hierarchies, groups, bulk administration, and an API-first surface so customers and partners can manage identity programmatically rather than one user at a time. Dive deep into the technical subject matter and re-emerge with an end-to-end blueprint the delivery teams can execute against.
* Own the Access Automation Initiative: Drive the joiner/mover/leaver lifecycle to automatic — permissions applied correctly the moment someone is added, revoked the moment they leave, with the audit trail to prove it. Partner with engineering on the provisioning architecture and with product on the administrative experience that sits on top of it.
* Connect Strategy to Execution: Synthesize business strategy, customer signals, and delivery realities to prioritize across both initiatives and keep teams focused on the highest-impact outcomes. Lead the tradeoff discussions, recommend the execution path, and ensure follow-through with stakeholders.
* Execute with Rigor: Partner across teams to define program outcomes, build the end-to-end delivery plan, and establish the governance model for both initiatives. Develop and drive the operating rhythm — planning, reviews, cutline sessions, and decision forums — that sets direction and instills accountability.
* Own Risks and Dependencies: Both initiatives carry committed dependencies from product teams across Intuit. Uncover risks and dependencies before they materialize, proactively escalate blockers, determine the optimal path to green, and hold partner teams to dated commitments.
* Identity Architecture Partnership: Work with Identity Architects and engineering leaders to ensure account hierarchy, provisioning, and access patterns scale consistently across the Intuit ecosystem, and that both initiatives compose cleanly with the authorization and governance work running alongside them.
* Lead Change Through Migration and Adoption: Own the path from the current account model to the new one — not just the capability, but how existing customers get there without disruption. Identify the impact of key changes, develop the change plan, and exhibit extreme ownership driving from plan to sustained adoption, tracking that customers actually move rather than that the feature shipped.
* Enable Scale and Velocity: Build the frameworks, tooling, and instrumentation that make identity program delivery repeatable — and apply AI agent tools to accelerate program analysis, delivery, and stakeholder communication, evaluating AI-generated program artifacts with the same rigor applied to human-generated output.

**Qualifications**

* Experience: 8+ years in technical program management within platform organizations or high-scale software development environments, including demonstrated ownership of programs spanning multiple engineering organizations.
* Education: BA/BS in Computer Science, Information Systems, or an equivalent technical degree.
* Identity Platform Depth: Direct experience delivering customer identity and access management (CIAM) capabilities — authentication, authorization, account and organization modeling, or user provisioning and administration — in a product-facing platform serving external customers at scale.
* Access Model Fluency: Working knowledge of role- and attribute-based access control (RBAC/ABAC/PBAC), permission and entitlement models, delegated administration, and the failure modes that come with them — over-permissioning, role sprawl, and orphaned access.
* Multi-Tenant Hierarchy Modeling: Experience with systems that represent a customer's own organizational structure — parent/child entities, groups, delegated admins, cross-organization access — and the design tradeoffs between flexibility and comprehensibility at scale.
* Technical Domain Expertise: Strong grasp of SDLC methodologies, microservices architecture, and platform design, with the systems thinking to form an end-to-end blueprint in an unfamiliar problem area and the credibility to be treated as a thought partner by technical stakeholders. Fluency with API-first delivery, including developer-facing surfaces and programmatic administration.
* Scale Judgment: Demonstrated experience taking a platform capability from a small-customer design point to a large-customer design point, including the migration path for customers already on the old model.
* AI-Native Delivery: Demonstrated use of AI agents and tools in your own program work to accelerate analysis, structure delivery, and sharpen stakeholder communication — with firsthand judgment about where AI accelerates delivery and where it introduces risk.
* Leadership Style: Proven ability to lead through influence rather than authority, at a scope where you define the program rather than inherit it. Credibility as a boundaryless change leader who drives from plan to sustained adoption. You are a self-starter who values "Leadership as a Coach" and supports the growth of those around you.
* Communication: Excellent articulate and warm communication skills, with strong written fluency. You can compress a complex program into a page an executive can act on, and simplify technical problems into actionable insight for engineers and leaders alike.
* Problem Solving: Demonstrated ability to establish order in ambiguous situations and use rapid experimentation to learn fast and pivot when necessary.
* Analytical Skills: Strong data-driven mindset with the ability to track and report on program health, delivery velocity, and customer impact metrics.
* Preferred: Experience with identity standards and protocols (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, ReBAC/ABAC engines such as OPA); B2B or B2B2C SaaS serving mid-market or larger customers; experience delivering through partner, reseller, or professional-services channels.

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

* Experience aligning teams across various disciplines, including operational, engineering, product, and UX.
* Ability to successfully navigate through competing priorities, present complex ideas with clarity, and build strong partnerships with stakeholders.
* Ability to lead projects by navigating priorities, measurable objectives, dependencies, planning, resourcing, scheduling, budgeting, implementation and subsequent monitoring, through informal authority.

**About The Job**
Our Security team works to create and maintain the safest operating environment for Google's users and developers. Security Engineers work with network equipment and actively monitor our systems for attacks and intrusions. In this role, you will also work with software engineers to proactively identify and fix security flaws and vulnerabilities.
  
  
Google’s Global Security and Resilience Services (GSRS) team is keeping Google employees safe and secure to manage disruptive incidents and crises, and to anticipate, deter, detect, and act.
  
  
In this role, you will help develop a culture where safety, security and resiliency are integrated into every facet of Google, including the creative process. You will help us continually identify, evaluate and monitor enterprise risks that could affect business activities and provide business leaders the information they need to make critical decisions. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to create innovative strategies and develop exceptional programs that drive sustainable effectiveness. You will be responsible for completing initiatives that improve Google’s ability to anticipate, deter, detect, and act on security risks globally. You will drive delivery of physical security technology solutions in scope of the Global Security and Resilience Services (GSRS) organization. You will partner internally to prototype and develop solutions on accelerated timelines against stakeholder requirements, owning the full end to end delivery and support of those solutions throughout their lifecycle. Your delivery will enable GSRS operations to keep Google and Google employees safe and secure across the global office locations.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Analyze operational processes and business requirements to ensure alignment with the overall goal and delivery of the technology roadmap, new or existing products, with a focus on accessibility, scalable growth, automation, and business outcomes that mitigate key risks.
* Deliver technology solutions against strategic plans through tactical activities such as gathering requirements, developing user stories, lab testing and creating project, rollout and communications plans. Support evaluation, integration, and implementation of third party solutions.

8af3124d.title: Senior Platform Architect
8af3124d.description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Senior Platform Architect
  
  
Who is Mastercard?
  
  
Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
  
  
Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
  
  
**Overview**
The Infrastructure Engineering team is looking for a Senior Platform Architect to lead the design and evolution of secure, scalable, and resilient enterprise infrastructure platforms that power Mastercard's critical business services. The ideal candidate is a strategic technology leader with deep expertise in enterprise architecture, infrastructure engineering, and cloud technologies. They are highly collaborative, intellectually curious, and passionate about solving complex technical challenges while driving innovation, operational excellence, and platform modernization. This individual excels at partnering across engineering, security, and product organizations to deliver scalable solutions that enable business growth and provide exceptional customer experiences.
  
  
Role
  
  

* Lead the architecture, design, and delivery of highly available, scalable, and secure enterprise infrastructure solutions across on-premises, hybrid, and cloud environments.
* Partner with Engineering, Network, Security, Cloud, Database, Middleware, Product, and Program Management teams to develop infrastructure solutions that support business and technology strategies.
* Drive infrastructure solution delivery from initial business engagement through architecture reviews, financial approvals, procurement, implementation, operational readiness, and production deployment.
* Design resilient networking, application delivery, and security architectures utilizing enterprise technologies including load balancing, web application firewalls, API gateways, and distributed infrastructure platforms.
* Lead infrastructure modernization initiatives focused on automation, Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), platform standardization, performance optimization, resiliency, and operational excellence.
* Develop enterprise architecture standards, technical roadmaps, and infrastructure documentation while mentoring engineering teams and promoting engineering best practices.
* Ensure infrastructure solutions meet stringent requirements for security, compliance, availability, scalability, disaster recovery, and performance across mission-critical platforms.

**All About You**
Essential Knowledge, Skills & Experience
  
  

* Deep expertise in enterprise infrastructure architecture across data center, hybrid cloud, and distributed computing environments.
* Advanced knowledge of enterprise networking, application delivery, and infrastructure security, including Zero Trust principles and modern network architectures.
* Experience designing and supporting enterprise platforms utilizing VMware, cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, GCP), load balancing, web application firewalls, API gateways, and distributed infrastructure.
* Strong expertise in infrastructure automation, Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Ansible), CI/CD integration, and configuration management using tools such as Git, Bitbucket, and Jenkins.
* Demonstrated ability to architect and deliver highly available, resilient, and secure infrastructure solutions while collaborating effectively across cross-functional engineering and business teams.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to influence technical and executive stakeholders.

**Desirable Or Additional Capabilities**

* Expertise in infrastructure performance engineering, including capacity planning, scalability testing, and performance optimization.
* Advanced experience creating technical architecture documentation and executive presentations using Microsoft Visio.
* Experience supporting mission-critical financial services platforms with stringent availability, security, resiliency, and regulatory compliance requirements.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

TAP is expanding Ability Rehabilitation Centers nationwide, creating pathways to empowerment, higher quality of life, and meaningful community participation for people with disabilities.

This role oversees the planning, implementation, and monitoring of rehabilitation, inclusion, and awareness projects, ensuring alignment with organizational strategy, donor expectations, and community needs. 24046901.title: GDS Microsoft Frontier Innovation Solution Architect - Associate Director - India
24046901.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Role Title: GDS Microsoft Frontier Innovation Solution Architect - Associate Director - India**
**The opportunity**
The Microsoft Alliance is one of EY’s most strategic ecosystem relationships, helping clients accelerate transformation through cloud, data, AI, automation, security and emerging technologies. Within this agenda, the Frontier Innovation team brings together EY’s industry knowledge and Microsoft’s technology capabilities to shape scalable, market-relevant solutions that respond to priority client needs and create new growth opportunities across global markets.
  
  
We are seeking a senior, highly collaborative, technology-led and business-oriented Solution Architect / Strategist to provide global support to the Microsoft Frontier Innovation agenda. This role will help shape architecture direction, solution strategy, technical design standards, readiness criteria and scalable build approaches for prioritized Frontier Innovation initiatives. The individual will be expected to translate innovation concepts, alliance priorities and market opportunities into structured, technically sound and commercially relevant solution designs that can progress from ideation to build, activation and scale.
  
  
This role is designed for an experienced professional who can connect business strategy with practical technology architecture and provide senior-level direction across complex, matrixed stakeholder groups. You will work closely with global alliance leadership, Microsoft stakeholders, regional teams, solution owners, service line and sector teams, architects, engineering teams, sales, marketing and GDS teams to ensure Frontier Innovation solutions are technically feasible, commercially relevant, governance-ready and positioned for market activation.
  
  
This is an opportunity for a senior professional who enjoys working at the intersection of AI, cloud architecture, Microsoft technologies, alliances, solution design, global innovation and go-to-market growth. The role offers the opportunity to influence how EY and Microsoft shape, mature and scale the next generation of Frontier Innovation solutions across global priority markets.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Provide senior solution architecture leadership and strategic technical direction**

* Lead architecture direction for the global Frontier Innovation portfolio, ensuring each solution has a clear strategic intent, technical scope, design assumptions, dependencies, integration considerations, delivery pathway and ownership model.
* Translate global market priorities, client challenges and business requirements into pragmatic solution strategies, architecture choices and scalable implementation approaches.
* Develop architecture blueprints, solution patterns, design principles and reusable components that support consistent solution build, adaptation and scale across regions.
* Partner with solution owners, architects and technology stakeholders to validate technical feasibility, scalability, security, integration readiness, commercialization potential and operational handover requirements.
* Ensure key technical and strategic decisions are supported by clear documentation, rationale, ownership, risks, assumptions and aligned next steps.

**Shape AI, cloud and Microsoft solution strategy and architecture focus**

* Shape the strategy, architecture and design of solutions powered by Microsoft technologies, including Azure, Copilot, AI Business Solutions, Cloud and AI Platforms, Security, data, automation and emerging technology priorities.
* Evaluate Microsoft technology capabilities, platform patterns and architecture options to identify practical opportunities for global Frontier Innovation solutions.
* Build visibility into AI-enabled solution concepts, including use cases, accelerators, demos, client-zero examples, architecture artifacts, solution assets and go-to-market readiness.
* Promote responsible and practical adoption of AI by ensuring solution architecture discussions consider business value, risk, governance, data requirements, privacy, security, compliance and adoption needs.
* Translate complex Microsoft architecture and technology themes into compelling, business-friendly narratives that can be used with global leadership, regional teams, sales and broader stakeholder groups.

**Strengthen solution design governance and technical assurance**

* Support solution design reviews, architecture walkthroughs and technical governance checkpoints across prioritized global Frontier Innovation initiatives.
* Assess architecture readiness across key areas including solution scope, integration approach, data flow, security, scalability, performance, support model and operational handover.
* Coordinate with alliance, technology, solution, delivery and commercial teams to maintain visibility across technical decisions, dependencies, risks and required actions.
* Help assess whether solutions are progressing toward intended outcomes, including maturity, activation readiness, adoption potential, implementation feasibility and global market relevance.
* Prepare concise, executive-ready leadership summaries on architecture status, technical risks, design decisions required, readiness gaps and recommended actions.

**Lead global stakeholder alignment and senior collaboration**

* Act as a senior connector across global alliance leadership, Microsoft field teams, regional stakeholders, solution owners, architects, service line leaders, sector stakeholders, sales, marketing and GDS support teams.
* Support alignment across business, technology, delivery and go-to-market stakeholders so global priorities are translated into executable solution architecture actions.
* Coordinate solution design workshops, architecture forums and leadership check-ins to ensure progress is visible, decision points are clear and follow-through is disciplined.
* Proactively identify stakeholder gaps, ownership ambiguities, technical dependencies and cross-team risks that could impact solution build, readiness or market activation across regions.
* Build trusted relationships across a complex global and regional stakeholder network, influencing senior outcomes through clarity, structure, credibility and practical problem solving.

**Drive strategic architecture reporting, insights and readiness tracking**

* Develop and maintain architecture trackers, solution readiness summaries and executive views that provide clear visibility into global Frontier Innovation solution health and technical progress.
* Monitor key indicators related to solution maturity, architecture readiness, integration dependencies, technical risk, asset completeness, activation readiness and business outcomes.
* Analyze trends across solution architecture activities and provide practical recommendations to improve solution design, governance, reuse and go-to-market impact.
* Prepare materials for leadership reviews, monthly business reviews, quarterly business reviews and other global governance forums.
* Use data, architecture inputs and stakeholder feedback to tell a clear executive story on where solutions are progressing well, where support is required and where leadership decisions are needed.

**Enable global Frontier Innovation activation readiness and market outcomes**

* Work with sales, marketing, regional and solution teams to support activation planning for prioritized Frontier Innovation solutions.
* Track readiness of key technical and solution assets such as demos, architecture diagrams, credentials, case studies, sales collateral, enablement material, marketplace content and client-facing narratives.
* Help identify opportunities to scale successful Microsoft-powered solutions across priority accounts, sectors, service lines and regions.
* Support coordination of global and region-specific enablement activities so client-facing teams understand the solution architecture, value proposition and activation pathway.
* Ensure architecture-level insights and lessons learned are fed back into solution teams to strengthen commercialization, adoption, reuse and governance discipline.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
We are looking for someone who brings a strong balance of technical depth, solution architecture discipline, strategic thinking, senior stakeholder influence and execution orientation. The successful candidate will be comfortable working across leadership audiences, evolving Microsoft technologies and complex global solution landscapes while maintaining a practical focus on scalable design, decision clarity, execution readiness and measurable outcomes.
  
  

* Deep solution architecture, technical design and architecture governance experience, preferably across cloud, AI, data, automation, security or digital transformation solution portfolios.
* Ability to translate global business priorities, client needs and market opportunities into scalable Microsoft-powered solution architectures and practical implementation approaches.
* Strong understanding of Microsoft solution areas and ecosystem themes, including Azure, Copilot, AI Business Solutions, Cloud and AI Platforms, Security, data, automation and emerging technologies.
* Strong communication skills, including the ability to simplify complex architecture and technology information for senior leadership, business stakeholders and client-facing teams.
* Ability to influence without authority and build alignment across senior, matrixed alliance, technology, delivery, regional and commercial teams.
* Strong analytical capability with experience developing architecture artifacts, readiness trackers, executive summaries, technical narratives, decision papers and governance materials.
* High attention to detail, strong follow-through and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, ambiguous and globally matrixed environment.
* Curiosity, adaptability and a genuine interest in innovation-led growth, responsible AI and Microsoft technology transformation.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 15+ years of relevant professional experience in solution architecture, technology consulting, enterprise architecture, cloud architecture, digital transformation, innovation management, technology program enablement or strategic technology operations.
* Experience designing, shaping or advising on complex cross-functional technology solutions across regional or global stakeholder groups.
* Experience with architecture governance, technical design documentation, solution readiness tracking, architecture reviews, risk identification and performance management.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including experience preparing executive-ready materials, leadership updates and business-friendly technical narratives.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, identify technical risks early and drive structured follow-through in a fast-paced global environment.
* Experience working with technology-enabled transformation, cloud, AI, automation, data, security or digital solution portfolios.
* Graduate or postgraduate degree in technology, engineering, computer science, business, innovation management or a related discipline.

**Preferred Experience**

* Strong exposure to Microsoft ecosystem programs and solution areas, including Azure, Copilot, AI Business Solutions, Cloud and AI Platforms, Security, data, automation or related technologies.
* Experience in alliance management, co-sell motions, Frontier Innovation programs, solution strategy, marketplace offerings or technology partner ecosystems.
* Experience supporting global, multi-region or cross-market business priorities in a professional services, consulting, technology or global delivery environment.
* Experience working with architecture patterns, solution blueprints, reusable assets, demos, accelerators, solution readiness frameworks or technical governance models.
* Experience engaging senior business and technology stakeholders to shape priorities, resolve design trade-offs and drive decisions across global programs.
* Understanding solution commercialization, go-to-market activation, architecture governance, innovation lifecycle management and market readiness.
* Familiarity with responsible AI, data privacy, security, compliance and governance considerations in solution design and technology activation.

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic global delivery network that plays a vital role in advancing EY’s growth strategy. Working across locations including Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK, GDS teams collaborate with EY service lines, geographies and sectors to deliver high-quality work for clients around the world. In GDS, you will have the opportunity to contribute to meaningful projects, collaborate with diverse teams and build capabilities across an expanding ecosystem of people, learning, technology and insights that support long-term career growth.
  
  

* Continuous learning: Develop the mindset, skills and confidence to adapt, grow and navigate what comes next.
* Success, as defined by you: Access the tools, flexibility and support to make a meaningful impact in the way that works best for you.
* Transformative leadership: Gain insights, coaching and experiences that help you grow into the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: Be valued for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

2ffe9c74.title: Cloud Migration Specialist / Cloud Automation Engineer / Cloud Network Architect
2ffe9c74.description:
**Role Description**

These roles help organisations move applications and data to the cloud and operate the resulting environments reliably. They work with application owners, infrastructure teams, and security teams to plan changes, minimise service disruption, and verify that systems meet performance and connectivity requirements.

The
**Cloud Migration Specialist**
maps application dependencies, groups workloads into migration phases, and coordinates data replication, cutover, and post-migration checks. The
**Cloud Automation Engineer**
builds reusable infrastructure templates and deployment pipelines, adding automated checks to catch configuration errors before release. The
**Cloud Network Architect**
designs cloud and hybrid networks, defining address ranges, routing, segmentation, private connectivity, and failover to meet security and availability requirements.

**Qualifications**

* Degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Network Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience in cloud migration, infrastructure automation, or network architecture relevant to the position.
* Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform, such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Understanding of cloud compute, storage, networking, identity and access management, and monitoring.
* For migration roles, experience assessing application dependencies, planning cutovers and rollbacks, and validating workloads after migration.
* For automation roles, experience with infrastructure as code tools such as Terraform, version control, and CI/CD pipelines. Proficiency in Python, Bash, or PowerShell is an advantage.
* For network architecture roles, experience designing virtual networks, routing, DNS, firewalls, and hybrid connectivity using VPNs or dedicated links.
* Ability to document designs and operational procedures, troubleshoot across systems, and communicate risks and trade-offs clearly.

c4ebf271.title: Cloud Engineer
c4ebf271.description:
**Role purpose:**

To design, operate, and optimize the organization’s multi-cloud infrastructure with AWS as the primary platform and Azure as secondary, ensuring secure, scalable, and cost-optimized services. The role drives Infrastructure as Code (IaC) adoption, cloud architecture, containerization, DevOps automation, FinOps practices, and disaster recovery, while maintaining limited on premises infrastructure. It also requires strong operational experience in Microsoft environments, infrastructure BAU, and SecOps disciplines to ensure system reliability, availability, and compliance.

**Key responsibilities:**

**Cloud Infrastructure Design & Management**

•        Act as a multi-cloud architect with primary focus on AWS and secondary focus on Azure.

•        Design, implement, and optimize cloud infrastructure for resilience, security, and scalability.

•        Manage AWS services including EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, VPC, CloudFormation, Route 53, and CloudWatch.

•        Manage Azure services including VMs, Storage, Networking, Azure AD, and Synapse.

•        Implement and validate disaster recovery (DR) strategies in AWS and Azure.

•        Drive FinOps practices including cost governance, workload rightsizing, and resource optimization.

**Microsoft & Enterprise Systems Administration**

•        Administer and support Microsoft environments including Microsoft 365, Exchange, Active Directory, and Windows Server OS.

•        Manage domain services, identity synchronization, and group policies.

•        Ensure integration and secure identity management across hybrid environments.

**Infrastructure Operations (BAU)**

•        Oversee daily infrastructure BAU operations, ensuring backups, monitoring, patching, availability, and capacity management.

•        Lead 24/7 NOC operations for proactive monitoring, incident response, and root cause analysis.

•        Maintain and secure limited on-prem infrastructure including firewalls, switching, and IP telephony.

•        Monitor performance, availability, and reliability across all systems, ensuring SLA compliance.

**SecOps & Security Management**

•        Manage SecOps activities such as endpoint and server patching, vulnerability remediation, and system hardening.

•        Maintain compliance with ISO 27001, NIST, and SCA standards.

•        Collaborate with Security and Operations teams to ensure governance, visibility, and protection across the hybrid environment.

**Automation, DevOps & Infrastructure as Code (IaC)**

•        Design and implement CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps (preferred), AWS CodePipeline, and GitHub Actions.

•        Build and manage Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM, Bicep, and Ansible.

•        Automate provisioning, monitoring, and configuration for scalability and consistency.

•        Deploy and manage container platforms such as Amazon EKS and Azure AKS.

•        Promote automation-first culture to streamline deployments and reduce human error.

**Systems & Platform Management**

•        Maintain hands-on knowledge across both Windows and Linux operating systems.

•        Support system upgrades, configuration management, and patch deployment.

•        Integrate monitoring tools for performance visibility and proactive issue detection.

**Required qualifications & experience:**

·      Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field (Master’s preferred).

·      10+ years in IT infrastructure, with at least 5 years in AWS cloud and 3+ years in Azure.

·      Proven expertise as Cloud Infrastructure Engineer / Architect in AWS-first, multi-cloud environments.

·      Strong operational experience with Microsoft infrastructure and productivity platforms, including M365, Exchange, Active Directory, Windows Server, and domain management.

• Experience managing infra BAU operations (backups, monitoring, patching, capacity, and availability).

·      Certifications:

* AWS Solutions Architect Professional (required)
* AWS SysOps Administrator or DevOps Engineer certification (preferred)
* Azure Solutions Architect Expert (preferred)
* Microsoft Enterprise Administrator Expert
* ITIL Certification

·      Strong hands-on experience with:

* AWS services (EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, VPC, Route 53, CloudWatch, CloudFormation)
* Azure services (VMs, Azure AD, Synapse, Key Vault)
* Kubernetes orchestration (EKS primary, AKS secondary)
* DevOps toolchains & IaC (Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM, Bicep, Ansible)
* FinOps frameworks & multi-cloud cost optimization

·      Familiarity with ITIL, ISO 27001, NIST, and SCA compliance requirements.

**Skills & competencies:**

·      Expertise in AWS & Azure cloud architecture.

·      Solid knowledge of Microsoft 365, Exchange, domain services, and Windows OS administration.

·      Solid knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles and toolsets (Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM, Bicep, Ansible).

·      Strong understanding of infrastructure BAU (backups, monitoring, capacity planning, patching, and availability).

·      Experience in SecOps operations including vulnerability management, endpoint hardening, and patch management.

·      Good working knowledge of Linux and Windows operating systems.

·      Proficiency in Kubernetes (EKS, AKS) and DevOps automation pipelines.

·      Deep understanding of networking, firewalls, and hybrid cloud connectivity.

·      Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking.

* ·      Effective collaboration and stakeholder management across technical and business teams.

ec411be4.title: Systems Architect - AWS Cloud with AI
ec411be4.description:
We are seeking a **Systems Architect – AWS Cloud with AI** to lead enterprise-scale cloud migration and transformation initiatives, design robust AWS architectures and drive the adoption of AI-enabled cloud solutions for our clients.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end AWS cloud migration and transformation strategies covering assessment, migration planning, execution, cutover, optimization and modernization
* Design enterprise AWS Landing Zones, multi-account architectures, governance frameworks, networking, identity, security and automation standards
* Define target-state cloud-native and AI-enabled architectures by translating business and engineering requirements into scalable, resilient and cost-optimized solutions
* Lead client-facing architecture workshops, executive briefings and technical decision-making, representing the company as a senior cloud architecture advisor
* Create and govern architecture assets including high-level designs, migration blueprints, wave plans, feature breakdowns, estimations, risk assessments, playbooks and system blueprints
* Lead technical solutioning for RFPs and proposals, including cloud transformation and migration approaches, business cases, effort estimates, assumptions, risks and cost models
* Coordinate and guide delivery teams, including mid-sized teams of 6+ members, while mentoring architects and engineers and supporting project planning across budget, timeline and migration complexity
* Evaluate external vendor proposals, conduct architecture reviews and ensure solutions align with AWS and industry best practices for scalability, resilience, security, performance and cost optimization

**Requirements**

* 16-25 years of overall IT experience, with strong expertise in enterprise AWS cloud and systems architecture across EC2, S3, VPC, ELB/ALB, IAM, RDS, Lambda, CloudFormation and CloudWatch
* Expertise in AWS Landing Zones, Control Tower, multi-account strategy, Service Control Policies (SCPs), IAM, governance and enterprise cloud operating models
* Proven experience leading large-scale AWS migration programs, including application and infrastructure assessment, migration planning, wave-based execution, cutover and post-migration optimization
* Knowledge of AWS Migration Factory approaches and migration tooling such as AWS Server Migration Service (SMS) / Application Migration Service, including rehost, replatform and refactor strategies
* Experience in AWS networking and security architecture covering Transit Gateway, NACLs, Security Groups, AWS Network Firewall, hybrid connectivity, resilience and security best practices
* Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation using Terraform, AWS CloudFormation and/or CDK, along with CI/CD, GitOps and platform automation practices
* Experience with cloud-native modernization using EKS, ECS, Lambda, API Gateway, microservices, containers, serverless and event-driven architecture patterns
* Understanding of Generative AI and Agentic AI concepts, including RAG, LLM integrations and AWS AI/ML services such as Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker and OpenSearch for vector search
* Customer-facing consulting, architecture documentation, estimation, RFP/RFI solutioning and stakeholder management experience, with the ability to lead technical teams and architecture discussions
* AWS certification such as Solutions Architect – Professional or active pursuit of relevant AWS certification, along with a strong continuous-learning mindset and ITIL Foundation exposure

**Nice to have**

* Knowledge of multi-cloud and hybrid cloud architectures
* Exposure to service mesh and advanced container platforms including EKS, ECS and AWS App Mesh
* TOGAF, SEI or other enterprise architecture certifications
* Additional hands-on exposure to GenAI/Agentic AI solution patterns and AI-enabled cloud transformation programs

a363de0a.title: Product Delivery Manager - ServiceNow - Moveworks
a363de0a.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-ServiceNow – Supervising Associate (Product Delivery Manager – Moveworks)**
**Role Overview:**
The ServiceNow Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the end-to-end management and delivery of one or more ServiceNow technology solutions within EY. The role ensures that solutions are aligned with the overall EY ServiceNow strategy, integrate effectively within the enterprise technology ecosystem, and consistently deliver high-quality business outcomes.
  
  
As the primary representative and advocate of ET ServiceNow, the Product Delivery Manager is accountable for the success of assigned products and services. This includes ownership of product planning, roadmap development, backlog prioritization, stakeholder engagement, and delivery oversight throughout the product lifecycle. The Product Delivery Manager is accountable for evaluating emerging ServiceNow capabilities, aligning them with business objectives, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption through demonstrations and consultations, and establishing a prioritized roadmap and implementation backlog to maximize platform value.
  
  
The Moveworks Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the successful implementation, adoption, and ongoing evolution of the Moveworks platform across the enterprise. The role is responsible for evaluating new Moveworks features and innovations, assessing their applicability to business needs, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption, and prioritizing implementation initiatives that maximize value realization. The Product Delivery Manager ensures that solutions are delivered in accordance with governance standards, within agreed timelines and budgets, and meet quality, security, and user experience expectation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Product Strategy & Lifecycle Management:**

* Ensure products align with the EY ServiceNow strategy and broader enterprise technology objectives.
* Evaluate new ServiceNow platform capabilities and features, assess business value, and drive adoption opportunities.
* Develop and maintain the product implementation backlog based on business priorities and platform capabilities.

**Stakeholder Management:**

* Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor between ET ServiceNow and business stakeholders.
* Collaborate with business teams to understand requirements, challenges, and strategic objectives.
* Translate business needs into scalable ServiceNow solutions while promoting platform best practices and standardization.
* Work with multiple stakeholders/ vendors to clear business/ technical impediments/ blockers

**Product backlog and Planning:**

* Own and govern the product backlog, ensuring alignment with business priorities and strategic goals
* Work closely with Product Owners to define, prioritize, and refine features, enhancements, and technical requirements
* Balance business demands with platform capabilities, technical constraints, and long-term solution sustainability (strong functional understanding of ServiceNow is a must. Development experience expected).

**Delivery Management:**

* Successfully execute the project to agreed schedule, budget and scope
* Manage the demand process
* Monitor risks, dependencies, and delivery milestones, implementing mitigation plans as required.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams, including architecture, development, testing, operations, and vendors.
* Coordinate UAT and production go-live

**Governance and Continuous improvement:**

* Establish and maintain governance processes for product performance, quality, and compliance.
* Track product KPIs, adoption metrics, and customer satisfaction measures.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to optimize business processes and maximize platform value.

**Innovation and Platform enablement:**

* Stay current with ServiceNow roadmap developments and emerging platform capabilities.
* Demonstrate new features and innovations to business stakeholders and leadership teams.
* Identify opportunities to improve user experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes through ServiceNow.

**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field
* 3+ years of hands-on experience in ServiceNow development.
* Understanding of ITIL processes and HR Services
* Strong understanding of the Move works platform, including enterprise search, conversational AI, natural language understanding (NLU), employee support automation, and AI-driven workflow orchestration.
* Knowledge of Move works integration capabilities with ServiceNow, Microsoft Teams, Slack, HR systems, identity platforms, and enterprise applications
* Understanding of conversational experiences, virtual agents, knowledge management, and self-service adoption strategies.
* Advanced comprehension of agile SAFe project management methodology, tools and templates (includes project planning, schedule development, scope management and cost management)
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification

**What are we looking for?**

* A team player and leader with strong technical acumen and leadership capabilities
* Proactive problem-solving mindset with a focus on operational excellence
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Passion to learn and adapt to new technologies
* Strong functional/ technical understanding of ServiceNow applications (ITSM, ITOM, HRSD).

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

5c71f049.title: Solutions Manager II, Finance Systems
5c71f049.description:
**Company Description**
**About Grab and Our Workplace**
Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Get to Know the Team**
Grabber Technology Solutions (GTS) aims to be a technology leader that provides predictive and seamless experiences to all Grab employees (Grabbers). We are a diverse team of technology practitioners looking to outserve Grabbers with positive, personalized IT experiences, and we are looking for individuals with similar customer-centric and innovative values to join our growing team.
  
  
**Get to Know the Role**
Reporting to the Senior Manager, Finance Systems, you will combine hands-on finance systems expertise with delivery leadership to improve and operate Grab's finance technology landscape. You will lead internal and external specialists across Singapore, Malaysia and the Philippines, translating business needs into robust functional and technical solutions across Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials and Procurement and other finance platforms.
  
  
You will own delivery from demand shaping through production adoption, while ensuring operational stability, quality, controls and stakeholder satisfaction. This role is suited to an experienced finance systems practitioner who can work across business process design, solution architecture, integrations, testing, release governance and vendor management.
  
  
This role is based onsite at our Bangalore, India office.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**What Essential Skills You Will Need**

* You will have at least 7 years of experience in finance systems, enterprise resource planning (ERP) or financial technology delivery, including responsibility for solution ownership, project or enhancement delivery management, and senior stakeholder engagement.
* You will have strong hands-on knowledge of Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials and Procurement, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, Cash Management and Procurement, with a practical understanding of source-to-contract, order-to-cash, procure-to-pay and record-to-report processes.
* You will have the ability to diagnose and resolve issues from both functional and technical perspectives, including experience with Oracle Integration Cloud, REST and SOAP web services, File-Based Data Import, Application Development Framework Desktop Integrator, scheduled processes, interface monitoring, data reconciliation, Oracle Transactional Business Intelligence and BI Publisher.
* You will have proven experience managing the full delivery lifecycle, including change request prioritization, backlog management, capacity planning, sprint planning, vendor coordination, testing, release management, deployment and post-production support.
* You will have experience governing financial systems controls and audit requirements, including SOX controls, change management, release management, access or process controls, internal and external audit requests, and production incident governance.
* You will have a track record of leading and developing internal and external teams, managing vendor relationships and budgets, and building trusted relationships with Finance, Procurement, Technology and other senior stakeholders.
* You have experience engaging with artificial intelligence tools and emerging technologies to enhance productivity, improve workflows and contribute new ideas.

**Good to have**

* Experience with Oracle Enterprise Performance Management Cloud, Smart View, Kyriba, Concur or other treasury, planning and expense platforms.
* Experience with Order to Cash and Supply Chain Management processes, or finance integrations with banking, tax, customer relationship management or procurement platforms.
* Experience leading Oracle Cloud implementation, migration, upgrade or regional rollout programmes.
* Knowledge of IT service management and governance frameworks, including ITIL, COSO or COBIT.

**Additional Information**
**Life at Grab**
We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:
  
  

* We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.
* With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.
* Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through Parental and Birthday leave, and give back to your communities through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) volunteering leave
* We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.
* Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours

**What We Stand For At Grab**
We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that provides equal opportunity for Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. We consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, race, religion, age, gender, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.
