c1810d78.title: Solution Engineer
c1810d78.description:
Job Title: Solution Engineer / Pre-Sales – Cybersecurity

Experience: 4–6 Years

Domain: VAPT, Red Teaming, Application & Network Security

Employment Type: Full-Time

Role Overview

We are looking for a technically strong and client-facing Solution Engineer / Pre-Sales professional with experience in Vulnerability Assessment & Penetration Testing (VAPT), Red Teaming, Application Security, Network Security, and Cybersecurity consulting.

The candidate will be responsible for understanding customer security requirements, designing appropriate security assessment solutions, preparing technical proposals and Statements of Work (SoWs), conducting solution presentations and supporting the sales team throughout the pre-sales cycle.

Key Responsibilities

1. Pre-Sales & Solution

* Understand customer requirements and translate them into appropriate cybersecurity solutions.
* Design solutions for VAPT, Red Teaming, Application Security, Network Security, Cloud Security and Security Assessments.
* Define assessment scope, methodology, assumptions, deliverables and timelines.
* Prepare technical proposals, SoWs, RFP/RFI responses and solution presentations.
* Provide effort estimation, resource planning and project timelines.
* Participate in customer meetings, requirement-gathering sessions and technical discussions.
* Conduct technical presentations, solution walkthroughs and demonstrations.
* Work closely with sales, delivery and cybersecurity teams to ensure proposed solutions are technically feasible.

2. VAPT & Security Assessment Knowledge

* Strong understanding of Web Application, API, Mobile Application and Network VAPT.
* Good understanding of OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Security Top 10 and common security vulnerabilities.
* Knowledge of vulnerability identification, exploitation, risk rating and remediation.
* Understanding of infrastructure security assessments, firewall reviews, configuration reviews and wireless security assessments.
* Ability to define appropriate testing methodologies based on customer requirements.

3. Red Teaming & Adversary Simulation

* Understanding of Red Teaming, Adversary Simulation, Attack Path Analysis and Threat-Based Security Assessments.
* Knowledge of Red Team phases such as:
* Reconnaissance
* Initial Access
* Privilege Escalation
* Lateral Movement
* Persistence
* Defense Evasion
* Command & Control
* Data Discovery / Exfiltration
* Understanding of MITRE ATT&CK framework and attack techniques.
* Ability to explain the difference between VAPT, Red Teaming, Purple Teaming and Vulnerability Scanning.
* Experience in defining Red Team objectives, Rules of Engagement (RoE), scope and success criteria.

4. Technical Solution Development

* Map customer requirements to appropriate security testing activities.
* Develop assessment approaches covering:
* Web/API VAPT
* Mobile VAPT
* Network VAPT
* Cloud Security
* Active Directory / ID Security
* Wireless Security
* Firewall Configuration Review
* Source Code Review
* Threat Modeling
* Red Team / Adversary Simulation
* Phishing / Social Engineering Assessments
* Identify dependencies, prerequisites, access requirements and testing limitations.
* Coordinate with technical teams to validate proposed approaches and estimates.

5. Customer Engagement

* Act as a technical point of contact during the pre-sales lifecycle.
* Conduct discovery workshops and requirement discussions with customers.
* Understand the customer's business objectives, technology landscape and security concerns.
* Explain technical findings and proposed security solutions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Handle technical queries and objections during sales discussions.
* Support Proof of Concept (PoC), demonstrations and pilot engagements where required.

**Requirements**

Required Technical Skills

* Strong knowledge of VAPT and penetration testing methodologies.
* Good understanding of web applications, APIs, mobile applications and network infrastructure.
* Knowledge of common security tools such as:
* Burp Suite
* Nessus
* Nmap
* Metasploit
* Wireshark
* Kali Linux tools
* Knowledge of OWASP, MITRE ATT&CK and PTES.
* Understanding of Active Directory and identity security.
* Understanding of cloud security concepts across AWS/Azure/GCP.
* Knowledge of security architecture and threat modeling.
* Ability to understand technical architecture diagrams and identify security testing requirements.

Pre-Sales Skills

* Strong proposal and technical documentation skills.
* Experience preparing RFP/RFI responses, SoWs, BOQs and technical proposals.
* Ability to estimate effort in person-days/man-days.
* Strong presentation and communication skills.
* Ability to conduct technical discussions with CISOs, security teams, architects and IT teams.
* Ability to work with sales teams to identify opportunities and create security solutions.
* Good negotiation and stakeholder-management skills.

98c11fac.title: Senior Solutions Architect
98c11fac.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
  
  
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
  
  

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

**An Overview Of This Role**
As a Senior Solutions Architect on GitLab's India team, you'll be a trusted advisor to prospects, customers, and partners across India. You'll help them understand how GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform addresses technical requirements and business goals across the software development lifecycle. This role supports Commercial and Enterprise segments in India's Southern Region. Experience with Global Capability Centers (GCCs), Digital Native organizations, and startups is highly valued given the accounts you'll support.
  
  
You'll partner closely with Account Executives and cross-functional teams to own technical evaluations, including proofs of value and workshops, shape solution architectures, and bring customer feedback to Product Management. You'll also occasionally support regional go-to-market partners that provide Professional Services. Your work will help customers adopt GitLab successfully, support revenue growth through solution selling, and build long-term, trusted relationships.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Lead technical discovery, demonstrations, and validation to show how GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform meets customers' technical and business needs across the software development lifecycle.
* Own the technical evaluation process, including solution design, proofs of concept or value, workshops, and technical contributions to tenders, audits, and value stream assessments.
* Collaborate with Account Executives and regional sales teams across Commercial and Enterprise segments to shape account strategies for new customer acquisition and expansion, with a focus on GCC, Digital Native, and startup accounts.
* Support regional go-to-market partners that provide Professional Services, helping them deliver consistent technical guidance and apply effective practices during partner-led engagements.
* Represent GitLab at online and in-person marketing events, including webinars, industry events, presentations, roundtables, panels, demonstration days, and hackathons.
* Build trusted relationships with technical practitioners and business leaders, guide GitLab-driven transformation, and help customers become GitLab advocates.
* Advise customers on modern software development, continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD), security, and cloud practices to improve their return on investment.
* Share customer feedback, use cases, and competitive insights with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing while continuing to build expertise and reusable guidance in GitLab, DevSecOps, AI, and cloud technologies.

**What You’ll Bring**

* Experience guiding Commercial and Enterprise customers through solution design and evaluation in technical presales, consulting, or a similar role.
* Experience working with India's GCCs, Digital Native organizations, and startups is highly valued.
* Knowledge of the end-to-end software development lifecycle, including modern DevSecOps practices and CI/CD workflows.
* Hands-on experience with GitLab or comparable source control, CI/CD, and collaboration platforms, with the ability to connect platform capabilities to customer use cases.
* Practical knowledge of cloud computing concepts and related technologies, including deployment, security, and operations options.
* Ability to lead proofs of concept or value, contribute to tenders or audits, and design and run workshops or value stream assessments.
* Clear technical communication and presentation skills, with the ability to adapt your message for practitioners and senior business and technical decision-makers.
* Skill in building trusted relationships, listening with empathy, advocating for customers, collaborating with go-to-market or Professional Services partners, and continuously learning new technologies.

**About The Team**
The Solutions Architect team is part of GitLab's Sales organization and serves as the technical counterpart to Account Executives. This role focuses on Commercial and Enterprise opportunities across India's Southern Region and works with Account Executives, the broader go-to-market team, and regional partners that provide Professional Services. The team advises on architecture, runs technical evaluations such as proofs of value, and guides customers through digital transformation. We collaborate asynchronously with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to share effective practices, create reusable technical resources, and represent the voice of the customer. Our focus is helping customers modernize software delivery, adopt GitLab at scale, and navigate a changing AI and DevSecOps landscape.
  
  
**How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees**

* Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
* Flexible Paid Time Off
* Team Member Resource Groups
* Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Growth and Development Fund
* Parental Leave

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.
  
  
**Country Hiring Guidelines:**
GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.
  
  
**Privacy Policy:**
Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.
  
  
GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.

* Understanding of Security considerations in industrial automation, including secure system architecture and data protection.
* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, or related engineering field; advanced certifications in automation or control systems are an advantage.
* Hands-on experience with PLC, SCADA, DCS, and related industrial automation platforms, preferably in Cement, Power, Chemical, Oil & Gas, or Water sectors.
* Proficiency in reading and preparing technical drawings, specifications, and documentation, with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Effective communication and presentation skills, with the ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and engage with customers on-site.
* Willingness to travel to customer locations and project sites as needed, adhering to safety and quality standards.

0ef3f678.description:
**Job Description**

**Pre-Sales & Experience Centre Executive (In-Charge)**

  

**Company Description**

  

Livin Interiors, based in Bangalore, is recognized as one of the leading interior design firms in the city. With a clear mission and ambitious goals, Livin Interiors strives to transform interior design in India by creating spaces that combine aesthetics, functionality, and affordability.

The company believes that well-designed living and working spaces can positively impact mood, energy, and productivity. Through innovative and client-centric designs, Livin Interiors aims to create homes and environments that inspire energy and enthusiasm.

Role Description

We are looking for a dynamic, well-organized, and customer-focused

**Pre-Sales & Experience Centre Executive (In-Charge)** for our Bangalore office HSR Layouts

This is a full-time, on-site role involving front desk management, customer engagement, and overall experience centre operations. The candidate will be responsible for creating a welcoming and professional first impression for visitors while ensuring smooth day-to-day functioning of the experience centre.

The role also involves engaging with potential clients, understanding their interior design requirements, generating leads, conducting initial needs assessments, and coordinating with the sales and design teams to ensure a seamless customer experience.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Experience Centre & Front Desk Management**

* Manage the overall day-to-day operations of the experience centre.
* Welcome and attend to walk-in customers, visitors, and business associates professionally.
* Handle front desk activities, incoming calls, emails, and customer enquiries.
* Maintain visitor records, appointment schedules, and customer databases.
* Ensure the experience centre is clean, organized, presentable, and welcoming at all times.
* Coordinate meetings, client visits, and appointments with the sales and design teams.
* Ensure all displayed samples, material selections, catalogues, and design displays are properly maintained.

**2. Pre-Sales & Customer Engagement**

  

* Attend to incoming enquiries through calls, walk-ins, WhatsApp, and other communication channels.
* Understand customer requirements, preferences, budgets, and project expectations.
* Generate and qualify potential leads and schedule client appointments.
* Explain the company's interior design services, offerings, and solutions to prospective clients.
* Coordinate with the sales and design teams for client consultations and follow-ups.
* Prepare initial proposals, quotations, and other customer-related documentation as required.
* Maintain regular follow-ups with prospective clients to support lead conversion.

  

**3. Coordination & Administration**

  

* Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, leads, appointments, and follow-ups.
* Update customer information and lead status in CRM systems.
* Assist the sales team with daily activities, reports, and documentation.
* Handle basic administrative responsibilities related to the experience centre.

  

**Qualifications & Skills**

* Strong communication, interpersonal, and relationship-building skills.
* Previous experience in front desk management, customer service, sales coordination, or hospitality.
* Experience in managing a showroom, experience centre, or customer-facing office will be an added advantage.
* Knowledge of interior design concepts and materials is preferred.
* Good customer-handling skills with a professional and welcoming personality.
* Proficiency in MS Office, Excel and email
* Presentable, confident, proactive, and customer-oriented.
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Hospitality, or a related field preferred.
* Prior experience in the interior design or real estate industry will be an added advantage.

  

**Job Details**

  

* **Position:** Pre-Sales & Experience Centre Executive (In-Charge)
* **Employment Type:** Full-Time
* **Location:** Bangalore
* **Industry:** Interior Design ( **strongly preferred.** )
* **Work Mode:** On-Site

**Location:**

(DEAI HV) Product

R0137531
  
  
**Our Company**
We're Hitachi Vantara, the data foundation trusted by the world's innovators. Our resilient, high-performance data infrastructure means that customers - from banks to theme parks - can focus on achieving the incredible with data. If you've seen the Las Vegas Sphere, you've seen just one example of how we empower businesses to automate, optimize, innovate - and wow their customers. Right now, we're laying the foundation for our next wave of growth. We're looking for people who love being part of a diverse, global team - and who get excited about making a real-world impact with data.
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Senior Integration Solutions Engineer is responsible for architecting, validating, and documenting enterprise solutions leveraging S3-compatible object storage. This role works across data protection, analytics, AI/ML, search, and modern data lakehouse platforms to ensure solution interoperability, performance, scalability, and operational excellence. The engineer functions as a technical authority, designing validation strategies, developing performance benchmarks, troubleshooting complex environments, and publishing best-practice guidance for customers and partners.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Solution Architecture & Validation**

* Validate partner solutions including data protection, analytics, observability, search, and data lake platforms.
* Design and validate end-to-end reference architectures leveraging S3-compatible object storage for data protection, analytics, search, AI/ML, and data lake workloads.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and identify strategic integration opportunities for object storage platforms.
* Define validation methodologies that accurately reflect real-world customer deployment scenarios.
* Work directly with engineering, product management, partners, and field teams to ensure successful solution integration and deployment.
* Serve as a subject matter expert for object storage integration patterns, performance characteristics, and best practices.

**Integration & Performance Testing**

* Develop and execute comprehensive integration, interoperability, scalability, and performance test plans.
* Design benchmark tests that characterize throughput, latency, concurrency, and scalability under production-scale workloads.
* Build automated validation frameworks and test environments that improve testing efficiency and coverage.
* Identify performance bottlenecks across storage, network, compute, application, and infrastructure layers.

**Troubleshooting & Root Cause Analysis**

* Investigate complex issues spanning distributed applications, object storage systems, networking, operating systems, and cloud-native technologies.
* Analyze logs, traces, metrics, and telemetry data to determine root causes and recommend corrective actions.
* Reproduce field and customer-reported issues and work with development teams to validate resolutions.
* Provide technical leadership during escalations involving partner integrations and strategic customer environments.
* Publish validated reference architectures, deployment guides, solution briefs, and technical whitepapers.
* Develop sizing guidance, architecture recommendations, and performance tuning documentation.
* Present technical findings to customers, partners, sales engineers, and executive stakeholders.

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience designing, validating, or supporting enterprise-scale data platform, storage, or cloud infrastructure solutions.
* Strong background in integration testing, performance testing, or solution validation.
* Proven troubleshooting experience with distributed applications and multi-tier architectures.
* Experience with object storage technologies and S3-compatible APIs.
* Strong analytical skills and ability to investigate complex technical challenges independently.
* Excellent written communication skills with experience creating technical documentation.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Commvault, Veeam, Cohesity, Rubrik, or other data protection platforms.
* Experience with Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Splunk, or large-scale search and observability platforms.
* Experience with Apache Spark, Kafka, Trino, Iceberg, Delta Lake, Starburst, Databricks, or similar data analytics technologies.
* Familiarity with AI/ML data pipelines and data lake architectures.
* Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and cloud-native environments.
* Experience authoring technical whitepapers, benchmark reports, and reference architectures.
* Experience presenting technical findings to customers and executive audiences.
* Strong knowledge of Linux, networking, and system administration concepts.
* Proficiency in Python, scripting, or test automation development.

**About Us**
We're a global team of innovators. Together, we harness engineering excellence and passion for insight to co-create meaningful solutions to complex challenges. We turn organizations into data-driven leaders that can make a positive impact on their industries and society. If you believe that innovation can inspire the future, this is the place to fulfil your purpose and achieve your potential.
  
  
**Fostering innovation through diverse perspectives**
Hitachi is a global company operating across a wide range of industries and regions. One of the things that sets Hitachi apart is the diversity of our business and people, which drives our innovation and growth.
  
  
We are committed to building an inclusive culture based on mutual respect and merit-based systems. We believe that when people feel valued, heard, and safe to express themselves, they do their best work.
  
  
**How We Look After You**
We help take care of your today and tomorrow with industry-leading benefits, support, and services that look after your holistic health and wellbeing. We're also champions of life balance and offer flexible arrangements that work for you (role and location dependent). We're always looking for new ways of working that bring out our best, which leads to unexpected ideas. So here, you'll experience a sense of belonging, and discover autonomy, freedom, and ownership as you work alongside talented people you enjoy sharing knowledge with.
  
  
We're proud to say we're an equal opportunity employer and welcome all applicants for employment without attention to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, age, disability status or any other protected characteristic. Should you need reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know so that we can do our best to set you up for success.

ab4d5da7.title: Solution Architect
ab4d5da7.description:
**Key Responsibilities**

* Business Partnership and Requirements Discovery
* Partner with business stakeholders to understand desired outcomes, operational challenges, and opportunities for technology improvement.
* Translate business needs into functional requirements, technical requirements, and actionable solution designs.
* Identify constraints, dependencies, assumptions, and success criteria early in the planning process.
* Help stakeholders evaluate whether to adopt existing capabilities, purchase a solution, build new functionality, or integrate available services.
* End-to-End Solution Design
* Design solutions spanning business applications, enterprise platforms, data flows, integrations, infrastructure, and cloud services.
* Balance business value, user experience, scalability, reliability, security, delivery complexity, and total cost of ownership.
* Evaluate proposed solutions for compatibility with existing systems, enterprise standards, and long-term technology direction.
* Develop architecture diagrams, integration specifications, architecture decision records, and implementation roadmaps.
* Identify opportunities to simplify the technology environment, reuse existing capabilities, and reduce unnecessary duplication.
* Technology Evaluation and Decision Support
* Assess products, platforms, services, and vendors against business and technical requirements.
* Present recommendations with clear explanations of alternatives, trade-offs, costs, risks, and operational implications.
* Lead or support proofs of concept to validate feasibility and resolve material uncertainties.
* Partner with procurement, legal, information security, and technology teams as needed during solution selection.

  

**Delivery Guidance and Collaboration**

* Provide architectural guidance to engineering, infrastructure, application, and implementation teams throughout delivery.
* Work with project and product leaders to align solution scope, dependencies, sequencing, and technical milestones.
* Review implementation designs and help resolve cross-system or cross-team technical issues.
* Identify material deviations from the agreed architecture and help teams evaluate and document appropriate changes.
* Support transition to operations through clear documentation, ownership definitions, and knowledge transfer.
* Architecture Alignment and Responsible Design
* Collaborate with Information Security Architecture to incorporate appropriate safeguards into solution designs from the outset.
* Partner with relevant specialists to address privacy, compliance, resilience, accessibility, and operational requirements.
* Align solutions with established architecture principles and technology standards while supporting justified exceptions.
* Surface material risks and unresolved decisions to the appropriate stakeholders and decision-makers.
* Contribute reusable patterns, reference architectures, and lessons learned to improve future solution delivery.

  

**Role Scope and Accountability**

* The roles primary accountability is the quality and suitability of the overall technology solutionnot ownership of the information security program.
* Business stakeholders retain ownership of business priorities, requirements, and acceptance.
* Delivery teams retain responsibility for implementation and ongoing technical execution.
* Security, privacy, compliance, and other specialist teams retain their respective policy, assurance, and approval responsibilities.
* The Solutions Architect connects these perspectives into a coherent design, makes recommendations, and guides architectural decisions within delegated authority.
* The reporting relationship provides a home for architectural leadership and secure design practices without limiting the role to security technologies, security reviews, or control enforcement.

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Demonstrated experience designing and delivering technology solutions across multiple systems or technical domains.
* Experience in solution architecture, software engineering, systems integration, infrastructure, cloud engineering, or a related discipline.
* Strong understanding of application architecture, APIs, integration patterns, databases, networking, and cloud services.
* Ability to translate ambiguous business needs into clear requirements and practical technical designs.
* Ability to evaluate alternatives across functionality, security, performance, reliability, maintainability, and cost.
* Experience producing architecture diagrams, technical documentation, and decision records.
* Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts to nontechnical audiences.
* Ability to build consensus, influence decisions, and work effectively across teams without direct management authority.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively in a fully remote environment.
* Bachelors degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with enterprise applications, SaaS platforms, cloud services, and hybrid technology environments.
* Experience with technology modernization, platform consolidation, or complex integration initiatives.
* Familiarity with identity and access management, data protection, and secure design principles.
* Experience evaluating vendors, developing proofs of concept, and assessing total cost of ownership.
* Familiarity with DevOps practices, infrastructure as code, and automated delivery pipelines.
* Relevant solution architecture, cloud, or enterprise architecture certifications.
* A dedicated cybersecurity background or security certification is not required. Candidates should demonstrate the ability to incorporate security requirements into broader solution designs and collaborate effectively with security specialists.

  

**Measures of Success**

* Proposed solutions address clearly defined business needs and measurable outcomes.

656bc41b.title: Solution Architect / Partner Solution Architect
656bc41b.description:
Solution Architect / Partner Solution Architect

**Function:** Auraa Engineering • **Level:** Senior individual contributor • **Product:** Auraa by Covasant, built on Databricks

Shape Auraa deals with enterprise customers, build trusted technical relationships with Databricks field teams, and design the one-week Proofs of Value that prove our platform.

Building the foundation for enterprise AI

Covasant is an AI native company building autonomous, agent driven systems for the modern data and AI stack. Auraa, our agentic data activation platform, builds governed lakehouses on Databricks, giving data and AI leaders the capacity to move from infrastructure to AI outcomes, faster.

We are ISO/IEC 42001 certified, and Google Cloud selected us as one of seven AI-native partners worldwide for its Gemini Enterprise Transformation program. Our customers include financial services firms, insurers, manufacturers and retailers.

The fastest path to AI-ready data on Databricks

We launched Auraa at Databricks Data + AI Summit 2026. It is our agentic data activation platform, built natively on Databricks. Customers describe what they need in plain language, and Auraa's agents discover sources, build pipelines, enforce data quality and register everything in Unity Catalog.

Auraa runs on governed, versioned metadata rather than generated code, so every decision is auditable and every result reproducible. We take it to market together with Databricks.

Trusted by customers, trusted by Databricks

You own the technical side of the Auraa deals you work on. For customers, that means an honest view of fit, a demo on their own data and an estimate you stand behind. For Databricks field teams, it means knowing when to bring us in and how to explain what Auraa does.

Every deal is proven through a one-week Proof of Value (PoV) on the customer's live data. You design it, and delivery team runs the build with you.

What you will do with customers

* **Run discovery.** Map the customer's Databricks estate, source systems, identity and security posture, and the AI use cases they care about.
* **Design the target architecture** that builds on the customer's existing Databricks investment.
* **Design the PoV.** Agree scope, out-of-scope items and written success criteria before the week starts, so it ends in a clear decision.
* **Size what comes next.** Turn PoV results into a phase two proposal with an estimate delivery can execute.
* **Support the buying process.** Architecture documents, security questionnaires and references for the CIO, CISO and procurement.

What you will do with Databricks

* **Develop technical champions** among Databricks account executives, solution architects and partner managers in your territory.
* **Co-sell on live deals,** joining Databricks account teams on discovery and account planning.
* **Enable the field** with short technical sessions, a demo they can run themselves and one-page reference architectures.
* **Represent Auraa** at Databricks events such as Data + AI Summit and in joint webinars, and keep our Marketplace listing and partner validations current.

What you bring

* **8 to 14 years in technical roles,** with at least 3 as a pre-sales, solution or consultant architect on data platform deals.
* **Hands-on Databricks.** Unity Catalog, Lakeflow, SQL Warehouses, MLflow, Mosaic AI and Genie, deep enough to build in a customer workspace yourself.
* **Data platform fundamentals.** Medallion architecture, CDC, governance and data quality.
* **Agentic AI experience,** with a realistic sense of what it takes to put agents into production.
* **Estimating discipline.** Estimates you can defend, with assumptions written down.
* **Partner fluency.** A co-sell track record with Databricks, a hyperscaler or a major ISV, and comfort with MEDDIC and forecast stages.
* **Clear communication** with executives and engineers, in strong written and spoken English.

What will stand out

* Field or partner experience at Databricks, a Databricks partner SI or a hyperscaler.
* Industry depth in financial services, retail or manufacturing, or regulated environments (SOC 2, GDPR, India DPDP).
* Experience with fixed-bid, outcome-based or marketplace commercial models.
* Databricks and cloud architect certifications (Google Cloud, Azure or AWS).

How we hire

Each stage reflects a real part of the role.

1. **Deal conversation.** Walk us through a data platform deal you shaped and what happened in delivery.

2. **Discovery role-play.** Run the first 30 minutes of discovery with a customer's head of data.

3. **Build exercise.** Build a working slice on a sample dataset and explain your choices.

4. **Partner scenario.** A Databricks AE wants a fast yes near quarter end. Tell us how you handle it.

*With your application, share a deal where your architecture made the difference.*

Covasant is an equal opportunity employer. We hire on capability and judgment.

**Innovation Hub Overview**

Jefferies is creating a Technology Innovation Hub in Pune, a greenfield opportunity to build the systems that power global markets. As our first India technology center, this hub brings together hands on builders who engineer the platforms behind Jefferies’ growth across capital markets, investment banking, and institutional securities. We’re scaling toward an elite team of 500 engineers while maintaining the agility, ownership, and meritocratic spirit that defines Jefferies. From cloud and data to AI, risk, and core business technologies, teams in Pune will lead high impact work with a global mandate.

**IT Infrastructure Technology**

Jefferies’ IT Infrastructure Technology team builds and runs the core technology backbone that enables the firm to operate globally. It covers enterprise infrastructure engineering and operations while driving modernization initiatives such as Cloud Adoption and Network Resiliency. The group supports critical platforms including networking, end-user computing, cloud, databases, server/Unix engineering, communications, and global data centers (including low-latency colocations near exchanges).

**Role summary**

Drive Azure cloud adoption and engineering excellence as part of our multi-cloud infrastructure strategy. You will design, deploy, and operate Azure-based solutions, establish Azure best practices and standards, and partner with the broader cloud team to ensure seamless integration with our AWS-primary environment. This role requires deep Azure expertise combined with the ability to navigate a multi-cloud landscape, strong Terraform skills, and a focus on security, governance, and operational excellence.

You will partner closely with Platform Engineering, Cloud Security, Networking, Identity Teams, Power Platform, Database, Unix, and business line technology teams supporting Equities, Investment Banking, and other divisions. Strong collaboration, interpersonal skills, and customer service orientation are critical as you work across global distributed teams. Experience working in Agile environments using Jira and Confluence is expected.

**Key responsibilities**

* Design, deploy, and operate highly available, scalable, and secure Azure cloud infrastructure supporting business applications
* Establish Azure reference architectures, best practices, and "golden path" patterns for workload onboarding aligned with existing AWS standards
* Implement Infrastructure as Code using Terraform Enterprise (modules, state management, workspaces) and Terraform Enterprise for Azure resources; maintain parity with AWS IaC patterns where applicable
* Architect and implement Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) clusters with a focus on security, RBAC, networking, autoscaling, and operational excellence
* Collaborate with Cloud Architecture, Cloud Security, Networking, Identity, Database, and Unix teams to integrate Azure workloads with existing infrastructure and security controls
* Develop and implement Azure governance frameworks: subscription design, management groups, Azure Policy, role-based access control (RBAC), and cost management
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for Azure deployments using GitHub, Bamboo, GitLab, ArgoCD, and Azure DevOps
* Provide consulting and technical expertise to application teams on securely integrating Azure services (Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Service Bus, Cosmos DB, Azure SQL, etc.)
* Troubleshoot complex issues spanning Azure infrastructure, AKS, networking (VNet, NSG, Application Gateway, Azure Front Door), and identity (Azure AD, managed identities)
* Drive compliance and security efforts: implement secure architectures, maintain audit readiness, and support regulatory requirements
* Create and maintain Azure-specific documentation, runbooks, and operational procedures
* Identify opportunities for automation and toil reduction; implement GenAI-assisted workflows where appropriate
* Participate in on-call rotation as needed to support Azure infrastructure and workloads
* Lead or contribute to incident response for Azure-related issues; conduct post-incident reviews and track corrective actions
* Develop runbooks and standard operating procedures for Azure operations; support knowledge transfer to global teams
* Define and monitor SLOs/SLIs for Azure services; drive continuous improvement in reliability and performance
*  Maintain compliance with change management, documentation, and security standards

**Requirements**

* 7+ years in cloud engineering, DevOps, or infrastructure roles with 4+ years of hands-on Azure experience
* Azure Administrator Associate and/or Azure Solutions Architect Expert certification required; Azure DevOps or Security certifications preferred
* Strong experience designing and implementing resilient, cloud-native, and multi-region Azure solutions
* Proficiency with Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS): networking, ingress controllers, RBAC, monitoring, security
* Deep understanding of Azure services: compute (VMs, App Service, AKS, Functions), networking (VNet, NSG, Application Gateway, Traffic Manager), storage (Blob, Files, Disks), databases (Azure SQL, Cosmos DB), and identity (Azure AD, managed identities)
* Expert-level Terraform skills for Azure; experience with Terraform Enterprise strongly preferred
* Strong understanding of IaC, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices
* Proficiency in Python, PowerShell, Azure CLI, and scripting for automation
* Experience implementing secure architectures for private and public-facing systems
* Strong understanding of networking protocols, distributed systems, and cloud security best practices
* Excellent communication, teamwork, and customer service skills; ability to partner with global technology and business teams
* Proficiency using GenAI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, GitHub Copilot) for infrastructure design, troubleshooting, code generation, and documentation
* Ability to implement AI agent-driven automation (agentic workflows) safely in enterprise environments: enforce human-in-the-loop controls, maintain comprehensive logging and auditability, establish guardrails, implement rollback mechanisms, and secure credential handling
* Proactive approach to identifying manual toil and shipping automation that measurably reduces repetitive work; track and report efficiency gains

**Preferred**

* AWS Solutions Architect Associate or equivalent; multi-cloud experience is highly valued
* CKAD certification or strong Kubernetes operations background
* Experience with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI for Azure workloads
* Background in software development or systems administration
* Familiarity with Azure monitoring and observability tools (Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics)
* Knowledge of compliance frameworks and shared responsibility models

9a575e37.title: L2 Cloud Operations Engineer (Azure & AWS)
9a575e37.description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an L2 Cloud Operations Engineer (Azure & AWS) based in India.**
As an L2 Cloud Operations Engineer, you will play a critical role in maintaining, securing, and optimizing enterprise cloud infrastructure across Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS). You will provide Level 2 operational support, troubleshoot infrastructure incidents, and ensure the availability, performance, and reliability of cloud-based environments. Working across virtual machines, storage, networking, security, and backup services, you will help maintain resilient and scalable cloud operations. You will collaborate closely with L1 support, senior cloud engineers, and cross-functional technical teams to resolve complex issues and improve service delivery. You will also contribute to infrastructure lifecycle management, vulnerability remediation, disaster recovery, and resource optimization. This is an opportunity to work with modern cloud technologies in a global, fast-paced environment supporting critical enterprise infrastructure around the clock.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Manage Azure cloud operations: Provide Level 2 support for Azure infrastructure incidents, monitoring alerts, and service requests, ensuring timely resolution and operational continuity.
* Administer Azure resources: Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Azure Virtual Machines, disks, storage accounts, and related cloud resources.
* Monitor Azure infrastructure: Track resource health, availability, performance, and utilization using Azure Monitor and Log Analytics.
* Troubleshoot Azure environments: Investigate VM startup failures, connectivity issues, CPU and memory utilization, disk performance, and operating system-related incidents.
* Manage Azure networking: Support Virtual Networks, subnets, Network Security Groups (NSGs), and connectivity troubleshooting to maintain secure and reliable communication.
* Support Azure lifecycle management: Execute approved VM provisioning, resizing, patching, backup validation, and infrastructure maintenance activities.
* Maintain Azure data protection: Support Azure Backup, Recovery Services Vault, restoration procedures, and disaster recovery operations.
* Manage Azure access and security: Assist with access management through Azure Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and support security and compliance remediation activities.
* Manage AWS cloud operations: Provide Level 2 operational support for AWS infrastructure incidents, alerts, and service requests.
* Administer AWS resources: Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Amazon EC2 instances, EBS volumes, snapshots, and associated infrastructure resources.
* Monitor AWS environments: Use Amazon CloudWatch to monitor infrastructure health, resource utilization, performance, and operational alerts.
* Troubleshoot AWS infrastructure: Investigate instance availability, connectivity, performance, and operating system-related issues to maintain service reliability.
* Manage AWS networking: Support VPCs, subnets, security groups, route tables, and network connectivity troubleshooting.
* Support AWS lifecycle activities: Perform approved instance provisioning, resizing, patching, backup validation, and infrastructure maintenance.
* Maintain AWS backup and recovery: Support AWS Backup, snapshot management, restoration procedures, and disaster recovery activities.
* Support AWS security: Assist with IAM access reviews, security remediation, and compliance activities within authorized operational responsibilities.
* Ensure SLA compliance: Resolve cloud infrastructure incidents and service requests within defined service-level agreements while following established operational procedures.
* Execute infrastructure changes: Implement approved changes and routine operational tasks, validating service health following maintenance activities.
* Support security and maintenance operations: Contribute to cloud patching, vulnerability remediation, backup verification, and recovery processes.
* Manage incident escalation: Investigate monitoring alerts and escalate complex platform, networking, identity, and architecture issues to Level 3 Cloud specialists.
* Follow ITIL processes: Apply Incident, Problem, Change, and Request Management practices to ensure consistent and controlled service delivery.
* Maintain technical documentation: Update operational runbooks, incident records, troubleshooting procedures, and shift handover documentation.
* Collaborate across technical teams: Coordinate with Security, Network, Windows/Linux, Storage/Backup, and Application teams to resolve infrastructure issues.
* Optimize cloud resources: Monitor utilization and identify opportunities to improve infrastructure capacity, performance, resource allocation, and cloud costs.
* Coordinate global operations: Ensure effective follow-the-sun handovers across APAC, EMEA, and North America teams, supporting uninterrupted 24/7/365 cloud operations.

**Requirements**

* Professional experience: 3–6 years of hands-on experience in cloud infrastructure operations, with practical expertise in Microsoft Azure and/or Amazon Web Services (AWS).
* Azure expertise: Working knowledge of Azure Virtual Machines, disks, storage accounts, Azure Monitor, and Log Analytics.
* AWS expertise: Practical knowledge of Amazon EC2, Elastic Block Store (EBS), snapshots, and Amazon CloudWatch.
* Cloud networking: Understanding of Azure Virtual Networks, subnets, Network Security Groups, AWS VPCs, security groups, route tables, and cloud networking fundamentals.
* Infrastructure administration: Experience with cloud VM provisioning, resource monitoring, troubleshooting, patching, resizing, and lifecycle management.
* Identity and access management: Working knowledge of Azure RBAC and/or AWS IAM, including access controls, permissions, and security management.
* Backup and disaster recovery: Understanding of cloud backup solutions, recovery procedures, disaster recovery fundamentals, and vulnerability remediation.
* ITSM and ITIL: Experience with IT Service Management platforms such as ServiceNow and familiarity with ITIL-based Incident, Problem, Change, and Request Management processes.
* Scripting and automation: Basic scripting knowledge using PowerShell, Python, Azure CLI, or AWS CLI to support infrastructure administration and operational automation.
* Production operations: Experience working in SLA-driven enterprise production environments, preferably within a 24/7 infrastructure support model.
* Cloud certifications: Microsoft Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104) certification is desirable.
* AWS certifications: AWS Certified CloudOps Engineer – Associate or an equivalent AWS certification is an advantage.
* Infrastructure as Code: Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or Bicep is beneficial.
* Cloud automation tools: Exposure to Azure Automation, Azure Update Manager, or AWS Systems Manager is desirable.
* Cost and capacity management: Knowledge of cloud cost optimization, resource tagging, capacity planning, and compliance monitoring is a plus.
* Monitoring and backup solutions: Experience with enterprise monitoring platforms, backup technologies, and disaster recovery tools is an advantage.
* Hybrid infrastructure: Familiarity with hybrid cloud environments and integration between cloud platforms and on-premises infrastructure is desirable.
* Problem-solving abilities: Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to investigate infrastructure issues, identify root causes, and implement effective solutions.
* Communication and collaboration: Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and global stakeholders.
* Schedule flexibility: Willingness to work rotational shifts within a global 24/7/365 follow-the-sun support model covering APAC, EMEA, and North America.

**Benefits**

* Remote working: Fully remote working arrangement from India.
* Technical development: Opportunities to strengthen expertise in Microsoft Azure, AWS, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise operations.
* Professional certifications: Exposure to industry-recognized cloud certification pathways, including Microsoft Azure and AWS.
* Continuous learning: Opportunities to develop skills in cloud automation, Infrastructure as Code, security, monitoring, and disaster recovery.
* Global exposure: Collaboration with international technical teams across APAC, EMEA, and North America.
* Career growth: Opportunities to expand your cloud engineering expertise while working on enterprise-scale infrastructure environments.
* Collaborative culture: A supportive environment that encourages innovation, knowledge sharing, and teamwork.
* Inclusive workplace: A diverse and welcoming culture where employees are encouraged to contribute ideas and develop their potential.

**How Jobgether Works**

**AI-powered matching process**
to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.
  
  
We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!
  
  
Why Apply Through Jobgether?
  
  
**Data Privacy Notice:**
By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. 6bf185f8.title: Hardware Technical Program Manager
6bf185f8.description:
**Arista Networks**
is an industry leader in data-driven, client-to-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. Arista is a well-established and profitable company with over $12 billion in revenue. Arista’s award-winning platforms, ranging in Ethernet speeds up to 800G bits per second, redefine scalability, agility, and resilience. Arista is a founding member of the Ultra Ethernet consortium. We have shipped over 20 million cloud networking ports worldwide with CloudVision and EOS, an advanced network operating system. Arista is committed to open standards, and its products are available worldwide directly and through partners.

At Arista, we value the diversity of thought and perspectives each employee brings. We believe fostering an inclusive environment where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome is essential for driving creativity and innovation.

Our commitment to excellence has earned us several prestigious awards, such as the Great Place to Work Survey for Best Engineering Team and Best Company for Diversity, Compensation, and Work-Life Balance. At Arista, we take pride in our track record of success and strive to maintain the highest quality and performance standards in everything we do.

**Who You’ll Work With:**

Arista is seeking a Hardware Technical Program Manager. This is a critical role, ensuring that Arista customer driven programs complete milestone deliverables to meet the customer’s needs and prevent delays to their internal development and deployment programs. As a Technical Program Manager you will work directly with experienced internal cross-disciplinary engineering team leaders, customers, and strategic partners to drive hardware product development from planning, design, validation, qualification, through release to volume production. You will lead the cross-functional engineering team through the NPI product lifecycle phases and the associated design and phase gate reviews. Strong leadership, communications, problem solving, and communication skills are essential.

**What You’ll Do:**

Specific Duties and Responsibilities:

* Creating statement of work (SoW) and product requirement documents (PRD) for complex technical programs
* Owns and facilitates weekly cross-functional engineering team meetings.
* Interface with key customers and strategic partners to develop program plans including negotiating schedules, milestone deliverables, prototype allocations, and feature set.
* Lead a cross-functional team from HW, SW, Central, and Diagnostic engineering, manufacturing engineering, product management, ODM/JDM partners, and customer support to deliver outstanding products to the market.
* You will be responsible for tracking and reporting on the cross-functional design engineering validation, and qualification status of your programs, as well as identifying and solving any concerns prior to them causing impact.
* Create a master schedule that captures and inter-connects the key cross-functional deliverables as defined by the product development lifecycle and ensure the team stays on track to meet program milestones.
* Lead program design review and bug scrub meetings
* Identify risks on program planning and actively work on mitigation plan with all stake holders
* Drive, coordinate, and monitor engineering programs including scheduling, planning, product and project cost analysis, and milestone checkpoint reviews.
* Drive cross-functional issue resolution ensuring issues are identified, assigned owners, and tracked to closure. Ensure issues are escalated to the appropriate functional leaders.
* Facilitate engineering portion of phase gate review meetings

**Qualifications**

* 10+ years of NPI hardware engineering and leadership experience
* Design engineering, New Product Introduction, and manufacturing experience with rack-mounted data center or enterprise equipment
* Experience working with multiple engineering disciplines including electrical, mechanical, software, diagnostics, test, and manufacturing engineering team members
* Exceptional project management skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication and organizational skills.
* Significant working knowledge of hardware development.
* Proven track record of managing hardware projects and delivering on time.
* Demonstrated ability to take initiative, define, document, implement new processes.
* Experience interfacing with product management, internal cross-functional engineering teams, and sub-tier suppliers
* Ability to listen and simplify complex topics for non-technical audiences, and prepare summaries for executives and stakeholders.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electronics and communication, industrial engineering or equivalent experience. MS/MBA and PMP are desirable.

f735f2ac.title: Program Manager
f735f2ac.description:
**Role Purpose**

myPulse.io is looking for an experienced Program Manager - Technology & Lending to lead and govern the delivery of strategic technology initiatives across the business. The role requires excellent understanding of lending businesses combined with strong technology program management expertise.

The Program Manager will manage Project Managers and provide end-to-end governance across the IT project portfolio, from requirements and planning through development, demonstrations, UAT, business sign-off, release and closure. The individual will be a key interface between Business, Product, Technology and senior management, ensuring that technology projects deliver agreed business outcomes with clear ownership, traceability and accountability.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Program and Portfolio Management**

* Own the integrated plan across major IT projects and technology initiatives.
* Manage and provide governance to Project Managers responsible for individual projects and workstreams.
* Establish project milestones, dependencies, critical paths, resource requirements and delivery commitments.
* Maintain consolidated RAID logs, decision logs, change controls and cross-project dependency tracking.
* Identify delivery risks early, drive mitigation actions and escalate material issues promptly.
* Ensure projects have clear scope, ownership, acceptance criteria, delivery dates and measurable outcomes.
* Track the technology portfolio against agreed milestones and highlight slippage before it becomes critical.
* Coordinate dependencies across Engineering, QA, Data, Infrastructure, Security, Product, Operations and third parties.

**2. Lending Domain Leadership**

Apply strong practical knowledge of the end-to-end lending lifecycle, including:

* Lead and application journey
* KYC/KYB and customer onboarding
* Credit bureau and data-provider integrations
* Credit assessment, decisioning, underwriting and approval
* Loan Origination Systems (LOS)
* Documentation and disbursement
* Loan Management Systems (LMS)
* Repayment, collections and arrears management
* Settlement, closure and customer servicing
* Regulatory, risk and operational controls

**3. Requirements Governance and Traceability**

* Ensure business requirements are formally elicited, documented, validated and approved.
* Provide governance across BRDs, functional requirements, user stories, process flows and acceptance criteria.
* Ensure end-to-end traceability across: Business Requirement -> Functional Requirement -> User Story -> Development -> Test Case -> UAT -> Business Sign-off -> Production Release.
* Ensure scope changes are assessed for business, technical, timeline and dependency impact before approval.
* Prevent requirements from being lost, changed informally or delivered without appropriate validation.
* Ensure Project Managers and Business Analysts maintain an accurate Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM).

**4. Business Demonstrations, Testing and UAT**

* Ensure regular sprint, solution and release demonstrations are conducted with relevant business stakeholders.
* Ensure delivered functionality is demonstrated against approved requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Coordinate UAT planning with business owners and ensure appropriate scenarios, test cases and test data are available.
* Track UAT defects, risks and exceptions through resolution or formal acceptance.
* Obtain formal business UAT sign-off before production release, in line with agreed release governance.
* Maintain auditable evidence of demonstrations, business acceptance, outstanding exceptions and approvals.

**5. Stakeholder Management**

* Act as the senior delivery interface between Technology and business stakeholders.
* Establish clear expectations regarding scope, timelines, dependencies, decisions and risks.
* Lead structured program governance and steering meetings.
* Drive timely decisions where projects are blocked by conflicting requirements or priorities.
* Ensure business owners actively participate in requirement validation, demonstrations and UAT.
* Escalate unresolved decisions and delivery constraints to the appropriate senior stakeholders.

**6. Senior Management Reporting**

* Provide concise, evidence-based executive reporting covering portfolio RAG status, milestones, delivery against plan, upcoming releases, risks, issues, dependencies, scope changes, UAT status and business sign-off.
* Highlight budget, capacity and resource constraints where applicable.
* Use exception-based reporting that clearly states what is on track, what is at risk, the cause, the recovery action, the owner and any management decision required.
* Provide a reliable single view of technology delivery for senior management.

**7. Project Manager Leadership**

* Manage, mentor and develop Project Managers.
* Create and enforce common project delivery, governance and reporting standards.
* Review project plans, estimates, delivery health, quality gates and recovery plans.
* Challenge unrealistic plans, incomplete dependencies and unsupported delivery commitments.
* Ensure Project Managers maintain risks, actions, issues, dependencies and decisions.
* Coordinate resources and priorities across projects, remove cross-project blockers and hold teams accountable for delivery commitments.

  

**Mandatory Experience and Capabilities**

* 12-16 years of overall professional experience, with significant experience managing complex technology programs and portfolios.
* Strong lending-domain experience is mandatory, with sound understanding of lending processes and technology platforms.
* Proven experience managing multiple Project Managers, workstreams and cross-functional delivery teams.
* Demonstrated delivery of technology initiatives involving Business, Product, Engineering, QA, Data, Infrastructure, Security and third parties.
* Strong requirements governance, change control and Requirements Traceability Matrix experience.
* Proven UAT governance, business acceptance and formal sign-off experience.
* Experience presenting program status, material risks and decisions to senior management.
* Excellent stakeholder management, negotiation, facilitation and executive communication skills.
* Strong knowledge of Agile, Scrum, Waterfall and hybrid delivery approaches.
* Hands-on experience with JIRA and/or Azure DevOps for planning, tracking, dashboards and governance.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology, Computer Applications, Business or a related discipline; MBA preferred.
* PMP, PRINCE2 Practitioner, PMI-ACP, SAFe or an equivalent recognized program/project management certification preferred.

59cc8424.title: Technical Lead - Salesforce Sales Cloud & Service Cloud
59cc8424.description:
Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way. Our software brings the physical and digital worlds together, enabling companies to improve operations, create better products, and empower people in all aspects of their business.

Our people make all the difference in our success. Today, we are a global team of nearly 7,000 and our main objective is to create opportunities for our team members to explore, learn, and grow – all while seeing their ideas come to life and celebrating the differences that make us who we are and the work we do possible.

**Position Summary**

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated **Support Technical Lead** to lead the administration, production support, incident management, and continuous improvement of our **Salesforce Sales Cloud** platform. This role requires a strong blend of Salesforce administration expertise, technical troubleshooting, stakeholder management, and team leadership.

The ideal candidate will serve as the primary escalation point for complex Salesforce issues, lead support operations, coordinate with business and technical teams, drive service excellence, and ensure platform stability, performance, security, and business continuity. The individual will also mentor support analysts and administrators while contributing to strategic roadmap and platform enhancement initiatives.

**Technical Leadership & Support Operations**

* Lead Salesforce Sales Cloud & Service Cloud support operations.

* Serve as the escalation point for critical incidents and technical issues.

* Mentor and guide Salesforce support team members.

* Ensure SLA compliance and support best practices.

* Drive process improvements and automation initiatives.

* Support resource planning and workload prioritization.

**Salesforce Administration & Platform Management**

* Administer and support Salesforce Sales Cloud and Service Cloud.

* Manage users, roles, permissions, security, and configurations.

* Maintain platform security, compliance, and data integrity.

* Evaluate Salesforce releases and feature enhancements.

* Collaborate with architects and developers on scalable solutions.

* Support deployments, releases, and environment management.

**Incident, Problem & Major Incident Management**

* Lead resolution of complex production incidents.

* Manage incident triage, escalation, and communications.

* Coordinate cross-functional teams during major outages.

* Conduct root cause analysis and preventive actions.

* Drive resolution of recurring platform issues.

* Ensure accurate incident and problem documentation.

**Monitoring, Reliability & Continuous Improvement**

* Establish proactive monitoring and alerting practices.

* Monitor application performance, integrations, and system health.

* Analyze support metrics and operational trends.

* Implement automation and operational improvements.

* Drive platform stability and service reliability initiatives.

**Integration & Technical Coordination**

* Monitor and support Salesforce integrations.

* Coordinate with development, infrastructure, and vendor teams.

* Troubleshoot integration, API, and authentication issues.

* Maintain integration monitoring and recovery processes.

**Change, Release & Business Continuity Management**

* Lead support activities for releases and deployments.

* Ensure operational readiness for platform enhancements.

* Support disaster recovery and business continuity testing.

* Assess and mitigate risks related to system changes.

* Enforce change management standards and compliance.

**Knowledge Management & Process Governance**

dd2467c5.title: Senior Solutions Engineer - BFSI
dd2467c5.description:
**About Neo4j**
Neo4j is the graph intelligence platform that transforms data into knowledge to power the next generation of intelligent applications and AI systems. It includes enterprise-ready knowledge graphs for accurate, explainable, and governed AI; the most comprehensive, trusted, and easy-to-deploy graph capabilities across any environment and data source; and an unmatched ecosystem trusted by 84 of the Fortune 100 and supported by the world’s largest graph community. Intelligence that works. Results that matter.
  
  
Built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous AI systems. We deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business.
  
  
**Our Vision**
At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data.
  
  
As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive.
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 7 years of experience in a pre-sales engineering, professional services, or customer-facing technical architecture role.
* Experience in programming languages (e.g., Java, Python, JavaScript), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and cloud infrastructure technologies.
* Experience engaging with, presenting to, and influencing both technical stakeholders and executive leaders (C-level) during complex sales cycles.
* Experience driving technical discovery and value-based selling to map enterprise business goals to technical architectures.
* Location: Candidates based in Mumbai or Bangalore will be prioritised.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field.
* Deep expertise in graph database technologies (e.g., Neo4j) along with knowledge of relational, NoSQL, and data visualization tools (e.g., D3.js, Linkurious).
* Proven experience building joint GTM solutions and co-selling with hyperscalers (AWS, Azure, GCP), strategic ISVs, and global systems integrators.
* Industry expertise within highly regulated sectors such as Banking & Financial Services, Telco, and Government.

**About The Job**
As a Solutions Engineer, you will be a key driver of Neo4j’s growth by shaping technical solutions that address complex enterprise challenges. You will serve as the technical authority during the pre-sales lifecycle, moving beyond standard product demonstrations to architect robust, value-driven graph database solutions. You will engage deeply with BFSI & Enterprise customers and strategic partners—including hyperscalers like AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud—to design interconnected data ecosystems that prove the tangible ROI of the Neo4j portfolio. In this role, you will blend consultative technical prowess, sales acumen, and ecosystem collaboration to accelerate adoption and secure the technical win.
  
  
Neo4j is the world leader in graph technology, helping organizations capture real-world context to drive choices for applications like artificial intelligence, fraud detection, and recommendation engines. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage connection-first data architectures to solve the world's most critical business problems. Turn your technical expertise into impact by helping India’s largest enterprises unlock the value of AI with connected data.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Drive the technical win for complex enterprise accounts, leading technical discovery, product demonstrations, and competitive positioning from evaluation through opportunity conversion.
* Design, build, and deliver proof-of-value (PoV) prototypes, tailored solution architectures, and technical workshops that clearly articulate Neo4j’s unique value proposition.
* Partner closely with hyperscalers (AWS, Azure, GCP), systems integrators, and ISVs to architect joint solutions, execute co-sell initiatives, and deliver technical enablement programs.
* Act as a cross-functional technical orchestrator, collaborating with internal sales teams on deal qualification and ensuring a seamless architectural handoff to Professional Services and implementation partners.
* Champion Neo4j’s technology by contributing to thought leadership, presenting at webinars and industry conferences, and supporting local developer community and marketing events.
* Travel to customer sites and partner events as required to run technical workshops and advance strategic engagements.

eb087098.title: Technical Solution Consultant for Storage and Power Systems ECM
eb087098.description:
**Job Description**
As the TSC, you will use your strong leadership and business development skills, deep knowledge of the battery energy storage and Power industry and the applicable Honeywell solutions to enable the profitable growth of the ECM Vertical in your associated regions of Europe and META.
  
  
This role reports into the Global TSC Leader and is primarily responsible for building go-to-market strategies, working collaboratively with business development and sales organizations in the regions assigned. You will be responsible for bringing a deep understanding of the market, products available, solutions requested, customer needs, trends, and government policies to the development of a pursuit strategy. This role also works collaboratively with other solutions leaders in the vertical to ensure alignment and consistencies across the globe.
  
  
The TSC, is responsible for benchmarking and evaluating new technologies or new offerings from suppliers to integrate into our solutions. Additionally, the role is responsible for supporting the identification and development of key partnerships in their associated pole. Attendance at key trade shows and technical conferences and presenting at such events is required when assigned.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Be a change agent - influence, consult, and lead efforts for sharing and standardizing of best-in-class solutions
* Coordinate customer segment focused solutions across various lines of business to act as a trusted client partner, relied on for strategic points of view to drive value-based solutions; facilitate cross SBU engagement.
* Provide strategic thought leadership and analytic consulting to businesses, sales, and vertical leadership
* Work with the Sales Teams and Vertical Leaders to align and drive the customer growth strategy for the vertical.
* Build strong relationships with key customers.
* Form and manage strategic partnerships with 3rd parties needed to support the new business models.
* Define, create, and socialize solutions offerings for industry and sub-industry solutions including supporting collateral (PPT, battlecard), target accounts/clients.
* Collaborating with other Vertical Solutions Leaders and Offering Management leaders to implement best practices and strategies for the Pole.
* Collaborate with offering management and technical solutions consultants to actively contribute as part of the relevant NPI business teams for the Vertical

**Qualifications**
**Basic Qualifications:**

* B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering or equivalent
* Five plus years of related technical experience, particularly in the delivery of electrical projects such as battery energy storage project, microgrids, microgrid controls applications and Power Generation.
* Five additional years of experience as a technical or business development lead, responsible for the delivery of electrical projects such as battery energy storage project, microgrids, microgrid controls applications, Combine Cycle control and/or implementation.

**Nice To Have Qualifications**

* Bilingual skills, English and a relevant language spoken on the region/s assigned
* Hands-on experience on Project implementation
* Finance background on related Renewable Projects

**About Us**
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.
