710159de.title: Principal Technology Consultant Retail Solutions
710159de.description:
Experience- 12 plus years
  
  
**Job Description**
We are seeking a customer-facing technology professional with strong retail domain expertise and a solid software engineering background. This role will work closely with retail customers to understand business challenges, identify opportunities for transformation, and shape practical technology solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have started their career in software development and progressed into architecture, consulting, customer engagement, or solutioning roles. They should be comfortable engaging with business stakeholders as well as technical teams and translating business requirements into scalable technology solutions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Engage directly with retail customers to understand business objectives, operational challenges, and transformation priorities.
* Conduct discovery workshops, requirement gathering sessions, and solution discussions with customer stakeholders.
* Translate business requirements into practical technology solution recommendations.
* Advise customers on modern retail technology platforms, digital transformation initiatives, and enterprise architecture considerations.
* Partner with sales, delivery, engineering, and product teams to develop customer-centric solutions.
* Create solution approaches, architecture blueprints, effort estimates, and implementation roadmaps.
* Support pre-sales activities including customer presentations, solution demonstrations, and proposal development.
* Stay current with emerging technologies and identify opportunities to drive innovation within customer environments.
* Candidates must be experts in one primary area and have good working knowledge of adjacent technology stacks (Frontend/UI Architecture OR AI/Data Engineering OR Microservices, Java & Cloud Native OR Commerce Technologies)
* Build trusted advisor relationships with customer leadership and technology teams.

**Required Experience**

* 12-15 years of overall experience in software technology, consulting, solution architecture.
* Strong foundation in software development with prior hands-on engineering experience.
* Experience working with enterprise retail organizations.
* Deep understanding of retail business processes and technology ecosystem.
* Experience engaging directly with customers, leading workshops, and gathering business requirements.
* Ability to translate complex business challenges into practical and scalable technology solutions.
* Exposure to modern enterprise technologies such as cloud platforms, microservices architectures, integration platforms, commerce solutions, data platforms, AI-enabled solutions, or digital transformation initiatives.
* Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience in customer-facing roles.
* Experience collaborating with both business and technical stakeholders.

**Key Success Factors**

* Customer-first mindset.
* Strong business consulting capability.
* Retail domain credibility.
* Stakeholder engagement skills.
* Solution oriented problem solving approach.

ad7ccd30.description:

Full time

Experienced (relevant combo of work and education)
  
  
**Education Desired**
Bachelor's Degree
  
  
**Pre-Sales Solution Architect – 10-15 Yrs of experience – Noida Location**
**About The Team**
You will join the Total Issuing Solutions Sales Operations team, supporting pre-sales engagements across
**IMEA**
,
**APAC**
and
**Europe**
. As a Senior Lead Pre-Sales Solution Architect, you will be the issuer processing subject matter expert supporting Sales throughout the opportunity lifecycle. You will lead discovery, solution design, RFI/RFP responses, product demonstrations and client presentations, translating complex issuer requirements into compelling solutions. Success requires deep payments expertise, strong consultative selling skills and the ability to influence senior client stakeholders.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**

* Partner with Sales on pre-sales opportunities from early-stage discovery through solution handover to implementation teams
* Lead client discovery sessions to understand business objectives, pain points, processing requirements and transformation priorities
* Develop pre-sales solution strategies addressing clients’ functional, technical, operational and commercial requirements
* Own solution content for RFIs and RFPs, ensuring responses are accurate, differentiated and aligned with client requirements
* Lead value proposition workshops to develop compelling, measurable and differentiated win themes
* Create solution proposals, presentations and pitch materials that clearly communicate business value and solution capabilities
* Deliver client-facing solution presentations, workshops and product demonstrations aligned with prospect use cases
* Collaborate with Sales, Product, Technology, Commercial and Implementation teams to develop viable and competitive solutions
* Provide technical and payments expertise during client meetings, addressing solution, integration and processing questions
* Coach Solution Architects and contribute to pre-sales enablement, knowledge sharing and strategic sales initiatives

**What You Bring**

* 10–15 years of relevant experience across pre-sales, solution consulting, solution architecture, payments or issuer processing
* Strong experience in technology pre-sales, including discovery, solutioning, proposals, RFI/RFP responses and client presentations
* Deep knowledge of issuer processing and card payments, including authorization, transaction processing and card lifecycle management
* Proven ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable functional and technical solution designs
* Strong consultative selling skills, with the ability to identify client pain points and position value-based solutions
* Demonstrated experience delivering technical presentations, solution workshops and product demonstrations to senior stakeholders
* Strong stakeholder management skills across Sales, Product, Technology, Commercial and Implementation functions
* Bachelor’s degree in technology, engineering, business or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in pre-sales solutioning for card issuing, issuer processing or payment technology platforms
* Knowledge of modern card processing, digital payments, APIs, integrations and value-added payment services
* Experience supporting complex enterprise sales opportunities with banks, financial institutions or payment providers
* Strong skills in solution storytelling, proposal development, presentation design and executive-level communication
* Experience leading competitive RFPs and developing solution differentiators, win themes and value propositions
* Experience mentoring Solution Architects, Pre-Sales Consultants or other client-facing technical professionals

**What We Offer You**
At FIS, you can grow your career as far as you want to take it. Here’s what else we offer~
  
  

* Opportunities to make an impact in fintech
* Personal and professional learning
* Inclusive, diverse work environment
* Competitive salary and benefits

**Privacy Statement**
FIS is committed to protecting the privacy and security of all personal information that we process in order to provide services to our clients. For specific information on how FIS protects personal information online, please see the Online Privacy Notice.
  
  
**Sourcing Model**
Recruitment at FIS works primarily on a direct sourcing model; a relatively small portion of our hiring is through recruitment agencies. FIS does not accept resumes from recruitment agencies which are not on the preferred supplier list and is not responsible for any related fees for resumes submitted to job postings, our employees, or any other part of our company.

e11d5f6d.title: Solutions Engineer (Security, GSSO) - Mumbai
e11d5f6d.description:
**Meet the Team**
You will be part of an outstanding technical pre-sales team in our Global Security Sales Organization (GSSO), responsible for driving the success of Cisco’s Security Portfolio and focusing on protecting Customer Application Environments across on-prem and cloud platforms. Our mission is to democratize security by making it easy and effective for everyone.
  
  
**Your Impact**
**Role**
As a key player in the team, you will have the opportunity to influence the security landscape by crafting tailored solutions that address specific customer needs. This role offers the excitement of working with cutting-edge technology and the fulfillment of building long-lasting relationships with customers. You will:
  
  

* Provide guidance and assist account teams in building solutions to address specific customer security needs.
* Understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
* Create, present, and document technical solutions to customers, partners, and prospects.
* Lead technical consulting and upper-level management presentations.
* Drive major account opportunities while enabling local account teams to maintain long-term ownership.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Minimum of 7 years of technical sales or pre-sales experience with 4+ years in Security specialization in Network Security and technologies including NGFW/NGIPS, Secure Network Analytics/NDR/NBAD, Email Security, Web & Cloud Security, CASB, SSE/SASE, Micro segmentation, Identity Security, Workload Protection, and Container Networking & Security.
* Experience with AI Security, including AI runtime security, workload protection, and security guardrails.
* Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Proven track record of successful quota achievement.
* Strong knowledge of cybersecurity concepts, technologies, and best practices.
* Industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or CCSP are preferred.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Excellent presentation and interpersonal skills.
* Commercial awareness and strong communication skills.
* Highly motivated self-starter who excels without day-to-day management.
* Experience with Cisco security technologies and programming languages such as UNIX shell, Perl, or C.
* Willingness to travel and work from a home office.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
**Disclaimer**
**About**
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
* begin with screening or an interview
* originate from a Cisco email address, and
* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https://careers.cisco.com or cisco.wd5.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.
  
  
If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

f097b10d.title: Software Architect
f097b10d.description:
**Hello Visionary!**

We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make a great addition to our vibrant international team.

**We are looking for a Software Architect**

**You’ll make a difference by:**

* Architecting Future-Proof Solutions: Lead the design and architecture of robust, scalable, and maintainable solutions for new features and enhancements on our existing product, ensuring seamless integration and performance.
* Technical Modernization & Quality: Proactively identify areas for technical improvement, refactoring, and modernization within our C++ and Angular codebase. Drive initiatives to enhance product stability, performance, and overall maintainability.
* Mentorship & Skill Development: Act as a technical mentor for the development team, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement. Provide guidance on C++ best practices, design patterns, performance optimization, and overall code quality.
* Cross-Team Collaboration: Work closely with product owners, other development teams, QA, and stakeholders to gather requirements, assess technical feasibility, and analyze the impact of proposed solutions across various systems.
* Performance & Reliability: Monitor and analyze solution performance, identify bottlenecks, and recommend strategies for optimization to ensure our product remains highly responsive and reliable.
* Driving Technical Excellence (GHCP): Lead the team in adopting and adhering to company-wide technical standards and methodologies, such as GHCP, ensuring continuous improvement in our development processes and outcomes.
* Code Quality & Standards: Establish and enforce best practices for code quality, testing strategies, and architectural patterns. Conduct thorough code reviews and provide constructive feedback to elevate the team's technical capabilities.
* Analyze complex bugs: Find the root cause of complex problems in legacy code and define the sustainable solution.
* **What You'll Bring:**
* **Experience:**
* 15+ years of experience in software development, with at least 5 years in a Solution Architect, Lead Developer, or similar senior technical role.
* Proven track record of successfully delivering complex software solutions, ideally involving legacy system modernization.
* Technical Expertise:
* Deep proficiency in C++: Extensive experience with modern C++ (C++11/14/17/20) and a strong understanding of object-oriented design principles, data structures, and algorithms.
* Frontend Mastery (preferred): Solid experience with Angular (or a comparable modern JavaScript framework like React/Vue.js) for building intuitive and performant user interfaces.
* Architectural Acumen: Strong understanding of various architectural patterns (e.g., monolithic, microservices, client-server) and the ability to choose the right approach for specific challenges.
* DevOps & Tools: Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, version control systems (Git), and modern development tools.
* **Leadership & Soft Skills:**
* Exceptional Communication: Ability to articulate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Mentoring & Coaching: A genuine passion for guiding and developing engineers, fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented team environment.
* Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an ability to break down complex issues into manageable parts.
* Stakeholder Management: Experience working effectively with product management, project managers, and other cross-functional teams.

**Your success is grounded in:**

* 15+ years of experience is required.
* Great Communication skills.
* Analytical and problem-solving skills

**Join us and be yourself!**

We value your unique identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us.  
  
This role is based in **Pune**, where you’ll get the chance to work with teams, impacting entire cities, countries - and the shape of things to come.  
  
We’re Siemens. A collection of over 312,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we encourage applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and imagination and help us shape tomorrow.

**Find out more about Siemens careers at:** **www.siemens.com/careers** **& more about mobility at** **https://new.siemens.com/global/en/products/mobility.html**

6ef47c1d.title: Architect - AI Business Solutions
6ef47c1d.description:
**Overview**
Microsoft Industry Solutions Delivery (ISD) is a global organization hosting over 6,000 strategic sellers, industry and security experts, elite engineers, world-class data scientists and architects, consultants, and delivery specialists. Together with our partners, we help Microsoft’s most strategic customers worldwide to address their specific challenges and provide comprehensive and industry-specific solutions that meet their unique needs. ISD is at the forefront of innovation, driving value across the entirety of the customers’ digital and AI transformation journey through repeatable and customized cutting-edge solutions through strategic engagements with customers across the globe powered by Microsoft Cloud and AI.
  
  
Microsoft Industry Solutions Delivery (ISD) is a global organization hosting over 6,000 strategic sellers, industry and security experts, elite engineers, world-class data scientists and architects, consultants, and delivery specialists. Together with our partners, we help Microsoft’s most strategic customers worldwide to address their specific challenges and provide comprehensive and industry-specific solutions that meet their unique needs. ISD is at the forefront of innovation, driving value across the entirety of the customers’ digital and AI transformation journey through repeatable and customized cutting-edge solutions through strategic engagements with customers across the globe powered by Microsoft Cloud and AI.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Understanding Customer Technical Environment**

* Engage business sponsors, product owners, Enterprise Architects, Security, and Operations leaders to frame outcomes and define the target agentic scenarios.
* Assess customer AI readiness across identity, data, security/compliance, and operating model; identify gaps to unlock Copilot and agent adoption at scale.
* Identify industry and technology trends including AI adoption patterns, Low‑Code modernization, Copilot usage, GitHub Copilot assisted development, and data readiness to influence solution architecture direction.
* Translate business requirements into end-to-end solution options across Power Platform, Azure, and Microsoft 365 Copilot/Copilot Studio extensibility.
* Socialize solution approaches with customers, validating feasibility, operating impact, scalability, and change management required for Copilot and agent rollouts.
* Maintain an iterative feedback loop with Product Engineering and internal communities to relay field insights that shape M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Power Platform capabilities for agentic engagements.
* Partner with account and delivery teams to shape the solution play, refine estimates, adjust pre‑sales solution components, govern scope changes, and position technical risks for agentic AI adoption.

**Architecture Design and Deployment**

* Apply structured delivery methodologies (Agile/Iterative/Hybrid) and reference architectures to design scalable Copilot and agentic solutions.
* Own and maintain architectural documentation, including agent design specs, integration contracts, and operational runbooks.
* Define and communicate end-to-end architecture with traceability from business outcomes to agent behaviors, tools, data grounding, quality attributes, and compliance controls.
* Lead cost- and technology-based discussions to assess feasibility, deployment options (cloud/edge), scale, and customer appetite for agentic innovation.
* Apply business value principles prioritizing ROI, productivity, adoption/usage intensity, and long-term operational efficiency.
* Partner with the Project Manager to drive governance across design, build, testing, deployment, pilots, and scale-out of Copilot and agent capabilities.
* Validate delivered business value (revenue enablement, productivity uplift, customer/employee experience improvement, cost savings) and connect outcomes to telemetry and adoption signals.
* Direct development and execution of test strategies (functional, security, privacy, and AI evaluations) to prove requirement compliance and support remediation and sign-off.
* Collaborate with bid teams to prepare costed, traceable solution approaches with trade-offs, AI risk posture, and clear positions on responsible AI.
* Lead implementation with the Project Manager, establishing quality standards, release planning, and operational transition for agentic workloads.
* Highlight invalidated assumptions and drive refinements through structured change control and continuous learning from production usage.

**AI, Copilot, LowCode, and Agent Extensibility**

* Establish enterprise-grade architecture to support scaled Copilot and agent deployments.
* Design Copilot extensibility solutions with secure data access patterns and clear user/agent experience flows.
* Use Copilot Studio to build and manage agents (topics/actions, orchestration, channels, monitoring) for customer productivity improvement and business process transformation.
* Apply GitHub Copilot to accelerate engineering, enforce secure coding and quality, and improve delivery velocity for agentic solutions.

**Practice Development**

* Continuously evaluate and evolve architectural approaches based on field learnings, product roadmap, and responsible AI guidance to maintain a high quality IP portfolio.
* Drive reuse of IP across pre-sales and delivery to accelerate pipeline, improve quality, and standardize agentic delivery practices. Drive reuse of IP across pre‑sales and delivery engagements.
* Contribute to internal and external Microsoft professional communities by sharing patterns, learnings, and reusable agent/Copilot assets.

**Trusted Advisor**

* Build strong networks and influence across customer and internal teams to remove barriers and accelerate Copilot and agent adoption.
* Stay current on Microsoft’s AI Business Solutions strategy and communicate platform direction across M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, and Azure.
* Act as the technical conscience balancing customer expectations with feasibility, security, privacy, and responsible AI practices.

**Thought Leadership**

* Share insights, reusable patterns, and strategic guidance for Copilot and agentic architectures across global communities.
* Mentor technical talent on agentic design patterns, Power Platform governance, Copilot extensibility, and responsible AI engineering.

**PreSales**

* Discover customer priorities and pain points to shape Copilot and agentic solution plays that deliver measurable business outcomes.
* Propose architectures and roadmaps with clear assumptions for data readiness, identity/permissions, integrations, and AI risk controls.
* Support Sales teams in winning and expanding enterprise engagements by leading with Copilot and Agents as the transformation entry point.
* Own technical estimates and delivery approach for agentic engagements using proven, experience‑based estimation methods and reusable accelerators.

**Solution Delivery**

* Guide Low‑Code / No‑Code AI adoption across Power Platform and Copilot-‑enabled development to accelerate business process transformation.
* Lead governance and deployment of Copilot Studio agents ensuring security, responsible AI, connector controls, and data boundary alignment.
* Deliver custom Microsoft 365 Copilot extensions using approved SDKs, plugins/connectors, automation frameworks, and secure data access patterns.
* Apply engineering excellence and DevOps practices (CI/CD, quality gates, automation, observability) using Azure DevOps and GitHub.
* Guide sprint/iteration planning, dependency mapping, and end‑to‑end release alignment to move from pilots to scaled production adoption.

**Quality Assurance**

* Review solutions for requirement fidelity, security/privacy posture, responsible AI compliance technical quality, best‑practice alignment, and operational readiness
* Provide advisory guidance for Copilot and agent architecture, design, and delivery execution.
* Enforce best practices for Copilot Studio agent lifecycle management, grounding strategies, evaluations, and monitoring for continuous improvement .

**Qualifications**
**Required/Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 14+ years in technology solutions, architecture, consulting, or specialized technical domains (e.g., Security).

OR
  
  

* Master’s degree in related field AND 12+ years in technology solutions, architecture, consulting, or specialized technical domains.

OR
  
  
Equivalent experience.
  
  

* Experience with a Global Systems Integrator, IT Vendor, or Microsoft Partner delivering enterprise‑scale Microsoft Business Applications.
* Strong hands‑on background in Business Applications and CRM solution delivery across medium to large enterprises.

**Additional Or Preferred Qualifications**
EndtoEnd IT / Low Code Business Applications Delivery
  
  

* Expertise across the full lifecycle of IT Solutions Delivery: Estimation, Proposal Development, Requirements, Business Process Modelling, Design, Development, Testing, Deployment, and Operations.
* Proven delivery experience on Power Platform, M365, Copilot Studio solutions across industries.
* Experience building or extending solutions using M365 Copilot and hands on Copilot Studio expertise.
* Proficiency using GitHub Copilot or similar tools to accelerate solution development, improve engineering productivity, maintain coding standards, and support modern DevOps workflows.

Architecture, Design & Technical Leadership
  
  

* Strong capability in Low Code architecture covering:
* Copilot Studio, Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Pages, Dataverse
* Environment strategy, DLP, governance frameworks
* ALM and solution structuring
* Enterprise maturity model implementation
* Handson experience implementing and leading architecture & solution design efforts in one or more of the following:
* Power Platform (Apps, Automate, Pages, Dataverse)
* M365 extensibility and Copilotenabled experiences
* Low Code AI Solutions based on Copilot Studio or similar solutions
* Azure integrations, Logic Apps, Functions, API Management
* Security, Compliance, Identity, and Responsible AI
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence without authority across global, multigeography delivery models.

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
  
  
Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. 114db432.title: AppModernization_Agentic_AI_Solution_Architect
114db432.description:
**Overview**
The primary responsibility of this role is to act as the Principal Agentic AI Solution Architect across large and strategic opportunities
  
  
for enterprise and mid-market clients. The core of the role is solution architecture and the RFI/RFP pursuit cycle — owning the
  
  
technical solution from first qualification through to signed proposal. Clients increasingly require agentic AI capabilities that are
  
  
demonstrably safe, auditable, and integrable with incumbent systems — not proofs-of-concept that stall before production.
  
  
The ideal candidate will bring two decades of solution architecture experience layered with current, working knowledge of agentic
  
  
AI. The role requires the credibility to sit with a client’s Chief Architect and defend a target-state architecture inside a competitive
  
  
bid, and the technical depth to judge whether what is being proposed can actually be built.
  
  
The successful candidate will bring a Principal Architect mindset, combining solution architecture rigour, multi-cloud depth,
  
  
agentic AI fluency, commercial and pricing judgement, and innovation-led thinking to solve complex client challenges and
  
  
accelerate business outcomes.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Solution Architecture, RFI / RFP & Pursuit Leadership (Primary)
  
  

* Own the end-to-end technical solution for RFI, RFP and RFQ responses — solution narrative, architecture, assumptions,

dependencies, risks, differentiators and win themes.
  
  

* Lead bid qualification: assess fit, shape the technical win strategy, and make a defensible go / no-go recommendation to

pursuit leadership.
  
  

* Author and orchestrate all technical sections of proposal documentation, ensuring a single coherent architecture story

across contributing workstreams.
  
  

* Design the target-state solution architecture across application, data, integration, infrastructure and security domains —

not AI in isolation.
  
  

* Own effort estimation, solution sizing, pricing constructs and commercial defensibility of the proposed architecture.
* Lead client-facing orals, solution defence sessions, technical clarifications and due-diligence responses through evaluation

to award.
  
  

* Conduct executive discovery sessions and client workshops to establish As-Is landscape, To-Be ambition, value hypotheses

and pain points.
  
  

* Produce solution blueprints, reference architectures, architecture decision records and option assessments that survive

client architecture-board scrutiny.
  
  

* Resolve conflicting stakeholder positions and drive consensus on architecture and scope decisions under bid timelines.
* Transition the approved architecture to execution teams, preserving design intent and architectural integrity after award.

Agentic AI Architecture & Design Authority
  
  

* Define reference architectures for agentic AI, multi-agent orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation and AI-native

applications across major cloud platforms.
  
  

* Act as design authority — reviewing and approving detailed designs, enforcing alignment with enterprise architecture

principles, and holding the non-functional bar.
  
  

* Define the evaluation and quality strategy: evaluation methodology, benchmark design and acceptance criteria for agentic

outputs.
  
  

* Define guardrails, responsible-AI posture and control frameworks appropriate to regulated and security-sensitive

environments.
  
  

* Make and document platform, framework and build-versus-buy decisions, including technology due diligence and product

selection.
  
  

* Assess architectural feasibility of agentic approaches to legacy modernisation and application rationalisation across

heterogeneous stacks.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Experience
  
  

* Minimum 15+ years in solution architecture, enterprise architecture, software engineering or cloud engineering, with at

least 3 years in Generative AI and agentic AI.
  
  

* Demonstrated ownership of the technical solution in competitive RFI / RFP / RFQ pursuits at scale, including estimation,

sizing, pricing input and solution defence.
  
  

* Proven solution architecture accountability on large transformation or regulatory programmes.
* Working knowledge of production agentic systems built with frameworks such as Google ADK, LangGraph, LangChain or

CrewAI.
  
  

* Deep experience architecting cloud-native, high-volume, customer-facing applications on at least one major cloud platform,

with working depth in a second.
  
  

* Experience advising senior client stakeholders across multiple geographies and industry sectors.
* Track record translating ambiguous business requirements into architecturally significant functional and non-functional

designs.
  
  
Education
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science or equivalent discipline; equivalent professional experience considered

in lieu.
  
  
**Preferred Skills**

* Solution architecture and bid/pursuit leadership — RFI, RFP and RFQ response ownership, solution sizing, estimation and

proposal authoring.
  
  

* Command of GenAI and agentic AI architecture: RAG, vector databases, prompt and context engineering, guardrails, model

evaluation, responsible AI.
  
  

* Sufficient technical fluency in Python and modern engineering practice to validate agentic designs and judge feasibility.
* Infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and DevOps architecture patterns — Terraform, Ansible or equivalent.
* Containerisation and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) and hybrid/multi-cloud HA, DR, sizing and cost-control design.
* API design and management: REST, OpenAPI/Swagger, versioning, rate limiting, caching, gateway patterns.
* Enterprise architecture frameworks and formal modelling; UML 2.0 artefacts; architecture governance.
* Exceptional stakeholder management, workshop facilitation and conflict resolution at senior client levels.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving capability under commercial pressure.
* The candidate should have a PE/VC mentality — capital-efficient, outcome-obsessed, intolerant of gold-plating.

Bonus Points
  
  

* Agentic AI certification (e.g. Google Cloud Generative AI / Agentic AI credentials, AWS Generative AI Specialty, Azure AI

Engineer Associate, or recognised vendor agentic-AI certification).
  
  

* TOGAF certification; Google Professional Cloud Architect; Azure Solution Architect; AWS Solution Architect.
* Published thought leadership, patents, or contributions to innovation programmes.
* Experience benchmarking agentic solutions against native platform capabilities (e.g. Vertex AI Agent Builder, Bedrock

Agents).
  
  

* Experience leading large multi-vendor or consortium bids.

bb0aba5a.title: Solution Architect - AI & AI Governance
bb0aba5a.description:
**Job Description: Solution Architect - AI & AI Governance**
Company: SCIKIQ Data Private Limited
  
  
Type - Product & Services
  
  
Location: Gurugram, Sector 32
  
  
Work Mode: Work from Office (5 days a week)
  
  
Experience: 10+ Years (3+ in AI / GenAI)
  
  
Employment Type: Full-time
  
  
**About SCIKIQ**
SCIKIQ is an AI-native, no-code data platform from Gurugram. Enterprises use it to connect their data ,govern it (catalog, lineage, data quality, policies) and use it through dashboards, data products and AI copilots driving relevant use cases.
  
  
**The Role**
You design the AI solutions our customers run on SCIKIQ - conversational analytics, copilots, GenAI apps and AI agents - on top of governed data. You also set up the AI governance that keeps them accurate, safe and auditable.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* AI solutions: Design and deliver natural-language query, copilots, GenAI apps and AI agents on SCIKIQ for enterprise customers.
* AI context layer: Connect glossary, semantic models, lineage and access rules to prompts, RAG and agents so answers are correct and permission-aware.
* AI governance: Set up use-case risk classification, guardrails (PII out of prompts, output checks), human-in-the-loop, evaluation / hallucination testing, monitoring and audit trails.
* Data governance for AI: Use SCIKIQ catalog, lineage, quality and trust scores to decide which data is safe for AI and show the evidence.
* Delivery: Run workshops, pick the right LLMs and patterns, build POCs, write solution designs and take solutions to production.
* Pre-sales: Demo AI capabilities and explain AI governance to CDOs, CISOs and compliance teams in plain language.
* Work with the DWH architect: Agree on data contracts, definitions and access rules with the DWH Solution Architect. Solve use cases together.

**Must have**

* 10 - 15 years in data warehousing and ML architecture experience
* 3+ years delivering GenAI solutions for enterprises.
* Hands-on with LLM apps: Prompts, RAG, embeddings / vector search, tool calling, agent frameworks, LLM evaluation.
* Working knowledge of ML basics and MLOps.
* Strong Python
* Good SQL required and should be comfortable with warehouses / lakehouses.
* Hands-on AI governance: Risk assessment, guardrails, monitoring, explainability, audit evidence
* Understands Data governance (catalog, lineage, quality, access) and AI security (data leakage, prompt injection).
* Explains AI and its risks simply to business, risk and compliance teams. Comfortable on the ground with customers. Should have very good communication skill

e6a8760d.description:
**About this role:**

Wells Fargo is seeking a Systems Operations Engineer - Cloud Ops.

**In this role, you will:**

* Participate in complex technical issues and initiatives related to large scale applications, systems, databases, or other technical products and services
* Identify opportunity for process improvements within technical support strategies and plans
* Review and analyze technical queries to extract data, create standard databases, or perform limited programming to fine tune systems supporting low to medium risk technical deliverables
* Present recommendations for resolving complex technical queries
* Exercise some independent judgment to analyze performance trends and recommend process improvements while developing understanding of technical process controls or standards
* Work as an internal consultant regarding use of tools and processes
* Provide information related to supported system area to functional colleagues, internal partners and stakeholders, including internal customers

**Required Qualifications:**

* 2+ years of Systems Engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

**Desired Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related technical field.
* Experience operating applications across OCP, GCP and Azure in a regulated, highly controlled enterprise environment.
* Experience with CI/CD and deployment platforms such as Git, GitHub, Jenkins, Harness, Azure DevOps or equivalent tools.
* Experience with ServiceNow, Jira and Confluence for incident, problem, change, work tracking and operational documentation.
* Knowledge of SLI/SLO practices, error budgets, capacity planning, performance engineering, backup, disaster recovery and resiliency testing.
* Experience creating reusable automation, self-healing or event-driven remediation for repeat operational failure patterns.
* Familiarity with AIOps capabilities such as anomaly detection, event correlation, alert enrichment and automated incident response.
* Relevant certifications such as Red Hat Certified System Administrator/Engineer, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, Google Associate Cloud Engineer or Microsoft Azure Administrator Associate.
* Provide L2 production support for cloud-hosted applications and platforms, including OpenShift Container Platform (OCP), Kubernetes-based workloads, GCP, Azure and related hybrid-cloud dependencies.·
* Monitor application and infrastructure health using Splunk, Grafana, ThousandEyes, SPLOC-style synthetic and service-level alerts, and cloud-native monitoring; validate signal quality and tune noisy or false-positive alerts.·
* Triage and resolve incidents involving pod restarts, CPU or memory saturation, failed mounts, network latency, storage, service errors, health-check failures, batch or CronJob failures, and application availability issues.·
* Coordinate major and high-priority incidents across application development, platform engineering, storage, network, database, security and vendor teams; maintain clear technical updates, shift handoffs and escalation paths.·
* Perform root-cause analysis and problem management for recurring issues; create or manage problem records, identify corrective actions, track remediation to closure and verify that fixes prevent recurrence.·
* Support approved production changes, releases and deployments by validating readiness, implementation steps, rollback plans, monitoring coverage and post-change health checks.·
* Execute operational actions such as pod restart or scaling, job restart, controlled failover, certificate validation, access verification and platform health checks in accordance with approved runbooks and change controls.·
* Develop and maintain dashboards, alerts, health checks, runbooks, standard operating procedures and knowledge articles that improve first-time resolution and consistent 24x7 support.·
* Automate repetitive operational tasks such as environment validation, log collection, health checks, alert enrichment, job recovery and common remediation using Python, PowerShell, Shell, Ansible or approved enterprise automation platforms.·
* Participate in operational readiness and non-functional requirement reviews covering observability, logging, alerting, access, capacity, performance, backup, disaster recovery, resiliency and support-model readiness.·
* Partner with SRE and Cloud COE teams to define and track service-level indicators, service-level objectives, availability, MTTR, incident recurrence, alert quality and automation coverage.· Contribute to shift-left and self-healing improvements by documenting exact operational commands, safeguards, test evidence and failure conditions for candidate automation use cases.· Support knowledge transfer, cross-training and shift coverage; provide concise handovers of open incidents, risks, pending actions and ownership.

**Job Expectations:**

  

* Hybrid work expectation: work from the office three days per week at an approved location, aligned to team and business needs.
* Ability to support assigned shifts, after-hours changes, production events, on-call rotations and weekend coverage when required.
* Follow all applicable information security, change-management, access-management, risk and regulatory requirements.

**Posting End Date:**

11 Nov 2026

* ***Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.***

**We Value Equal Opportunity**

Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit’s risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements.

India

Partner-Led Market Development

Proposition & Asset Development

* Provide field feedback to product and engineering teams.

**What You Bring:**

* Pre-sales / solution consulting in Financial Services technology.
* Strong domain expertise in Financial Crime (AML, Fraud, KYC, Transaction Monitoring).

* Executive-level presentation and storytelling capability.
* Working knowledge of AI/ML, SaaS, and cloud architectures.

* Build FinCrime market presence with leading global partners.
* High-visibility role with direct exposure to alliance and vertical leadership.
* Opportunity to shape CoEs and partner competency at scale.
* Competitive compensation with performance incentives.

Competitive compensation with performance incentives.

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

  
About Us:

SymphonyAI is building the leading enterprise AI SaaS company for digital transformation across the most critical and resilient growth industries, including retail, consumer packaged goods, financial crime prevention, manufacturing, media, and IT service management. Since its founding in 2017, SymphonyAI today serves 1500+ Enterprise customers globally and has grown to 3,000 talented leaders, data scientists, and other professionals across over 30 countries.

c934499a.title: Customer Success Technical Architect
c934499a.description:
**Introduction**
At IBM Global Sales, we bring together innovation, collaboration, and expertise to help clients solve their most complex business challenges. Working across industries and geographies, you'll partner with colleagues, clients, and partners to co-create solutions that drive digital transformation and lasting impact.Success in Global Sales is built on curiosity, empathy, and collaboration. You'll connect technical understanding with strong people skills, building trusted relationships and shaping solutions that improve business and society. With world-class onboarding, continuous learning, and a supportive culture, IBM offers the tools and opportunities to grow your career. Join us and be part of a global team that's passionate about driving innovation and making a difference.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
As a Customer Success Technical Architect (CSTA), you will be a trusted technical advisor to Confluent (an IBM Company) customers after they adopt our platform. You will help customers achieve measurable value from their Confluent investments by improving technical health, accelerating adoption, guiding best-practice decisions, and proactively managing risks across their streaming environments.
  
  
You will work as part of the broader customer account team and partner closely with Customer Success, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Professional Services, Support, Product, and Engineering. The role combines technical depth, customer leadership, structured execution, and the ability to translate complex architecture and operational topics into clear business outcomes.
  
  
What you will do
  
  

* Own customer-facing technical execution for a portfolio of strategic customers, aligning activity to customer goals, adoption plans, and desired business outcomes.
* Build trusted-advisor relationships with technical and business stakeholders, from practitioners and architects to senior leaders.
* Provide proactive guidance on Confluent and Apache Kafka architecture, workload optimization, operational practices, upgrades, reliability, security, governance, and adoption.
* Maintain a regular customer operating rhythm via office hours, quarterly reviews, health checks, roadmap alignment, and enablement.
* Assess technical health, identify adoption blockers and emerging risks, and create clear action plans with owners, milestones, and follow-through.
* Coordinate with Support and other Confluent and IBM teams on escalations, ensuring the customer has a clear path forward and that remediation actions are tracked to completion.
* Help customers prepare for critical events such as upgrades, major launches, architecture changes, and production growth.
* Educate customer teams on Confluent capabilities, recommended practices, and relevant product developments.
* Bring customer feedback and product insights back to Confluent, helping improve the customer experience and inform product direction.
* Contribute to the CSTA practice by sharing technical knowledge, reusable guidance, playbooks, and lessons learned.

**Preferred Education**
Bachelor's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field, or comparable practical background.
* 5+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical role such as Customer Success Architect, Technical Account Manager, Solutions Architect, Support Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer, or equivalent.
* Ability to discuss application architecture, APIs, networking, security, observability, data integration, and production operations with technical stakeholders.
* Hands on knowledge of one or more key cloud vendors (AWS, GCP and Azure)
* Solid understanding of cloud networking and security technologies (e.g. VPC, Private Link, Private Service Connect, TLS/SSL, SASL, Kerberos, etc.)
* Experience prototyping and analyzing code for client solutions in multiple languages (e.g. Java, Python, Go, etc.)
* Experience with Java Virtual Machine (JVM) tuning and troubleshooting
* Experience with operating Linux, you know how to configure, tune and troubleshoot both RedHat & Debian based distributions
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to lead structured conversations with both technical teams and executives.
* Ability to manage multiple customer priorities, create clarity in ambiguous situations, and drive actions to completion.
* A proactive, consultative mindset focused on preventing issues and creating customer value rather than only reacting to incidents.
* Willingness to continue learning in a rapidly evolving technical domain and to share knowledge with peers.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Experience helping customers build distributed systems or streaming solutions that use Apache Kafka alongside technologies such as Spark, Flink, Hadoop, Cassandra, etc
* Experience with Apache Kafka & Apache Flink
* Confluent or Apache Kafka certification
* Experience working with global customers

**CREATIVITY IS OUR SUPERPOWER**. It’s our heritage and it’s also our future. Because we don’t just make toys. We create innovative products and experiences that inspire, entertain and develop children through play. We are seeking an experienced **Senior GCP & Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) DevOps Engineer** to design, implement, and manage secure, scalable, highly available, and resilient cloud infrastructure across **Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)**.

  

The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in **multi-cloud architecture, DevOps practices, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD automation, Kubernetes, cloud networking, observability, and cloud security**. * Manage scope, capacity, risks, assumptions, dependencies, blockers and trade-offs, escalating early with clear options and recommendations.
* Lead stakeholder alignment across Finance, Product, Data, Architecture, Engineering, Risk and third-party suppliers.
* Facilitate Scrum activities including refinement, sprint planning, daily coordination, reviews and retrospectives, applying Agile practices pragmatically rather than mechanically.
* Maintain delivery transparency through Jira, dashboards, milestone reporting, decisions, delivery confidence and measurable outcomes.
* Create a culture of ownership, experimentation, learning and continuous improvement in a setting where no established playbook may exist.

**Essential Experience And Capabilities**

* Proven ownership of complex technology, transformation, data or AI-enabled delivery, with clear evidence of personal contribution and business impact.
* Experience establishing a new squad, delivery model, product initiative or programme from an early or undefined starting point.
* Ability to operate confidently in ambiguity, structure complex problems and progress decisions with incomplete information.
* Strong delivery management across planning, governance, risk, dependencies, stakeholder communication and execution.
* Practical Scrum and Agile expertise, supported by delivery judgement rather than ceremony-only facilitation.
* Credibility with senior business and technology stakeholders, including the ability to challenge constructively and influence without formal authority.
* Working knowledge of AI, data, automation or emerging-technology delivery is strongly desirable; deep technical development expertise is not mandatory.
* Basic delivery-level understanding of the SAP Finance landscape is advantageous, including exposure to SAP S/4HANA, SAP BW and Finance processes such as Record to Report (R2R), together with awareness of other relevant SAP modules. This is desirable rather than mandatory; deep SAP functional or technical expertise is not required.

a0581c6a.title: Engagement Manager
a0581c6a.description:
**Key Responsibilities**

* Project Initiation & Setup
* Review Salesforce opportunities, Statements of Work (SOWs), service notes, project documentation, and resource allocations.
* Identify potential project risks, scope discrepancies, budget gaps, and delivery challenges.
* Conduct internal Knowledge Transfer (KT) sessions with Account and Delivery teams.
* Set up projects using tools such as Clarizen, Smartsheet, Asana, Google Sheets, and Slack.
* Develop initial project schedules, communication plans, and documentation repositories.
* Organize and lead project kick-off meetings.
* Establish customer expectations regarding project scope, timelines, deliverables, escalation procedures, and change management.
* Project Planning & Coordination
* Coordinate discovery sessions, functional and technical design discussions, and project planning activities.
* Develop and maintain project schedules, milestones, and delivery plans.
* Facilitate weekly customer status meetings and internal delivery reviews.
* Prepare meeting agendas, document discussions, and track action items.
* Ensure effective communication and alignment between customers, delivery teams, and internal stakeholders.
* Project Tracking & Resource Management
* Monitor project progress, resource utilization, timelines, and budgeted hours.
* Maintain project tracking systems and ensure timely updates.
* Manage resource allocation, forecasting, and capacity planning.
* Review project timesheets, invoice reports, and customer billing queries.
* Identify resource constraints and overallocation and coordinate with Delivery Managers.
* Prepare and distribute Weekly Status Reports (WSRs).
* Track milestones, deliverables, dependencies, risks, and project health.
* Project Execution & Delivery Management
* Manage end-to-end project execution, ensuring delivery within agreed scope, timelines, and budgets.
* Oversee project tasks, dependencies, issues, risks, and escalations.
* Facilitate Functional and Technical Design Sessions.
* Coordinate deliverable reviews, including Functional Design Documents (FDDs) and Technical Design Documents (TDDs).
* Manage scope changes, budget adjustments, and deliverables through formal Change Order processes.
* Organize Steering Committee (SteerCo) meetings wherever required.
* Develop and execute mitigation plans to bring projects back on track.
* Maintain strong customer relationships and ensure stakeholder satisfaction.
* Go-Live & Project Closure
* Develop and maintain cutover checklists and go-live plans.
* Coordinate go-live readiness reviews with customers and delivery teams.
* Facilitate go-live meetings and track outstanding issues.
* Ensure successful project closure, including documentation, customer communication, and final sign-offs.
* Update project management systems and Salesforce records.
* Coordinate customer satisfaction (CSAT) surveys and project closure activities.
* Client Relationship & Business Growth
* Act as a trusted advisor to customer executives, project managers, and key stakeholders.
* Identify opportunities for upselling, cross-selling, and expanding existing engagements.
* Proactively identify scope, budget, and timeline gaps that may create additional service opportunities.
* Manage customer escalations and negotiate effective resolutions.
* Collaborate with Account Management, Customer Success, Delivery, and Pre-Sales teams to drive business growth.
* Conduct project retrospectives and share lessons learned to improve delivery effectiveness.

**Mandatory Skills & Qualifications**

* 8+ years of overall experience in project management, engagement management, or delivery management.
* Minimum 3 years of hands-on Project Management / Engagement Management experience.
* PMP Certification or equivalent project management certification.
* Strong experience in end-to-end project lifecycle management.
* Excellent client-facing communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience handling complex projects involving cross-functional and geographically distributed teams.
* Strong understanding of project scope, budgeting, resource planning, risk management, and change control.
* Proven experience managing customer escalations and resolving delivery challenges.
* Ability to identify upselling and business expansion opportunities.
* Excellent presentation, negotiation, documentation, and problem-solving skills.

* Partner with HR on recruitment, performance management, annual reviews, and career development.

384bf8db.title: Capital Program Manager
384bf8db.description:
Technical Capital Program Manager – Data Centre & Lab Facilities
  
  
**LOCATION:**
Cessna Bangalore, India
  
  
**AREA OF INTEREST:**
Construction Program Management
  
  
**TECHNOLOGY INTEREST:**
Data Centres, Laboratories & Critical Facilities
  
  
**About The Role**
Workplace Resources (WPR) is seeking a Technical Capital Program Manager to lead the delivery of capital projects with a specific focus on data centre and laboratory environments across the APJC (Asia Pacific, Japan & China) region. This role combines the core discipline of capital program management - planning, budgeting, and delivering projects from inception through handover - with the technical depth required to manage complex, mission-critical facilities where uptime, resiliency, and compliance are paramount.
  
  
The ideal candidate will bring a strong construction/capital program management background together with hands-on exposure to data centre or lab build, fit-out, or upgrade projects, and will be comfortable engaging directly with M&E engineers, critical facilities teams, and specialist technical vendors.
  
  
The candidate should be based close to our Bangalore campus and have the ability to be on campus, participate in meetings in person and interact with vendors as needed.
  
  
Meet the Team
  
  
Workplace Resources (WPR) delivers workplace experiences to employees and optimizes company working capital at scale, with a focus on productivity and business outcomes. Within WPR, the Workplace Design & Construction Team comprises four pillars: Design, Change Management, Centralized Capital Program Management, and Commercial Management Offices. The team is responsible for the delivery of projects including data centre, lab, and critical facilities work, in addition to a broader transformational effort shaping how employees, partners, and customers interact with company spaces for decades to come.
  
  
Your Impact
  
  
As Technical Capital Program Manager, you will be accountable for planning, executing, and finalizing capital projects, including data centre and laboratory builds and upgrades, according to strict deadlines and within budget. This includes partnering with global procurement to acquire resources, coordinating the efforts of internal team members and third-party contractors or consultants, and acting as the single point of responsibility and escalation for the project life cycle from inception through design, business case development, delivery, and handover.
  
  
What You'll Do Day-to-Day
  
  

* Manage APJC capital program service partners to successfully plan, design, deliver, handover of capital projects assigned to you.
* Own the successful planning, brief development, and budgeting of a portfolio of capital projects, determined by the manager, with particular emphasis on technical and critical-infrastructure spaces.
* Act as the single point of responsibility and escalation for the project life cycle from inception through design, business case development, delivery, and handover.
* Effectively manage both upward communication to clients and stakeholders to ensure transparency and alignment, while providing clear, actionable direction and feedback to team members through consistent downward communication.
* Develop Project Execution Plans and manage Change Control for technical builds, including data centre and lab-specific commissioning and validation stages.
* Ensure projects comply with Construction Health & Safety Guidelines as well as data centre and laboratory-specific safety, security, and compliance standards.
* Develop a quarterly APJC Delivery Plan identifying requirements for capital projects, including due diligence, due diligence funding, and partner resourcing.
* Own due diligence for capital projects managed by service partners, ensuring cross-functional input (risk management, IT, critical facilities engineering, capital project management).
* Own compliance to global offerings guidelines and standards, including relevant data centre design and operational standards.
* Solve complex problems and identify viable, innovative options, using analytical skills and judgment to recommend an appropriate solution, particularly where technical, operational, and construction constraints intersect.
* Translate strategy into clear operating plans that promote operational excellence in service delivery with measurable results.
* Leverage program management expertise, together with technical facilities knowledge, to identify areas of risk or concern in complex, mission-critical builds.

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Capital Project Planning: Using agreed business requirements from WPR partners, develop comprehensive project plans, including for data centre and lab environments, that align with the strategic objectives of the organization.
* Technical & Critical Facilities Delivery: Partner with project teams, M&E engineers, critical facilities operations, and specialist vendors to deliver data centre and laboratory capital projects, covering power, cooling, redundancy, and life-safety systems.
* Portfolio Management: Oversee the performance of multiple projects, ensuring they remain on track in terms of scope, schedule, and budget.
* Budget Management: Partner with the Commercial Management Office to oversee budget development and financial project controls; partner with business managers on budget submissions to the Capital Finance Review Board.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Serve as a primary point of contact for stakeholder engagement across the APJC Theatre for assigned programme, providing updates on project performance and addressing concerns.
* Team Coordination: Lead, coach, and motivate project team members and project managers leading and executing projects in your portfolio, influencing them to take positive action and accountability for their assigned work.
* Risk Management: Identify and manage project dependencies and critical path, assess risks, including those specific to live or occupied technical environments and develop mitigation strategies.
* Reporting: Track project milestones and deliverables and prepare status reports for senior management.
* Performance Monitoring: Track and report on project metrics and performance indicators to senior management.
* Process Improvement: Continuously evaluate and improve project management processes and methodologies, including those specific to data centre and lab delivery, to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.

**Knowledge, Skills & Experience**

* Deep understanding of the processes, procedures, and systems used in Capital Program Management and Service Delivery Management, and recognition of downstream impact on other disciplines.
* Working technical knowledge of data centre and/or laboratory environments, including power and cooling infrastructure, redundancy/resiliency concepts, and commissioning processes.
* Proficient with technology, tools, and processes that support service delivery; plays a part in promoting and developing improvements to functional tools and processes.
* Deep knowledge of project/program management methodologies and an understanding of real estate and critical facilities industry practices, evolution, and application to service delivery processes.
* Ability to analyse multiple sources of complex information and evaluate several alternative solutions before recommending a path forward.
* Ability to explain complex technical information and effectively lay out the pros and cons of alternatives for non-technical stakeholders to consider.
* Strongly developed ability to communicate and drive improvement across cross-functional teams to improve operations metrics and customer satisfaction; strong service level management and operations management skills.
* Deep understanding of key Capital Program Management concepts with the ability to explain these effectively to management or cross-functional teams and provide training.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Project Management, Construction Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Extensive experience in project and program management (8+ years minimum), with a strong focus on construction capital program management and program delivery for construction projects.
* Demonstrable experience delivering data centre, laboratory, or other mission-critical/technical facility projects, from design through commissioning and handover.
* Expertise in managing diverse teams of vendors, M&E engineers, and contractors across multiple projects.
* Demonstrates proficiency in concise reporting and clear communication when providing updates to senior leadership.
* Proficiency in project management software tools.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Excellent communication and leadership skills.
* Knowledge of local regulations and industry standards relevant to data centre and laboratory construction across APJC markets, specifically Special Economic Zone (SEZ) in Bangalore, India.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Experience managing projects in sectors such as data centres, laboratories, critical infrastructure, or IT/technology fit-out.
* Certification in project management (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2) is a plus.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
**Disclaimer**
**About**
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
* begin with screening or an interview
* originate from a Cisco email address, and
* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https://careers.cisco.com or cisco.wd5.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.
  
  
If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.
