e31d0329.title: Director - Security Architecture & Solution Engineering - Network & Zero Trust Architecture
e31d0329.description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Domain focus: Network & Zero Trust Architecture; domain authority across a large enterprise estate.**

**Job Purpose:**

  

Own the Network and Zero Trust domain as design authority for GSK. Zero Trust is a current Cyber Architecture and Solutions priority being built from the ground up rather than maintained, so this role is designing where GSK has no incumbent framework. A two-person domain: you and one Principal Architectyou and one Senior Principal Architect, with no engineering function of your own — Security Solution Engineering builds to your specifications and a managed service vendor operates the result.

**About the team**:

Security Architecture and Solution Engineering sets the target-state security architecture for GSK and builds the solutions that realise it. The function brings IT and OT architecture under single ownership for the first time, spanning Network and Zero Trust, Application Security, Platform Security, MDR and Detection Engineering, VM and Configuration Management, Data Security, and OT Security across a global manufacturing, laboratory and research estate. Architecture sets the standards and reference designs, Solution Engineering builds, tests and packages them, and a managed service vendor operates them. Architecture accountability never transfers: Cyber Architecture and Solutions designs and builds, the vendor runs. Twenty roles, with standards applying in more than 100 countries.

**What makes this role different.** You are building a Zero Trust framework from nothing, not operating one someone else designed. This is a design authority role with a very small team: one Principal Architectvery small team: one Senior Principal Architect, no engineering function of your own — Solution Engineering builds what you specify and the vendor operates it. If you need a large team or direct control of implementation to be effective, you will find this frustrating. Expect to be asked what failed in a Zero Trust programme you ran, not just what you designed.

**Key responsibilities:**

This role will provide you the opportunity to lead key activities to progress your career. These responsibilities include some of the following:

  

* Act as design authority for Network and Zero Trust architecture across GSK.
* Own the Zero Trust policy framework: device trust, identity trust and application access policy.
* Own network segmentation and microsegmentation standards across the estate.
* Own SASE and SD-WAN security architecture, secure remote access design and DNS security architecture.
* Produce architecture specifications that Solution Engineering builds from without reinterpretation.
* Maintain the Network and Zero Trust reference architecture library.
* Reject network and Zero Trust tooling that cannot express policy as code, integrate with the existing identity provider, or be operated by the managed service without Cyber Architecture and Solutions present.
* Assure the handover pack for every Zero Trust enforcement point and segmentation policy change before the vendor takes it, and retain the architecture decision when they propose a workaround in production.
* Resolve the segmentation boundary with OT Security where Purdue Level 3.5 meets the corporate network, and with Platform Security where NAC posture checks depend on EDR health.
* Secure Zero Trust design funding in major programme business cases at the point segmentation is still cheap — before application teams have built east-west dependencies that cannot be unpicked.
* Lead your team in using approved AI tools to improve productivity and ways of working, role-modelling responsible use and follow GSK's Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements.
* Mentor architects and engineers across the function and contribute to the architecture community of practice, setting the technical standard by example rather than by headcount.
* This is a specialist-track Director role with one direct report; authority is held through the specification and the design review, not through line management.

**Basic Qualifications:**

  

* 20+ years in network security architecture, with technical authority held through specification and design review rather than headcount — the domain team is one Principal Architectone Senior Principal Architect.
* Designing Zero Trust from the ground up — device trust, identity trust and application access policy — and sequencing the move from a perimeter-based estate
* Network segmentation and microsegmentation standards, SASE and SD-WAN security architecture, secure remote access and DNS security, with policy-as-code and automated enforcement
* Specifications a separate engineering team builds from without rework, holding technical authority through the specification rather than line management
* Zero Trust architecture for AI workloads and agents — non-human identity, LLM API egress control and segmentation of AI platforms and the data fabric

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Recognised architecture certification such as SABSA or TOGAF
* Zero Trust programme at enterprise scale, including the organisational resistance it attracts
* Regulated industry experience, including GxP environments where a routine network control can affect validated systems
* Technical evaluation of new network and Zero Trust tool proposals against the architecture model (vendor selection sits with Product Management), including automation of policy enforcement and network change

* Experience retiring a legacy remote-access estate — VPN concentrators and jump hosts — onto ZTNA without a change freeze.
* Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Typical tools and technologies: Zero Trust policy architecture across device, identity and application access, microsegmentation platforms such as Illumio, Guardicore and Cisco Secure Workload, SASE and SD-WAN including Zscaler, Netskope and Prisma Access, secure remote access design, DNS security, 802.1X and network access control, cloud network security on Azure and GCP, reference architecture libraries.

**Skills**

AI for Cybersecurity, Application Security, Cloud Security, Computer Programming, Data Security, Identity Access Management (IAM), Identity Resolution, Information Systems, Infrastructure Security, ML Security, Network Segmentation, Operating Systems Security, Probate Estates, Scripting, Security Engineering, Security Technologies, Security Testing, Vulnerability Management, Zero Trust, Zero Trust Architecture

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

7676b2d7.description:
Job Description
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  

* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
* Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the worlds greatest health threats.

Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our companys’ IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
  
  
A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
ThePrincipal Architect, Network Observability AI will join the Data Insights and Visualization team to contribute to the intersection of business intelligence (BI), telemetry visualization, and modern artificial intelligence. This role will contribute to the development of generative, conversational, and agentic AI capabilities into our existing telemetry platforms and new initiatives. By exploiting the advanced features of our commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) tools alongside custom, home-grown solutions, you will transform raw network data into immediate, actionable insights for our business and operational value teams.
  
  
What will you do in this role
  
  

* Architect unified dashboard platforms that convert complex telemetry into simplified, AI-driven visual scores for leadership and operational teams.
* Design, build and deliver end-to-end telemetry analytics and interactive dashboards that combine network flow, metrics, logs, traces, and business context to reduce time-to-insight and time-to-resolution.
* Design, build and deliver high-throughput telemetry pipelines that correlate multi-vendor syslog, SNMP, streaming telemetry, and VPC flow logs into cohesive telemetry lakes.
* Develop agentic AI agents and AIOps components that continuously analyze streaming telemetry to detect anomalies, and surface proactive recommendations to stakeholders.
* Embed AI-driven insights into visualizations and web applications so executives, product leaders, SREs and network engineers receive role-appropriate, actionable views.
* Build reusable visualization components, templates, and libraries to support routers, switches, firewalls, wireless, SD‑WAN, and core application observability.
* Contribute to telemetry data quality improvement, and performance measurement initiatives for critical network components.
* Provide technical mentoring and project leadership to local peers.

**Primary skills (must-have):**  

* Strong communicator who can translate technical analysis into clear, concise presentations for peers, managers, and executives.
* Strategic architectural mindset with deep technical expertise in multi-source correlation, and a proven track record of mentoring engineering teams on pipeline construction.
* Collaborative team player able to coordinate cross-functional work and deliver on time.

**Primary skills (must-have):**  

* Exposure to large global network infrastructures (routers, switches, LAN, SD‑WAN, firewalls, wireless).
* 6 years leading network monitoring, network telemetry, or network observability project using tools such as LogicMonitor, Thousand Eyes, Big Panda, Dynatrace, NetBrain, Grafana Cloud, Zscaler ZDX, or similar.
* Subject expertise and experience working as primary contributor on projects with Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) frameworks, or building conversational interfaces (chatbots) that translate user intent into structured queries (SQL, API calls, or platform-specific query languages).
* 6 years architecting enterprise-scale network monitoring or observability architectures, integrating network telemetry platforms with IT Service Management (ServiceNow API) and incident correlation engines.
* 6 years building observability and data normalization across complex telemetry types (logs, metrics, traces, flows) and proactive alerting/AIOps integration.
* 8 years developing complex multi-source data pipelines using data engineering tools such as Dataiku, Databricks.
* Proven experience building actionable dashboards and role-based views for executives, product owners, and engineers.
* Experience embedding visualizations in web applications and building reusable visualization components.
* Proficiency with one or more general-purpose programming languages and web frameworks: JavaScript (React/Vue), Python (Django/Flask), Java, or similar.
* 4-year college degree majoring in Computer Science, Telecommunications, Business Intelligence, or similar.

Secondary skills (nice to have)
  
  

* Engineer or specialist level developer certifications (AWS, Python, SQL) or equivalent hands-on experience.
* Familiarity integrating agents with ITSM/incident platforms (ServiceNow or similar) and network automation tools (Ansible, or similar).

Who we are
  
  
We are known as Merck Co., Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, we have been inventing , bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the worlds most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world.
  
  
What we look for
  
  
Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. Our team is constantly evolving, so if you are among the intellectually curious, join us—and start making your impact today.
  
  
**Additional location(s) Compensation Information:**  
**Required Skills:**  
AI Ops, AI Ops, Chatbots, Commercial-Off-The-Shelf (COTS) Software, Computer Science, Databricks Unified Data Analytics Platform, Data Engineering, Data Normalization, Data Pipelines, Emerging Technologies, JavaScript, Large Language Models (LLMs), Mentorship, Methods and Tools, Network Automation, Network Monitoring, Programming Languages, Project Leadership, Query Language, Requirements Management, ServiceNow Platform, Software Development, Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), Solution Architecture, Strategic Planning {+ 4 more}
  
  
**Preferred Skills:**  
Analytics, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Data Insights

You will work closely with clients, project managers, and other team members to understand business needs and develop solutions that meet client requirements.

* Maintain Technical Documentation: Develop and maintain technical documentation, including configuration documents and testing scripts.
* Stay Up-to-Date with SAP Cloud Integration: Stay current with SAP Cloud Integration releases, patches, and new features, and apply this knowledge to client projects.

Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Exposure to SAP Cloud Integration: Experience with designing, implementing, and configuring SAP Cloud Integration solutions, including analyzing business requirements and ensuring successful project delivery.
* Knowledge of SAP Cloud Integration Modules: Experience with configuring and implementing SAP Cloud Integration modules, such as API Management, Integration Flow, and Cloud Connector.
* Testing and Quality Assurance: Experience with performing unit testing, integration testing, and user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure solution quality.
* Technical Documentation: Experience with developing and maintaining technical documentation, including configuration documents and testing scripts.

1510e796.title: Enterprise Architect
1510e796.description:
Position Summary
  
  
As an Enterprise Architect at Adobe, you will build the future of digital experiences by helping global organizations unlock the full potential of data, AI, and cloud technologies. You will collaborate with executive leaders to develop transformation strategies, compose enterprise architecture roadmaps, and deliver innovative solutions that drive measurable business outcomes.
  
  
In this highly visible role, you will serve as a trusted advisor, guiding clients through complex digital, data, and AI transformations. You will build scalable, secure, and future-ready architectures that connect customer data, intelligence, content, and activation across Adobe Experience Cloud and modern cloud ecosystems.
  
  
You will influence strategic decisions, bring collaborators together around a shared vision, and help organizations accelerate innovation while delivering outstanding customer experiences.
  
  
Success in this role is measured by the value you build for customers. It also depends on the quality and impact of your architectural leadership. Additionally, success includes the adoption of recommended solutions and the positive relationships you develop with executives and delivery teams.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
Organizations are reimagining how they engage customers in an increasingly digital and technology-driven world. Adobe is at the forefront of this transformation, helping businesses build personalized, connected, and intelligent experiences at scale.
  
  
As a member of Adobe’s Enterprise Architecture group, you will:
  
  

* Work alongside executives to establish approaches for digital experience, customer data, and AI transformation.
* Build enterprise architectures that connect content, data, insights, and activation across the customer journey.
* Assist organizations in embracing cloud-native, API-first, and event-driven architectures through Adobe Experience Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, and major public cloud providers.
* Enable clients to accelerate innovation while reducing complexity and enhancing business value.

This is an opportunity to influence enterprise-scale transformation initiatives, build technology strategy, and help clients achieve lasting competitive advantage.
  
  
What You Will Do
  
  
Develop Digital, Data, and AI Strategy
  
  

* Collaborate with executive and senior partners to establish a clear vision for digital experiences, customer engagement, and AI-powered innovation.
* Translate business priorities into actionable, multi-year architecture roadmaps that align technology investments with strategic outcomes.
* See opportunities to improve customer experiences, operational efficiency, and business performance by using data, AI, and personalization.
* Define success measures, value hypotheses, and benchmarks that guide investment decisions and demonstrate impact.

Lead Enterprise Architecture Build
  
  

* Build scalable, secure, and resilient enterprise architectures across Adobe Experience Cloud and client technology ecosystems.
* Define modern data and AI architecture patterns, including customer data platforms, identity management, real-time decisioning, and personalization.
* Establish architecture standards and guidelines for cloud-native, API-first, event-driven, and microservices-based solutions.
* Develop reference architectures that enable agility, governance, security, and long-term scalability.
* Ensure architecture decisions support reliability, observability, performance, and business continuity.

Drive Alignment and Transformation
  
  

* Align business strategy, enterprise architecture, and delivery execution across marketing, technology, product, analytics, and data teams.
* Establish governance frameworks, operating models, and decision-making processes that enable balanced adoption and continuous improvement.
* Build positive relationships across client organizations, Adobe teams, and external partners to accelerate successful outcomes.
* Guide organizations through technology change while managing complexity and reducing risk.

Influence and Encourage
  
  

* Communicate architecture vision, trade-offs, and recommendations with clarity and confidence to executive audiences.
* Lead strategy workshops, architecture reviews, and roadmap discussions that align collaborators and build momentum for transformation.
* Advocate for data-driven and AI-powered experiences that build measurable value for customers and businesses.
* Serve as a leader with a point of view who helps clients navigate new technologies and evolving market trends.

Contribute to Adobe's Growth
  
  

* Build reusable frameworks, reference architectures, accelerators, and guidelines that strengthen Adobe's consulting capabilities.
* Mentor architects and consultants, encouraging a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning.
* Support strategic sales opportunities through solution building, executive presentations, and proposal development.
* Contribute to the evolution of Adobe's Enterprise Architecture practice and help build its strategic direction.

What You Need to Succeed
  
  
**Required Qualifications**

* Proven success developing and leading enterprise architecture strategies for complex organizations.
* Deep expertise with enterprise architecture frameworks and integration patterns, including TOGAF, API-first, and architectures built on connecting different services.
* Experience crafting and delivering cloud-native solutions on Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services, or comparable cloud platforms.
* Demonstrated experience crafting AI-enabled customer experiences and applying concepts such as large language models, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), prompt engineering, and model evaluation.
* Understanding of AI governance, agentic architectures, observability, reliability, and responsible AI practices in enterprise environments.
* Ability to translate business objectives into scalable technology strategies and architecture roadmaps.
* Strong executive communication and collaborator management skills, with the ability to influence decision-making across organizations.
* Experience collaborating with software engineers, data architects, application developers, data scientists, and business leaders to deliver end-to-end solutions.
* Outstanding written, verbal, and presentation skills.
* Ability to lead through influence and drive alignment across diverse teams and functions.
* Willingness to travel up to 50%.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working with Adobe Experience Cloud and Adobe Experience Platform tools.
* Experience working with digital marketing, customer experience, customer data, or personalization platforms.
* Knowledge of customer journey orchestration, decisioning, and real-time activation strategies.
* Experience leading enterprise-scale digital transformation initiatives.

**About Adobe**
Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.
  
  
Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.
  
  
**Let’s Adobe together**
At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.
  
  
Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more.
  
  
Adobe aims to make our Careers website and recruiting process accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe.com.

Our interviews are designed to reflect your own skills and thinking. a26f305d.description:
**About Persistent**
We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what's next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry-leading organizations across the world, including 18 of the Fortune 50 companies, 7 of the 10 top US banks, 9 of the 10 technology companies, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.
  
  
Our disruptor's mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We have delivered 26 sequential quarters of growth with $487.6M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 7.8% Q-o-Q and 20.0% Y-o-Y. Our 29,500+ global team members, located in 21 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We received five awards at the ISG (Information Services Group) Provider Lens Awards 2026 and, for the second year in a row, were awarded the Growth Honor of the Year at the Everest Group Elevate 2026.
  
  
**About Position**
We are seeking an experienced Senior Data Architect with 10 to 16 years of experience in designing and implementing enterprise-scale cloud data platforms. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in Snowflake, AWS, ETL/ELT frameworks, data warehousing, data lakes, and cloud-native architectures. This role requires strong architectural leadership to drive data modernization, migration, governance, integration, and analytics initiatives while delivering scalable, secure, and cost-optimized data solutions.
  
  

* Role: Senior Data Architect - Snowflake & AWS
* Location: Pune
* Experience: 10 to 16 Years
* Job Type: Full-Time Employment

**What You'll Do**

* Design end-to-end cloud data architectures leveraging Snowflake, AWS, and modern data platform technologies.
* Define architecture standards and implementation strategies for Data Warehouses, Data Lakes, Lakehouse platforms, and analytics ecosystems.
* Architect scalable and resilient ETL/ELT pipelines supporting batch, near real-time, and real-time data processing workloads.
* Lead modernization and migration initiatives from legacy and on-premises systems to Snowflake on AWS.
* Design Snowflake environments including databases, schemas, virtual warehouses, security models, resource monitors, and workload management strategies.
* Build data ingestion and integration frameworks using AWS services such as S3, Glue, Lambda, DMS, Kinesis, and other cloud-native technologies.
* Define enterprise data modeling standards, metadata strategies, data governance frameworks, and integration patterns.

* Establish security, compliance, and governance standards including RBAC, encryption, masking policies, auditing, and access management.
* Define CI/CD, automation, deployment, monitoring, and operational best practices for enterprise data platforms.
* Partner with business stakeholders, data engineers, architects, security teams, and cloud teams to convert business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Conduct architecture reviews, technology assessments, and solution design workshops.
* Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and guidance to Data Engineering and Analytics teams.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex performance, scalability, integration, and platform architecture challenges.
* Drive adoption of best practices across cloud data engineering and enterprise data management initiatives.

**Expertise You'll Bring**

* 10 to 16 years of overall IT experience with significant experience in Data Architecture, Cloud Data Platforms, and Enterprise Analytics solutions.
* Extensive hands-on expertise in designing and implementing Snowflake-based data architectures.
* Strong experience with Snowflake components including databases, schemas, virtual warehouses, RBAC, Snowpipe, Streams & Tasks, Secure Data Sharing, and Time Travel.
* Deep understanding of AWS cloud services including Amazon S3, AWS Glue, Lambda, IAM, KMS, DMS, CloudWatch, Kinesis, and related data platform services.
* Proven experience architecting enterprise-scale ETL/ELT frameworks, data ingestion processes, and integration solutions.
* Strong expertise in Data Warehousing, Data Lakes, Lakehouse architectures, and analytical data platforms.
* Proficiency in data modeling techniques including dimensional modeling, star schema, snowflake schema, and enterprise data architecture principles.
* Experience with structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data processing across large-scale environments.
* Strong understanding of cloud security, governance, compliance, data privacy, and access management frameworks.
* Expertise in Snowflake performance tuning, query optimization, workload management, storage optimization, and cloud cost management.
* Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, infrastructure automation, and data platform monitoring strategies.
* Strong understanding of modern cloud-native architecture patterns and scalable distributed systems.
* Excellent stakeholder management, architecture governance, communication, and presentation skills.
* Proven ability to lead technical discussions, influence architecture decisions, and guide engineering teams across large transformation programs.

**Benefits**

6ac1ce2b.title: Director, Systems Architecture & Modernization
6ac1ce2b.description:
At Quickbase, we help organizations build better ways to run their operations. Our products give teams the flexibility to create applications around how their work actually happens, connecting people, information, and processes so they can keep work moving as needs change.
  
  
For more than 25 years, organizations have turned to Quickbase to solve operational challenges that off-the-shelf software wasn't built for. Today, we’re building on that foundation with new products and new possibilities for how people create, adapt, and improve the systems their work depends on.
  
  
Working at Quickbase means helping find better ways forward. We’re a team of curious, collaborative people who care about solving problems, learning as we go, and building things that make work better for our customers and each other.

**Job Title** : Director, Systems Architecture and Modernization

**Reporting to** : Chief Business Transformation Officer

**Location** : Bangalore, India

**Department** : Enterprise Transformation Engine

  

**The Mandate**
===============

Quickbase's Core systems weren't built for what comes next. Every AI workflow, every agentic capability, every attempt to let people outside ETE build against our data runs into the same wall: systems that are tightly coupled, hard to decouple, and carrying years of technical debt.

This role exists to tear that wall down. You will lead the people who build and maintain Core Architecture and Systems Engineering, reduce the debt in systems like Salesforce, and make headless real at Quickbase — our systems exposing clean APIs instead of forcing every integration through custom logic. That is the precondition for everything else ETE is building, including the Builder platform that will let the business build AI workflows without waiting on ETE.

You will also own the technical direction for the biggest systems project ETE will run this cycle: rebuilding our Core Quoting and Billing infrastructure.

**What You'll Lead**
====================

**Team Leadership**

* Lead the combined Core Architecture and Systems Engineering teams — architects and Salesforce/systems engineers

* Set the technical bar for the people who build and maintain the systems Quickbase's revenue motion runs on

* You are accountable for the outcome. You do not chair a review committee. You make the call and document it.

**Systems Modernization & Technical Debt**

* Own the reduction of technical debt in Salesforce and adjacent Core systems: fewer custom flows, less undocumented logic, a system that can actually be reasoned about

* Define and drive the headless architecture strategy — decouple Core systems behind clean APIs so they can be consumed safely by any system, human, or agent that needs them, not just the ones built to know their internals

* Partner with the Sr. Manager of Systems Management on platform health and technical debt prioritization

**CPQ & Billing Platform**

* Own the technical architecture and design standards for the CPQ and Billing Platform rebuild

* Run the architecture review gate — nothing ships without your sign-off on the design

* Delivery cadence, stakeholder management, and program timeline sit with the assigned Program/BPM lead. Your job is the design underneath it, not the standup.

**Builder Platform — Precondition, Not Ownership**

* Make Core systems headless and API-exposed so the AI Automation & Engineering team can build the Builder platform on top of them safely

* You do not own the semantic layer, the skills repository, or the AI orchestration infrastructure. That work sits elsewhere, full stop.

* Your job is making Core systems safe and ready to be reached — not defining what Builder does with them

**What's Next**

* Once the above is underway, you have the latitude to reshape or reallocate resources across your own team toward forward-looking architecture work — agentic system design, patterns for a PLG motion, whatever the next constraint turns out to be

* This is not a separately funded mandate. It's your call, with your team, once the foundation is solid.

**What We Look For**
====================

* **Stack polyglot.** As comfortable in a Salesforce CPQ data model as evaluating what “headless” means for a legacy monolith. You don't default to the tool you know — you default to what the business needs.

* **Owner, not coordinator.** You own the standards, the review process, the quality bar, and the outcome for your domain, completely.

* **AI-fluent by necessity, not by title.** You understand what agentic AI needs from the systems underneath it well enough to make Core systems safe to build against. You are not building the AI infrastructure yourself.

* **Governance-first instinct.** You partner with Security and Legal on architecture guardrails because you know what breaks when you don't, not because a committee told you to.

* **Communicator across registers.** You can walk Finance through why the Billing data model matters for their close process, then turn around and review integration architecture with an engineer. Neither conversation intimidates you.

* **Comfortable with ambiguity, allergic to vagueness.** You can start before the full picture is clear, but once you have a direction, you write it down and hold people to it.

**What Success Looks Like, Year One**
=====================================

* Measurable reduction in Salesforce technical debt — custom flow/code surface, undocumented logic

* A defined and adopted headless architecture standard, with a first wave of Core systems exposed behind it

* CPQ & Billing Platform: architecture locked, review gate operating, first milestone shipped

* Core systems ready for Builder to safely consume, with the handoff defined and working

**Qualifications**
==================

* 10+ years in enterprise systems architecture, including 3+ years in a senior technical leadership role with direct people management

* Deep Salesforce platform architecture experience — Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, CPQ, multi-org/multi-product environments

* Direct experience decoupling monolithic or tightly-coupled systems into API-first, headless architectures

* Hands-on integration architecture experience — Workato, MuleSoft, or equivalent iPaaS

* Enough fluency in AI/agentic system design to know what those systems need from the platform underneath them, even without owning the AI stack itself

* Proven track record leading distributed technical teams across geographies

* B2B SaaS experience strongly preferred

**Preferred**

* Familiarity with PE-backed operating environments

* Experience leading architecture through a PLG transformation or major GTM motion change

* Familiarity with Snowflake, dbt, or the modern data stack

* Experience with AI governance frameworks in enterprise contexts
  

  

**Important Notices**  
**Recorded Interviews.** Quickbase uses an interview recording tool to record and transcribe interviews for evaluation purposes in accordance with applicable privacy laws. By participating in an interview, you consent to this recording and transcription.
  
**Interview Integrity.** AI is part of how we work at Quickbase — we expect you to use it too. Your application and interviews should still reflect you and your own thinking. We'll tell you when AI is encouraged throughout the selection process. Misrepresentation at any stage may result in removal from consideration for this and future roles.
  
**How We Review Applications** We use AI throughout our hiring process to help review, screen, schedule interviews, and assess applications. These tools support our team's review; they do not replace it, and every hiring decision is made by a person.

  
  
  

**Equal Opportunity Statement**

Quickbase is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply – even if you don’t meet every qualification listed. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

  
  

**Benefits**

* Modern Health
* Group Medical Insurance
* Night Shift Allowance
* Hybrid Work Allowance
* Mobile and Internet Allowance
* Meal Benefit
* Office Transportation
* On-Call Weekend Allowance
* Weekend Working Allowance
* Employee Referral Bonus

The Project Manager II will oversee day-to-day technology operations and production support for a mid-sized Health Plan, ensuring seamless delivery of services across core healthcare administration systems, including enrolment, claims, adjudication, and payments.

This role requires strong leadership, project management, service delivery, and stakeholder management capabilities. * Oversee day-to-day production support activities for healthcare administration platforms and associated applications.
* Plan, prioritize, and coordinate operational activities, enhancements, maintenance, and release schedules.
* Ensure timely delivery of project milestones, tasks, and customer commitments.
* Drive service delivery excellence through continuous process improvements and operational efficiencies.

### **2. Production Support & Incident Management**

* Manage incidents, service requests, and change activities using service management tools such as ServiceNow and JIRA.

* Establish standardized processes to improve consistency, quality, and service delivery.
* Drive change management, release management, and successful client rollouts.
* Apply ITIL best practices, SDLC, and Agile methodologies to enhance operational effectiveness.

Required Skills & Experience

* 12+ years of relevant experience in IT, Healthcare IT, technology operations, or service delivery management.
* Strong experience in project management, production support, and service delivery operations.
* Proven experience managing customer-facing technology support teams in complex IT environments.
* Experience managing healthcare payer systems, preferably HealthEdge HealthRules suite.

* Proven experience in vendor management and stakeholder engagement.
* Strong understanding of SDLC and Agile methodologies.
* Excellent planning, coordination, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively with customers, senior management, and cross-functional teams.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, drive accountability, and deliver results in a dynamic environment.

Educational Qualification

* 12+ years of relevant professional experience in IT or Healthcare Management.

What We Look For

* Strong customer focus and commitment to service excellence.
* Ability to lead teams and manage complex operational challenges.
* Proactive approach to risk identification, issue resolution, and continuous improvement.

3135f06d.title: Principal Technical Program Manager, AFT Outbound & Flow
3135f06d.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT) powers the physical engine at the heart of Amazon. **Job Description: Strategic Program Manager – CEO's Office**

**Reports To:**
Chief Executive Officer (CEO)

**Industry:**
IT Services / Technology

**Location:**
Anna Nagar -
Chennai, TN, India (Onsite)

**Timings: 8.30 PM to 5.30 PM Indian Standard Time (7.00 AM to 4 PM Pacific Time)**

**Important Role Requirements**

**1. Communication & Prioritization:**
Excellent verbal and written communication skills are essential, along with the ability to effectively manage competing priorities and deadlines.

**2. Pacific Time Alignment:**
Must be comfortable aligning working hours and availability with management's schedule in the Pacific Time (PT) time zone.

**3. Technical Aptitude:**
A strong interest in technology, with the ability to understand the IT services industry, stay current with emerging technologies, and keep up with relevant industry trends.

**4. Onsite Requirement:**
This is a 100% onsite position, five days a week, at our Anna Nagar, Chennai office. Remote or hybrid arrangements are not available.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and strategically minded
**Strategic Program Manager**
to work closely with the CEO and executive leadership team in driving business operations, strategic initiatives, and organizational growth.

This is a high-ownership role that will serve as a key execution partner to the CEO, ensuring alignment across teams, driving operational efficiency, and translating business priorities into measurable outcomes.

The individual will oversee multiple aspects of the business, including program management, resource planning, staffing, service delivery coordination, and business development support.

The ideal candidate is technically proficient, business-oriented, highly adaptable, and capable of bringing structure and accountability to a fast-paced, evolving startup environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Strategic & Operational Management**

* Partner with the CEO to drive strategic priorities and business initiatives.
* Translate leadership objectives into actionable plans and measurable outcomes.
* Oversee day-to-day business operations and cross-functional coordination.
* Establish processes, accountability, and operational discipline.

**2. Resource & Staffing Management**

* Coordinate resource planning, staffing, and workforce allocation.
* Work with technical teams to assess resource requirements and capacity.
* Identify staffing gaps and support recruitment and onboarding initiatives.

**3. Program & Service Delivery Oversight**

* Monitor program execution, project timelines, and delivery commitments.
* Coordinate across technical, operational, and client-facing teams.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and drive timely resolution.
* Ensure visibility into project performance, risks, and deliverables.

**4. Business Development & Growth**

* Support the CEO in identifying and pursuing new business opportunities.
* Coordinate prospect outreach, follow-ups, and client engagement activities.
* Assist with proposals, presentations, and business development initiatives.
* Track opportunities and ensure consistent follow-through.

**5. Executive & Leadership Support**

* Serve as a key liaison between the CEO, leadership, and operational teams.
* Drive execution of leadership decisions and strategic action items.
* Prepare management reports, business updates, and performance dashboards.
* Proactively identify challenges and manage competing priorities.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 5–10 years of experience in program management, business operations, IT services, or technology consulting.
* Strong technical aptitude and understanding of technology-driven business environments.
* Experience in resource planning, staffing, project coordination, or service delivery.
* Excellent organizational, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and drive execution independently.

**Key Attributes**

* Strategic thinker with a strong execution mindset.
* Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive.
* Comfortable working directly with executive leadership.
* Ability to bring structure and order to ambiguous situations.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making capabilities.
* Adaptable and effective in a fast-paced startup environment.
* High degree of ownership, accountability, and initiative.

**What We Are Looking For**

We are looking for someone who can function as an extension of the CEO's office and act as a trusted operational partner to leadership.

This individual must be equally comfortable driving strategic initiatives, coordinating technical teams, managing business operations, supporting growth opportunities, and resolving day-to-day challenges.

**The ideal candidate is someone who takes ownership, anticipates needs, connects the dots across the organization, and ensures that things get done.**

**Brennan. Where true performance thrives.**
At Brennan, we believe that
*how*
technology is delivered is every bit as important as
*what*
the technology is. We focus on creating real and relevant value for customers with solutions that fit their specific needs and always reflect their true interests. It’s a claim backed by our
**True Performance System**
- a way of working engineered to get us closer, and deliver better, for our customers and their actual experience of technology.
  
  
**Why join Brennan**
True performance for our customers starts with a true belief in our people.
  
  
It’s why we’ve structured our business to help our teams, and their talents, shine bright. It's why we’ve created a workplace where people of all backgrounds, beliefs and experiences are welcomed and empowered. And it’s why we’ve built an organisation where real innovation makes a genuine impact and generates true rewards for our team members.
  
  
**True rewards**
In addition to competitive remuneration, Brennan offers extensive benefits, including:
  
  

* Training and certification bonuses
* Culture Awards that recognise excellence
* Brennan Daredevils - our annual, all-expenses paid trip awarded to our top performers and outstanding contributors
* Vibrant, fun social activities
* Discounted hardware and software
* An environment that embraces learning and development

**PURPOSE OF ROLE**
The Presales Solutions Engineer is a technical-sales focused professional responsible for growing revenue across the Brennan IT portfolio. As a Presales Solutions Engineer you will be responsible for providing pre-sales technical consulting expertise to assist Brennan IT winning new and retaining existing business.
  
  
The Presales Solutions Engineer core role is to provide pre-sales technical insights, solution design and solution support to the Australia Based Pre Sales Team and existing Brennan customers.
  
  
Presales Solutions Engineer will assist in developing technical solutions for existing customers with regards to Managed Services, Hybrid Cloud (IaaS, Azure, AWS), Modern Workplace (M365), Networking & Security and SDWAN. This role will also involve the development of customer facing artifacts, Work Breakdown Structures and Statements of Work (SOW) and the Individual must have the ability to follow the Internal processes for sign off and approvals prior to releasing documentation to the customer.
  
  
An individual who has a generalist technical background with ability a proven ability to problem solve will be key to being successful in this role. A successful Presales Solutions Engineer must also have the ability to understand the customer requirement, develop task based breakdown structures coupled with effort estimations in line with customer outcomes, and collaborate with the Pre Sales Architecture Community to develop and recommend solutions.
  
  
As a Presales Solutions Engineer you will
  
  

* Have an attention to detail and provide a high standard of technical solution design to clients and create SOWs
* Ability to think outside the box when scoping and solutioning outcomes In line with customer objectives and budget
* Support the development of Statement of Work's and follow due process for Internal sign off prior to customer release
* Ability to work across competing priorities and outcomes
* Ability to build relationships with the wider Pre Sales Architecture community and Practice Leads where required
* Support the development of proposals, presentations and technical documentation where required
* Contribute to the Product Development cycle by participating in internal and client Workshops.

**ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Working in collaboration with an Australian Based Pre Sales Architect to produce customer facing artifacts required during the sales process
* Utilising internal systems to create relevant artifacts for generation of Work Breakdown Structure, Managed Services Renewals and Variations and follow process for peer review and technical sign off
* Attending customer meetings to discuss and obtain customer requirement
* Development of a scope of work at the direction of key stakeholder
* Transcribing the technical outcomes and scope to an order form
* Owning and following the Internal process for peer review and approval prior to releasing to customer.
* Working alongside an Australian Based Pre Sale Architect to produce and develop customer artifacts required for a successful sale.
* Coordinating internal teams to inputs required to complete multi solutions proposals
* Maintain an in-depth knowledge of the company’s products and services offerings and methodologies.
* Any other task/duties aligned with your role or in support of your team as advised by your leader.
* Delivery of various pre-sales activities - including responding to customer requests for information, developing and planning conceptual solution presentations and demonstrations, technical/product guidance in meetings etc.

**KEY COMPETENCIES**

* Passion for customer service
* Excellent communication and presentation skills (verbally and in writing)
* Proven experience of scoping and developing solutions
* Experience within an IT solutions business with experience in Cloud Services and IT outsourcing / managed services
* A “trusted advisor” and “project leader” attitude
* Well organised, ability to perform and work well under pressure.
* A willingness to work and adapt to a fast growing & changing environment
* Technical understanding of IaaS and Hybrid Cloud
* Technical understanding of Microsoft Office 365 Suite of technologies including, Endpoint Management, Security and Teams
* Understanding of Cloud Connectivity, Networking and SDWAN technologies
* Understanding of AI and how to apply AI to achieve the required outcomes
* Industry based technical certifications (e.g. Microsoft, , VMWare, EMC, Cisco, HP, Sophos, Fortinet)
* Experience working with Cloud, IaaS and Hosting solutions including products such as Microsoft Azure and Office 365
* Prior experience within an outsourced service delivery environment
* Proven experience and ability to provide consultative guidance combined with previous customer facing Presales and presentation experience
* 5+ years industry experience in professional services or experience in technical service delivery roles

is an equal opportunity employer.

Within 3 months at SailPoint you will have:

* Completed all assigned training to become ‘field ready’
* Present SailPoint, platform and demo to your manager
* Continued to have periodic meetings with your buddy
* Have regular scheduled meetings with your partnering Account Executives, Digital Sales, Customer Success and Delivery Services Team.
* Ready to execute as Lead Solution Engineer
* Know the RFx response process, tools and lead your first RFx response

By the end of your first 12 months at SailPoint you will have:

* Completed your platform training and attained product certification

* Confidently engage with senior execs and articulate the business values of identity security
* Led the technical aspects of opportunities alongside your partnering Account Executives from discovery, to presentation, to demo, to evaluation and to close
* Contribute to customer success stories, white papers, blogs and social media posts that show our expertise in the Identity Security Market.
* Actively participate in internal meetings, knowledge sharing sessions and enablement
* Mentor and coach new sales and presales team members on SailPoint solution
* Be the Solution Engineering rock star you were born to be

**Requirements:**

* 5+ years professional experience as a pre-sales technical resource in an enterprise software company
* 3+ years working with Identity, Governance and Access Management solutions.
* Excellent written and verbal communications skills.
* A working knowledge of technical infrastructure including application servers, databases, virtualization and directories is required.
* Familiarity with Java, XML, LDAP, SQL is desirable.
* Understanding of Cloud platforms like Azure, Google and AWS is desirable.
* Ensure proposed deals include technical solutions that accurately address customer needs, and appropriately supported by key customer technical decision-makers.
* Lead and engage in technical conversations with customers.
* Work with Product team to improve roadmap based on technical experience with customers.
* Understand and ability to explain Identity Security processes, deployment models & best practices.

* Mumbai, India
* Travel is expected.

****What we are looking for****

* Candidates with results-oriented mindset, focusing on improving client satisfaction and providing a very high standard of service, driving towards Kinaxis’s success.
* Sound knowledge in Supply Chain concepts especially scheduling with 6+ years of experience.
* Strong intent to learn our first in class product “Maestro”

* Ability to solve complex problems, think critically and make sound judgement decisions.

* Ability to communicate complex ideas effectively in English, both verbally and in writing

#Senior
  
  
**Work With Impact:**
Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day—when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.
  
  
**Work with Fortune 500 Brands:**
Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Ford, Unilever, Yamaha, P&G, Lockheed-Martin, and more.
  
  
**Social Responsibility at Kinaxis:**
Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to net-zero operations strategy for the long term. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact.
  
  
People matter at Kinaxis and these are some of the perks and benefits we created for our team:
  
  

* Flexible vacation and Kinaxis Days (company-wide day off on the last Friday of every month)
* Flexible work options
* Physical and mental well-being programs
* Regularly scheduled virtual fitness classes
* Mentorship programs and training and career development
* Recognition programs and referral rewards
* Hackathons

For more information, visit the Kinaxis web site at www.kinaxis.com or the company’s blog at http://blog.kinaxis.com .

If you require an accommodation, please reach out to us at recruitmentprograms@kinaxis.com. 6be16e7f.title: Customer Solutions Engineer
6be16e7f.description:
**Build the Future Workforce**
Wand turns AI into labor. It enables humans and AI agents to operate together as a unified, hybrid workforce, with comprehensive management and oversight. And it’s already operating at scale inside some of the world’s largest organizations.
  
  
Wand built the world’s first Agentic Labor Infrastructure enabling governments and global enterprises to create, manage, and scale digital workforces.
  
  
Our mission is to integrate agent ecosystems into the core of work and business, unlocking a generational leap in the global economy. We’re building the infrastructure that lets humans and AI agents operate together safely, transparently, and at scale.
  
  
**Join Wand in leading the Agentic Shift**
Wand is building a high-performing global team who take full ownership of what they build. We lead by example, move fast, make data-aware decisions, and continuously push for more- always with a focus on delivering real value to customers.
  
  
You would be joining a world-class team that combines deep research expertise and real-world product execution, with experience spanning Deepmind, Google, Amazon, Miro, Elise AI, IBM and Accern.
  
  
**About The Role**
We’re looking for a Field Solutions Engineer to sit at the intersection of engineering and go-to-market: pairing deep hands-on building with direct customer work to turn Wand’s platform into real agent-hours, workflows, and value in production.
  
  
You’ll work across the lifecycle from early technical validation and pilots through rollout and adoption translating messy business problems into concrete, testable workflows, building believable prototypes, and helping customers scale usage across many use cases.
  
  
If you love writing Python, wiring up APIs, and experimenting with LLMs as much as you enjoy talking to customers, this is a chance to shape how enterprises actually adopt the next generation of AI systems.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**
*Build and ship real solutions*

* Design and implement workflows, agents, and integrations on Wand for live customer scenarios (not just demo toys).
* Turn one-off builds into reusable patterns: templates, starter kits, and internal tools other CEs/SEs can reuse.
* Own technical quality: performance, reliability, and auditability of what you ship.

*﻿Lead technical validation (“Proof-to-Contract”)*

* Help customers frame clear technical hypotheses: what needs to be proven (accuracy, coverage, latency, safety) for them to buy.
* Design lightweight proofs, benchmarks, and evals that credibly answer, “Does this actually work for our data and process?”
* Set up simple measurement for before/after: time saved, error reduction, or volume handled.

*﻿Support pre-sales and pilots*

* Partner with Sales to shape and deliver believable demos and pilots that showcase Wand’s differentiators (agentic workflows, governance, complex document workflows, etc.).
* Adapt and extend our demo environments rather than rebuilding from scratch each time.
* Join customer calls to explain how things work under the hood and handle deep technical questions.

*﻿Drive onboarding, adoption, and expansion*

* Help design and run onboarding plans: initial workflows, training sessions, office hours, and enablement for power users.
* Instrument your solutions for usage and value (DAU/WAU, agent-hours, workflow runs) and use this data to guide iteration.
* Partner with Customer Success to identify new use cases and turn proven workflows into broader rollouts.

*﻿Handle issues with urgency*

* Debug and triage customer-facing issues, working closely with core Engineering when needed.
* Provide clear, customer-ready explanations, workarounds, and follow-ups.
* Feed recurring issues back into platform fixes, docs, and playbooks.

*﻿Build the CE toolbox and playbooks*

* Contribute Python scripts, API workflows, and reference architectures that show “the Wand way” to build.
* Document patterns for common use cases (e.g., contract review, research copilots, support augmentation) so the next deployment is faster.
* Help define and refine internal CE rituals: intake criteria, pilot checklists, and demo/pilot templates.

**﻿Key Qualifications:**

* 5+ years in a hands-on technical role such as Sales Engineer, Solutions Architect, Customer/Field Engineer, or Product-adjacent Engineer, working directly with enterprise customers.

Strong
**practical engineering skills**
:
  
  

* Comfortable writing Python in a professional context (scripts, services, ETL, automation).
* Experience integrating with APIs, webhooks, and data sources (files, DBs, SaaS tools).
* Able to design simple, robust systems and debug real-world failures.
* Experience building with LLMs or applied AI systems:
* Prompting, RAG, or agent/workflow orchestration (homegrown or with tools like LangChain, LlamaIndex, etc.).
* You’ve shipped at least one real application, prototype, or internal tool that used an LLM or similar model in production or a serious pilot.

Comfortable in front of customers:
  
  

* Can walk through an architecture diagram, show live workflows, and answer hard questions without hand-waving.
* Can listen deeply, translate fuzzy asks into concrete technical work, and push back when a request doesn’t make sense.
* Demonstrated ability to work across the lifecycle: discovery/solution design, proof/pilot build, rollout, and post-launch iteration.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

**﻿Who You Are:**
**Builder First, Then Storyteller**
You reach for a REPL or notebook before a slide. You’re happiest when you can show, not just tell — but you can narrate clearly for both engineers and executives.
  
  
**Customer-Obsessed Problem Solver**
You care less about “cool tech” and more about whether the workflow actually saves time, reduces risk, or lets the customer do something genuinely new.
  
  
**Hands-On and Pragmatic**
You’re comfortable with ambiguity and partial requirements. You find the smallest credible thing to build that proves the point and moves the deal or deployment forward.
  
  
**Systems Thinker**
You see how pre-sales, pilots, adoption, support, and metrics fit together and look for ways to turn one success into a pattern others can reuse.
  
  
**Bias to Action and Ownership**
You don’t wait for perfect specs. You pick up the ball, talk to whoever you need to, and get the workflow, demo, or fix over the line — then you document it so it’s easier next time.

We are seeking an experienced and technically proficient **Solution Architect** to lead the end-to-end solution design and upgrade strategy for **UDM (User Data Management), IMS (IP Multimedia Subsystem), and Packet Core** network elements. The architect will collaborate with cross-functional teams to define upgrade paths, validate design impacts, and ensure seamless execution in live network environments.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Upgrade Strategy & Planning**:

+ Define upgrade approach (ISSU vs. redeployment) based on product capabilities and customer environment.
+ Evaluate backward compatibility and interoperability impacts across EPC/5GC/Cloud components.
+ Align upgrade activities with network architecture roadmap, lifecycle policies, and vendor release cycles.

* **Solution Architecture & Design**:

+ Develop high- and low-level solution architecture for upgrades, including software/hardware pre-requisites.
+ Create detailed upgrade impact assessments and rollback strategies.
+ Validate upgrade path for clustered/HA deployments, geo-redundancy, and distributed architectures.

* **Stakeholder Coordination**:

+ Work with delivery, operations, product teams, and customers to gather requirements and constraints.
+ Participate in technical governance and change control boards for upgrade approvals.
+ Present solution documents, risk mitigations, and test validation plans to internal and external stakeholders.

* **Tools, Automation & Compliance**:

+ Leverage automation for pre-checks, health-checks, and post-upgrade validation (e.g., EVFNM, CaaS scripts).
+ Ensure compliance with security, data protection, and audit standards during upgrade cycles.
+ Integrate solutions with CI/CD pipelines where applicable.

* **Documentation & Knowledge Sharing**:

+ Develop and maintain architecture documentation, upgrade playbooks, and decision logs.
+ Share knowledge across teams via technical sessions, mentoring, and documentation.

ea8436c7.title: Salesforce Technical Architect- Automotive Cloud
ea8436c7.description:
**Description**
**What You'll Be Doing & Why It Matters**
The Technical Architect — Automotive Cloud successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex, enterprise-grade Salesforce solutions for automotive clients operating across OEMs, authorized dealership networks, commercial fleet operators, and emerging mobility providers. Technologies include Salesforce Automotive Cloud, Vehicle Console, Dealer Management, Fleet Management, Salesforce APIs, Apex/LWC, Agentforce, and DMS/telematics integrations.
  
  
You are both a big-picture automotive enterprise thinker and a deep, hands-on problem solver. You take pride in designing systems that withstand high transaction volumes across distributed dealer networks, support complex OEM-to-dealer data hierarchies, and will not fail at critical inflection points such as vehicle launch campaigns, service recall operations, or connected vehicle data ingestion spikes. The solutions you design are built for long-term scalability, growing seamlessly alongside the customer's dealer network footprint and connected vehicle ecosystem.
  
  
You have a strong mix of technical depth and enterprise consulting acumen, knowing how to leverage AI development tools like Claude, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot to optimize code quality, accelerate architectural design cycles, and rapidly prototype automotive-specific configurations. As Salesforce leads the agentic era, you play a front-line role in driving AI-First delivery—designing autonomous agents that power intelligent dealer assist, predictive service scheduling, and connected vehicle conversational experiences.
  
  
**What You'll Actually Be Doing**
**Stakeholder Collaboration:**
Collaborate with automotive client stakeholders—CTO, VP Digital, Head of Dealer Operations—to define requirements, deliverables, and manage expectations across enterprise OEM and dealer network engagements.
  
  
**Solution Architecture:**
Translate complex automotive business requirements into well-architected Salesforce solutions, identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI using Agentforce for intelligent dealer assist, predictive service agents, and connected vehicle conversational experiences.
  
  
**Enterprise AI Architecture:**
Design and integrate scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within Automotive Cloud environments—optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits to support real-time telematics ingestion and high-volume dealer operations.
  
  
**Technical Design Leadership:**
Lead design sessions; author TDDs/ADDs aligned to client commercial objectives; leverage AI tools to review architectural assumptions and simulate edge cases such as peak vehicle launch traffic, concurrent DMS sync operations, and large-scale recall campaign orchestration.
  
  
**AI-First Governance & Code Standards:**
Provide project oversight championing AI-First delivery using AI tools and agentic evaluation frameworks. Lead code reviews and enforce standards using AI coding assistants to identify governor limit risks and optimize integration performance.
  
  
**Technical Delivery Management:**
Manage delivery of custom development, DMS integrations, telematics ingestion pipelines, and vehicle master data migrations—using AI tools to accelerate Apex class generation, mock data creation, and REST integration scaffolding
  
  
**Performance Evaluation & ROI:**
Collaborate with automotive customers to develop evaluation frameworks measuring AI performance, dealer satisfaction scores, service retention rates, and business value for specific automotive use cases.
  
  
**Pre-Sales & Prototyping:**
Participate in automotive discovery workshops, technical deep-dives, and rapid POC development—using AI tools to prototype Vehicle Console configurations, dealer portal experiences, and Agentforce automotive agents for prospective clients.
  
  
**Product Team Liaison:**
Liaise with Salesforce Automotive Cloud product teams to channel client implementation feedback, influence roadmap decisions, and ensure implementations align with platform evolution.
  
  
**You're Our Person If...**
**Experience & Platform Depth**

* Degree or equivalent proven experience (extracurricular leadership, military, volunteer, work experience)
* 9–14 years CRM/enterprise software; 6+ years Salesforce platform; 3+ years Automotive Cloud
* Expert Automotive Cloud data model: Vehicle Console, Dealer Management, Fleet Management modules
* Expert-level Salesforce platform suite: Sales, Service, Experience, Automotive Cloud, Agentforce architecture
* Scalable solution design for high-volume automotive scenarios with AI-assisted load modeling
* LDV limitations, design patterns, and data distribution risk analysis
* Multi-tier dealer hierarchy sharing: OWD, sharing rules, and permission sets for OEM/dealer data isolation
* Platform security capabilities: TLS, SSL, and data encryption for automotive commercial data

**Integration, AI & DevOps**

* Expert DMS integration: CDK, Reynolds & Reynolds, Tekion; telematics ingestion platforms; OEM proprietary back-end systems
* Middleware platforms: MuleSoft, Boomi, Azure Integration Services; ETL/ELT frameworks
* Auth patterns: SAML, SSO, OAuth 2.0 — secure configuration for OEM and dealership enterprise identity providers
* DevOps: environment management, Git, Copado/Gearset, multi-sandbox deployment pipelines and release management
* Practical fluency: accelerate delivery using AI tools, document architecture, maintain code quality
* Agentforce design: dealer assist agents, connected vehicle chatbots, predictive service recommendations, intelligent recall orchestration
* Collaboration with customers to develop AI performance and business value evaluation frameworks

**Certification Pathway & Continuous Learning**
**Required Certification**
Salesforce Administrator
  
  
Platform App Builder
  
  
Platform Developer I
  
  
Agentforce Specialist
  
  
Integration Architect
  
  
Sharing & Visibility Designer
  
  
**Preferred Certification**
System / Application Architect
  
  
CRM Analytics Consultant
  
  
**Leadership Qualities & Core Values**
To navigate high-stakes technical environments and successfully lead automotive enterprises through digital disruption, the Technical Architect must embody specific consulting behaviors that translate technical capability into executive alignment and customer trust.
  
  
**Core Leadership Pillars**

* PASSION: Customer Success First : Deep personal investment in transforming complex OEM and dealer implementations into tangible market wins and measurable outcomes for automotive clients and their networks.
* BEGINNER'S MIND: Continuous Learning : Approaches every engagement with humbleness and curiosity—dismantling assumptions to keep pace with rapid shifts in EV transitions, connected vehicle technology, and consumer expectations.
* ADAPTABLE: Thrives in Uncertainty: Remains poised, agile, and decisive navigating structural volatility, shifting regulatory landscapes, and market disruption as permanent constants in the automotive sector.
