4b9fb6e8.description:
**Sr CloudOps Engineer**

*Cloud Platform • Kubernetes • Infrastructure as Code • Technical Leadership*

**Location:** Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Chennai

**Mode of Work:**  Hybrid

**Shift Timings:** General or 2 PM to 11 PM

**Type:** Full-time • Senior/Lead • 8+ years

**Reporting to:** Cloud Operations Lead / Head of Engineering

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

We are looking for a Senior Cloud Ops Engineer to manage and improve our cloud infrastructure, security, and platform engineering capabilities across GCP and AWS.

The role involves designing secure and scalable cloud environments, managing Kubernetes platforms, automating infrastructure using Terraform, improving CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring high availability and reliability. The candidate will also lead incident response, implement security best practices, and mentor engineers.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Platform Architecture & Strategy Primary**

* Lead the architecture and implementation of complex cloud solutions across GCP and AWS — networking, compute, storage, and multi-environment design.
* Define platform standards and reusable patterns (landing zones, Terraform modules, cluster blueprints) that teams build against.
* Evaluate new cloud technologies and guide cloud strategy and platform roadmap improvements.
* Drive cost optimisation and FinOps practices — right-sizing, commitment planning, and resource governance across environments.
* Own reliability and scalability targets — capacity planning, high availability, and disaster recovery design.

**Kubernetes & Container Platform — Primary**

* Design and operate production GKE clusters — cluster architecture, node pool strategy, upgrades, and autoscaling.
* Own the container platform experience — Helm/Kustomize standards, namespace and RBAC models, and workload onboarding.
* Manage service mesh (Istio) for traffic management, mTLS, and observability across services.
* Define golden paths for application teams to deploy safely and consistently.

**Automation & Infrastructure as Code — Primary**

* Own Terraform standards and module design — secure, reusable, and version-controlled infrastructure as code.
* Drive end-to-end automation of provisioning, configuration, and platform operations.
* Own GitLab CI/CD pipeline architecture for infrastructure and platform delivery.
* Eliminate manual toil through tooling, self-service, and platform automation.

**Reliability, Observability & Leadership**

* Instrument platform observability in Datadog — metrics, logs, traces, SLOs, and alerting.
* Lead incident response and post-incident reviews for platform-impacting events.
* Mentor junior and mid-level engineers; provide technical direction and review designs.
* Collaborate with cross-functional and on/offshore teams to deliver high-impact project lifecycles.

**TECH STACK**

**Required**

* GCP — Compute Engine, GKE, VPC, Cloud Storage, IAM, Cloud Load Balancing
* AWS — EC2, EKS, VPC, S3, IAM (multi-cloud operation)
* Kubernetes — GKE architecture, Helm/Kustomize, autoscaling, RBAC, upgrades
* Terraform — module design, remote state, multi-environment IaC
* GitLab — CI/CD pipeline design for infrastructure and platform delivery
* Datadog — metrics, logs, traces, SLOs, alerting
* Istio — traffic management, mTLS, service mesh observability

**Good to have**

* ArgoCD/Flux (GitOps), Vault, Cloud FinOps tooling, Python or Go, packer, service catalog/self-service platforms

**REQUIREMENTS**

**Must have**

* 8+ years in cloud platform, infrastructure, or DevOps engineering, including a lead or architect-level remit.
* Deep expertise in GCP and/or AWS — hands-on architecture and implementation.
* Strong production Kubernetes experience — cluster design, operations, and upgrades.
* Expert-level Terraform — reusable module design and multi-environment IaC.
* Proven CI/CD and automation experience at scale.
* Experience managing global on/offshore teams and high-impact project lifecycles.
* Ability to mentor engineers and communicate architecture decisions to technical and business stakeholders.

**Nice to have**

* Google Professional Cloud Architect or AWS Solutions Architect Professional certification.
* Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA).
* GitOps (ArgoCD/Flux) and progressive delivery experience.
* FinOps / cloud cost optimisation experience.
* Experience in regulated environments (HIPAA, SOC 2, ISO 27001).

20210bad.title: Oracle Financials & PPM Solution Architect
20210bad.description:
**Role: Senior Principal Consultant Oracle Financials & PPM Solution Architect**

**Experience: 15- 18 Years**

**Location: Hyderabad || Chennai || Bangalore**

**Role: Senior Principal Consultant Oracle Financials & PPM Solution Architecture**

  

**1. Role Overview**

The Senior Principal Consultant will serve as a **Solution Architect**  for Oracle **Financials and Project Portfolio Management (PPM**), with strong hands-on functional experience across **Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and Oracle E-Business Suite**.

  

The role requires proven experience in **solution architecture, delivery ownership, direct client interaction, stakeholder communication, and complex problem solving** across large-scale global Oracle ERP programs.

  

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Solution Architecture, Delivery Leadership & Client Ownership**

* Lead **end-to-end Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and Oracle EBS implementations, rollouts, upgrades, and transformation programs** across Financials and PPM modules
* Own **solution architecture, functional design, delivery planning, and execution governance** aligned with enterprise standards and client objectives
* Act as a **Functional Solution Architect, Delivery Lead, and trusted client-facing SME** for complex business scenarios
* Ensure delivery of scalable, secure, high-performance, and business-aligned Oracle ERP solutions with clear ownership of outcomes

**B. Oracle Financials & PPM Expertise across Fusion and EBS**

* Design, configure, and architect Oracle Financials and PPM solutions across both **Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and Oracle EBS** landscapes:
* **Financials Modules**: GL, AP, AR, FA, CM, SLA
* **PPM Modules**: Project Costing, Project Billing, Project Contracts, Revenue Management
* Lead advanced implementations such as:
* Multi-org structures (MOAC)
* Revenue recognition (ASC 606)
* Intercompany accounting
* Drive integration between Financials and upstream/downstream systems

**C. Client Engagement & Consulting**

* Engage with global clients to:
* Gather and analyse business requirements
* Conduct **workshops, CRPs, and design sessions**
* Translate business needs into **functional and technical solution designs**
* Act as a **trusted advisor** to business and IT stakeholders
* Present solution architecture, proposals, and roadmap to leadership teams

**D. Implementation & Delivery Governance**

* Own lifecycle activities:
* **Requirement gathering Design Build Test (SIT/UAT) Go-Live Support**
* Lead:
* Data migration and reconciliation
* RICEW (Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Extensions, Workflows) design
* Ensure adherence to:
* Project timelines
* Quality standards
* Risk mitigation and issue resolution

**E. Complex Problem Solving**

* Resolve:
* Complex accounting and project accounting challenges
* Integration and data inconsistencies
* Provide **innovative solutions** leveraging:
* Standard EBS capabilities
* Custom extensions where required
* Lead root cause analysis for critical production issues

**F. Team Leadership & Mentoring**

* Lead and mentor **functional consultants and cross-functional teams**
* Provide guidance on:
* Best practices
* Solution design standards
* Drive knowledge sharing across teams

**G. Pre-Sales & Business Development**

* Support:
* Proposal creation
* Solution estimations
* Client presentations
* Contribute to new business opportunities and account growth

**3. Required Skills & Competencies**

**Functional Expertise**

* Strong experience in:
* Oracle EBS R12.2.10 (mandatory)
* Oracle Financials (GL, AP, AR, FA, CM, SLA)
* Oracle PPM (Costing, Billing, Contracts, Revenue)
* **Strong working experience in Oracle Fusion Financials & PPM and Oracle EBS Financials & PPM is required**, with the ability to compare, design, and guide solutions across both platforms

**Technical & Architecture Skills**

* Strong understanding of:
* EBS architecture
* Integrations (APIs, interfaces)
* RICEW components
* Ability to design **end-to-end enterprise solutions**

**Client Interaction, Communication & Consulting Skills**

* Excellent:
* **Direct client interaction experience** with business users, IT teams, senior stakeholders, and program leadership
* **Very good verbal and written communication skills**, including the ability to explain complex Oracle Financials and PPM solutions clearly
* Strong presentation, workshop facilitation, requirement clarification, and stakeholder management capabilities
* Experience working with **global clients, onsite-offshore delivery models, and preferably prior onsite client-facing experience**

**Problem Solving, Analytical Thinking & Delivery Leadership**

* Ability to:
* Analyse complex, ambiguous business problems across Oracle Financials and PPM and convert them into practical solution options
* Demonstrate strong problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making skills in high-pressure delivery environments
* Lead issue resolution, design trade-off discussions, risk mitigation, and cross-functional alignment with client and delivery teams

**4. Experience Requirements**

* **15–18 years** of Oracle ERP consulting, solution architecture, and delivery leadership experience
* Minimum **8+ years in Oracle Financials and PPM** across Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and/or Oracle EBS
* Proven experience in:
* Large-scale implementations
* Solution architecture roles
* Client-facing delivery

**5. Education & Certifications**

* Bachelor’s/master’s degree in finance, Accounting, IT, or related field. CA/CMA
* Oracle Certifications (EBS / Fusion Financials / PPM) – preferred

**6. Key Success Indicators**

* Successful delivery of complex Oracle programs
* High client satisfaction and stakeholder trust
* Quality of solution architecture and scalability
* Strong team leadership and mentorship outcomes

16e1b4f6.title: Salesforce Technical Architect- Automotive Cloud
16e1b4f6.description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*

Job Category

Customer Success

Job Details

**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

**What You'll Be Doing & Why It Matters**

The Technical Architect — Automotive Cloud successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex, enterprise-grade Salesforce solutions for automotive clients operating across OEMs, authorized dealership networks, commercial fleet operators, and emerging mobility providers. Technologies include Salesforce Automotive Cloud, Vehicle Console, Dealer Management, Fleet Management, Salesforce APIs, Apex/LWC, Agentforce, and DMS/telematics integrations.
  
You are both a big-picture automotive enterprise thinker and a deep, hands-on problem solver. You take pride in designing systems that withstand high transaction volumes across distributed dealer networks, support complex OEM-to-dealer data hierarchies, and will not fail at critical inflection points such as vehicle launch campaigns, service recall operations, or connected vehicle data ingestion spikes. The solutions you design are built for long-term scalability, growing seamlessly alongside the customer's dealer network footprint and connected vehicle ecosystem.
  
You have a strong mix of technical depth and enterprise consulting acumen, knowing how to leverage AI development tools like Claude, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot to optimize code quality, accelerate architectural design cycles, and rapidly prototype automotive-specific configurations. As Salesforce leads the agentic era, you play a front-line role in driving AI-First delivery—designing autonomous agents that power intelligent dealer assist, predictive service scheduling, and connected vehicle conversational experiences.

**What You'll Actually Be Doing:**
----------------------------------

**Stakeholder Collaboration:** Collaborate with automotive client stakeholders—CTO, VP Digital, Head of Dealer Operations—to define requirements, deliverables, and manage expectations across enterprise OEM and dealer network engagements.
  
**Solution Architecture:** Translate complex automotive business requirements into well-architected Salesforce solutions, identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI using Agentforce for intelligent dealer assist, predictive service agents, and connected vehicle conversational experiences.
  
**Enterprise AI Architecture:** Design and integrate scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within Automotive Cloud environments—optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits to support real-time telematics ingestion and high-volume dealer operations.
  
**Technical Design Leadership:** Lead design sessions; author TDDs/ADDs aligned to client commercial objectives; leverage AI tools to review architectural assumptions and simulate edge cases such as peak vehicle launch traffic, concurrent DMS sync operations, and large-scale recall campaign orchestration.
  
**AI-First Governance & Code Standards:** Provide project oversight championing AI-First delivery using AI tools and agentic evaluation frameworks. Lead code reviews and enforce standards using AI coding assistants to identify governor limit risks and optimize integration performance.
  
**Technical Delivery Management:** Manage delivery of custom development, DMS integrations, telematics ingestion pipelines, and vehicle master data migrations—using AI tools to accelerate Apex class generation, mock data creation, and REST integration scaffolding
  
**Performance Evaluation & ROI:** Collaborate with automotive customers to develop evaluation frameworks measuring AI performance, dealer satisfaction scores, service retention rates, and business value for specific automotive use cases.
  
**Pre-Sales & Prototyping:** Participate in automotive discovery workshops, technical deep-dives, and rapid POC development—using AI tools to prototype Vehicle Console configurations, dealer portal experiences, and Agentforce automotive agents for prospective clients.
  
**Product Team Liaison:** Liaise with Salesforce Automotive Cloud product teams to channel client implementation feedback, influence roadmap decisions, and ensure implementations align with platform evolution.

**You're Our Person If...**
---------------------------

**Experience & Platform Depth**

* Degree or equivalent proven experience (extracurricular leadership, military, volunteer, work experience)
* **9–14 years** CRM/enterprise software; **6+ years** Salesforce platform; **3+ years** Automotive Cloud
* Expert Automotive Cloud data model: Vehicle Console, Dealer Management, Fleet Management modules
* Expert-level Salesforce platform suite: Sales, Service, Experience, Automotive Cloud, Agentforce architecture
* Scalable solution design for high-volume automotive scenarios with AI-assisted load modeling
* LDV limitations, design patterns, and data distribution risk analysis
* Multi-tier dealer hierarchy sharing: OWD, sharing rules, and permission sets for OEM/dealer data isolation
* Platform security capabilities: TLS, SSL, and data encryption for automotive commercial data
  

**Integration, AI & DevOps**

* Expert DMS integration: CDK, Reynolds & Reynolds, Tekion; telematics ingestion platforms; OEM proprietary back-end systems
* Middleware platforms: MuleSoft, Boomi, Azure Integration Services; ETL/ELT frameworks
* Auth patterns: SAML, SSO, OAuth 2.0 — secure configuration for OEM and dealership enterprise identity providers
* DevOps: environment management, Git, Copado/Gearset, multi-sandbox deployment pipelines and release management
* Practical fluency: accelerate delivery using AI tools, document architecture, maintain code quality
* Agentforce design: dealer assist agents, connected vehicle chatbots, predictive service recommendations, intelligent recall orchestration
* Collaboration with customers to develop AI performance and business value evaluation frameworks
  

**Certification Pathway & Continuous Learning**  
**Required certification**  
Salesforce Administrator
  
Platform App Builder
  
Platform Developer I
  
Agentforce Specialist
  
Integration Architect
  
Sharing & Visibility Designer
  
  
**Preferred certification :**  
System / Application Architect
  
CRM Analytics Consultant  
  
  
  
**Leadership Qualities & Core Values**  
To navigate high-stakes technical environments and successfully lead automotive enterprises through digital disruption, the Technical Architect must embody specific consulting behaviors that translate technical capability into executive alignment and customer trust.
  
**Core Leadership Pillars**

* **PASSION:** **Customer Success First :** Deep personal investment in transforming complex OEM and dealer implementations into tangible market wins and measurable outcomes for automotive clients and their networks.
* **BEGINNER'S MIND:** **Continuous Learning :** Approaches every engagement with humbleness and curiosity—dismantling assumptions to keep pace with rapid shifts in EV transitions, connected vehicle technology, and consumer expectations.
* **ADAPTABLE:** **Thrives in Uncertainty:** Remains poised, agile, and decisive navigating structural volatility, shifting regulatory landscapes, and market disruption as permanent constants in the automotive sector.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and *be your best* , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can *do your best* . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form .

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Posting Statement

It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. de39403d.description:
**Job Description – Senior Project / Delivery Manager**

**Experience:**

8-10 years

**Type:**

Full-time

**Location:**

Bengaluru, with frequent GCC travel

**About ALP**

Angel Lane Partners (ALP) is a computational finance, data engineering and AI/ML firm with offices in Dubai, London, Bengaluru and Riyadh. We work with banks, financial institutions and government entities across the GCC.

**Role Overview**

You will run ALP's technology implementation engagements at banks and financial institutions, from contract signature through go-live and handover. Engagements include credit and risk platforms, data platforms, calculation and analytics engines, and AI applications, often deployed on the client's own infrastructure. You will manage teams of business analysts, data engineers, developers, quants and AI engineers, and work alongside the client's business, risk and IT teams and any third-party vendors. You will report to ALP partners. This is a hands-on technical role: you will read, review and improve the code your teams write, including core calculation engines, data pipelines and application components.

**Travel**

The role is based in Bengaluru, with frequent travel to client sites in the GCC, sometimes for several weeks at a time. A valid passport is required.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Delivery and governance*

·      Own delivery end to end: mobilisation, requirements, design, build, testing, deployment, hypercare and handover.

·      Set up engagement governance, including steering committee and working group cadence, status reporting, RAID and decision logs, and escalation paths.

·      Build and maintain the integrated plan across workstreams, covering milestones, dependencies, critical path and resourcing.

·      Track effort, cost and margin against budget.

·      Manage scope against the statement of work, assess change requests and their commercial impact, agree acceptance criteria and obtain milestone sign-offs.

·      Coordinate third-party and client-appointed vendors where the solution depends on them.

·      Run lessons-learned reviews and feed them into ALP's delivery methodology.

*Technical implementation*

·      Agree the deployment architecture with ALP architects and client IT, covering on-premise, private cloud or public cloud hosting, environments (DEV, SIT, UAT, PROD), network access and integration points.

·      Plan and track integration with core banking, loan origination, treasury, data warehouse and reporting systems through APIs, file feeds or database interfaces.

·      Take the solution through the bank's IT and security processes, including architecture review, information security assessment, penetration testing, vendor onboarding, change advisory boards and production release approval.

·      Manage data readiness and migration, covering source identification, data quality, reconciliation and parallel runs.

·      Plan test phases (SIT, UAT, performance, security) with entry and exit criteria, and run defect triage.

100347a8.title: Program Manager, AI Data Operations
100347a8.description:
**About AiDASH**

AiDASH is leading the PreventionFirst™movement for electric utilities and transforming grid resilience through its pioneering platform that unifies vegetation, asset, storm, and wildfire intelligence. Powered by SatelliteFirst™ Inspection & Monitoring, AiDASH delivers comprehensive visibility across the entire grid at the right frequency and budget, using the right data modality. More than 200 customers trust AiDASH to keep the lights on, spend where it counts, and defend every decision, Securing Tomorrow across every mile of the grid. Learn more at
www.aidash.com.

The PreventionFirst movement is growing, and so is the recognition behind it. In 2026, Forbes named AiDASH one of America's Best Startup Employers for the 4th consecutive year, and TIME included AiDASH among America's Top GreenTech Companies for the 3rd year in a row.
Deloitte Technology Fast 500
™ ranked AiDASH No. 12 in the San Francisco Bay Area, and No. 59 overall in their selection of the top 500 for 2024.

Join us in Securing Tomorrow Together!

**The Role**

AiDASH is looking for a high-agency Program Manager to help scale our AI Data Ops function: the team responsible for sourcing, processing, and annotating the satellite and remote sensing imagery that powers our AI/ML models.

This role is a new addition to the leadership team, created specifically to bring an
**automation-first, numbers-backed, process-driven**
operating model to how Ops runs . This role is designed to reduce operational complexity over time, not to manage individual queues or projects indefinitely. You will sit at the intersection of strategy, operations, vendor management, and data science delivery, helping AI Data Ops evolve from a fast-scaling function into a well-designed, repeatable operating system.

You will need to zoom in to solve real problems on the ground — a stuck vendor SLA, a high priority escalation, a broken handoff — and zoom out to design the processes, playbooks, and automation that stop the same problems from recurring.

This is a high-visibility, build-from-scratch role: you'll be judged on the systems and habits you install, not just the projects you close.

**How You’ll Make an Impact:**

**Automation & AI-native ways of working**

* Identify repetitive, manual workflows across annotation, QA, imagery processing and reporting, and drive their automation — via internal tooling, scripting, RPA, or AI-assisted workflows.
* Build and own the automation roadmap and drive it seamlessly across the team

**Program & project management**

* Run structured program governance (milestones, RAID logs, status cadence) across cross-functional initiatives that no single manager owns end-to-end.
* Bring discipline — timelines, ownership, dependencies — to all team initiatives

**Cost reduction**

* Own a cost-efficiency roadmap for Ops: vendor spend, tooling spends, rework/error costs, and capacity utilization.
* Build the business case and track savings with real numbers- Clear visible impact

**Vendor performance frameworks**

* Design and own scorecards/SLAs for imagery, annotation and other third-party vendors.
* Run regular vendor performance reviews and own escalation/renewal/replacement decisions in partnership with managers.

**Cross-functional ownership & data ownership**

* Serve as the connective tissue across all managers and leads — surfacing shared problems (tooling, process, vendor etc) that no single manager can fix alone.
* Own org-wide SOP creation and the dashboard/metrics layer (throughput, quality, SLA, utilization) so every manager works off the same numbers.

**Enable leadership with insight and structure**

* Build dashboards/reports tracking throughput, accuracy, vendor performance, and cost efficiency; define KPIs that drive decisions on quality, capacity, and cost
* Manage budgets across data sourcing, annotation ops, and vendor contracts, identifying cost-optimization opportunities
* Translate ambiguous problems into structured, actionable plans

**What We're Looking For:**

* 6+ years of experience spanning program/project management, business operations, or management consulting — ideally with exposure to automation, Ops, vendor management and cost optimization.
* A genuine track record of building metrics/automation programs from scratch — not just running ones someone else designed.
* Comfort with data: you should be able to build and defend a dashboard or a business case yourself, not just commission one.
* Strong written and verbal communication — you'll be the face of Ops in external conversations.
* Experience managing external vendors/partners and negotiating SLAs.
* Bonus: prior exposure to GIS, geospatial, imagery, or annotation-heavy operations; experience standing up automation/RPA/AI tooling programs (This is not mandatory)
* Must-have: hands-on experience working in a startup environment.

We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to embracing diversity and inclusion in our hiring practices, and we promote a work environment where everyone, from any race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin, can do their best work.

We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible interview experience for all candidates. Please let us know if you require any accommodation during the interview process, and we will make every effort to meet your needs.

Read our Privacy Policy here:
https://www.aidash.com/policy/privacy-policy/

5f89cce6.description:
**[ WHO WE ARE]**
Based out of South Korea, KRAFTON, Inc. is committed to discovering and globally publishing games that deliver a uniquely fun experience with global production studios known for distinctive creatives. Founded in 2007, KRAFTON consists of PUBG STUDIOS, Bluehole Studio, RisingWings, Striking Distance Studios, Dreamotion, Unknown Worlds, 5minlab, Neon Giant, KRAFTON Montréal Studio and ReLU Games, each trying to innovate the enjoyment of games through continuously embracing challenges and new technologies, expanding our platforms and services to win the hearts of more fans.
  
  
KRAFTON India has established itself as a trailblazer in the gaming industry, driven by its unwavering commitment to delivering distinctive and enjoyable gaming experiences. At the heart of KRAFTON India's success lies a deep understanding of the Indian gaming community.
  
  
The company takes immense pride in its premier entertainment properties that include highly popular titles like BATTLEGROUNDS MOBILE INDIA (BGMI), Road To Valor: Empires, Defense Derby, New State Mobile. These games have not only captured the hearts of Indian players but have also played a pivotal role in fostering a thriving e-sports ecosystem in the country.
  
  
With a focus on India, KRAFTON is dedicated to nurturing the gaming and start-up ecosystem. In line with this commitment, KRAFTON initiated the KRAFTON India Gaming Incubator (KIGI) in October 2023. KIGI aims to support 6-10 teams annually with program durations ranging from six months to one year. Additionally, KRAFTON India has invested over $150 million in the Indian market in the past two years and has committed an additional $150 million to the Indian start-up ecosystem over the next three years.
  
  
**[About the role]**
We are looking for a Program Manager to drive the successful execution of the KRAFTON India Gaming Incubator (KIGI) program, bringing a strong product design lens to the role. In this role, you will manage the end-to-end operations of one or more incubation cohorts, working closely with game studios and cross-functional teams to ensure milestones, budgets, and deliverables stay on track — while also acting as a hands-on product/design sounding board for incubated studios as they shape their games' UX, onboarding, and player experience. You'll serve as the primary liaison between incubated studios and internal stakeholders, coordinate mentorship and enablement programs, monitor progress, and provide strategic reporting to leadership in India and Korea. This role is ideal for someone with a product design background who also has strong program management instincts, excellent stakeholder management skills, and a passion for supporting game developers and fostering innovation in the gaming ecosystem.
  
  
**[Key Responsibilities]**

* Own end-to-end program operations for one or more KIGI cohorts onboarding, milestone tracking, reporting cadence, and offboarding/graduation
* Serve as the primary point of contact between incubated studios and internal KRAFTON stakeholders (legal, finance, publishing, tech)
* Bring a product design perspective to studio reviews evaluating game UX, onboarding flows, and player experience alongside standard milestone and business metrics
* Track studio progress against milestones, budgets, and deliverables; flag risks early and drive resolution
* Coordinate mentorship sessions, workshops, and masterclasses for incubated teams, including product/UX-focused sessions
* Prepare regular status updates, dashboards, and reports for leadership (India and Korea)
* Support due diligence and evaluation processes for new cohort selection, with particular attention to product design quality and player experience potential
* Manage program documentation agreements, milestone trackers, funding schedules
* Facilitate cross-functional coordination with publishing, UA, and data teams when studios need support
* Help identify and troubleshoot blockers studios face (technical, business, product/design, or operational)
* Contribute to continuous improvement of program structure, evaluation criteria, and processes based on cohort learnings

**[Required Experience]**

* Strong understanding of mobile game development lifecycles, from pre-production through to live operations.
* Proven ability to define and manage product roadmaps, feature prioritization, and backlog management.
* Excellent analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data sets and translate them into actionable product decisions.
* Solid understanding of mobile gaming KPIs including DAU, MAU, retention, LTV, and monetization metrics.
* Strong cross-functional collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across development, marketing, QA, and publishing teams.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Deep understanding of the mobile gaming market, player behaviour, and industry trends.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and project management tools such as Jira or similar platforms.
* Passion for gaming, with a strong understanding of the cricket sports genre being a significant advantage.

**[Preferred Qualifications]**

* 6+ years of experience in Product Management, preferably within the mobile gaming industry.
* Prior experience managing sports or cricket-themed gaming titles is highly desirable.
* Experience working on games from early development stages through to global launch.
* Demonstrated track record of successfully managing multiple products simultaneously.
* Experience with live ops management and seasonal content planning.
* Familiarity with monetization strategies specific to mobile gaming, including in-app purchases and battle pass systems.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Game Design, or a related field; MBA or equivalent is a plus.
* Prior experience working within a publishing environment is an added advantage.

3b342d6a.title: Associate Program Manager

19f08205.title: Sap Delivery Manager
19f08205.description:
**Role Objective**

The Senior SAP Delivery Manager will lead a portfolio of SAP implementation, rollout, migration, and support engagements, with accountability for delivery quality, project profitability, client satisfaction, and team development.

We are looking for an experienced SAP delivery professional with strong ownership, commercial awareness, and the ambition to grow into SAP Business Unit leadership. The role offers opportunities to progressively take on business planning, account growth, and practice development responsibilities based on demonstrated performance and readiness.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. SAP Delivery Management**

* Own end-to-end delivery across assigned SAP engagements, ensuring agreed scope, timelines, quality, and budgets are met.
* Lead project managers, functional leads, and technical leads in planning and executing delivery.
* Establish clear milestones, responsibilities, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.
* Identify delivery risks early, implement mitigation plans, and escalate issues with recommended actions.
* Manage scope changes through impact assessments and appropriate client approvals.
* Drive recovery plans for engagements facing delays, quality concerns, or client dissatisfaction.
* Ensure effective handovers between implementation, hypercare, and support teams.

**2. Project Profitability and Resource Management**

* Own financial performance across the assigned delivery portfolio, including budgets, delivery costs, utilisation, and project margins.
* Review planned versus actual effort, staffing costs, and estimates to complete, taking corrective action when profitability is at risk.
* Manage staffing mix and resource allocation to balance delivery needs, capability development, and cost.
* Plan resource requirements and release dates proactively, assessing available internal talent before requesting external hires.
* Ensure timely timesheet approvals, milestone acceptance, and billing inputs to minimise revenue leakage.
* Partner with Finance and the BU Leader on forecasts and financial reviews.

**3. Client and Stakeholder Management**

* Build trusted relationships with client delivery stakeholders and business owners.
* Lead regular project and service reviews, communicating progress, risks, decisions, and actions clearly.
* Handle escalations with ownership and follow through until resolution.
* Set realistic expectations and address difficult issues promptly.
* Coordinate across clients, sales, delivery teams, and internal functions to resolve dependencies.

**4. Team Leadership and Capability Development**

* Lead, coach, and develop SAP project managers, module leads, and consultants.
* Set clear expectations and hold team members accountable for delivery outcomes.
* Conduct regular performance and development conversations with direct reports.
* Identify skill gaps and create development plans aligned with upcoming project needs.
* Support hiring through technical and delivery assessments.
* Build succession coverage for critical roles and reduce dependence on individual specialists.
* Promote knowledge sharing, collaboration, and consistent delivery practices across teams.

**5. Account Growth and Presales Support**

* Identify opportunities for additional services and improvements within existing client accounts.
* Partner with sales and the BU Leader to qualify and develop these opportunities.
* Contribute to proposals, effort estimates, staffing plans, delivery approaches, and client presentations.
* Validate delivery assumptions, dependencies, risks, and commercial viability before commitments are made.
* Support smooth transitions from sales to delivery.

**6. Delivery Governance and Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain accurate portfolio reporting covering delivery health, financial performance, resource availability, and client concerns.
* Establish a regular review cadence with clear decisions, owners, and follow-up actions.
* Ensure adherence to organisational policies, quality standards, and client commitments.
* Conduct lessons-learned reviews and translate findings into delivery improvements.
* Identify opportunities to improve productivity through reusable assets, automation, and appropriate AI-enabled tools.

**Required Experience and Qualifications**

* Typically 1015 years of overall experience, with substantial experience in SAP delivery and at least 4–6 years leading SAP projects or delivery teams. Candidates with equivalent demonstrated scope and capability will also be considered.
* Proven experience managing multiple SAP engagements, including implementation and support.
* Strong grounding in at least one SAP functional or technical area, with the ability to lead teams across multiple domains.
* Demonstrated ownership of project budgets, resource planning, utilisation, and margins.
* Experience managing client escalations and recovering engagements facing delivery challenges.
* Experience leading project managers, module leads, or multidisciplinary SAP teams.
* Strong communication, negotiation, analytical, and stakeholder management skills.
* A bachelor’s degree in engineering, technology, business, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

**Preferred Experience**

* SAP S/4HANA implementations, conversions, rollouts, or transformation programs.
* SAP ECC and application support or managed services.
* Experience working with global clients and distributed onsite and offshore teams.
* Exposure to SAP Activate, delivery estimation, proposal development, and account expansion.
* Relevant SAP or project management certifications.

**Leadership Qualities**

* Takes responsibility for outcomes and follows through on commitments.
* Identifies risks early and brings practical recommendations.
* Makes decisions with an understanding of client needs, team capacity, and business economics.
* Addresses disagreements and performance concerns constructively.
* Develops others and delegates with clear accountability.
* Seeks feedback and demonstrates readiness to take on broader business responsibility.

**Success Measures**

* Predictable delivery against agreed milestones, scope, quality standards, and service commitments.
* Achievement of project margin and utilisation targets.
* Accurate delivery and financial forecasts, with early visibility of risks.
* Timely billing inputs and control of unapproved scope or effort.
* Client satisfaction, retention, and effective escalation resolution.
* Development of team capability and stronger leadership coverage.
* Contribution to account expansion and delivery improvements.

**Growth Opportunity**

This role provides a progression path toward SAP Delivery Head or SAP Business Unit Leader. Broader responsibilities may include BU financial planning, executive client relationships, revenue growth, and practice strategy as the individual demonstrates readiness and business opportunities arise.

2075612a.title: Senior Manager- Demo & Solutions Consultant
2075612a.description:
**About Beroe And MAX**
Beroe is a procurement intelligence company. Global enterprises rely on our market, supplier and category insight to make better sourcing decisions.
  
  
MAX is Beroe’s AI-powered decision engine for procurement, built in partnership with Kearney. It turns market signals, supplier risk and spend data into recommendations that CPOs and category leaders can act on.
  
  
**Role purpose**
You’ll be the hands-on demo specialist for MAX in APAC and Europe. You will deliver sharp, client-specific demonstrations to senior procurement and supply chain leaders, and you’ll build the collateral that makes those demos land.
  
  
You’ll work under the direction of the Presales & Solutions lead. Your job is to make every client conversation look polished, relevant and credible.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Demonstrations**

* Deliver MAX demos to CPOs, CFOs, heads of category and supply chain leaders at enterprise accounts across APAC and Europe
* Tailor each demo to the client’s categories, spend profile, regional context and business priorities, using discovery notes from the account team
* Tie each demo to a clear value story (savings, risk reduction, speed to decision) and agree a concrete next step with the account executive
* Handle client questions on product, data and integration with confidence. Build a working understanding of AI and security topics (e.g., how MAX models work, data handling, access controls) so you can respond credibly, and escalate deeper technical questions to Product or the Director

**Collateral and demo assets**

* Build and maintain client-facing materials: tailored demo decks, one-pagers, use-case stories, ROI and business-case templates, and leave-behinds
* Create demo scripts and storylines by industry (e.g., pharma, chemicals, food & beverage, CPG), following the narrative standards set by the Director
* Work with Product to keep demo environments, sample data and sandboxes current and realistic
* Keep a clean, versioned library of assets that account teams can reuse

**Deal and event support**

* Support account executives with pre-demo preparation and follow-up materials
* Contribute to RFP and RFI responses on MAX (a regular part of the role, though not its core focus)
* Contribute to pilot design and success criteria, and help prepare pilot results readouts
* Represent MAX at industry events, client workshops and joint sessions with Kearney
* Capture client reactions and objections after each demo and share them with the Director, Product and Marketing

**Qualifications**
**Must-have**

* 10+ years in B2B software, consulting or procurement/supply chain, including 3+ years in presales, solution consulting, product specialist or demo roles
* Proven ability to deliver polished, client-specific demos to senior business audiences
* Working knowledge of procurement, sourcing or supply chain, from practice, consulting or selling into those functions
* Strong storytelling and visual communication skills, with a track record of building high-quality decks and collateral
* Comfort explaining AI and analytics platforms in plain business terms, or the curiosity and ability to build that quickly
* Excellent written and spoken English, and experience working with clients across multiple cultures and regions

**Nice-to-have**

* Background in procurement tech (e.g., Coupa, SAP Ariba, Jaggaer) or procurement intelligence
* Consulting experience in operations or procurement
* Industry exposure to pharma/life sciences/chemicals or CPG

**Minimum qualifications:**

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience in a customer-facing technical role, delivering product and solution briefings, partnering with security leaders and technical teams, and optimizing for production results.
* Understanding of the impact of AI on both offensive and defensive security strategies, including how AI can be leveraged to exploit binaries and firmware as source code.
* Familiarity with platforms for deploying and managing security agents or AI models for security applications, particularly in code analysis and remediation workflows.

**About The Job**
When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem-solving key technical issues for our customers. You liaise with the product marketing management and engineering teams to stay on top of industry trends and devise enhancements to Google Cloud products.
  
  
As a Customer Engineer, you will help grow our cyber security business by building and expanding relationships with new and existing customers. You will be a trusted advisor to customers and an advocate for our security solutions. You will provide support to C-level, security leaders, cloud security architects and security analysts, using both technical and business skill sets to lead projects forward. You will accompany customers in discovering the technology/solution and consult around the best way to secure and ensure compliance. You will optimize for results when in production, leading with empathy, while identifying innovative ways to multiply the impact of the team.
  
  
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Work with the team to identify and qualify business opportunities, understand customer technical objections, and develop the strategy to resolve technical blockers.
* Work directly with customers to demonstrate and prototype Google Cloud product integrations in customer/partner environments.
* Recommend integration strategies, enterprise architectures, platforms, and application infrastructure required to complete solutions using best practices on Google Cloud.
* Share security experience to support the technical relationship with customers, including product and solution briefings and proof-of-concept work, partnering with product management to prioritize solutions impacting customer engagement with Google Cloud.
* Support customer-facing presentations and conduct workshops to share the experience and be a subject matter expert on cyber security.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

77f48500.title: Technical Account Manager, ES - INDIA
77f48500.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.  
  
Amazon has built a global reputation for being the most customer-centric company, a company that customers from all over the world recognize, value, and trust for both our products and services. Amazon has a fast-paced environment where we “Work Hard, Have Fun and Make History.”  
  
As an increasing number of enterprises move their critical systems to the cloud, AWS India is in need of highly efficient technical consulting talent to help our largest and strategically important customers navigate the operational challenges and complexities of AWS Cloud. We are looking for Technical Consultants to support our customers creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Data Analytics, Application services, Networking, Server-less and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor for organizations ranging from start-ups to large enterprises.  
  
As a Technical Account Manager, you will be the primary technical point of contact for one or more customers helping to plan, debug, and oversee ongoing operations of business-critical applications. You will get your hands dirty, troubleshooting application, network, database, and architectural challenges using a suite of internal AWS Cloud tools as well as your existing knowledge and toolkits. We are seeking individuals with strong backgrounds in I.T. Consulting and in any of these related areas such as Solution Designing, Application and System Development, Database Management, Big Data and Analytics, DevOps Consulting, and Media technologies. Knowledge of programming and scripting is beneficial to the role.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Every day will bring new and exciting challenges on the job while you:  
  

* Learn and use Cloud technologies.
* Interact with leading technologists around the world.
* Work on critical, highly complex customer problems that may span multiple AWS Cloud services.
* Apply advanced troubleshooting techniques to provide unique solutions to our customers' individual needs.
* Work directly with AWS Cloud subject matter experts to help reproduce and resolve customer issues.
* Write tutorials, how-to videos, and other technical articles for the customer community.
* Leverage your extensive customer support experience and provide feedback to internal AISPL teams on how to improve our services.
* Drive projects that improve support-related processes and our customers’ technical support experience.
* Assist in Design/Architecture of AWS and Hybrid cloud solutions.
* Help Enterprises define IT and business processes that work well with cloud deployments.
* Be available outside of business hours to help coordinate the handling of urgent issues as needed.

  
About the team  
Diverse Experiences  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  
  
Why AWS?  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Inclusive Team Culture  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.  
  
Work/Life Balance  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree
* 3+ years of technical engineering experience
* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
* Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, engineering, analytics, mathematics, statistics, IT or equivalent, or Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
* 7+ years of hands-on infrastructure, troubleshooting, systems administration, networking, DevOps or applications development experience
* Experience in external enterprise customer-facing role as a technical lead, with strong oral and written communication skills, presenting to both large and small audiences
* Experience managing multiple projects, prioritizing, planning, and managing time
* Be mobile and travel to client locations as needed.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Experience in internal enterprise or external customer-facing environment as a technical lead

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

**Company Description**

**Work with Us. Change the World.**

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

We are seeking a talented and experienced Architect to join our Buildings + Places (B+P) team. The role involves developing innovative, sustainable, and high-quality architectural solutions while managing projects through all design and delivery phases. The successful candidate will combine strong design capabilities with technical expertise and project coordination skills to ensure the successful execution of complex building projects.

**Key Responsibilities**

Design & Project Delivery

* Develop architectural concepts, schematic designs, detailed designs, and construction documentation.
* Deliver high-quality architectural solutions that meet client objectives, technical requirements, and regulatory standards.
* Prepare design presentations, reports, specifications, and technical documentation.
* Ensure adherence to project budgets, timelines, and quality standards.

Project Management & Coordination

* Manage project deliverables from concept through construction administration.
* Conduct design reviews and resolve technical issues during project execution.
* Monitor project progress and proactively mitigate design and delivery risks.

Client & Stakeholder Engagement

* Interface with clients, contractors, consultants, and authorities throughout the project lifecycle.
* Participate in client meetings, workshops, and presentations.
* Support business development activities including proposal preparation and project pursuits.

Technical Excellence

* Ensure compliance with local building codes, regulations, and industry standards.
* Review drawings and specifications for quality, accuracy, and constructability.
* Incorporate sustainable design principles and innovative technologies into project solutions.
* Stay updated with emerging architectural trends, materials, and digital delivery tools.

  
**Qualifications**

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's Degree in Architecture (B.Arch.).
* Master's Degree in Architecture is preferred.
* Registered Architect with relevant professional body/council registration.
* 10-15 years of architectural design and project delivery experience (depending on grade level).

  
**Additional Information**

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.***

**About AECOM**

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

**What makes AECOM a great place to work**

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community - where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

9cb51989.description:
**FICO (NYSE: FICO)**
is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100+ countries make better decisions. Join our world-class team today and fulfill your career potential!
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Work with existing and new customers to understand their key initiatives in Consumer Lending and Retail Banking across Marketing, Originations, Customer Management, Personalization, Collections and Fraud. Uncover and discover ways for the FICO Platform to help our customers rapidly develop, deploy, and manage analytics & strategies across the lifecycle that deliver optimal results within articulated constraints. With more than 60 years of stable growth, FICOs world-class Software solutions support smarter decisions for thousands of businesses worldwide. As a Platform Sales - Sr Partner you'll be responsible for educating our customers about the enormous opportunity of empowering business users to leverage the FICO Platform as the ‘brain and central nervous system’ for mission critical decisions that unlock human and analytic capital permitting our customers to achieve their unique potential.
  
  
**What You’ll Contribute**

* Share expertise and thought leadership in Decisioning, Analytics, & Optimization within Financial Services with the goal of helping our clients leapfrog the competition leveraging FICO’s cutting-edge Platform.
* Build relationships with senior client stakeholders in Business and Technology to gain insights into their most urgent decision management related problems while articulating FICO’s platform capabilities.
* Research and shape potential solution opportunities through collaborative engagement with internal Key Account Managers, Pre-Sales Domain Experts and Pre-Sales Architects to formulate and effectively position solution proposals.
* Ensure clients are delighted with solutions purchased to create win-win relationships that are long-term, expanding, and profitable.
* Collaborate across internal FICO teams including Global Solution Architecture, Product Development, Finance and Professional Services to shape a cohesive sales effort that educates our customers on the tremendous business value the FICO Platform delivers.
* Work with the largest and most advanced Financial Institutions in South East Asia as well as a core set of leaders in the Fintech, Telecommunications, Media, and Entertainment industries.
* Manage sales to quarterly and annual targets, with significant earnings upside when targets are exceeded.

**What We’re Seeking**

* Bachelor’s degree and, or experience developed in work environments.
* Strong track record building relationships and a knack for understanding the client’s industry and business/technology challenges.
* Demonstrated success structuring and selling complex, enterprise software solutions to large clients in financial services/banking a plus.
* Knowledge or experience in Consumer Lending, Credit Risk, Account Management, Retail Banking and Fraud is also a plus.
* Have a deep interest in, and or experience in both the technical and business use of data, behavioral profiles, decision management, orchestration, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Simulation, and Optimization in SaaS offerings.
* Techno-Functional expertise preferred
* A Passion to learn and educate customers and FICO colleagues through presentations, and conversations. Strong soft skills, and a genuine interest in people and a desire to help them be wildly successful.
* A Passion to work hard under tight deadlines and a pension for thriving in high pressure situations.
* A Collaborative style of working where the strengths of teammates are celebrated and the whole team is greater than the sum of its players.
* Ability to travel up to 50% of business week as we need to know our customers and their aspirations intimately to truly make difference

**Our Offer to You**

* An inclusive culture strongly reflecting our core values: Act Like an Owner, Delight Our Customers and Earn the Respect of Others.
* The opportunity to make an impact and develop professionally by leveraging your unique strengths and participating in valuable learning experiences.
* Highly competitive compensation, benefits and rewards programs that encourage you to bring your best every day and be recognized for doing so.
* An engaging, people-first work environment offering work/life balance, employee resource groups, and social events to promote interaction and camaraderie.

**Why Make a Move to FICO?**
At FICO, you can develop your career with a leading organization in one of the fastest-growing fields in technology today – Big Data analytics. You’ll play a part in our commitment to help businesses use data to improve every choice they make, using advances in artificial intelligence, machine learning, optimization, and much more.
  
  
FICO makes a real difference in the way businesses operate worldwide:
  
  

* Credit Scoring — FICO® Scores are used by 90 of the top 100 US lenders.
* Fraud Detection and Security — 4 billion payment cards globally are protected by FICO fraud systems.
* Lending — 3/4 of US mortgages are approved using the FICO Score.

Global trends toward digital transformation have created tremendous demand for FICO’s solutions, placing us among the world’s top 100 software companies by revenue. We help many of the world’s largest banks, insurers, retailers, telecommunications providers and other firms reach a new level of success. Our success is dependent on really talented people – just like you – who thrive on the collaboration and innovation that’s nurtured by a diverse and inclusive environment. We’ll provide the support you need, while ensuring you have the freedom to develop your skills and grow your career. Join FICO and help change the way business thinks!
  
  
Learn more about how you can fulfil your potential at www.fico.com/Careers
  
  
FICO promotes a culture of inclusion and seeks to attract a diverse set of candidates for each job opportunity. We are an equal employment opportunity employer and we’re proud to offer employment and advancement opportunities to all candidates without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. Research has shown that women and candidates from underrepresented communities may not apply for an opportunity if they don’t meet all stated qualifications. While our qualifications are clearly related to role success, each candidate’s profile is unique and strengths in certain skill and/or experience areas can be equally effective. If you believe you have many, but not necessarily all, of the stated qualifications we encourage you to apply.
  
  
Information submitted with your application is subject to the FICO Privacy policy at https://www.fico.com/en/privacy-policy

**Overview**
Are you insatiably curious, deeply passionate about the realm of databases and analytics, and ready to tackle complex challenges in a dynamic environment in the era of Agentic AI? If so, we invite you to join our team as Digital Cloud & AI Data Solution Engineer for mid-market customers at Microsoft. Here, you'll be at the forefront of cutting-edge projects that leverage the latest technologies to drive meaningful impact. Join us and be part of a team that thrives on collaboration, creativity, and continuous learning.
  
  
In this technical sales role, you'll be at the forefront of cutting-edge projects that leverage the latest technologies to drive meaningful impact. Join us and be part of a team that thrives on collaboration, creativity, and continuous learning.
  
  
Databases & Analytics is a growth opportunity for Microsoft Azure, as well as its partners and customers. These technologies empower customers to build, deploy, and manage database and analytics solutions in the age of Frontier AI.
  
  
At Small Medium Enterprises and Channel (SME&C), we are leading a high-growth, AI-powered global sales team—one that is deeply connected to our partners and driven by customer success. By uniting our Small Medium Business, Corporate, Strategy, and Partner teams, we are unlocking the largest customer opportunity, backed by the industry’s most significant investments. Leveraging the power of AI and our extensive partner ecosystem, we are redefining how businesses of all sizes adopt technology to drive growth.
  
  
SME&C is more than a sales organization—it’s a culture of opportunity, and inclusivity. Here, you’ll be part of a diverse, high-performing, and customer-obsessed team where collaboration, connection, and continuous learning fuel everything we do.
  
  
If you thrive in a fast-paced, digital-first environment and are eager to make a meaningful impact, explore how SME&C can be the next step in your career. Together, we are shaping the future of business.
  
  
As a Data Platform Digital Solution Engineer (DSE), you will play a pivotal role in helping enterprises unlock the full potential of Microsoft’s cloud database and analytics stack across every stage of deployment. You will work directly with technical and business stakeholders to design secure, scalable, and resilient database and analytics architectures that support business-critical applications and Frontier AI transformation. As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll guide customers and win their technical decisions on Azure for their database and analytics deployment.
