268d62b1.description:
**Job Title :SAP Joule / AI Solution Engineer**

**Location : Remote**

**Employment : Fulltime with VDart Digital**

**Key Responsibilities:**

•
**SAP AI Architecture & Roadmap:**
Define and establish the overall SAP Joule and SAP AI architecture strategy. Develop and maintain a comprehensive implementation roadmap that aligns AI capabilities with business priorities and technical requirements across the SAP landscape.

•
**SAP Joule Implementation Leadership:**
Lead the end-to-end implementation, configuration, and enablement of SAP Joule within the organization's SAP environment. Ensure successful deployment of Joule capabilities across different user personas and business use cases.

•
**Custom Joule Agents & Use Cases:**
Design, develop, and implement custom Joule Agents tailored to specific business processes and organizational requirements. Create AI-powered use cases that deliver measurable business value, ranging from simple automation to complex, multi-step workflow intelligence.

•
**Joule Studio & SAP Build Configuration:**
Configure and optimize SAP Joule Studio and SAP Build environments for skills development and agent creation. Establish best practices for low-code/no-code AI development within the organization.

•
**Joule for Developers (J4D) Enablement:**
Enable and support Joule for Developers capabilities, including ABAP AI features for code generation, explanation, and testing. Configure connections to Eclipse ADT and Visual Studio Code for seamless developer tooling integration. Train development teams on leveraging AI-assisted development capabilities.

**• AI Agent Optimization:**
Develop expertise in leveraging existing SAP AI Agents, features, and pre-built skills. Understand how to customize and extend standard capabilities to meet specific business requirements.

•
**AI Unit Consumption Management:**
Establish methods to quantify and monitor AI Unit Consumption across all Joule implementations. Develop optimization strategies to ensure efficient usage and avoid excessive consumption costs. Implement monitoring and alerting for consumption thresholds.

•
**Custom AI Solution Development:**
Develop and customize SAP AI solutions using appropriate technical components including SAP APIs, OData services, SAP BTP services, and various SAP integration technologies. Ensure solutions follow SAP best practices and architectural patterns.

•
**Microsoft 365 & Copilot Integration:**
Support integration scenarios between SAP Joule and Microsoft 365, Microsoft Copilot, and Microsoft Teams where applicable. Design hybrid AI solutions that span SAP and Microsoft ecosystems.

•
**Model Context Protocol (MCP) Integration:**
Implement and support integration patterns involving MCP (Model Context Protocol) for advanced agent communication and interoperability scenarios.

•
**Security & Governance Framework:**
Establish comprehensive security controls, authorization models, data privacy safeguards, AI governance policies, and consumption management frameworks for all SAP AI implementations. Ensure compliance with enterprise security standards and regulatory requirements.

•
**Cross-Functional Collaboration:**
Work closely with SAP Platform teams, BASIS administrators, Security teams, BTP architects, development teams, and functional consultants to successfully move AI use cases from development through production deployment. Coordinate across multiple technical domains to ensure seamless integration.

•
**Technical Troubleshooting:**
Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues related to Joule configuration, BTP integration, AI service connectivity, and cross-platform integration challenges. Provide expert-level support for production AI solutions.

•
**Documentation & Knowledge Transfer:**
Create comprehensive technical documentation including architecture diagrams, configuration guides, integration specifications, and operational procedures. Establish configuration standards and best practices. Provide knowledge transfer sessions to build internal team capabilities.

Requirements

**Experience:**

• 8+ years of SAP experience with strong recent hands-on experience in SAP BTP and S/4HANA environments

• Proven hands-on SAP Joule implementation experience (this is mandatoryâ€”not theoretical knowledge)

• Direct experience implementing or configuring SAP Joule for Developers (J4D) including ABAP AI capabilities

• Experience with Joule Studio and creation of custom Joule agents and skills

• Strong SAP BTP architecture experience including service provisioning, destinations, connectivity, and multi-cloud scenarios

• Hands-on experience with SAP Build, SAP AI Core, and Generative AI Hub for developing AI-powered solutions

• Deep expertise in SAP APIs, OData services, and BTP destination configuration

• Strong knowledge of S/4HANA integration patterns and SAP security/identity architecture

• Understanding of IAS/IPS (Identity Authentication/Provisioning Service), OAuth protocols, Cloud Connector, and BTP security models

• Working knowledge of ABAP programming and SAP development architecture to effectively support developer-focused AI capabilities

• Experience designing and implementing enterprise Generative AI and Large Language Model (LLM) solutions

• Understanding of RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), grounding techniques, prompt engineering, and agentic AI architecture patterns

• Proven track record of taking SAP AI solutions from POC/pilot phase through full production deployment including post-go-live support

**Preferred Experience:**

• Experience with SAP Cloud ALM and AI-assisted operations/monitoring capabilities

• Implementation of SAP operational AI and intelligent monitoring use cases

• Knowledge of Microsoft Azure AI services and Azure OpenAI integration patterns

• Experience integrating SAP solutions with Microsoft Copilot and Microsoft 365 ecosystem

• Implementation of MCP (Model Context Protocol)-based agent integrations

• Deep understanding of SAP security and compliance requirements in large global enterprises

• Experience working with SAP RISE and S/4HANA Private Cloud deployment models

• Familiarity with SAP Business AI and industry-specific AI use cases

• Experience with vector databases and semantic search implementations

**Technical Skills:**

• Expert-level proficiency in SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform)

• Advanced knowledge of SAP Joule architecture and configuration

• Strong understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, and prompt engineering

• SAP integration technologies (APIs, OData, RFC, Web Services)

• SAP security frameworks and identity management

• Cloud architecture patterns and microservices design

• ABAP programming and SAP development tools (Eclipse ADT, Visual Studio Code extensions)

• AI governance, monitoring, and cost optimization strategies

**Education:**

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or related technical field

• SAP certifications in BTP, S/4HANA, or AI-related technologies are highly valued

c08b66d1.title: Senior Solutions Architect, Agentic AI - Public Sector
c08b66d1.description:
NVIDIA is seeking a dynamic and experienced Generative AI Solution Architect with specialized expertise in training Large Language Models (LLMs) and Agentic AI . As a key member of our AI Solutions team, you will play a pivotal role in architecting and delivering cutting-edge solutions that leverage the power of NVIDIA's generative AI technologies. This position requires a deep understanding of language models, particularly LLMs, and a strong proficiency in designing and implementing agentic and RAG-based workflows.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**

* Architect end-to-end generative AI solutions with a focus on LLMs, Agentic and RAG workflows.
* Collaborate closely with customers to understand their language-related business challenges and design tailored solutions.
* Collaborate with sales and business development teams to support pre-sales activities, including technical presentations and demonstrations of LLM and RAG capabilities.
* Work closely with NVIDIA engineering teams to provide feedback and contribute to the evolution of generative AI technologies.
* Engage directly with customers to understand their language-related requirements and challenges.
* Lead workshops and design sessions to define and refine generative AI solutions focused on LLMs and RAG workflows and lead the training and optimization of Large Language Models using NVIDIA’s hardware and software platforms.
* Implement strategies for efficient and effective training of LLMs to achieve optimal performance.
* Design and implement RAG-based workflows to enhance content generation and information retrieval.
* Work closely with customers to integrate RAG workflows into their applications and systems and stay abreast of the latest developments in language models and generative AI technologies.
* Provide technical leadership and guidance on best practices for training LLMs and implementing RAG-based solutions.
* Collaborating and working with Government, Research and Public sector departments

**What We Need To See**

* B.Tech ,Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or equivalent experience
* 10+ years of hands-on experience in a technical role, specifically focusing on generative AI, with a strong emphasis on training Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Proven track record of successfully deploying and optimizing LLM models for inference in production environments.
* In-depth understanding of state-of-the-art language models, including but not limited to GPT-3, BERT, or similar architectures.
* Expertise in training and fine-tuning LLMs using popular frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Hugging Face Transformers.
* Proficiency in model deployment and optimization techniques for efficient inference on various hardware platforms, with a focus on GPUs.
* Strong knowledge of GPU cluster architecture and the ability to leverage parallel processing for accelerated model training and inference.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience leading workshops, training sessions, and presenting technical solutions to diverse audiences.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Proven ability to optimize LLM models for inference speed, memory efficiency, and resource utilization.
* Familiarity with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker) and orchestration tools (e.g., Kubernetes) for scalable and efficient model deployment.
* Deep understanding of GPU cluster architecture, parallel computing, and distributed computing concepts.
* Hands-on experience with NVIDIA GPU technologies, and GPU cluster management and ability to design and implement scalable and efficient workflows for LLM training and inference on GPU clusters

With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, we are widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our exclusive engineering teams are rapidly growing. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with a real passion for technology, we want to hear from you!
  
  
NVIDIA is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.
  
  
, , JR2026267

4d56ea88.description:
**We are Siemens**

  

Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our software.

Siemens Digital Industries Software is looking for a Software Engineer - Advanced to design and develop scalable application frameworks and reusable software components that form the foundation of high-quality engineering software products.

  

You will work at the core framework and architecture layer, solving complex software engineering problems involving large datasets, performance, memory management, scalability, reliability, and cross-platform development.

  

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys building reusable technology and solving challenging problems through strong software design and engineering fundamentals.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and develop core frameworks: Build scalable, reusable, and maintainable C++ components and application frameworks that enable product teams to deliver robust software efficiently.
* Solve complex software problems: Apply strong algorithms, data structures, and object-oriented design to address challenging problems involving large datasets, memory, performance, and scalability.
* Build high-quality cross-platform software: Develop and maintain software for Windows and Linux platforms with a focus on reliability, maintainability, and consistent product behavior.
* Apply modern C++ engineering: Use modern C++ standards, STL, Boost, design patterns, and sound software architecture principles to develop production-quality components.
* Drive software quality: Design for testability, troubleshoot complex issues, participate in code reviews, and ensure functional quality across supported platforms and product releases.
* Collaborate across engineering teams: Work with architects, developers, product teams, and other stakeholders to understand complex requirements and deliver effective technical solutions.
* Continuously improve the technology: Refactor and evolve existing frameworks, improve performance and maintainability, and contribute to engineering best practices and technical innovation.

  

**Qualifications**

* Bachelors or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 5+ years of professional software development experience on Windows and/or Linux platforms.
* Strong hands-on expertise in modern C++, including C++11/14/17, STL, and object-oriented programming.
* Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and computational problem-solving.
* Strong experience with object-oriented analysis and design (OOAD) and software design principles.
* Experience designing and developing reusable software components, frameworks, or libraries for complex applications.
* Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills with the ability to understand and resolve complex technical problems.

  

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with Qt/C++ and desktop application frameworks.
* Experience with Python for scripting, automation, tooling, or application development.
* Experience with Tcl/Tk or similar scripting technologies.
* Experience with Git/GitLab, Jira, Confluence, and modern software development practices.
* Experience with performance optimization, memory management, profiling, or large-scale data processing.
* Experience developing CAD, CAM, CAE, PLM, or PDM software applications.
* Experience working in Agile development environments and contributing to technical design and code reviews.

844a452d.title: Digital Cloud Solution Architecture IC5
844a452d.description:
**Overview**
At
**Small Medium Enterprises and Channel (SME&C)**
, we are leading a high-growth, AI-powered global sales team, one that is deeply connected to our partners and driven by customer success. By uniting our Small Medium Business, Corporate, Strategy, and Partner teams, we are unlocking the largest customer opportunity, backed by the industry’s most significant investments. Leveraging the power of AI and our extensive partner ecosystem, we are redefining how businesses of all sizes adopt technology to drive growth and innovation. SME&C is more than a sales organization, it’s a culture of innovation, opportunity, and inclusivity.
  
  
Here, you’ll be part of a diverse, high-performing, and customer-obsessed team where collaboration, connection, and continuous learning fuel everything we do. If you thrive in a fast-paced, digital-first environment and are eager to make a meaningful impact, explore how SME&C can be the next step in your career. Together, we are shaping the future of business.
  
  
Do you thrive in the room where business strategy meets technology, equally at home challenging a CxO on their AI transformation ambition, going broad with an architect, or getting deep with an engineer on what needs to be built?
  
  
As a
**Senior Digital Cloud Solution Architect (DCSA)**
, you will lead customer AI transformation by conducting Frontier and customer conversations, translating business priorities into secure, scalable AI, data, and cloud outcomes while accelerating adoption, consumption, and measurable business value. You will serve as a senior technical leader for a strategic portfolio of Microsoft customers, helping them translate business priorities into secure, scalable, AI-ready cloud solutions. With the support of best-in-class sales processes, techniques, and technologies, you will influence customer decision makers, shape technical strategy, and orchestrate Microsoft and partner resources to accelerate adoption and business value realization. You will be accountable for driving durable cloud consumption growth, identifying expansion opportunities, removing technical blockers, and building trusted customer relationships that position Microsoft as a long-term strategic partner. While the role is India based, you will be expected to drive impact across Asia and worldwide, scaling repeatable practice and influencing beyond your own territory and region.
  
  
This role is flexible in that you can work up to 50% from home / 50% from a designated Microsoft office.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* You will drive Frontier Transformation by helping customers identify, prioritize, and realize AI and agentic use cases through consultative engagement and technical leadership.
* You will lead complex customer engagements across a strategic portfolio, owning technical strategy, customer success outcomes, and repeatable achievement of net new revenue and consumption targets.
* You will use deep customer, industry, and cloud architecture insights to shape modernization roadmaps and influence executive and technical stakeholders, expanding adoption of Microsoft Cloud and AI solutions.
* You will architect and validate scalable, secure, and resilient solutions from design through deployment and ongoing value realization, leading architectural design sessions that align Microsoft, partner, and customer teams.
* You will analyze usage, business priorities, technical blockers, and competitive dynamics to identify growth opportunities, drive optimization, and accelerate cloud consumption.
* You will lead and orchestrate across DCSAs, sales specialists, customer success teams, engineering, and partners to remove blockers, and proactively manage progress, risks, and forecasts in CRM.

**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 6+ years experience in technical architect, technical consulting, design and implementation, and/or technical sales; OR

00825bdb.title: Solution Architect
00825bdb.description:
**Company Description**
Join the leader in global work. Vialto helps leading organizations identify, develop, and execute their workforce priorities with confidence. Our practice areas include global tax, immigration, rewards, advisory and Vialto private and our team is the gold standard in navigating the complexities of cross-border compliance, and workforce strategies. We look for people our clients and assignees can count on to thoughtfully deliver clear solutions to complex problems.
  
  
To be the best in the business, we cultivate a dynamic, highly collaborative culture that fuels the growth of our people. We invite you to inquire boldly, learn deeply, and grow endlessly with us. You’ll work alongside recognized experts, shaping people-first, technology-driven solutions that drive the future of work. We help our clients achieve their goals and imagine new possibilities. And we can do the same for you. Whatever your aspirations, Vialto can help you find your way.
  
  
**Job Description**
We are hiring a hands-on Solutions Architect to design, build, and operate complex, regulated, global solutions across payroll, tax, and immigration domains. This role is technical-first: you will own the end-to-end architecture for a product or suite of products and contribute directly to implementation (spikes, reference services, critical-path features), while partnering with a global, cross-functional team to drive delivery, deployments, and production support across time zones. You will also lead the adoption of AI-powered development practices—including spec-driven development and agentic coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex)—and design AI-enabled solutions using Azure OpenAI APIs and intelligent agents to automate business process flows.
  
  
**What You’ll Do (Hands-On)**

* Architecture + Build: Produce architecture designs and implement key components (reference implementations, platform libraries, integration adapters, critical workflows).
* Distributed Systems: Design and build event-driven services (messaging, async workflows, idempotency, retries, backpressure, eventual consistency), including well-defined event contracts and versioning strategies.
* Azure Solution Design: Build using Azure PaaS services and patterns (identity, networking, storage, messaging, API management, monitoring), with practical tradeoffs across cost, scalability, resilience, and latency. Design and integrate AI capabilities using Azure OpenAI APIs (GPT, embeddings, assistants) to enable intelligent features and agent-driven automation within business process flows.
* Front-End Architecture: Architect and ship large Next.js/React applications (routing, state strategy, data-fetching patterns, performance, accessibility, modularization, micro-frontend considerations where relevant).
* Integration Architecture: Define secure integration patterns (REST and event-based), build connectors/adapters, and establish operational runbooks for partner/client integrations.
* Security by Design: Implement secure SDLC practices—threat modeling, secrets management, encryption, least-privilege access, audit logging, and secure defaults aligned to regulated environments.
* Authentication & Authorization: Implement end-to-end authn/authz using OAuth2/OIDC, SSO, and token-based access. Design RBAC/ABAC/ReBAC, tenant-aware authorization, API scopes/claims, and service-to-service identity (e.g., managed identities).
* Operational Readiness: Own observability and reliability patterns (structured logging, metrics, tracing, SLOs, alerting, incident response) and participate in troubleshooting production issues.
* Documentation that Ships: Create actionable architecture artifacts (ADRs, sequence diagrams, domain flows, deployment diagrams, runbooks) that teams can execute against.
* AI Agent Design; Process Automation: Design, build, and deploy AI agents that automate business process flows—using Azure OpenAI APIs, function calling, orchestration frameworks, and RAG pipelines—with appropriate guardrails, evaluation, and human-in-the-loop controls for regulated environments.
* Technical Leadership: Drive peer architecture/code reviews, coach engineers, and raise engineering standards across onshore/offshore teams. Lead and mentor teams in agentic development practices—spec-driven workflows, AI-assisted coding (Claude Code, Codex), and automated test/review generation—to accelerate delivery velocity while maintaining quality and governance.

**Patterns We Expect You to Use**

* Event-based systems (pub/sub, workflow orchestration, event sourcing where appropriate)
* Distributed systems (partitioning, resiliency, failure-mode design, consistency tradeoffs)
* Domain-driven integration approaches (bounded contexts, contracts, anti-corruption layers)
* Agentic AI patterns including plan/execute/verify loops, tool/function calling, RAG, verifier/critic steps, guardrails, evaluation, and agent observability/auditability. Experience applying these patterns to automate business process flows using Azure OpenAI APIs and orchestration frameworks.

**AI-Enabled Delivery Expectations**

* Experience working in environments using AI for development, build, and operations (coding assistants such as Claude Code and Codex, automated PR reviews, test generation, incident support).
* Comfortable using a spec-driven AI development workflow: translating requirements into structured specs, acceptance criteria, diagrams, and prompts that accelerate delivery while maintaining governance. Ability to lead teams in adopting agentic development practices—spec-driven development, AI-assisted coding, and agent-based automation—as standard ways of working.

**Required Qualifications**

* 10+ years in software engineering, including 3+ years in architecture/solution design (or equivalent scope).
* Proven experience designing and operating solutions in a regulated global environment (privacy, auditability, security controls, cross-border considerations).
* Strong Azure experience designing and building cloud-native solutions using Microsoft PaaS and frameworks, including Azure OpenAI APIs for AI-enabled features and agent-based automation.
* Strong experience architecting Next.js and/or React applications at scale.
* Demonstrated experience with event-driven and distributed system design and production operations.
* Hands-on experience with agentic development tools and practices (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, spec-driven development) and a track record of leading engineering teams in AI-assisted delivery workflows.
* Strong communication skills: can explain tradeoffs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with enterprise integrations (HRIS, payroll providers, finance systems) and/or iPaaS patterns.
* Strong testing and automation mindset (TDD/BDD, CI/CD quality gates).
* Experience with data modeling, SQL, and reporting/analytics.
* Microsoft certifications (Azure Solutions Architect or similar) a plus.
* Experience designing AI agents to automate business process flows (e.g., using Azure OpenAI Assistants API, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or similar orchestration frameworks).
* Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree preferred.

**Additional Information**

* This job is based in our Bangalore office, with the possibility of a hybrid work mode
* We are an equal opportunity employer that does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected status
* Please note that AI is used as part of the application process

6b850cc8.title: Solutions Architect
6b850cc8.description:
**Role Purpose**

As a Solution Architect, you will lead the architecture and solution design of large-scale technology initiatives spanning multiple systems across the OTT platform ecosystem.

You will be responsible for translating business and product requirements into scalable, secure, resilient and maintainable technical solutions that align with the organisation's strategic objectives.

Our culture is highly delivery-focused, and the role extends well beyond producing architecture diagrams and design documentation.

You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Programme Management, Operations and external partners throughout the delivery lifecycle, providing hands-on architectural guidance, resolving technical challenges, managing design trade-offs and ensuring successful implementation of solutions through to production release.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. **Solution Architecture:**
   Lead the architecture and solution design of strategic initiatives across the OTT platform ecosystem, ensuring alignment with business objectives and technology strategy.
2. **Architectural Evolution:**
   Drive architectural evolution by assessing existing systems, identifying improvement opportunities and challenging established assumptions and technical constraints, including the pragmatic application of AI-enabled tools and capabilities where they deliver measurable value.
3. **End-to-End Delivery:**
   Own solution delivery from concept through implementation, providing technical leadership, resolving complex challenges and ensuring successful outcomes.
4. **Scalable Solution Design:**
   Design scalable, secure, resilient and maintainable solutions, defining both functional and non-functional requirements and producing key architectural artefacts, including requirements for responsible AI use, data privacy, security, observability and governance where AI capabilities are involved.
5. **Stakeholder Collaboration:**
   Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Delivery and Business stakeholders to ensure solutions adhere to architectural principles, standards and best practices.
6. **Architecture Reviews:**
   Conduct architecture reviews, identify and mitigate technical risks, dependencies and gaps, and drive continuous quality improvement.
7. **Engineering Guidance:**
   Support engineering teams throughout delivery with architectural guidance, governance and decision-making for complex technical issues. Promote effective and responsible use of AI-assisted engineering and delivery practices.
8. **Technology Innovation:**
   Evaluate emerging technologies, industry trends, OTT best practices and relevant AI capabilities to enhance platform capabilities, engineering efficiency and long-term architectural sustainability.

**Skills and Experience**

**You'll Be Set Up for Success If You Have**

* 6+ years' experience as a Solution Architect or similar role, designing and delivering large-scale technology solutions in complex environments.
* Deep understanding of OTT platform architectures and domains, including subscriptions, monetisation, identity and access management (IAM), content and metadata management, and related platform services.
* Proven experience designing and delivering scalable, distributed systems using
  **Microservices and Event-Driven Architecture (EDA)**
  principles.
* Strong knowledge of cloud-native architectures and services, preferably
  **AWS**
  .
* Strong solution design expertise, including integration and management of third-party vendor solutions and in-house platforms.
* **AI fluency:**
  Practical understanding of Generative AI, Machine Learning and AI-enabled platform capabilities.
* Experience using AI-assisted tools to improve architecture, analysis, documentation, engineering productivity and problem-solving, while validating outputs and retaining appropriate technical judgement.
* Ability to assess AI use cases, dependencies, risks and non-functional requirements.
* Solid understanding of the software development lifecycle, with hands-on experience in technologies such as
  **Node.js, Java, Python or Go**
  , and strong knowledge of database technologies.
* Proven ability to solve complex business and technology challenges, navigate ambiguity and drive effective technical outcomes.
* Experience analysing and optimising business processes, operating models and technology landscapes.
* Strong documentation skills and experience applying industry-standard architecture and design methodologies.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence decisions and communicate complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.

**Even Better If You Have**

* Experience designing and implementing Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions.
* Experience integrating payment providers, subscription billing platforms and related monetisation services.
* Experience working with external vendors and partners, including content security, authentication, authorisation and platform protection.
* Experience designing event-driven integrations, data pipelines and asynchronous workflows using messaging and streaming technologies.
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments, including Scrum, backlog refinement and technical planning.

0345a11f.title: Staff Solution Architect
0345a11f.description:
**Strength in Trust**
OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.
  
  
Staff Solutions Architect (Design Partner Program)
  
  
The Challenge
  
  
We're looking for a Solutions Architect to join our R&D Customer Engineering organisation and partner with strategic Design Partner customers. This is a highly customer-facing role that sits at the intersection of solution architecture, product strategy, and enterprise governance.
  
  
You will work directly with customers to understand their business challenges, technical requirements, regulatory considerations, and strategic objectives. Acting as the bridge between customers, Product Management, Engineering, and Executive Leadership, you will help shape product direction, influence roadmap investments, and design scalable solutions that deliver measurable customer outcomes.
  
  
Success in this role means helping customers operationalise trust, governance, privacy, risk management, consent, and responsible data use while accelerating adoption, improving implementation outcomes, and driving long-term platform value.
  
  
**Your Mission**

* Partner directly with enterprise customers to understand business objectives, technical requirements, operational challenges, and strategic priorities.
* Lead discovery workshops, architecture reviews, solution assessments, and technical design sessions.
* Translate customer needs into scalable solution architectures, implementation strategies, and reusable design patterns.
* Bridge customer requirements with Product Management and Engineering teams by identifying product gaps, influencing roadmap priorities, and driving platform improvements.
* Design secure, scalable, and resilient enterprise solutions across workflows, integrations, APIs, data models, governance processes, and operational architectures.
* Drive measurable customer outcomes through successful adoption, implementation quality, operational efficiency, governance maturity, and long-term platform value.
* Create reference architectures, best practices, implementation standards, and reusable solution patterns that improve customer success and scalability.

**You Are**

* A customer-facing technical leader who operates at the intersection of solution architecture, business strategy, and enterprise technology.
* Comfortable engaging with executives, architects, engineers, product leaders, privacy, risk, compliance, security, governance, identity, marketing, and business stakeholders.
* Able to translate complex technical concepts, architecture decisions, and regulatory requirements into clear business outcomes.
* A systems thinker who designs for scalability, security, resilience, maintainability, and long-term platform success.
* Influential without direct authority and effective at driving alignment across cross-functional teams.

**Your Experience Includes**

* 8+ years of experience in Solution Architecture, Enterprise Architecture, Solutions Consulting, Technical Product Leadership, Customer Engineering, or similar customer-facing technical roles within enterprise SaaS organizations.
* Proven experience working directly with enterprise customers to gather requirements, lead discovery, shape technical strategy, design solutions, and drive adoption.
* Strong solution architecture experience, including APIs, integrations, workflow design, data models, enterprise platforms, governance controls, security, and scalable implementation patterns.
* Experience partnering with Product Management and Engineering teams to influence product direction and solve complex customer challenges.
* Strong executive communication, facilitation, stakeholder management, and presentation skills.
* Experience designing reusable frameworks, reference architectures, implementation patterns, best practices, and solution standards.

Domain Experience
  
  
Experience in one or more of the following areas is preferred:
**Privacy, Risk & Governance, Compliance, Security Governance, Data Governance, Consent & Preference Management, Identity, MarTech, Customer Data Platforms (CDP), or related enterprise SaaS domains.**
Where we Work
  
  
We are embracing an office-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person.
  
  
Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview.
  
  
**Benefits**
As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you’ll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers.
  
  
Resources
  
  
Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people:
  
  

* OneTrust Careers on YouTube
* @LifeatOneTrust on Instagram

Your Data
  
  
You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview
**.**
You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form.
  
  
Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Be aware that we never ask candidates for personal information, IDs or bank information during the interview process. We do not interview prospective candidates via instant message or group chat, and do not require candidates to purchase products or services, or process payments on our behalf as a condition of any employment offer. Please note that any legitimate interview availability requests will come directly from a OneTrust recruiter with an "@onetrust.com" email address. You may also receive legitimate emails from "@us.greenhouse-mail.io". Recruiters will only reach out to candidates who have applied for a role through our ATS (Greenhouse) or prospects via LinkedIn InMail. Job offers will come from a recruiter and may have a "@docusign.net" email address. For more information or if you have been targeted please reach out to askrecruiting@onetrust.com.
  
  
**Our Commitment to You**
When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad — the countdown has begun. The destination? A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. As a pioneer, your voice and expertise will help chart the direction of an entirely new category. Our commitment to putting people first starts with you. Your growth is part of the mission. Our goal is to give you the power to embark on the next phase of your uniquely, unique career.
  
  
OneTrust provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by local laws.

e9726923.description:
**Department:**
Sales

**Location:**
Mumbai, India

**Description**
Hazelcast is hiring one on-site Technical Account Manager (TAM), L2 for the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) engagement. In RBI’s staffing model, this person serves as the Hazelcast OEM on-site Resident Engineer provided through the bidder. You will work closely with RBI’s L1 help desk, Bank technology teams, the L3 TAM, the bidder’s service team and Hazelcast support to keep the environments healthy and restore service quickly. The role begins after Go-Live and formal RBI sign-off. The initial assignment is at least one year; any extension during the five-year contract will depend on RBI’s call-off or extension decision.
  
  
**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

* Monitor Hazelcast caching environments through agreed tools and dashboards; perform daily configuration, job-status, restart and health checks and act on alerts.
* Take ownership of incidents escalated by RBI’s L1 help desk, including problems caused by breaks in existing configuration or custom development, and resolve medium-complexity errors, access issues and environment problems across UAT, pre-production and production.
* Guide incidents from initial triage through diagnosis, stakeholder updates and resolution—or make a clear handoff to the right support team. Gather the right logs, record findings and keep ticket status current.
* Work within and help keep current the agreed roles and responsibilities (RACI), escalation matrix and transition call flow, involving L3, Bank teams, developers or Hazelcast support when needed.
* Keep the Hazelcast run-book, system and configuration documentation, standard operating procedures, knowledge-base articles and version-controlled operational records current. After P1, recurring or critical incidents close, add the cause, fix and lessons learned to the knowledge base.
* Participate in disaster-recovery drills; prepare and implement backup and restoration guidance, record test results and drive closure of identified gaps.
* Own day-to-day service requests, required authorizations, coordination records and configuration backups. For changes, prepare impact analysis and approved procedures, test and rollback steps; work within approved maintenance windows and notify RBI of emergency changes within one day.
* Coordinate with RBI teams on performance, connectivity and cross-team dependencies; troubleshoot functional issues and escalate unresolved items with a complete evidence package.
* Join the on-call rotation and help the team support an unlimited number of cases under the contract. The service provides 24x7 P1/P2 coverage, with response targets of 30 minutes initially and 1 hour ongoing for P1; 1 hour and 2 hours for P2; 4 hours and 8 business hours for P3; and 8 hours and 2 working days for all other cases.
* Keep clear records of health checks, incidents, escalations, tickets, disaster-recovery tests, changes, attendance and on-call acknowledgements, and contribute to quarterly service-level reporting and RBI certification.

**WHAT YOU HAVE**

* Graduate qualification such as BE, BSc, MCA or equivalent; an engineering background is preferred.
* At least 4 years of relevant experience, including at least 3 years designing, implementing and upgrading Hazelcast or the directly relevant OEM product.
* Hands-on experience operating and monitoring Hazelcast across enterprise UAT, pre-production and production, with strong incident triage, log analysis and service-restoration skills.
* Working knowledge of IT service management for incidents, problems, changes, tickets, authorizations, service requests and escalation.
* Ability to build and maintain runbooks, standard operating procedures, knowledge articles, health-check records and controlled configuration documentation.
* Experience supporting disaster-recovery drills and backup/restoration procedures, with clear communication skills for RBI stakeholders, L1/L3 teams, developers and OEM support.

Be prepared to share degree records, project dates, relevant experience and evidence of your Hazelcast or OEM association so Hazelcast can support RBI’s approval process.

b6973aff.title: Security Program Manager, Infrastructure Physical Security
b6973aff.description:
**Description**
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
The Amazon Data Services (India) Pvt. Ltd. (ADSIPL) Data Center Security Group is seeking a highly talented and motivated Security Systems Project Manager to join our team. The team is responsible for the design, installation and integration of security systems equipment including, but not limited to, Access Control/Intrusion Detection and CCTV Surveillance systems.
  
  
You will also be responsible for the continuous review of existing standards and to stay abreast of developments in new technology that will enhance the physical security of ADSIPL data centers and co-locations. You will work directly with the Cluster Security Manager, the Infrastructure Operations and Construction teams, and other customers, both internal and external, to integrate the business' requirements into physical security systems design and implementation. Your work will include supporting the construction and deployment of physical security packages for all ADSIPL data centers and co-locations in the cluster. You will also work closely with contractors and vendors to ensure compliance with all security standards during the construction, testing and acceptance phases of the projects.
  
  
The ideal candidate for the role will have demonstrated the ability to work in all disciplines, at all levels; from technology research to system design and layout, oversight of construction and implementation, as well as maintenance and upgrades over the life of the system. You will have an in-depth knowledge of security technology, be innovative, highly organized, and will have demonstrated the ability to deliver results on time and within budget.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
You will be responsible for observing Physical Security Standards and Programs that support the goals of the Global Physical Security Team, while enabling the local site managers to draw related services from the team, in a self-service manner.
  
  
**This Includes**
Excellent large-scale project and program management experience, with the ability to work in a fast-paced environment
  
  
Lead physical security design and system installation for new data centers, data center expansions and special projects
  
  
Lead physical multi-million-dollar security project lifecycle management including bid packages, specifications, drawings, code compliance, vendor management, budget, change orders, and close-out documentation.
  
  
Contemporary knowledge of emerging physical security technologies to assess their applicability within the AWS physical security program.
  
  
Provide Subject Matter Expert (SME) support for leadership to make strategic decisions regarding technology and procedure.
  
  
Effective prioritization of tasks, and seamless operation across organizational boundaries
  
  
Execution and coordination of preventative maintenance and repairs to security system equipment.
  
  
Ensuring compliance with physical security project standards, project Scopes of Work, budgets and timelines.
  
  
Designing, developing, and implementing solutions for system installations, upgrades, repairs and change management.
  
  
Supporting security system equipment commissioning, Completing final Test, Acceptance and project hand-off
  
  
Building and deploying training programs for all users of physical security systems
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
Mission: Deliver physical security infrastructure by working vigorously and collaborating with various stakeholders to earn and keep customer trust; providing a safe and secure environment for our people, assets, and customer data.
  
  
Vision: Develop exceptional security infrastructure delivery professionals, consistently apply security processes, and pioneer new technologies that effectively balance security requirements with operational needs.
  
  
**About The Team**
About AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of leading large complex programs experience
* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering/Communications Engineering
* Experience with security equipment such as intrusion detection devices, access control systems, etc.
* Experience with AutoCAD, Revit, Bluebeam, and MS Office Suite
* 10 years’ experience managing the Physical Security System Deployment Projects.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5+ years of vendor management experience
* 5+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* PMP, Prince2, PgMP, SAFe or SCRUM/Agile certification

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. 3e8f740c.title: Senior Solutions Architect - Generative AI
3e8f740c.description:
NVIDIA is seeking a dynamic and experienced Generative AI Solution Architect with specialized expertise in training Large Language Models (LLMs) and implementing workflows based on Pretraining, Finetuning LLMs & Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). As a key member of our AI Solutions team, you will play a pivotal role in architecting and delivering cutting-edge solutions that leverage the power of NVIDIA's generative AI technologies. This position requires a deep understanding of language models, particularly open source LLMs, and a strong proficiency in designing and implementing RAG-based workflows.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**

* Architect end-to-end generative AI solutions with a focus on LLMs training , deployment and RAG workflows.
* Collaborate closely with customers to understand their language-related business challenges and design tailored solutions.
* Collaborate with sales and business development teams to support pre-sales activities, including technical presentations and demonstrations of LLM and RAG capabilities.
* Work closely with NVIDIA engineering teams to provide feedback and contribute to the evolution of generative AI software.
* Engage directly with customers/partners to understand their requirements and challenges.
* Lead workshops and design sessions to define and refine generative AI solutions focused on LLMs and RAG workflows and lead the training and optimization of Large Language Models using NVIDIA’s hardware and software platforms.
* Implement strategies for efficient and effective training of LLMs to achieve optimal performance.
* Design and implement RAG-based workflows to enhance content generation and information retrieval.
* Work closely with customers to integrate RAG workflows into their applications and systems and stay abreast of the latest developments in language models and generative AI technologies.
* Provide technical leadership and guidance on best practices for training LLMs and implementing RAG-based solutions.

**What We Need To See**

* Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or equivalent experience
* 7+ years of hands-on experience in a technical AI role, specifically focusing on generative AI, with a strong emphasis on training Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Proven track record of successfully deploying and optimizing LLM models for inference in production environments.
* In-depth understanding of state-of-the-art language models, including but not limited to GPT-3, BERT, or similar architectures.
* Expertise in training and fine-tuning LLMs using popular frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Hugging Face Transformers.
* Proficiency in model deployment and optimization techniques for efficient inference on various hardware platforms, with a focus on GPUs.
* Strong knowledge of GPU cluster architecture and the ability to leverage parallel processing for accelerated model training and inference.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience leading workshops, training sessions, and presenting technical solutions to diverse audiences.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Experience in deploying LLM models in cloud environments (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and on-premises infrastructure.
* Proven ability to optimize LLM models for inference speed, memory efficiency, and resource utilization.
* Familiarity with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker) and orchestration tools (e.g., Kubernetes) for scalable and efficient model deployment.
* Deep understanding of GPU cluster architecture, parallel computing, and distributed computing concepts.
* Hands-on experience with NVIDIA GPU technologies, and GPU cluster management and ability to design and implement scalable and efficient workflows for LLM training and inference on GPU clusters

The Google Cloud team helps companies, schools, and government seamlessly make the switch to Google products and supports them along the way. You listen to the customer and swiftly problem-solve technical issues to show how our products can make businesses more productive, collaborative, and innovative. You work closely with a cross-functional team of web developers and systems administrators, not to mention a variety of both regional and international customers. Your relationships with customers are crucial in helping Google grow its Cloud business and helping companies around the world innovate.
  
  
As an AI Outcome Customer Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE), you will be responsible as an enterprise architect, technical debugger, and engineering liaison. You will bridge the gap between pre-sales agreement shaping and post-sales execution. Entering the agreement cycle during the technical evaluation phase for strategic accounts, you will ensure that solutions are shaped strictly through the lens of adoption, rapid activation, and viable delivery. You will be the overarching Enterprise Architect and Technical Delivery Manager charting the course. You will also be responsible for technical design, systemic debugging, product and engineering integration, and strategic FDE alignment. You will architect how these technical marvels actually integrate into the customer's IT ecosystem (connectors, identity, data residency, legal constraints) and drive the technical delivery strategy from start to finish.
  
  
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Partner with Account teams and practice Customer Engineer (CEs) during technical evaluation phases to assess project feasibility, shape proposals for long-term adoption, and validate FDE engagement requests.
* Lead upfront technical design for enterprise-grade AI solutions, ensuring seamless and secure integration of models, agents, and connectors into existing customer data pipelines, identity providers, and compliance boundaries.
* Dive into code-level context to diagnose and resolve complex customer implementation issues, identify core product bugs, and test workarounds to clear execution roadblocks.
* Serve as the definitive liaison to core Product and Engineering teams, troubleshooting systemic deployment blockers and translating real-world field feedback into actionable feature requests.
* Steer implementation strategy through technical authority and architectural foresight while owning the technical reality of delivery alongside customer-facing teams.

dc85629f.title: Partner Solutions Engineer-Product & Platform Engineering
dc85629f.description:
Genpact runs customer operations at enormous scale—tens of millions of voice, chat, email and ticket interactions a year—in regulated, audit-intensive industries including banking, insurance and healthcare. Agentic CX is Genpact's point of view on where customer operations are heading: autonomous agents that don't just assist a human, but reason through a customer situation, decide the outcome and execute it end-to-end, escalating only the exceptions a human genuinely needs to see.

Genpact does not build the underlying conversational AI runtime. We partner with leading CCaaS and agentic platforms—Amazon Connect, Sierra, Observe.AI, NiCE and others—and own the layer that makes their platforms enterprise-ready: decades of process intelligence, exception logic and governance, encoded into four IP assets—CX Intelligence (powered by Maestro Spine), CX Assure, CX Insights and CX Integrate. Platform from partners; outcome ownership from Genpact.

Inviting applications for the role of
**Partner Solutions Engineer-Product & Platform Engineering!**

We're hiring a Partner Solutions Engineer into the Product and Platform Engineering organization behind Agentic CX. Where a Forward Deployed Engineer owns a client engagement end-to-end, the Partner Solutions Engineer is our depth specialist on the partner platforms themselves: you are the person who knows Amazon Connect, Sierra and Observe.AI (and the next platform we add) well enough to configure a production-grade voice or chat agent on any of them, and to make Genpact's domain intelligence portable across all of them.

You take a Genpact Standard Operating Procedure—written for a human agent—and convert it into an Agent Operating Procedure (AOP): a codified, testable set of decision rules, data lookups, disclosures, escalation triggers and tool calls that an AI agent can execute on a specific partner runtime. You then map every AOP back to the business requirement it serves—the outcome metric, the compliance control, the policy it encodes—so every autonomous decision stays traceable, auditable and explainable.

**Where You Sit**

You'll be part of the dedicated CX engineering capability inside Product and Platform Engineering, working alongside:

* Product engineering, who own CX Intelligence, CX Assure, CX Insights and CX Integrate as reusable, partner-agnostic assets that your AOPs are built on.
* Forward Deployed Engineers, who own the client relationship and go-live; you are their platform-depth partner on the harder configuration and integration problems.
* Domain operations teams, who hold the SOPs, exceptions and regulatory nuance your AOPs are translated from.
* Partner technical teams at Amazon Connect, Sierra, Observe.AI and others, whose platforms, roadmaps and best practices you track closely.

**What You'll Do**

* Convert Genpact SOPs into Agent Operating Procedures (AOPs): structured, testable agent logic, prompts, decision trees, tool calls and escalation rules, tailored to the target partner platform.
* Map every AOP back to the business requirement it serves—the outcome metric, policy or compliance control—so autonomy stays explainable and audit-ready.
* Configure and tune voice agents end-to-end on partner platforms, including:
* Amazon Connect: contact flows, IVR and routing logic, Lex bots, Lambda integrations, Contact Lens analytics and Agent Assist.
* Sierra: agent skills across the Agent Development Life Cycle (ADLC), prompt and eval design, and RAG-grounded knowledge configuration.
* Observe.AI: Voice and Chat AI agent configuration, prompt design, workflow and telephony setup, and AI Copilot tuning.
* Build and run golden test sets and evaluation frameworks so every AOP is validated before it ever touches a live customer interaction.
* Integrate partner platforms with CRM, ticketing and backend systems (e.g., Salesforce, ServiceNow, ticketing and core systems), using Maestro for selected backend integrations.
* Instrument agents with CX Assure and CX Insights so every interaction—human or AI—is scored, auditable and feeds the intelligence layer.
* Work with Forward Deployed Engineers to troubleshoot and harden configurations during embedded client engagements and go-lives.
* Maintain deep, current expertise on each partner platform's roadmap, new features and best practices, and feed platform-specific learnings back into reusable CX Intelligence, CX Assure, CX Insights and CX Integrate assets.
* Partner with governance, legal and compliance stakeholders to keep every autonomous decision within approved guardrails on every platform it runs on.

**What You'll Bring**

**Required**

* A software/solutions engineer, implementation engineer, or developer in a client-facing, platform-configuration-heavy role.
* Hands-on, production experience with at least two of: Amazon Connect (contact flows, Lex, Lambda, Contact Lens), Sierra (ADLC, agent/prompt tooling, eval frameworks), Observe.AI (voice/chat agent and workflow configuration, telephony integration).
* Strong software engineering fundamentals: comfortable writing production-quality code (Python, JavaScript/TypeScript or Go), working with REST/webhook APIs, and debugging in a live client environment.
* Demonstrated experience translating ambiguous business processes (SOPs, policy documents, exception logs) into structured, testable agent logic—i.e., converting SOPs into AOPs—and mapping that logic back to the original business requirement.
* Experience building or consuming golden test sets and evaluation frameworks for conversational AI or automation quality.
* Comfort configuring voice agent experiences specifically: IVR/contact flow design, telephony setup, prompt and dialogue design, IVR self-service.

**Preferred**

* Platform certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Amazon Connect Developer, or equivalent partner certifications from Sierra or Observe.AI.
* Experience in customer operations, contact center technology, or BPO/CX environments, especially in regulated industries such as banking, insurance or healthcare.
* Familiarity with RAG pipelines, LLM-based agent frameworks and prompt engineering beyond a single platform.
* Exposure to governance, risk and compliance concepts relevant to AI deployment (model cards, DPIAs, control-to-regulation mapping).
* Willingness to travel to client sites for embedded deployment engagements.

**How We'll Measure Success**

* AOP quality: SOPs converted into agent-ready logic that passes golden test sets on the first or second pass, with clear traceability back to the business requirement.
* Platform depth: ability to stand up a production-grade voice or chat agent on any of our partner platforms with minimal ramp-up.
* Outcome quality: resolution rate, containment, first-contact resolution and compliance defect rate against an agreed baseline, on whichever partner platform is in play.
* Reusability: platform-specific learnings and new exception patterns feed back into CX Intelligence, CX Assure, CX Insights and CX Integrate for the next engagement, on any partner stack.

**Why Join Now**

Agentic CX is a newly defined, fast-moving priority for Genpact, backed by a dedicated CX engineering capability being built through targeted hiring. As a Partner Solutions Engineer, you'll be the person who makes Genpact's domain intelligence work—production-grade—on whichever partner platform a client has chosen, shaping how we standardize AOP design across an expanding partner ecosystem.

At **ABB**, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

HRXP People Experience Lead

\_\_

This role bridges deep technical Workday knowledge with a passion for employee experience, ensuring ABB leverages the full potential of the Workday platform - including its growing AI capabilities.

* Serve as ABB's Workday architecture lead, maintaining a holistic understanding of the entire Workday ecosystem, including HCM, Recruiting, Compensation, Talent, Payroll, Benefits, Reporting, Integrations, and emerging capabilities.
* Act as the internal authority on Workday configuration, ensuring solutions are scalable, sustainable, aligned with global standards, and optimized for ABB's business processes, security model, and organizational structure.
* Drive innovation and employee experience improvements by identifying opportunities to leverage Workday AI, automation, and intelligent recommendations to simplify employee and manager journeys.
* Partner closely with HR, IT, Enterprise Architecture, Integration teams, and business stakeholders to design, govern, and continuously improve Workday solutions and connected business processes.
* Own solution architecture and integration design, assessing the impact of changes across systems, processes, data flows, and stakeholder groups while ensuring alignment with strategic priorities.

* Coach and guide Solution Architects and stakeholders on best practices, emerging Workday capabilities, and strategic technology decisions, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and innovation.

* 5+ years of hands-on Workday configuration experience across multiple modules, with strong knowledge of business processes, security, integrations, and cross-functional dependencies.
* 7+ years of experience in Solution Architecture, designing and governing enterprise-scale technology solutions.
* Proven experience working within large, complex, global organizations and navigating diverse stakeholder environments.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit **https://www.abb.com** to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

,

,

d66050d8.title: Technical Account Manager, ES - INDIA
d66050d8.description:
**Description**
AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  
  
Amazon has built a global reputation for being the most customer-centric company, a company that customers from all over the world recognize, value, and trust for both our products and services. Amazon has a fast-paced environment where we “Work Hard, Have Fun and Make History.”
  
  
As an increasing number of enterprises move their critical systems to the cloud, AWS India is in need of highly efficient technical consulting talent to help our largest and strategically important customers navigate the operational challenges and complexities of AWS Cloud. We are looking for Technical Consultants to support our customers creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Data Analytics, Application services, Networking, Server-less and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor for organizations ranging from start-ups to large enterprises.
  
  
As a Technical Account Manager, you will be the primary technical point of contact for one or more customers helping to plan, debug, and oversee ongoing operations of business-critical applications. You will get your hands dirty, troubleshooting application, network, database, and architectural challenges using a suite of internal AWS Cloud tools as well as your existing knowledge and toolkits. We are seeking individuals with strong backgrounds in I.T. Consulting and in any of these related areas such as Solution Designing, Application and System Development, Database Management, Big Data and Analytics, DevOps Consulting, and Media technologies. Knowledge of programming and scripting is beneficial to the role.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Every day will bring new and exciting challenges on the job while you:
  
  

* Learn and use Cloud technologies.
* Interact with leading technologists around the world.
* Work on critical, highly complex customer problems that may span multiple AWS Cloud services.
* Apply advanced troubleshooting techniques to provide unique solutions to our customers' individual needs.
* Work directly with AWS Cloud subject matter experts to help reproduce and resolve customer issues.
* Write tutorials, how-to videos, and other technical articles for the customer community.
* Leverage your extensive customer support experience and provide feedback to internal AISPL teams on how to improve our services.
* Drive projects that improve support-related processes and our customers’ technical support experience.
* Assist in Design/Architecture of AWS and Hybrid cloud solutions.
* Help Enterprises define IT and business processes that work well with cloud deployments.
* Be available outside of business hours to help coordinate the handling of urgent issues as needed.

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree
* 3+ years of technical engineering experience
* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
* Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, engineering, analytics, mathematics, statistics, IT or equivalent, or Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
* 7+ years of hands-on infrastructure, troubleshooting, systems administration, networking, DevOps or applications development experience
* Experience in external enterprise customer-facing role as a technical lead, with strong oral and written communication skills, presenting to both large and small audiences
* Experience managing multiple projects, prioritizing, planning, and managing time
* Be mobile and travel to client locations as needed.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Experience in internal enterprise or external customer-facing environment as a technical lead

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
  
  
  
**Company**
- AWS India - Karnataka
