3e6ccef0.description:
**SaaS Security Delivery Lead**

*About the Job*

BluOcean Cyber is seeking a SaaS Security Delivery Lead to lead client engagements focused on SaaS security, security program maturity, and modern enterprise risk reduction. This role is ideal for a consulting-oriented security leader who can manage complex delivery work, build trusted client relationships, coordinate cross-functional teams, and ensure high-quality deliverables across multiple security initiatives.

You will serve as a client-facing delivery lead, trusted advisor, and engagement manager across SaaS security programs. You will help clients identify risk, prioritize remediation, improve security controls, and mature their security operating models across enterprise SaaS environments.

The ideal candidate brings strong cybersecurity knowledge, Big 4 or comparable consulting delivery experience, executive communication skills, and the ability to translate technical findings into clear, actionable deliverables. This is a leadership role for someone who can bring structure to ambiguous client needs, manage teams toward measurable outcomes, and ensure BluOcean delivers practical, high-impact work.

This role is well suited for someone who enjoys leading engagements from kickoff through final delivery, managing client expectations, coordinating resources, developing executive-ready materials, and helping scale repeatable consulting delivery capabilities in a fast-moving startup environment.

**What You’ll Do**

* Lead client engagements focused on SaaS security program development, risk reduction, control improvement, and implementation planning.
* Own end-to-end engagement delivery, including scope, timelines, workplans, stakeholder coordination, status reporting, risks, issue resolution, deliverable quality, and client outcomes.
* Manage day-to-day client engagement activities, including kickoff planning, recurring client meetings, executive updates, progress tracking, and expectation management.
* Partner with clients to understand business goals, security priorities, operational constraints, and risk tolerance, then translate those needs into practical delivery plans and prioritized recommendations.
* Develop polished, client-ready deliverables, including assessment reports, maturity models, security roadmaps, executive presentations, implementation plans, risk summaries, operating models, and business cases.
* Coordinate security engineers, consultants, architects, and client stakeholders to ensure work is completed on time, aligned to scope, and communicated clearly.
* Lead SaaS security program workstreams from discovery through recommendations and execution planning, including current-state assessment, gap analysis, roadmap development, and outcome measurement.
* Facilitate workshops and working sessions with CISOs, security leaders, IT teams, product teams, engineering teams, and business stakeholders.
* Translate complex technical findings into clear, business-aligned guidance for technical teams, executives, and non-technical audiences.
* Identify engagement risks, delivery blockers, scope changes, and client concerns early, and drive resolution in partnership with internal and client leadership.
* Support client relationship management by building trust, maintaining strong communication, and helping identify opportunities for additional value.
* Apply security frameworks and control models to help clients evaluate risk, prioritize improvements, and strengthen security governance across SaaS and cloud-connected environments.
* Partner with internal leadership to build repeatable delivery playbooks, templates, methodologies, client-facing collateral, and consulting offerings.

ee1d01d3.title: Lead I - Product Architect
ee1d01d3.description:
**Role description**

Data Architect Role Overview The Data Architect will define and own end-to-end data architecture for AI initiatives on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). This role establishes the data models, platform patterns, governance, and operational standards needed to support ingestion, storage, transformation, serving, and retrieval. Working with business stakeholders, AI specialists, platform engineers, and data engineers, the Data Architect will translate business needs into scalable data foundations and clear architectural direction. Key Responsibilities Data architecture and modeling: Own the architecture across BigQuery, AlloyDB/PostgreSQL, Cloud Storage, and related services. Lead conceptual, logical, and physical data modeling, including domain boundaries, partitioning, indexing, and schema evolution. Pipeline architecture: Establish reference architectures and reusable design patterns for batch and streaming pipelines using Dataflow, Cloud Composer/Airflow, Pub/Sub, and Cloud Run. AI-ready data foundations: Design data foundations for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), semantic search, and hybrid search, including document ingestion, chunking, metadata, embedding pipelines, vector storage using pgvector/ScaNN, and refresh and re-indexing patterns. Large language model integration and evaluation: Define standards for integrating large language model (LLM) APIs, including Vertex AI/Gemini and other providers, into extraction, classification, summarization, and enrichment workflows. Balance quality, cost, latency, and security. Partner with quality assurance (QA) to design evaluation frameworks covering golden datasets, sampling, human review, regression testing, and ongoing measurement of accuracy, consistency, cost, and latency. Governance and data quality: Establish validation, cataloging, and lineage architecture, including tools such as Dataplex. Define standards for personally identifiable information (PII), retention, access controls, and auditability. Reliability and operations: Set service-level agreement (SLA) and service-level objective (SLO) standards, monitoring, ing, idempotency, backfills, failure handling, and incident response. Lead architectural root cause analysis and post-incident reviews. Technology strategy: Evaluate data technologies and platforms, document trade-offs, and guide build-versus-buy decisions, cost optimization, and scalability planning. Support integration with hybrid-cloud and legacy systems, including Azure-based data services where applicable. Cross-functional architecture: Partner with the AI Architect and AI Engineer to support retrieval and agent solutions through sound data design. Work with the Platform Engineer on continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), Infrastructure as Code, and environment standards for data workloads. Technical leadership: Mentor Data Engineers, conduct design and code reviews, and guide complex implementations. Translate business needs and data domains into architectural roadmaps, and produce clear architecture documentation and decision records for technical and non-technical audiences. Qualifications and Technical Expertise Experience designing end-to-end cloud data architectures, with expertise in GCP data services such as BigQuery, AlloyDB/PostgreSQL, and Cloud Storage. Strong conceptual, logical, and physical data modeling skills, including schema evolution, partitioning, indexing, and domain design. Experience defining batch and streaming pipeline patterns using Dataflow, Cloud Composer/Airflow, Pub/Sub, and Cloud Run. Experience designing data foundations for RAG, semantic and hybrid search, embedding pipelines, vector storage, and LLM-enabled workflows. Ability to define data quality, governance, lineage, security, retention, and access-control standards, alongside evaluation approaches for AI-enabled data use cases. Knowledge of data-platform reliability, monitoring, failure recovery, CI/CD, and Infrastructure as Code, with the ability to evaluate scalability, cost, and operational trade-offs. Ability to lead architectural decisions, mentor Data Engineers, collaborate across business and engineering teams, and communicate technical direction through clear documentation and roadmaps. Familiarity with hybrid-cloud and legacy-system integration, including Azure-based data services where applicable.

 **Skills**

AlloyDB, Google Cloud Platform, Data Modeling, Data Governance, LLMs, Vertex AI, Data Privacy, RAG, Observability, Google Cloud Dataflow, BigQuery

 **About UST**  
UST is a global digital transformation solutions provider. For more than 20 years, UST has worked side by side with the world’s best companies to make a real impact through transformation. Powered by technology, inspired by people and led by purpose, UST partners with their clients from design to operation. With deep domain expertise and a future-proof philosophy, UST embeds innovation and agility into their clients’ organizations. With over 30,000 employees in 30 countries, UST builds for boundless impact—touching billions of lives in the process.

We are seeking an experienced  Solution Architect - AI with 10+ years of overall technology experience, including at least 3 years of hands-on experience designing and architecting AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, or Agentic AI solutions. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in enterprise solution architecture and experience designing scalable, secure, resilient, and production-ready AI solutions on at least one major cloud platform such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  
  
The role will be responsible for defining end-to-end AI solution architectures covering application, data, AI/ML, integration, security, infrastructure, and operational components. The architect will work closely with business stakeholders, enterprise architects, data teams, AI engineers, software engineers, security teams, and cloud platform teams to translate business requirements into practical and scalable technology solutions.
  
  
The candidate should have strong knowledge of modern AI architecture patterns including Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agentic AI, AI agents, vector databases, knowledge retrieval, API/tool integration, model orchestration, observability, security, and responsible AI. Experience in taking AI solutions from initial discovery and proof-of-concept through production deployment and operationalization is essential.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**

* Design end-to-end AI and Generative AI solution architectures that address business requirements while meeting enterprise standards for scalability, security, performance, reliability, and maintainability.
* Define appropriate architecture patterns for Generative AI, Agentic AI, RAG, Machine Learning, intelligent automation, conversational AI, and AI-enabled enterprise applications.
* Provide architectural leadership across the complete solution lifecycle, from discovery, feasibility assessment, architecture definition, prototyping, implementation, production deployment, and post-production operations.
* Collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to evaluate AI use cases, identify suitable technologies, assess technical feasibility, and define implementation roadmaps.
* Lead the architecture and solution design of enterprise AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, and Agentic AI solutions across cloud and hybrid environments.
* Translate business requirements, functional requirements, and non-functional requirements into scalable and secure solution architecture designs, architecture diagrams, integration patterns, and technical specifications.
* Design AI solutions using services and technologies available on AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, including managed AI/ML, data, integration, compute, security, and observability services.
* Define architectures for LLM-based applications, including prompt orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector search, embeddings, model routing, grounding, knowledge bases, AI agents, tool/function calling, and multi-agent architectures.
* Design enterprise integration patterns connecting AI solutions with APIs, databases, data platforms, SaaS applications, enterprise applications, event-driven systems, and external services.
* Evaluate and recommend appropriate foundation models, LLMs, embedding models, AI platforms, vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and supporting technologies based on business, technical, security, cost, and performance requirements.
* Define architecture approaches for AI security, identity and access management, data privacy, guardrails, content filtering, responsible AI, model governance, and regulatory compliance.
* Establish architectural standards for AI observability, monitoring, tracing, logging, evaluation, performance management, reliability, and operational support.
* Work closely with AI engineers, data scientists, data engineers, application developers, DevOps/MLOps teams, cloud engineers, and security teams to guide implementation and ensure alignment with the target architecture.
* Lead architecture reviews, technical design workshops, proof-of-concepts, technology assessments, and design governance activities while communicating complex technical concepts effectively to both technical and business stakeholders.
* Ability to conduct AI use-case discovery, technical feasibility assessments, architecture assessments, technology evaluations, and solution option analysis.
* Ability to create and communicate high-level architecture, detailed solution architecture, sequence diagrams, data flows, integration diagrams, deployment architectures, and architecture decision records.
* Ability to design appropriate AI guardrails addressing areas such as hallucination, prompt injection, data leakage, harmful content, unauthorized tool execution, and inappropriate model responses.
* Ability to define reference architectures, reusable architecture patterns, technical standards, and architecture governance frameworks for AI solutions.

The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in Snowflake, AWS, ETL/ELT frameworks, data warehousing, data lakes, and cloud-native architectures. * Troubleshoot and resolve complex performance, scalability, integration, and platform architecture challenges.

* Proven experience architecting enterprise-scale ETL/ELT frameworks, data ingestion processes, and integration solutions.
* Strong expertise in Data Warehousing, Data Lakes, Lakehouse architectures, and analytical data platforms.
* Proficiency in data modeling techniques including dimensional modeling, star schema, snowflake schema, and enterprise data architecture principles.
* Experience with structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data processing across large-scale environments.
* Strong understanding of cloud security, governance, compliance, data privacy, and access management frameworks.
* Expertise in Snowflake performance tuning, query optimization, workload management, storage optimization, and cloud cost management.
* Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, infrastructure automation, and data platform monitoring strategies.
* Strong understanding of modern cloud-native architecture patterns and scalable distributed systems.
* Excellent stakeholder management, architecture governance, communication, and presentation skills.
* Proven ability to lead technical discussions, influence architecture decisions, and guide engineering teams across large transformation programs.

**Benefits**

The Pre-Sales Lead will lead the pre-sales function, working closely with Sales, Business Development, Engineering, Delivery, and Marketing teams to drive opportunity qualification, solution development, and customer engagement throughout the sales lifecycle.

The Pre-Sales Lead will be responsible for driving solution strategy, managing pre-sales engagements, ensuring the quality of proposals and presentations, and enabling the sales team to effectively position the organization's technology capabilities and services to prospective customers.

1. Lead the pre-sales function and collaborate with Sales and Business Development teams to qualify opportunities, understand customer requirements, and develop effective solution strategies.

2. Drive customer discovery sessions, stakeholder discussions, and workshops to identify business challenges, technical requirements, and potential solution opportunities.

3. Lead the development and delivery of solution presentations, product demonstrations, technical walkthroughs, and Proof of Concept (PoC) engagements.

4. Work closely with Engineering and Delivery teams to develop solution architectures, delivery approaches, effort estimates, implementation roadmaps, and technical proposals.

12. Drive the development of differentiated value propositions, solution narratives, and competitive positioning to strengthen the organization's market presence.

13. Stay updated on emerging technologies, industry trends, and competitive developments across Digital Transformation, Enterprise Applications, Mobile Development, Cloud, Software Testing, and related technology domains.

Secondary Skills: Stakeholder Management & Communication, Technical Research & Industry/Technology Trends.

b318679b.description:
**Company Description**
It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
  
  
Join us to put AI to work for people.
  
  
**Job Description**
**What you get to do in this role:**
  
  

* Support product sales as a technical, solution, and industry domain expert within a client-facing sales team pursuing strategic enterprise customers and prospects.
* Bring industry-specific expertise across Manufacturing, Retail, IT/ITES, and/or Telecommunications, with the ability to understand industry operating models, customer journeys, service operations, business processes, technology landscapes, and transformation priorities.
* Translate industry challenges into compelling solution narratives by connecting business outcomes, customer experience, workflow transformation, automation, data, and AI with ServiceNow capabilities.
* Lead executive and technical discovery workshops to uncover customer priorities, operational challenges, transformation opportunities, and desired business outcomes.
* Develop and deliver compelling product demonstrations and solution experiences that reflect real industry scenarios and end-to-end business processes, rather than feature-led demonstrations.
* Engage credibly with senior business stakeholders, CIO/CTO/CBO organizations, enterprise architects, operations leaders, and transformation teams.
* Develop strong client and partner relationships and establish yourself as a trusted advisor throughout the sales cycle.
* Develop solution architectures that demonstrate how ServiceNow integrates with a customer's broader enterprise technology ecosystem, including CRM, ERP, contact center, data, integration, and AI platforms.
* Articulate the role of AI, Agentic AI, automation, workflow orchestration, and data in transforming industry-specific processes and customer experiences.
* Stay current on competitive positioning, industry trends, emerging technology, AI developments, and market differentiation.
* Represent ServiceNow at executive briefings, customer workshops, conferences, industry forums, user groups, partner events, and trade shows.

**Qualifications**
**To be successful in this role you have:**

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* 10+ years of experience in pre-sales Solution Consulting, Sales Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, Technology Consulting, or a comparable customer-facing technology role.
* Strong domain expertise in at least one, preferably more, of the following industries: Manufacturing, Retail, IT/ITES, or Telecommunications.
* Demonstrated ability to understand and articulate industry business processes, customer journeys, operational challenges, transformation priorities, and technology landscapes.
* Experience converting complex business requirements into solution architectures, demonstrations, transformation roadmaps, and compelling executive narratives.
* Experience engaging both business and technical stakeholders, ranging from operational teams to senior executives and enterprise architects.
* Proficiency with the ServiceNow platform or strong technical expertise with enterprise cloud software platforms and architectures.
* Strong understanding of enterprise integrations and the role of platforms such as CRM, ERP, contact center, data platforms, APIs, integration technologies, and AI services within an enterprise architecture.
* Experience working collaboratively with Product Management, Product Marketing, Sales, Partners, Professional Services, and customer technology teams.
* Strong discovery, storytelling, presentation, demonstration, and executive communication skills.
* Ability to operate strategically within complex enterprise accounts while remaining hands-on with solution development and demonstrations.
* Ability and willingness to travel as necessary.

Additional Information

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer**

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.
  
  
**Accommodations**

If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.
  
  
**Export Control Regulations**
For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. 16f00792.description:
**About Kinaxis**
Elevate your career journey by embracing a new challenge with Kinaxis. We are experts in tech, but it’s really our people who give us passion to always seek ways to do things better. As such, we’re serious about your career growth and professional development, because People matter at Kinaxis.
  
  
In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers based in Ottawa, Canada. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, and support 40,000+ users in over 100 countries. As a global leader in end-to-end supply chain management, we enable supply chain excellence for all industries. We are expanding our team in Chennai and around the world as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.
  
  
Our journey in India began in 2020 and we have been growing steadily since then! Building a high-trust and high-performance culture is important to us and we are proud to be Great Place to Work® Certified TM . Our state-of-the-art office, located in the World Trade Centre in Chennai, offers our growing team space for expansion and collaboration.
  
  
**Location**
Chennai, India
  
  
**About The Team**

****What you will do****

* Collaborates closely with agile team members to support the configuration, implementation of Maestro software to enable the solution according to our customers distinct needs
* Translate business requirements into Kinaxis Maestro software specifications, following supply chain industry trends and best practices.
* Support senior team members in providing creative solutions to complex business problems while maintaining best practices.
* Participate in data management and data integration activities, including source systems data transformation, data loading, data cleanup and validation.
* Perform training of customer end users on the configured solution.
* Provide technical support to end users and resolve issues of the configured solutions, escalating to senior team members as needed.
* Support the validation and testing of the solution and capture user feedback.
* Actively engage, guide and mentor to develop the skills of junior consultants on projects.
* Any other reasonable project related tasks as assigned by the Project Manager.

****What we are looking for****

* Candidates with results-oriented mindset, focusing on improving client satisfaction and providing a very high standard of service, driving towards Kinaxis’s success.
* Sound knowledge in Supply Chain concepts especially scheduling with 6+ years of experience.
* Strong intent to learn our first in class product “Maestro”
* Work in a fast-paced project environment and co-ordinate with members at all levels in an organization
* Highly adaptable professional, able to embrace teamwork in diverse and evolving work environments.
* Capability to lead by example, having the drive to think in an innovative way and have passion about new challenges
* Ability to solve complex problems, think critically and make sound judgement decisions.
* A passion for working in customer facing roles that require high level of interpersonal, communication, facilitation and presentation skills.
* Ability to communicate complex ideas effectively in English, both verbally and in writing
* Technical skills such as SQL, R, Java Script, Python, etc.
* Experience with manufacturing planning solutions such as Kinaxis, SAP, JDA, etc. is an added advantage

#Senior
  
  
**Work With Impact:**
Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day—when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.
  
  
**Work with Fortune 500 Brands:**
Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Ford, Unilever, Yamaha, P&G, Lockheed-Martin, and more.
  
  
**Social Responsibility at Kinaxis:**
Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to net-zero operations strategy for the long term. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact.
  
  
People matter at Kinaxis and these are some of the perks and benefits we created for our team:
  
  

* Flexible vacation and Kinaxis Days (company-wide day off on the last Friday of every month)
* Flexible work options
* Physical and mental well-being programs
* Regularly scheduled virtual fitness classes
* Mentorship programs and training and career development
* Recognition programs and referral rewards
* Hackathons

For more information, visit the Kinaxis web site at www.kinaxis.com or the company’s blog at http://blog.kinaxis.com .
  
  
Kinaxis welcomes candidates to apply to our inclusive community. We provide accommodations upon request to ensure fairness and accessibility throughout our recruitment process for all candidates, including those with specific needs or disabilities. If you require an accommodation, please reach out to us at recruitmentprograms@kinaxis.com. Please note that this contact information is strictly for accessibility requests and cannot be used to inquire about application statuses.
  
  
Kinaxis is committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process. After the initial screening, all subsequent decisions regarding your application, including final selection, are made by our human recruitment team. AI does not make any final hiring decisions.

Founded in 2002 in Sydney, with offices in India and a presence across the Americas and Europe, Prospecta is a leading data management software company. Our flagship platform, Master Data Online (MDO), enables accurate, compliant, and relevant master data for asset-intensive industries including Energy, Utilities, Oil & Gas, Mining, Infrastructure, and Manufacturing.

We pride ourselves on agility, collaboration, and innovation delivering real value to customers while fostering a diverse, growth-driven culture that encourages learning, embraces challenges, and celebrates success.

**About the Job:**

**Position:**
Senior Solution Consultant

**Location:**
Gurugram

**Role Summary:**
Prospecta is looking for an experienced Senior Consultant to join our Master Data Online (MDO) practice, supporting the design and delivery of enterprise data governance solutions on SAP. The successful candidate will bring a combination of SAP functional knowledge and strong consulting capabilities, including requirements discovery, stakeholder engagement, process design, workshop facilitation, and solution documentation. The role requires working closely with customers to understand business challenges and translate them into scalable data governance solutions.

**Must Have:**

* Experience working directly with customers in consulting and implementation roles is mandatory.
* 5+ years of experience in SAP consulting, or SAP master data governance, or part of SAP transformation initiatives.
* Strong consulting and business analysis skills, including requirements gathering, workshop facilitation, stakeholder management, and customer engagement.
* Strong understanding of SAP business processes with functional knowledge in one or more domains such as Asset Management, Material Management, Business Partner, Vendor, or related areas.
* Excellent communication, presentation, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.

**Good to Have:**

* Experience with SAP Information Steward, SAP Data Quality Management, MDO, or other master data governance/data quality platforms.
* Been involved in integration projects where SAP was involved, understanding of SAP BTP and Integration Suite
* Familiarity with standards like ISO 14224 or other asset and equipment classification standards.
* Experience in data analytics, data quality management, or data transformation initiatives.
* Background in asset-intensive industries such as Oil & Gas, Mining, Utilities, Manufacturing, or similar sectors.
* Experience supporting pre-sales, solution consulting, and proposal responses.
* Experience working within consulting organizations or SAP practices of global system integrators.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Work as an integral part of the project team and help drive project outcomes as per the plan and scope.
* Lead customer discovery sessions, requirements gathering workshops, and solution design discussions to understand business needs and define solution approaches.
* Prepare and own the design document including all the test cases that will be used as acceptance of the solution.
* Understand the core MDO platform and ability to map the requirements into a solution design
* Act as a liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams throughout the project lifecycle, from design through go-live and stabilization.
* Support configuration, testing, and validation activities, ensuring alignment between business requirements and system behaviors.
* Work closely with the build team and be always available to remove any bottlenecks or requirements that need customer input.
* Independently run solution walkthroughs during build and other phases of the project
* Support pre-sales activities, including solution demonstrations and Statement of Work (SOW) preparation.
* Contribute customer and industry feedback to product enhancement discussions.

**Job Details**  

**Job Type:** Permanent

**Title:** AI Solutions Engineer

**Department:** AMP Research SI

**Location:** Bengaluru or Gurgaon, India

**Reports To:** Principal Engineer

**Level:** 4

  
  
**About your team**  

Asset Management Platforms (AMP) is responsible for the design, engineering and delivery of technology solutions that support Fidelity's global Asset Management business. We partner with Research Analysts, Portfolio Managers, Asset Management Operations, Sustainability teams, and Distribution teams across Europe and Asia to deliver modern platforms that enhance investment research, knowledge discovery, data-driven insights, and informed investment decision-making.

Our team develops and supports the technology ecosystem used across multiple investment capabilities, including Equities, Fixed Income, Multi-Asset, Systematic Investing, and Sustainable Investing. Our platforms underpin critical research processes including company and market research, sustainability analysis, financial modelling, investment content management, knowledge discovery, collaboration, and research analytics, enabling investment professionals to generate high-quality investment insights and improve client outcomes.

As Artificial Intelligence continues to transform investment research and software engineering, we are investing in modern engineering practices that combine AI-assisted software development with AI-powered research capabilities to improve productivity, accelerate insight generation, and enhance engineering quality. The AI Solutions Engineer will play a key role in designing, developing, and delivering enterprise AI solutions while enabling engineering teams to adopt AI-enabled development practices safely, effectively, and responsibly across the Research Technology platform.

  
  
**About your role**  

The AI Solutions Engineer is a hands-on technical engineer responsible for accelerating software engineering delivery through the effective adoption of Artificial Intelligence and modern engineering practices.

Working closely with Engineering Leads, Solution Architects, Product Owners and software engineering teams, you will identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity through AI-assisted development while maintaining Fidelity's high standards for architecture, engineering governance, software quality and security.

You will combine strong software engineering expertise with practical knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI-powered development tooling to establish best practices for AI-assisted software engineering. This includes to make effective use of technologies such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and other AI coding assistants to improve software design, implementation, testing, documentation and operational support.

The role is equally focused on engineering excellence and innovation. You will apply modern software and AI engineering practices through hands-on design, development, testing, deployment, and production support, contribute to architectural decisions within established standards, support the adoption and continuous improvement of CI/CD, DevSecOps practices and implement approved security, governance, and Responsible AI controls throughout the software development lifecycle.

This is an exciting opportunity to shape how AI is adopted across Asset Management Platforms, helping engineering teams deliver high-quality software faster while ensuring solutions remain secure, maintainable and aligned with Fidelity's engineering standards.

  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  
  
**AI Engineering Enablement**  

* Design, build, deploy, and support enterprise AI applications using LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector search, tool calling, and agentic workflows.
* Build grounded RAG pipelines covering document ingestion, parsing, chunking, metadata enrichment, hybrid retrieval, reranking, citation, and response validation.
* Develop AI agents capable of planning, reasoning, maintaining context, invoking approved tools, and executing governed business workflows.
* Integrate commercial and open-source models through platforms such as AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, Anthropic, or equivalent services.
* Implement prompt and model configuration management, evaluation datasets, automated quality testing, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Evaluate AI technologies progmatically and select solutions based on business value, quality, security, latency, scalability, and cost.
* Coach and mentor engineering teams in the effective use of Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and other AI-assisted development tools.

  
  
**Software Engineering**  

* Build complete AI-assisted apps using modern frontend technologies such as Angular or React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
* Develop secure and scalable APIs, microservices, and orchestration services using Python, FastAPI, Node.js, or NestJS.
* Integrate applications with enterprise APIs, market and research data, document repositories, collaboration platforms, and structured and unstructured data sources.
* Work with Relational, NoSQL, Cloud and vector technologies such as PostgreSQL, OpenSearch, Snowflake and pgvector.
* Participate in engineering practices, including modular design, API contracts, code reviews, performance optimization and secure coding.

  
  
**Engineering Excellence**

* Work with engineering teams to optimise software delivery pipelines.
* Promote unit test automation and engineering best practises throughout the SDLC.
* Create reusable AI services, reference implementations, engineering standards, and ready-to-use development capabilities that improve developer productivity.

  
  
**Architecture Governance**  

* Collaborate with Solution Architects and Engineering Leads to ensure solutions align with Fidelity's target architecture.
* Ensure AI-assisted software development complies with engineering standards, security policies and regulatory requirements.
* Promote sound software engineering principles including maintainability, scalability, resilience and observability.
* Implement controls for prompt injection, sensitive-data exposure, unsafe responses, hallucination, unauthorized tool use, and third-party model risk.
* Balance innovation with appropriate technology risk management and governance.
* Communicate technical decisions, risks, trade-offs, and delivery progress clearly to engineering, architecture, product, and business stakeholders.

  
  
**Stakeholder Engagement**  

* Build strong working relationships with Engineering Leads, Product Owners, Solution Architects and software engineering teams.
* Partner with investment technology stakeholders to understand engineering challenges and identify opportunities for AI-enabled improvement.
* Establish and support communities of practice around AI-assisted software engineering.
* Deliver demonstrations, technical workshops and knowledge-sharing sessions with senior investment professionals.
* Stay informed on emerging AI technologies and assess their applicability within Fidelity's engineering environment.

d9b10927.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud journeys and work backwards from their industry-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.  
  
As an Amazon Web Services (AWS) Solutions Architect within the Strategic Accounts segment you are responsible for partnering with our most valuable customers to design cloud architectures utilizing AWS services. You have technical depth, business aptitude, and the ability to lead in-depth technology discussions, articulating the business value of the AWS platform and services. Effective communication and interpersonal skills are required for engaging and influence Enterprise Architects, Technical Architects, Cloud Architects, Directors, VP’s and CXOs.  
  
You will be part of a culture of innovation where you’ll use AWS services to help our customers solve business challenges such as rapidly releasing products/services to the market or building an elastic, scalable, cost optimized application. Enable innovation through continuous deployment in DevOps, build highly scalable web & mobile applications with data store technologies.  
  
AWS services cover a wide range of technologies including operational security, infrastructure, DevOps, highly available software architectures, observability, machine learning and analytics. Our customer solutions usually involve many of these at once. AWS Solutions Architects are expected to have at least one technical areas of depth, but also need to be capable of leading discussions across most of these areas.  
  
Here at AWS, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have ten employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and we host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon diversity conferences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.  
  
Our team also puts a high value on work-life balance. Striking a healthy balance between your personal and professional life is crucial to your happiness and success here, which is why we aren’t focused on how many hours you spend at work or online. Instead, we’re happy to offer a flexible schedule so you can have a more productive and well-balanced life—both in and outside of work.  
  
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  
As a Solutions Architect, you will provide architectural and technical leadership to a portfolio of customers who are looking to leverage AWS services at scale. You will be the domain expert guiding architectural design decisions, while demonstrating customer obsession to ensure high availability and performance of the customers applications. You’ll have the opportunity to learn and be curious while evangelizing the latest innovations and best practices in infrastructure, engineering and application design. You will mentor peers and customers while growing your knowledge.  
  
As a core member of the account team, you will drive revenue growth across a specific customer. As a trusted customer advocate, you will help organizations understand and implement advanced cloud-based solutions, and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. You will have the opportunity to shape and execute a strategy to build knowledge and broad use of AWS. You will also need to be adept at interacting, communicating and partnering with other teams within AWS such as services teams, marketing, and professional services, as well as representing your team to executive management.
  
  
About the team  
The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud journeys and work backwards from their industry-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience

b3c4a708.title: SAP Treasury and Risk Management Consultant (Architect)
b3c4a708.description:
**Role Overview:**

As the Senior Capability Lead SAP Treasury and Risk Management (TRM), you will lead the end-to-end capability for SAP Treasury within a global services organization. This strategic role requires deep functional expertise in SAP S/4HANA Treasury and Cash Management, along with proven leadership in building competencies, driving solution innovation, and supporting complex digital finance transformations across industries.

You will work closely with clients CFO organizations to reimagine their Cash, Liquidity, Risk, and Bank Communication functions using SAP solutionsenabling real-time visibility, financial risk mitigation, and intelligent automation.

  
  

**Job Description:**

**Practice & Capability Leadership**

* Build and manage the global SAP TRM and Cash Management capability, including training, asset development, and certification roadmap.
* Establish solution blueprints, accelerators, and industry-specific templates for treasury transformations.
* Mentor consultants, architects, and solution leads; develop a scalable delivery model across regions.
* Ensure continuous upskilling in TRM functional areas and S/4HANA innovations (Embedded Analytics, Fiori, BTP, AI).

  

Functional Expertise in SAP TRM Areas You will own capability and delivery oversight across the following SAP TRM functional areas.

You will own capability and delivery oversight across the following SAP TRM functional areas:

**Core Treasury Modules (S/4HANA):**

* Cash and Liquidity Management
* Cash Positioning & Forecasting
* Liquidity Planning & Analysis
* Group-wide Cash Visibility
* Bank Account Management with workflows
* In-House Cash
* Centralized payments & receivables
* Intercompany Netting & Settlement
* Internal Banking Setup
* Bank Communication Management (BCM)
* Payment approval workflows
* Digital Signature Management
* Integration with SWIFT and multibank networks

**Financial Risk Management:**

* Transaction Manager
* FX, MM, Derivatives, Debt, Investments
* Deal capture, valuation, accruals, and settlements
* Market Risk Analyzer
* Market data integration (e.g., Reuters, Bloomberg)
* MTM, PV, Risk Metrics
* Credit Risk Analyzer
* Exposure Management & Limits Monitoring
* Hedge Management and Hedge Accounting (HMA)
* IFRS 9 / ASC 815 compliant
* Effectiveness testing and accounting

**Cash Management & Integration Areas:**

* Bank Statement Processing (MT940, BAI2)
* Payment Integration with AP/AR/FI-CA
* Integration with external banks, SWIFT Service Bureau, Payment Hubs
* Advanced Cash Pooling (Notional/Physical)
* Solutioning & Delivery Oversight
* Act as Solution Architect or Treasury Track Lead on large programs.
* Review solution designs and ensure alignment with best practices and industry standards.
* Govern project delivery across regions ensure quality, scope, and client satisfaction.

  

**Business Development & Thought Leadership**

* Lead response for RFPs, client presentations, and demonstrations focused on TRM & Cash Management.
* Collaborate with industry, sales, and SAP alliance teams for GTM planning.
* Represent the firm in SAP forums, Treasury Summits, and co-innovation events.

  

**Required Skills & Experience:**

* 15+ years total SAP experience, with 10+ years in SAP TRM and Cash Management.
* Experience with at least 3 end-to-end implementations in S/4HANA Treasury (on-premise or cloud).
* Deep understanding of Treasury operations, financial instruments, cash visibility needs, and risk frameworks.
* Strong configuration and process knowledge across all TRM areas listed above.
* Cross-functional exposure to SAP FI, FSCM, BTP, MDG-BP, and integration with third-party payment/banking platforms.

  

**Qualifications:**

* MBA (Finance) / Chartered Accountant / CFA / CTP
* SAP Certified in Treasury or S/4HANA Finance
* Experience with Central Finance, Shared Services Treasury, or AI-based treasury analytics
* Experience in regulated industries like Banking, FMCG, Manufacturing, or Life Sciences

  

**Travel Requirement:**

Willingness to travel (up to 40%) based on project and client location.

  

**What You Get:**

* Strategic role in a high-growth SAP practice with treasury transformation focus
* Opportunity to lead global programs for Fortune 500 clients
* Access to internal innovation platforms, SAP BTP, and AI-based treasury solutions
* Mentoring and growth opportunities across leadership tracks

Lead and deliver end-to-end SAP S/4HANA Finance implementations (Private and Public Cloud) for global clients. You will be responsible for solution design, configuration, integration, and deployment of core Finance processes, ensuring best practices and business value.

b81f5894.title: Solution Architect-Data Platforms
b81f5894.description:
**Introduction**
A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
As a Solution Architect specializing in Data Platforms, you design end-to-end Big Data Solutions across various platforms and manage large data repositories. You leverage expertise in industry standards, best practices, and leading technologies to create tailored data solutions for clients.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**

* Design End-to-End Solutions: Design comprehensive Big Data Solutions across multiple platforms, incorporating industry standards and best practices to meet client needs.
* Oversee Data Platform Architecture: Lead the development of architectures for data platform and cognitive components, including unstructured data technologies, annotation, and related data and analytics.
* Manage Large Data Repositories: Manage and maintain large data repositories, ensuring scalability and performance, and leveraging expertise in HADOOP Framework, Ecosystem, MapReduce, and Data on Containers.
* Develop Cloud-Based Solutions: Create data solutions using Cloud-native platforms such as AWS, Azure, Google, IBM Cloud, or Cloud-Native data platforms like Snowflake, tailored to client requirements.
* Deliver Client-Facing Solutions: Collaborate with clients to understand their needs and deliver customized data solutions that meet their business objectives.

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Data Platform Architecture: Experience with designing and overseeing architectures for data platform and cognitive components, including unstructured data technologies, annotation, and related data and analytics.
* Big Data Solution Design: Experience in designing comprehensive Big Data Solutions across multiple platforms, incorporating industry standards and best practices.
* Large Data Repository Management: Experience managing and maintaining large data repositories (terabyte scale or larger), ensuring scalability and performance.
* Cloud-Native Platform Expertise: Experience with Cloud-native platforms such as AWS, Azure, Google, IBM Cloud, or Cloud-Native data platforms like Snowflake.
* HADOOP Framework and Ecosystem: Experience with HADOOP Framework, Ecosystem, MapReduce, and Data on Containers (data in OpenShift).

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Cloud-Native Platform Knowledge: Experience with Cloud-native platforms such as AWS, Azure, Google, IBM Cloud, or Cloud-Native data platforms like Snowflake, with the ability to design and implement scalable data solutions.
* Unstructured Data Technologies: Experience with unstructured data technologies, annotation, and related data and analytics, with the ability to integrate these into comprehensive data solutions.
* Industry Standards and Best Practices: Experience with industry standards and best practices for data platform architecture and big data solution design, with the ability to apply these to meet client needs.

We are seeking a Senior Oracle Cloud HCM Consultant to drive the optimization, delivery, and scaling of our global HR technology platform. You will serve as the functional subject matter expert, translating complex HR, payroll, and talent strategies into seamless system configurations.

In this role, you will partner directly with HR leaders to streamline processes, manage critical module rollouts, and ensure our Oracle Human Capital Management infrastructure fully supports a modern, global workforce.

  

Key Responsibilities:

  

Module Configuration: Lead the functional design, system setup, and maintenance across core modules including Global Human Resources (Core HR), Benefits, Absence Management, and Talent Management.

Business Process Automation: Architect and configure complex HCM design structures, including enterprise/workforce components, position management, and automated approval workflows via BPM Worklist.

System Integrations: Collaborate with technical teams to build, test, and maintain robust data exchanges between Oracle HCM, internal payroll systems, and third party vendor platforms using HCM Extracts and HDL (HCM Data Loader).

Reporting & Analytics: Design and deliver executive dashboards, operational HR metrics, and compliance reporting using OTBI (Oracle Transactional Business Intelligence) and BI Publisher.

Release Management: Oversee the evaluation, testing, and deployment of Oracles quarterly cloud upgrades, identifying new features to enhance user experience and process efficiency.

Security & Compliance: Manage and audit HCM security profiles, custom role definitions, and data privacy controls to ensure strict alignment with global regulations (such as GDPR or HIPAA).

  

Required Qualifications & Skills Experience:

  

Minimum of 46 years of hands on experience implementing or managing Oracle Cloud HCM, including at least two full lifecycle global deployments.

Technical Tools: Advanced proficiency with HDL, HCM Extracts, Spreadsheet Data Loader (HSDL), and Fast Formulas.

Domain Knowledge: Deep understanding of core HR business processes, compensation structures, time tracking logic, and talent lifecycle management.

Reporting Mastery: Proven capability in building advanced, real time reports within OTBI and utilizing BI Publisher for scheduled, highly formatted document generation.

Communication: Exceptional consultative skills with a track record of translating complex human resources requirements into lean, logical system behaviors.

83bcc878.title: Senior Salesforce Developer - Service Cloud
83bcc878.description:
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Service Cloud Engineering**

* Design, build and maintain the case lifecycle: record types, case assignment, escalation, queues, milestones, entitlements and SLA enforcement.
* Build and tune Omni-Channel routing skills-based routing, capacity models, presence, and queue design — against real support workload patterns.
* Develop Lightning Web Components and Apex to streamline the agent console: custom quick actions, guided flows, related-record panels, and macros that remove clicks from high-volume work.
* Configure and extend intake channels: Email-to-Case, Web-to-Case, Experience Cloud customer portal, chat/messaging, and in-product case creation.
* Build and maintain Knowledge: article types, approval and publishing workflows, data categories, article recommendations, and attach-to-case behaviour.
* Implement CSAT/NPS survey capture and feed the results back into reporting and coaching workflows.

**AI and Automation**

* Build Agentforce service agents for case deflection, summarisation, and assisted resolution, including topic and action design, grounding in Knowledge and Data Cloud, and testing against real case history.
* Implement Einstein capabilities such as case classification, article recommendations, reply recommendations, and work summaries.
* Design the guardrails: escalation to a human, confidence thresholds, audit logging, and measurement of whether the automation actually helped.
* Automate repetitive support operations work with Flow, Apex, and scheduled jobs.

**Integrations**

* Integrate Service Cloud with telephony/CTI (Amazon Connect, Genesys, Five9 or similar), engineering issue trackers (Jira or Azure DevOps), ERP and entitlement sources, and the data warehouse.
* Build and maintain API-based integrations using REST/SOAP, Platform Events, Change Data Capture, and middleware such as MuleSoft.
* Own error handling, retry logic, and reconciliation so that failed integrations are visible and recoverable rather than silent.

**Quality and Operations**

* Write unit tests with meaningful assertions and maintain coverage well above the platform minimum.
* Participate in code review both as author and reviewer, and mentor junior developers on the team.
* Support production incidents affecting the support organisation, perform root-cause analysis, and prevent recurrence.
* Deploy through a Git-based CI/CD pipeline and keep metadata under source control.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* **Experience:** 5–9 years in software development, including at least 4 years building on Salesforce with substantial Service Cloud work.
* **Service Cloud depth:** Hands-on with case management, Omni-Channel routing, entitlements and milestones, Knowledge, the Service Console, and at least two intake channels in production.
* **Apex:** Strong Apex — trigger frameworks, asynchronous processing, bulkification, governor limits, and SOQL optimisation for large data volumes.
* **LWC:** Production Lightning Web Component development with modern JavaScript, including Apex wiring, events, and console-specific APIs.
* **Declarative craft:** Strong Flow skills and good judgement about when a Flow is the right answer and when it is not.
* **Integration:** Experience building API integrations with authentication patterns (OAuth 2.0, JWT, Named Credentials) and robust error handling.
* **DevOps:** Salesforce DX, Git, and deployment through a CI/CD pipeline.
* **Communication:** Comfortable gathering requirements directly from support managers and agents, and pushing back with a better option when the requested solution is the wrong one.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Production experience with Agentforce, Einstein for Service, or Data Cloud.
* CTI/telephony integration experience.
* Salesforce Field Service experience.
* Experience Cloud customer or partner portal development.
* Experience supporting an internal support organisation in a SaaS or software company.
* Familiarity with support metrics — first response time, time to resolution, deflection rate, CSAT — and how platform design moves them.

**CERTIFICATIONS**

* **Required:** Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I.
* **Strongly preferred:** Salesforce Certified Service Cloud Consultant.
* **Valued:** Platform Developer II, Agentforce Specialist, Agentforce Service Consultant, JavaScript Developer I, or Platform Administrator.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

* **By 60 days:** You understand our case lifecycle and routing model end to end and have shipped your first production changes.
* **By 6 months:** You own a meaningful area of the Service Cloud platform outright, have delivered at least one measurable improvement to agent efficiency or customer response time, and support operations comes to you directly.
* **By 12 months:** Agentforce or Einstein capability you built is live, measured, and demonstrably deflecting or accelerating case work.

d5612e2b.title: Service Delivery Manager – GAM & CSM
d5612e2b.description:
·       
**Service ownership:**
Own overall operational service performance and user experience across GAM and CSM within their respective agreed scope, service levels and support guidelines. Maintain clear responsibilities, workflows, priorities and escalation paths for each team.

·       
**GAM tiered operations:**
Coordinate daily activities across L1, L2 and L3. Ensure L1 handles standard access requests, identity checks and Joiner/Mover/Leaver processes; L2 resolves escalated and complex requests, supports access reviews and maintains runbooks; and L3 provides expert escalation support, root cause analysis, governance, automation definition and knowledge ownership.

·       
**CSM managed-service delivery:**
Oversee delivery against the agreed service model and customer commitments. Maintain visibility of service scope, deliverables, dependencies, risks and outstanding actions, with clear ownership and follow-through rather than assuming GAM’s tiered structure applies to CSM.

·       
**Service levels and reporting:**
Monitor SLA compliance, customer satisfaction, service consistency, workload and ageing. Use separate views for GAM and CSM so differences in demand, delivery commitments and outcomes remain visible; agree measures and targets appropriate to each service.

·       
**Escalations and service recovery:**
Lead operational escalation coordination, prioritisation and stakeholder communications. Ensure critical issues have clear resolution owners and that recurring incidents lead to root cause investigation and corrective actions.

·       
**Demand, capacity and supplier coordination:**
Oversee workload distribution, resource coverage and capacity planning with team leads and L3 engineers. Balance daily operations with improvement work and planned demand, escalating resource constraints and delivery risks. Provide resource and cost forecasts to support planning, and coordinate supplier dependencies within agreed responsibilities and delegated authority.

·       
**Process and knowledge management:**
Maintain consistent incident, request, problem, change and knowledge management practices. Ensure teams use current procedures, runbooks and knowledge articles, while preserving workflows appropriate to each service model.

·       
**Governance and compliance:**
Ensure operational activities follow access policies, controls and audit requirements. Coordinate evidence collection, access governance activities, risk assessments and remediation tracking with the responsible teams.

·       
**Stakeholder and customer engagement:**
Act as the operational point of contact for business stakeholders and service customers. Lead regular service reviews covering performance, risks, escalations, customer feedback and improvement actions for GAM and CSM.

·       
**Automation roadmap and prioritisation:**
Own the operational automation backlog across GAM and CSM within their respective agreed scopes. Identify opportunities in recurring access requests, Joiner/Mover/Leaver activities, request routing, reporting and evidence collection. Prioritise opportunities using workload, manual effort, error patterns, customer impact, risk and feasibility. Define business requirements, expected benefits and acceptance criteria with service stakeholders, and coordinate delivery with L3 engineers and automation or platform owners. Lead operational acceptance and adoption, with technical design and implementation owned by the relevant technical teams.

·       
**Continual improvement:**
Drive Lean improvements, standardisation and reduction of process variability. Prioritise opportunities to reduce manual work, repeat incidents and unnecessary escalations, coordinating automation delivery with technical owners.

·       
**Team development:**
Support training, coaching, mentoring and knowledge transfer across both teams. Work with GAM L3 engineers to strengthen L1/L2 capability and ensure CSM has the knowledge and coverage needed for its managed-service commitments.

·       
**Operational handovers:**
Coordinate with application, product, project and technical teams so new or changed services have clear support ownership, documented procedures, knowledge transfer and capacity considerations before operational handover.

**Required Qualifications**

·       Experience leading service delivery, IT operations or infrastructure support, demonstrated through responsibility for service levels, incident and change coordination, and cross-functional delivery. Ability to oversee both multi-level support teams and managed-service delivery, with clear accountability for each service model.

·       Ability to lead and develop teams, coordinate workloads and capacity, and establish clear operational ownership across different service models.

·       Good understanding of ITIL-aligned incident, request, problem, change, knowledge and continual service improvement practices.

·       Understanding of access management operations, including Joiner/Mover/Leaver processes, provisioning and deprovisioning, escalation paths, access governance and audit requirements.

·       Ability to manage service levels, analyse operational reporting and customer feedback, and translate findings into practical improvement actions.

·       Strong stakeholder communication, customer engagement and escalation management skills, including leading service reviews and coordinating issue resolution.

·       Experience with process standardisation and continuous improvement, supported by strong organisational, analytical and mentoring skills.

·       Advanced or fluent English and the ability to communicate clearly with business and technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

·       ITIL certification and Lean certification or practical Lean improvement experience.

·       Experience leading geographically distributed support teams, coordinating cross-regional handovers and maintaining consistent processes. Experience overseeing access management within a Lean, global support structure, including follow-the-sun delivery, is an advantage.

·       Experience managing customer-facing managed services, including scope boundaries, service commitments, reporting and service improvement plans.

·       Familiarity with ServiceNow or comparable ticketing and workflow systems, reporting dashboards, knowledge management and collaboration tools.

·       Familiarity with SAP authorisations, identity management platforms and opportunities to automate recurring access management activities.

18a47296.title: Service Delivery Manager
18a47296.description:
About the Role

The Service Delivery Manager (SDM) – Cloud Management & Operations Platform is responsible for overseeing the end-to-end operational support, customer satisfaction, and service reliability for an enterprise multi-tenant cloud management platform. In this leadership role, you manage a tiered operational organization comprising L1 (Incident Monitoring & Triage), L2 (Platform & Agentic Operations), and L3 (SRE & Core Platform Escalations) teams. You will act as the primary operational liaison between external enterprise customers and internal engineering organizations. You will own Service Level Agreements (SLAs/SLOs), drive major incident governance, lead post-incident reviews (RCAs), optimize support workflows, and spearhead continuous operational improvements to minimize customer downtime and maximize adoption of the cloud management platform.

Responsibilities

* Tiered Team Leadership & Resource Management: Direct, mentor, and allocate resources across 24/7/365 L1, L2, and L3 support teams. Define shift coverage, on-call rotations, escalation matrices, and technical career progression pathways for support engineers.
* SLA/SLO Ownership & Service Governance: Accountable for meeting contractual Service Level Agreements (MTTA, MTTR, availability targets) across all customer accounts. Maintain live service health dashboards and deliver periodic operational reviews (QBRs/MBRs) to customer leadership.
* Major Incident Management (MIM): Act as the executive incident commander during Critical/P1 outages impacting customer cloud environments or platform availability. Direct the cross-functional resolution bridge, manage external crisis communications, and eliminate operational bottlenecks.
* Problem Management & RCA Delivery: Partner with L3 engineers, SREs, and product engineering to lead Root Cause Analyses (RCAs) following outages. Track post-incident corrective and preventative action items (CAPAs) to ensure systemic platform vulnerabilities are resolved.
* Operational Shift-Left & Automation: Drive "shift-left" operational strategies—empowering L1 teams to resolve recurring issues through automated runbooks developed by L2/L3 engineers, thereby reducing MTTR and tier-escalation volume.
* Customer Relationship & Escalation Handling: Serve as the designated operational escalation contact for enterprise customer stakeholders. Manage client friction, track recurring customer pain points, and translate operational findings into feature requests for the product roadmap.
* Vendor & Tooling Operations: Oversee support tools and platforms, including ITSM systems (ServiceNow, Jira Service Management), paging systems (PagerDuty, Opsgenie), and client-facing status portals.

Requirements

* Experience: 7–12 years in IT service management, technical support leadership, or cloud infrastructure operations, with at least 3+ years directly managing multi-tiered technical teams (L1/L2/L3) in a B2B SaaS, Managed Service Provider (MSP), or Cloud Platform setting.
* ITSM & Framework Expertise: Deep practical knowledge of ITIL processes (Incident, Problem, Change, and Release Management), with demonstrated experience tailoring frameworks to agile cloud environments.
* Cloud & Platform Technical Acumen: Broad understanding of cloud infrastructure concepts (AWS, Azure, or GCP), container platforms (Kubernetes, Docker), and cloud operational paradigms (monitoring, log ingestion, and API-based integrations).
* Incident & Crisis Leadership: Proven track record acting as Incident Commander or escalation manager during complex, high-impact enterprise production outages.
* Metrics & Analytics Driven: Strong ability to track, analyze, and present operational KPIs (Ticket Volume, First-Contact Resolution, SLA Breaches, MTTA/MTTR trends, CSAT) using reporting tools (Power BI, Tableau, Jira dashboards).
* Communication & Executive Presence: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to articulate technical failures and remediation steps clearly to C-level client executives and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to Have

* Certifications: ITIL v4 Foundation / Managing Professional, PMP (Project Management Professional), or Certified Scrum Master (CSM).
* Cloud Certifications: Foundational cloud certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner / Solutions Architect Associate, Azure Fundamentals AZ-900).
* DevOps & SRE Alignment: Experience transitioning traditional ITSM support structures toward modern Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices and error budget management.
* Tooling Proficiency: Deep administrative experience configuring workflows, SLAs, and routing rules inside ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, or Zendesk.
* FinOps/Contract Knowledge: Exposure to cloud economics, consumption models, and managing operational support profitability (P&L tracking, statement of work commitments).

Pay: ₹1,079,000.00 - ₹2,230,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* Do you have experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP?
* Do you have Experience in SLA/SLO Management & Operational KPI Reporting

Experience:

* IT service management: 8 years (Required)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu

Position Summary
  
  
The Retail Technology Delivery Lead is responsible for leading and coordinating offshore delivery activities, while building, nurturing and coaching Bridgestone’s Retail Technology offshore teams. Thiss role serves as the primary delivery lead for a portfolio of retail applications and platforms, partnering closely with North American business stakeholders, Product Managers, Product Owners, Architects, and technical teams to ensure successful execution of strategic initiatives and operational support. The position oversees offshore resources including developers, testers, integration specialists, reporting analysts, and Scrum Masters while ensuring quality delivery, platform stability, and continuous improvement.
  
  
This position requires a strong combination of technical understanding, Agile delivery leadership, stakeholder management, and experience working across global teams in a fast-paced retail technology environment.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Culture & People Leadership: Build and sustain a high-performing, inclusive, and accountable team culture across global and offshore delivery organizations.
* Lead end-to-end offshore delivery for retail technology projects, enhancements, and support initiatives.
* Coordinate and manage day-to-day activities across development, testing, integration, reporting, and support teams to ensure successful execution of delivery commitments.
* Facilitate Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily standups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Monitor project progress, sprint outcomes, resource utilization, and delivery milestones while proactively identifying and resolving risks and impediments.

* Support solution design discussions and collaborate with architects and technical leads to ensure alignment with enterprise standards and best practices.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on delivery efficiency, quality, team productivity, and business process optimization.
* Foster strong collaboration between offshore and onshore teams while promoting accountability, transparency, and operational excellence.

**Required Qualifications**

* Demonstrated experience delivering large-scale technology initiatives involving software development, integration, testing, and production support.
* Strong understanding of Agile and Scrum delivery methodologies.
* Experience working directly with US-based stakeholders and managing cross-functional global teams.

* Experience working with quality assurance, test automation, and release management processes.

* Experience using Agile project management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or equivalent.

* Scrum Master, SAFe Agilist, PMP, or related Agile certification.
* Experience managing vendor-delivered services and offshore delivery models.
* Exposure to omnichannel retail, eCommerce, POS, inventory management, or customer engagement platforms.
